A short, memorable phrase used to promote an idea, product, organization, or movement. Used in advertising, politics, education, and workplace campaigns.
Physically straight or unblended. Used for hair (straight hair), drinks (undiluted), and fastball pitches in baseball.
Expressing feelings or opinions directly without beating around the bush. Describes a straightforward communication style.

A visible or audible response to something, especially an expressive or animated reaction. In Japanese, particularly associated with exaggerated physical responses seen in comedy and variety TV shows.
Something that does not move or cannot be moved. Used both literally (not moving physically) and figuratively (firm, unwavering, established beyond doubt).
The act of giving concrete, tangible form to an abstract idea, value, or quality. Often used to describe a person or thing that perfectly represents an abstract concept.

glosses: to create; to produce; to generate
to create; to produce; to bring into being
to generate; to give rise to; to create (an atmosphere, situation)
explanations: To make something new that did not exist before. Emphasizes the creative act of bringing something into existence from nothing or from raw materials.
To cause a condition, atmosphere, or situation to come about. Used for abstract things like moods, environments, and opportunities.
A factual occurrence or observable event. Used in formal, academic, or technical contexts to describe something that has happened or been observed. More objective and analytical than {出来事|できごと}.
To come into possession of something, especially something that required effort or was difficult to find. Often implies that the item was not easily available.

glosses: full effort, all one's strength, utmost power
explanations: Putting everything one has into an action. Used for both physical exertion and mental or emotional commitment.
The complete elimination or destruction of a group. Used literally for military contexts and figuratively in everyday speech and gaming for situations where everyone or everything is wiped out.
A performance or show presented to the public, typically in a theater or concert hall. Used for plays, musicals, concerts, ballet, and other staged performances.
To officially announce or disclose information to the public. Implies a deliberate act of releasing information that was previously private or restricted.
Formal recognition or approval by an authority, organization, or institution. Often used for officially sanctioned candidates, certified products, or publicly acknowledged relationships.
The act of bathing, especially soaking in a bathtub or hot spring. More formal than お{風呂|ふろ}に{入|はい}る, often used in written instructions, medical contexts, and facility signage.

glosses: becoming a disciple, entering a school
explanations: An introductory-level resource or course for learning something new. Commonly used in book titles and course names.
Formally becoming a student or disciple under a master, especially in traditional arts, martial arts, or crafts.
The period when someone or something is at the height of their power, popularity, or success. Used for people, organizations, cultures, and industries.
The craft of making or altering clothing, or the quality/style of how a garment is made.
The way something is prepared, arranged, or presented. Used for how things are organized or made to appear.
A person who accompanies someone to provide care, assistance, or supervision. Often used in medical, caregiving, and child-related contexts.
A grammatical term for a word that takes the place of a noun, such as これ, それ, {彼|かれ}, {私|わたし}.
Something so closely associated with a quality or concept that it serves as a representative example. Used figuratively to mean "the very definition of" something.

glosses: banquet-style Japanese cuisine, formal multi-course dinner
explanations: A style of Japanese cuisine served as a sequence of courses at banquets, parties, or upscale restaurants. Emphasizes seasonal ingredients, beautiful presentation, and the social aspect of dining together.
To adopt or embrace something before others do, or to act in advance of a trend or development. Often used for fashion, trends, and seasonal themes.

glosses: to get into, to slip into
to get into, to slip into, to enter deeply
to become deeply involved, to be absorbed in
explanations: To go deep into a place, often suggesting entering somewhere that is enclosed, hidden, or not easily accessible.
To become immersed in or deeply engaged with something such as a story, role, or activity.

glosses: to accomplish, to fulfill, to carry out completely
explanations: To see something through to the end, especially a duty, responsibility, or role. Implies completing something fully and properly.
Relating to or provided for the general public or community. Used as a modifier before nouns to indicate that something is publicly owned, operated, or intended for common use.

glosses: campaign promise, public pledge, manifesto commitment
explanations: A promise or commitment made publicly, especially by a politician or political party during an election campaign. Can also refer to any formal pledge made to the public.
Differences or variations between individuals. Commonly used when noting that results, effects, or experiences may vary from person to person.

glosses: completion of a course, finishing a program
explanations: Successfully completing all requirements of an academic course, training program, or curriculum. Distinct from graduation ({卒業|そつぎょう}), which applies to completing an entire degree program.
Trust or confidence placed in a person, especially in a political or organizational context. Often refers to the formal trust bestowed upon a leader, diplomat, or official.
The maintenance of safety and security, especially in public facilities, transportation, and workplaces. Often refers to the systems and personnel responsible for keeping places safe.

glosses: inaugural year, dawn of a new era
explanations: The first year of a Japanese era ({年号|ねんごう}). Each time a new emperor ascends the throne, a new era begins and that year is called {元年|がんねん}.
Used figuratively to mark the year when something new begins or a major shift occurs, such as a technological breakthrough or cultural movement.

glosses: full picture, whole story, complete picture
explanations: The entirety of something, especially the complete truth or scope of a situation. Often used when details have been unclear and the full extent is finally revealed or still remains unknown.
The people in general, especially when considered as a group that uses shared facilities or services. Almost always used as a modifier before another noun.
Caused or created by human action rather than by natural processes. Often implies that something was deliberately done or is the result of human intervention.
Relating to or concerned with the welfare and dignity of human beings. Used especially in international affairs, disaster relief, and human rights contexts.
Considering something as a whole rather than focusing on individual parts. Used when making general assessments or describing broad tendencies.

glosses: to go through, to use as an intermediary
explanations: To use something or someone as a means, channel, or intermediary. Almost always appears in the pattern 〜を{介|かい}して (through ~, via ~).
To be bothered by or concerned about something. Used in the negative pattern {意|い}に{介|かい}さない (not to care, not to be bothered).

glosses: release to the public, opening, disclosure
explanations: Making something available or accessible to the general public. Used for releasing films, opening facilities, disclosing information, or publishing content.

glosses: sharing, joint ownership, having in common
explanations: Possessing or using something together with others. Covers both physical joint ownership (property, resources) and abstract sharing (information, values, experiences).
Meeting someone again after a period of separation. Carries an emotional nuance of being reunited with someone missed.

glosses: to serve as both, to double as
to serve as both, to combine roles
to be unable to, to find it hard to
explanations: To fulfill two functions or roles simultaneously. The subject takes on a dual purpose.
Used as a suffix after the stem of another verb (Vます + かねる) to express inability or reluctance to do something, often due to moral hesitation or difficulty. More formal than できない.

glosses: inwardly, in one's heart, one's true feelings
explanations: What one truly feels or thinks inside, especially when those feelings differ from what is outwardly expressed. Used both as a noun (one's inner thoughts) and as an adverb (inwardly, secretly).

glosses: winning a prize, placing (in a competition)
winning a prize, placing in a competition
explanations: Finishing in a prize-winning position in a contest, competition, or tournament. Does not necessarily mean first place — any placement that earns a prize or recognition counts.
Becoming a member of a club, organization, association, or similar group. Refers to the act of formally signing up.
The entire content of a written document, speech, law, or other text, as opposed to a summary or excerpt.
The entirety of the United States. Almost always used as a modifier before another noun. 米 is the kanji abbreviation for アメリカ (America).
A round or circular shape. Often used as a modifier to describe something that is circular in form.
Existing side by side, especially in cases where the two things might otherwise be in conflict. Used for people, cultures, species, and abstract concepts like old and new.
Appearing or performing together in a film, drama, concert, or other performance. Used for actors, musicians, and other performers.
A document created or maintained by a government body or public institution in the course of its official duties. Has legal significance and is subject to records management laws.
A language designated for use in government, law, and official business of a country or region. A country may have one or multiple official languages.
Instruments or devices used in warfare. Covers a broad range from conventional arms to weapons of mass destruction. A formal, military-oriented term.
A person who serves in an army. A neutral, general term for military personnel, especially rank-and-file soldiers rather than officers.
The point where something is attached to or joins a larger body. Most commonly used for body parts (where a limb meets the torso) but also for plants and other objects.

glosses: introduction from abroad, transmission across regions
explanations: The historical introduction or transmission of culture, technology, religion, or goods from one country or region to another. Often used in the context of things brought to Japan from the Asian continent or Europe.
Something passed down within a family or lineage over generations. Used as a modifier meaning 'ancestral' or 'hereditary.'
Used to question or express uncertainty about someone's identity, background, or nature. Often carries a sense of suspicion, awe, or mystery about the person in question.
People who originally inhabited a land before colonization or settlement by others. The standard modern term used in academic, political, and news contexts.

glosses: joining a club, entering a school club
explanations: Becoming a member of a club activity (部活動) at school, typically in middle school or high school. A fundamental part of Japanese school life.

glosses: being selected, being accepted for exhibition or publication
explanations: Having one's work selected for display, exhibition, or inclusion in a competition. Commonly used for art exhibitions, photography contests, literary competitions, and similar juried selections.
Participation in a crime together with another person. Can refer to the act of being complicit or to the person who is an accomplice.
Living together in a mutually beneficial or interdependent relationship. Used in biology for symbiosis between species, and in social contexts for harmonious coexistence between different groups.

glosses: inner feelings, inner self, psychological interior
explanations: A person's inner thoughts, emotions, and psychological state, as opposed to their outward appearance or behavior.
The interior surface or inside of a physical object.

glosses: once more, again, a second time
explanations: Doing something one more time. More formal than もう一度 or また, often used in written language, announcements, and formal speech.

glosses: wabi-sabi, aesthetic of imperfection and transience
explanations: A traditional Japanese aesthetic concept that finds beauty in imperfection, impermanence, and incompleteness. Rooted in Zen Buddhism, it values simplicity, rustic elegance, and the natural aging of materials.
The operation or functioning of a machine, device, or mechanism. Refers to whether something is running or how it operates, rather than operating it manually.

glosses: being attached to, adjoining, having an annexed facility
explanations: Setting up or having an additional facility alongside or within an existing one. Describes the relationship where a secondary facility operates together with a main one.
A person or group sent on a diplomatic or official mission to represent their country or organization. Also refers to the mission itself.

glosses: nowadays, these days, the present day
explanations: A formal or literary way to say 'today.' More elevated in register than きょう, used in speeches, writing, and set phrases.
Refers to the current era or modern times. Commonly used to discuss contemporary society, trends, or conditions.
The act of finding and recruiting talented people, especially for sports teams, entertainment, or business. Also refers to the person who does the recruiting.
A step-by-step guide or introductory lesson, especially in software, games, or online learning. Used broadly for any guided instruction format.
An attempt or effort to do something, often with a positive nuance of taking on a challenge. Used as a suru verb to mean 'to give something a try.'
In rugby, scoring by touching the ball down in the opponent's in-goal area.
The outer wrapping or container of a product. Also refers to the visual design of product packaging.
A set of items or services sold or offered together as a single unit, such as a travel package or software package.
The act of selecting or highlighting specific items, people, or topics from a larger group. Commonly used in media, marketing, and recommendations.
Going to pick up or collect a person, especially by car. Also used for pickup trucks.
A genre of fiction involving magic, mythical creatures, and imaginary worlds. Also refers to works in this genre.
An unrealistic or fanciful idea or mental image, often implying wishful thinking.
Physical health and the activities done to maintain or improve it. Often refers specifically to gym-based exercise and wellness programs.
A large organized event, typically involving music, arts, food, or cultural activities. Often used for Western-style or modern festivals rather than traditional Japanese ones.

glosses: plate, flat piece of metal or material
explanations: A flat dish for serving food. In Japanese, プレート tends to refer to flat, Western-style plates rather than Japanese-style dishes.
A flat, rigid piece of metal or other material used for various purposes, including nameplates, license plates, and tectonic plates.
Widely known, accepted, or enjoyed by the general public. Used to describe things that have broad appeal, such as music, sports, or products.

glosses: reality, realism, sense of being real
explanations: A sense of realism, believability, or vividness. Often used to describe whether fiction, art, or an experience feels authentic or true to life.
Used as a modifier for entertainment formats based on real-life situations, particularly reality television shows.
Having progressive or open-minded views, particularly regarding politics, society, or personal values. Also used as a noun to refer to a person or group with such views.
A system that uses radio waves to detect the position, distance, and speed of objects. Used in aviation, meteorology, maritime navigation, and speed enforcement.
Something wound into a cylindrical shape, or a small rounded piece of bread. Also used for rolling actions.
A part played by someone in a particular situation or activity. Used in gaming, business, and organizational contexts.

glosses: lower rank, lower position, subordinate level
explanations: A position or rank that is below another in a hierarchy, classification, or ordering system. Used for rankings, categories, and organizational structures.
The state of not dying or being unable to die. Used in mythology, fantasy, religion, and figurative expressions about things that endure.

A lord to whom a vassal or retainer owes loyalty and service. Primarily a historical term from feudal Japan, frequently encountered in period dramas, historical fiction, and discussions of samurai culture.

glosses: friendship, social relations, association with friends
explanations: The act or state of associating with friends and acquaintances. Often used to describe the scope or nature of someone's social connections.
Physical power or effort provided by people rather than machines. Refers to tasks accomplished through human effort alone.
A man-made object placed in orbit around the Earth or another celestial body, used for communication, observation, navigation, and scientific research.
Additional value created through processing, service, or enhancement. Used in business and economics for the extra worth added to a product or service beyond its raw cost.

glosses: to substitute, to replace with, to use in place of
explanations: To use one thing in place of another. The focus is on providing a substitute or alternative for something.

glosses: to take the place of, to be substituted
to take the place of, to replace, to substitute for
explanations: For one thing or person to serve in place of another. The subject takes over the role or function of something else.

glosses: inn waitress, ryokan attendant, traditional restaurant server
explanations: A female attendant at a traditional Japanese inn (ryokan) or traditional restaurant (ryoutei) who serves food, prepares rooms, and attends to guests. Typically wears a kimono.

glosses: counter for cases, incidents, or items
explanations: A specific matter, topic, or incident under discussion or consideration. Often used to refer back to something previously mentioned.
A counter used for incidents, cases, complaints, applications, and similar discrete items or occurrences.

A rank of nobility, third in the five-rank peerage system. Equivalent to 'count' in continental European nobility or 'earl' in British peerage. Also used in the former Japanese peerage system (kazoku) established in 1884.

glosses: colloquial name, popular name, common name, nickname
explanations: An informal or commonly used name for something, as opposed to its official or formal designation. Used for places, laws, phenomena, and other things that have both formal and informal names.
The body of a deceased person. A literary and respectful term, more elevated in register than 死体. Often used when treating the deceased with dignity.
The act of engaging in armed conflict or battle. A formal term used in military, legal, and historical contexts.
The very beginning or opening part of a speech, text, story, or event. Emphasizes the first portion rather than a point in time.

glosses: exhibiting, displaying (at an exhibition or show)
listing for sale, putting up for auction
explanations: Submitting or displaying an item at an exhibition, trade show, or contest.
Putting an item up for sale, especially on an online marketplace or at an auction.

glosses: to get very cold, to drop sharply
to get bitterly cold, to have the temperature drop sharply
to cool down, to worsen (of a relationship, economy, etc.)
explanations: For the air or weather to become intensely cold, especially in the morning or at night.
For a relationship, the economy, or a situation to deteriorate or become strained, used figuratively.

glosses: to tease, to make fun of; to window-shop
to tease, to make fun of, to jeer at
to window-shop, to browse without buying
explanations: To mock or ridicule someone in a playful or slightly malicious way, often by making comments about their behavior or situation.
To look at goods in a shop or stall without intending to purchase anything.
Physically cool or chilly to the touch or in temperature.
Showing a cold, detached, or unsympathetic attitude toward someone or something.
The process of preserving food or other items by freezing them, or the state of being frozen.
Keeping food or other items at a cool temperature (above freezing) to preserve freshness.

glosses: appearing, performing (in a show, film, or on stage)
explanations: The act of appearing or performing in a movie, TV show, play, concert, or other public performance.

glosses: one's turn to appear or perform, cue
explanations: The scheduled or expected time for someone to go on stage, take action, or play their part. Also used figuratively for the moment when something is needed or called upon.
The act of giving birth to a child. Used for both the mother's experience and as a general term for the event.
The flow of blood from a wound or internal injury. Also used figuratively to mean a significant financial loss.

glosses: to appear on the market, to circulate
to appear on the market, to be widely available, to circulate
explanations: For goods, products, or information to become widely available or to spread through circulation.
Describes something felt deeply and urgently, or a problem or need that is pressing and real rather than abstract.
With deep sincerity and urgency. Used to express heartfelt wishes, prayers, or requests.

glosses: archipelago, island chain, chain of islands
explanations: A group of islands arranged in a line or arc. Most commonly used to refer to Japan as an island chain.

glosses: early summer, the beginning of summer
explanations: The period at the start of summer, typically May to early June in Japan, when the weather begins to warm noticeably.
The first day of an event, performance run, tournament, or period. Often refers to the opening day of a show or competition.

glosses: early period, initial stage, beginning phase
explanations: The first or early phase of a process, era, illness, or development. Emphasizes the stage rather than the exact starting point.

glosses: reorganization, restructuring, getting back on one's feet
explanations: Rebuilding a physical structure such as a building or temple that has been destroyed or damaged.
Rebuilding or restructuring something abstract such as a business, finances, or one's life after a setback.
Thinking about something again, especially a decision, plan, or policy, with a view to possibly changing it.
The act of dividing something into separate parts or sections. Used for physical objects, payments, data, and abstract concepts.
The act of dividing and distributing something among multiple recipients, such as profits, resources, or tasks.
A group, organization, or opinion breaking apart into opposing factions. Implies conflict or disagreement.
The splitting of cells or atomic nuclei in scientific contexts.
A group of people or nations bound together by shared interests, location, or purpose. Used for both small local communities and large international organizations.

glosses: civil war, internal strife, rebellion, uprising
explanations: Armed conflict or violent unrest within a country, as opposed to war between nations.

glosses: to possess both, to combine qualities
to possess both qualities, to combine, to have together
explanations: To have two or more qualities, abilities, or characteristics at the same time. Implies that having both together is impressive or noteworthy.

glosses: calm, lull, stillness (of wind and sea)
explanations: A state where the wind dies down and the sea becomes calm and still. Also used figuratively for a period of quiet or pause.
A general term for any tool with a cutting edge, including knives, scissors, razors, and swords.

glosses: fork in the road, branching path
explanations: A point where a road splits into two or more directions. Also used figuratively for a critical turning point or decision.

glosses: with dignity, in a stately manner
with dignity, in a stately and composed manner
explanations: Describes someone who carries themselves with an air of dignity, poise, and inner strength. Can also describe a crisp, bracing quality in the air.
The winter period, often used in formal or institutional contexts such as sports seasons, academic terms, or official schedules.

The day with the shortest period of daylight and the longest night of the year, occurring around December 21-22 in the Northern Hemisphere. In Japan, it is traditionally associated with eating kabocha squash and taking yuzu baths.
The carrying out of a death sentence. Used in legal, historical, and journalistic contexts.
The act of appearing or coming into existence. Used for phenomena, creatures, people, or things that appear on the scene, often with a sense of something notable or unexpected.

glosses: to freeze solid, to be frozen stiff
to freeze solid, to freeze over
to freeze up, to be paralyzed with fear or shock
explanations: For something to freeze completely and become stuck or solid due to cold.
To become unable to move or react due to fear, shock, or terror. A figurative extension of the physical meaning.
The discovery of artifacts, remains, or other items through archaeological excavation. Describes the act of something being dug up from the ground.

glosses: entering the priesthood, becoming a monk or nun
explanations: The act of leaving secular life to enter religious orders, particularly in Buddhism. Can also refer to a person who has done so.

glosses: to be all present, to be complete
to be all present, to be complete, to all come together
explanations: For all expected members, items, or elements to have arrived or appeared. Implies that the full set is now assembled.
The quality or outcome of something that has been made or done. Refers to how well something turned out.
The act of a ship leaving a harbor or port. Used in maritime, travel, and news contexts.
A company that produces and distributes books, magazines, or other printed materials.
The event of being born. Used primarily in official, demographic, and statistical contexts rather than everyday conversation.

glosses: to share, to divide among each other
explanations: To divide something and distribute it among multiple people so that everyone gets a portion. Implies mutual sharing.

glosses: minute by minute, by the minute
minute by minute, by the minute, down to the minute
explanations: A schedule or pace measured in minute-level increments. Describes an extremely tight or precisely timed schedule.

glosses: molecule; numerator; member of a group
explanations: The smallest unit of a chemical compound that retains its chemical properties. A scientific term used in chemistry and biology.
The number above the line in a fraction.
A person who belongs to a particular group, often used with a negative connotation to describe troublesome or dangerous members.
The point where something splits into two or more paths, directions, or outcomes. Used for physical paths, decisions, and abstract concepts.
The act of dividing work, costs, or responsibilities among multiple people or groups so that each bears a portion.
The act of cutting or splitting something into separate parts, often implying a forceful or harmful separation. Used for physical division as well as social or political fragmentation.
The act of separating or being separated from something. Used in scientific, political, medical, and general contexts.

glosses: to cut into pieces, to carve up
to cut into pieces, to carve up, to slice and divide
explanations: To cut something into portions for distribution or serving. Often used for food but also applicable to abstract concepts like isolating problems.

A form of ritualized suicide practiced by samurai in feudal Japan, performed by cutting open the abdomen with a short blade. It was carried out as a form of atonement, to preserve honor, or as a form of capital punishment.
The powerful nations of the world, especially in a historical context referring to the dominant imperial or military powers.
The act of listing items one by one. Used when presenting a series of examples, reasons, or items in a systematic way.

glosses: first generation, founder, first (in a line)
explanations: The first person in a succession or lineage, such as the first leader, first head of a family business, or the original version of something.
The salary received at the beginning of one's employment, or specifically the first paycheck a new employee receives.

glosses: first time, first round, first inning
explanations: The first occurrence or round of something in a series. Commonly used for the first episode, first session, or first inning in sports.
The most basic level of skill, knowledge, or difficulty in a graded system. Often used for courses, textbooks, and certifications.
Something that had subsided or been resolved coming back again. Used for disputes, controversies, diseases, and other issues that resurface.
A comprehensive collection of all or most works by a single author, artist, or on a single subject, typically published as a multi-volume set.
The first snowfall of the winter season in a given area. An event that is often reported in the news and marks the arrival of winter.
Something previously unknown becoming clear or being determined. Often used when facts, causes, or identities come to light through investigation or over time.
A secondary residence used for holidays or retreats, typically located in the countryside, mountains, or by the sea.
A favorable point or benefit of something. Used when discussing the positive aspects of a choice, method, or situation.
The coming or arrival of a time, era, season, or opportunity. Used for abstract arrivals rather than physical ones.
Cutting down or reducing something, especially costs, budgets, personnel, or quantities. Often used in business, government, and policy contexts.
A previous case or instance that can serve as a reference or standard for similar situations. Often used in legal, administrative, and formal contexts.
The foremost line of a battle or conflict. Also used figuratively for the forefront of any activity or field.
A boundary between two air masses of different temperatures, as used in meteorology. Commonly heard in weather forecasts.
The act of starting or founding a business. Also refers to the time when a business was first established.
The act of working on raw materials to change their form or properties, such as processing food, machining metal, or editing images.
The ratio of useful output to total input; how effectively time, resources, or effort are used to produce results.
Winning a contest, battle, election, or competition. Used in both literal and figurative contexts.
The preserved remains or traces of ancient organisms found in rock. Also used figuratively to describe something outdated or behind the times.
The state of being unnamed or unidentified. Used as a noun or as a modifier (匿名の) to describe something done without revealing one's name.
A dangerous or critical situation that threatens serious harm. Used for political, economic, environmental, health, and personal crises.

glosses: to account for; to make up
explanations: To physically or abstractly occupy a place, position, or role.
To constitute a certain proportion or percentage of a whole.
Taking in and housing people or things in a facility. Also refers to the capacity of a venue.
Confining people in a facility, such as a detention center or internment camp.
A fundamental rule or standard that guides actions or decisions.
Used adverbially to indicate what is generally the case, implying that exceptions may exist.
The basic materials from which a product is manufactured or processed. Refers to materials that undergo significant transformation in the production process.
The way someone speaks, including their tone, manner, and style of expression. Reflects the speaker's attitude, emotion, or personality.
A city that served as a capital in the past. In Japan, this most commonly refers to Kyoto and Nara.
Something being completely ruined or made worthless. Used when effort, plans, or something of value is destroyed or wasted.
In all of recorded history. Used as a modifier before superlatives to emphasize something as the most extreme or notable in history.

glosses: to fulfill; to grant; to make come true
explanations: To make a wish, dream, or hope become reality. Can describe both fulfilling one's own dreams and granting someone else's wishes.

glosses: to tell; to inform; to announce
explanations: To communicate important information or news to someone. Has a somewhat formal or literary tone and often implies delivering significant or weighty news.
Used figuratively when something signals or marks the beginning or end of a period, season, or event.
The four seasons of the year: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. A culturally important concept in Japan, where seasonal awareness permeates daily life, food, art, and customs.
The act of avoiding or steering clear of something undesirable such as risk, danger, conflict, or responsibility.
A condition or factor that limits freedom of action. Used for rules, conditions, budgets, time limits, and other factors that restrict what can be done.
The power or influence that a person, group, or organization wields. Also used for the strength of natural phenomena like typhoons.
Kind or well-meaning intentions behind an action. The desire to help or do good for others.
In legal contexts, acting without knowledge of wrongdoing or defect. The opposite of bad faith ({悪意|あくい}).

glosses: to lament; to grieve; to bewail
explanations: To feel deep sadness or sorrow about something, or to express that grief. Often used for mourning a loss or deploring a situation.
The act of reaching a destination, goal, or level after a process of progress or effort. Used for both physical arrival and abstract achievement of targets or milestones.
The act of controlling or regulating something, especially machinery, systems, or physical forces. Often used in technical and scientific contexts for precise management of processes or devices.

glosses: last time, previous occasion, previous time
explanations: Refers to the previous instance of a recurring event or action. Commonly used as an adverbial noun (without a particle) to mean 'last time.'

glosses: moving up (a schedule), advancing, bringing forward
explanations: Rescheduling something to an earlier date or time than originally planned. Commonly used in business and project management contexts.

A double-edged sword or blade. While {刀|かたな} refers specifically to the single-edged Japanese sword, {剣|けん} is a broader term that can refer to swords in general, including Western-style double-edged swords and swords in fantasy/game contexts.

glosses: to spare, to devote, to set aside
explanations: To allocate or devote time, effort, resources, or space for a particular purpose. Often implies carving out something from a limited supply.
To tear or split something apart by pulling. A physical sense that is less common in modern everyday usage but appears in literary contexts.
The natural process of getting older over time. Used especially in medical, health, and scientific contexts to describe age-related changes, as opposed to {老化|ろうか} which emphasizes deterioration.

glosses: to devote oneself to, to work hard at
to devote oneself to, to work hard at, to strive
explanations: To apply oneself diligently to a task or pursuit. Takes に to mark the activity one is devoted to.
The sudden outbreak or eruption of a major event, especially war, conflict, or a crisis. Implies something erupting suddenly and violently.
The power or ability of something to produce an intended effect. Often used in legal and official contexts to mean 'validity' or 'legal force' of a document, law, or agreement.
In a state of danger or instability where something bad could easily happen. Describes situations that are on the verge of going wrong.
In the adverbial form {危|あや}うく, means 'nearly' or 'almost' — typically describing a narrow escape from something bad.
Something done or prepared immediately without advance planning. Used both for physical products (instant food) and for actions done spontaneously (impromptu speeches, offhand performances).
The original version of a creative work, especially a novel, manga, or other literary work that has been adapted into another medium such as film, anime, or drama.

The fundamental starting point or basis of something. Used figuratively to refer to the core principles or beginnings that define a person, project, or idea. Also used in mathematics and coordinates to mean the origin point (0,0).
The act of gathering or collecting things together. Used for both systematic gathering of data or materials, and for collecting items as a hobby.
The act of soliciting and collecting monetary donations for a cause. Can refer both to the act of raising funds and to the donated money itself.
A formal organization or association established to promote or regulate a particular activity, profession, or cause. Often appears in the names of professional bodies and industry groups.
Lacking in variety or change, resulting in boredom. Describes repetitive situations, routines, or sounds that feel dull due to their uniformity.

glosses: old traditional Japanese house, old folk house
explanations: A traditional Japanese residential house, typically built before the mid-20th century using traditional construction methods. Many have been preserved, relocated, or renovated as cafes, inns, or cultural facilities.

glosses: to be in full bloom, to bloom magnificently
explanations: To bloom in full glory, with flowers at the peak of their beauty. Conveys a sense of splendor and abundance in blooming.
A theatrical genre or work intended to amuse, as opposed to tragedy. Also used more broadly to describe absurd or laughable real-life situations.
The loss of something important or valuable, especially abstract things like rights, qualifications, memory, or identity. More formal and weighty than simply 'losing' something.

glosses: to run, to operate, to manage (a business)
to conduct, to carry out (a ceremony or life activity)
explanations: To operate or manage a business, shop, or enterprise. Slightly more formal and literary than {経営|けいえい}する.
To carry out or perform certain life activities, ceremonies, or rituals. Used in more literary or formal contexts.
A container or dish used for holding food, drink, or other items. Often refers to pottery, ceramics, or tableware with aesthetic value.
A person's capacity, caliber, or suitability for a role. Used figuratively to describe whether someone has the personal qualities needed for a position or responsibility.
The act of recalling or reflecting on past experiences and memories, often with a sense of nostalgia or contemplation.
A distinct variety or breed of a plant or animal, especially one developed through selective breeding or cultivation. Widely used in agriculture, horticulture, and animal husbandry.
A retail shop or store, typically a smaller independent establishment. Often used in compound forms, especially in {商店街|しょうてんがい} (shopping street/district).

glosses: to be blown away, to be swept away (by wind or force)
explanations: To be physically blown away or scattered by wind, an explosion, or other powerful force.
Used figuratively to describe negative feelings, worries, or fatigue disappearing suddenly and completely.
Words or phrases chanted to invoke magical or supernatural effects. Used both in traditional religious/spiritual contexts and in modern fantasy, games, and popular culture.

glosses: product lineup, assortment, selection of goods
explanations: The range and variety of products available at a store or business. Used to evaluate or describe how well-stocked or diverse a shop's offerings are.

glosses: to be effective; to work; to be possible
to be effective, to work, to take effect
to be possible, to be able to do
explanations: Describes something functioning properly or producing the intended effect. Used for medicine, brakes, air conditioning, seasoning, etc.
Indicates that something can be done or is available as an option. Often used in the pattern ～が利く.
A punitive measure imposed on a person, organization, or nation for violating rules, laws, or norms.
Describes someone or something that displays courage or a bold, spirited bearing. Often carries a heroic or admirable nuance.

glosses: to surpass, to exceed, to be superior to
explanations: To be better than or exceed something in comparison. Used with に to mark the thing being surpassed.

glosses: to transform, to disguise oneself, to take the form of
to transform, to take the form of, to appear as
to change drastically, to be transformed
explanations: To change one's appearance or form, especially said of supernatural beings (foxes, tanuki, ghosts) disguising themselves as humans or other things.
Used figuratively for dramatic changes in character, ability, or circumstances.

glosses: to punctuate; to divide, to mark off
to divide, to mark off, to segment
to bring to a close, to put a stop to
explanations: To separate something into sections or segments by marking boundaries. Used for dividing text, time, space, or abstract concepts.
To mark a stopping point or conclusion in an activity or period.
The formal term for a licensed medical doctor. Used in official, legal, and professional contexts.

glosses: to persuade; to hit on, to seduce
to persuade, to talk into, to win over
to hit on, to make a pass at, to court
explanations: To persistently try to convince someone to agree or comply. Often implies repeated or prolonged attempts.
To try to win someone's romantic interest through persistent attention or flattery.

A large earthen mound built as a tomb for rulers and powerful figures in ancient Japan, dating mainly from the 3rd to 7th centuries. The most distinctive type is the keyhole-shaped mound ({前方後円墳|ぜんぽうこうえんふん}).

glosses: to curse, to put a curse on
to curse, to put a curse on, to hex
explanations: To invoke supernatural harm upon someone, or to wish ill upon them. Can refer to literal supernatural curses or strong feelings of resentment.
A public appeal or call to action directed at people, asking them to do something. Also refers to the act of addressing or calling out to someone.
Putting one's life on the line; doing something with total commitment as if one's life depended on it. Used both literally and figuratively.
A powerful, deep cry or roar, typically of a large animal such as a lion or beast. Also used figuratively for thunderous sounds or for a person roaring in rage.

glosses: to fit into; to settle down, to be resolved
to fit into, to be contained in
to settle down, to subside, to be resolved
explanations: To fit or be accommodated within a space, container, or limit.
For a situation, disturbance, or emotion to calm down and return to a normal state.
Refers to two sides or parties involved in a situation. Used in formal and written contexts for negotiations, disputes, agreements, and comparisons.
An organized armed resistance against an established authority or government. Also used figuratively for strong defiance.
Without any delay or hesitation; right away. Most commonly used in the adverbial form {即座|そくざ}に.
A feeling of worry or concern about a potential negative outcome. More formal than {心配|しんぱい} and often used in written or official contexts.
The act of taking control of a territory, area, or position by military force. Also used figuratively for monopolizing a space.
Having an atmosphere of gravity, reverence, and dignity. Used to describe ceremonies, buildings, music, and other things that inspire awe and respect.
The act of selecting with great care and strict standards. Commonly used in marketing and advertising to emphasize quality.
The act of looking at or consulting materials, documents, or other sources for information. Frequently used as a direction to the reader meaning 'see' or 'refer to.'

glosses: winning a prize, receiving an award
explanations: The act of being awarded a prize, medal, or other recognition. Commonly used in news about literary awards, Nobel prizes, film festivals, and competitions.
The written text of a play, film, TV show, or other performance, containing dialogue, stage directions, and scene descriptions.
An outstanding or highly acclaimed work of art, literature, film, or other creative endeavor.
A list of names, often with associated information such as addresses or contact details. Used for membership rolls, class rosters, voter registries, and similar records.
A hot pepper of the genus Capsicum, used widely in Japanese cooking as a spice. Includes both fresh and dried forms.
The relationship between causes and their results. Used in both philosophical/scientific and Buddhist contexts.
From the Buddhist concept that past actions determine present circumstances. Often carries a negative nuance, suggesting misfortune brought about by past deeds.

glosses: to assign, to allocate, to allot
explanations: To distribute or apportion something (tasks, resources, roles, etc.) to specific people or purposes.

glosses: to call oneself, to give one's name, to claim to be
to give one's name, to introduce oneself
to call oneself, to claim to be, to go by the name of
explanations: To state one's own name or identity when meeting someone or in an official context.
To adopt or use a particular name, title, or identity. Can imply the claim may or may not be legitimate.
The first half of a time period, event, game, or other divisible whole. Commonly used for halves of sports matches, decades, books, and similar.
The evening or night immediately preceding a particular event or day. Often used for the eve of holidays, ceremonies, or significant occasions.
A completely different person. Often used figuratively to describe someone who has changed so dramatically in appearance, personality, or behavior that they seem like a different person.
A different name by which someone or something is also known. Used for alternate names of places, animals, plants, people, and other things.
A married couple or family members living in separate residences. Often refers to a formal or informal separation between spouses, sometimes as a step before divorce.

glosses: different thing entirely, something completely different
explanations: Something that is fundamentally different from what it is being compared to. Emphasizes that two things that might appear similar are in fact not comparable.

Done or handled as a separate matter, not included in the main item or arrangement. Frequently used in business and commercial contexts to indicate that something requires separate handling or payment.
The opening phase of a time period such as a century, decade, year, or month. Typically attaches to a time word to specify the early portion.
Rigidly adhering to rules, deadlines, or regulations without exception. Implies zero tolerance for deviation.
Extremely careful, exact, and thorough with no room for looseness or approximation. Used for reasoning, definitions, distinctions, analyses, and other intellectual or procedural matters.
Demanding strict adherence to rules or standards, often describing a person's character, upbringing, or a system of discipline. Implies severity and unwillingness to tolerate lapses.
Thoroughly secured or tightly controlled, leaving no gaps or vulnerabilities. Commonly describes security measures, guarding, warnings, and protective arrangements.

glosses: attendance at a ceremony, participation in a formal event
explanations: Attending a formal ceremony such as a wedding, funeral, or official event. More formal than simply attending; implies respectful participation.
The process of becoming smaller, tighter, or more compact. Used for physical contraction of materials or muscles, as well as figurative shrinkage of economies or markets.

glosses: seeing a doctor, medical consultation, getting examined
explanations: The act of visiting a medical professional for examination or treatment. Refers to the patient's action of receiving medical care.

glosses: area around the mouth, lips and mouth area
explanations: The region of the face around and including the mouth. Often referenced when describing facial expressions, makeup, or physical features.
Communicated by speaking rather than in writing. Used as a noun modifier (with の) to describe instructions, agreements, explanations, and other forms of communication that are delivered orally.
Having the style, manners, or appearance of an earlier era. Can be used positively (charming, classic) or neutrally (dated, old-style), but rarely carries a strongly negative connotation.
A person employed to do household work or attend to the needs of a master or household. In modern usage, primarily appears in historical, literary, or fantasy contexts.

glosses: disclosure, confession, revealing one's true feelings
explanations: The act of openly expressing or revealing one's innermost thoughts, feelings, or emotions that had been kept hidden. Implies a sense of emotional release or vulnerability.

A day considered favorable for undertaking important activities such as weddings, moving house, opening a business, or other significant events. Based on traditional calendar systems and superstitions.

glosses: ambition, desire to improve oneself, aspiration
explanations: The inner drive to better oneself, develop skills, or advance in life. A positive character trait involving the motivation to keep growing and not become complacent.
Black clothing worn when attending funerals or memorial services. In Japan, this typically means a black suit or black dress with minimal accessories.
The quality of food or drink as perceived by the palate. A more refined or literary term than simply {味|あじ}.
An intangible quality of depth, elegance, or appeal in things like art, scenery, experiences, or craftsmanship. Suggests something that becomes more appreciated the more one engages with it.
A style of sushi restaurant where plates of sushi travel on a conveyor belt past the customers, who pick what they want. Known for being affordable and casual compared to traditional sushi counters.
A period where a group stays together at a location away from home for intensive training, practice, study, or team building. Common for sports clubs, school clubs, and company groups.

glosses: joining up, meeting up, linking up
explanations: The point where rivers, roads, or traffic lanes come together and merge into one.
People or groups coming together to join forces, meet at a point, or unite for a common purpose.

glosses: cohabitation, living together (as an unmarried couple)
explanations: An unmarried romantic couple sharing a residence. In Japanese society, this term specifically implies a romantic partnership rather than simply being roommates.
A sustained human activity or way of living. Often refers to the fundamental activities that make up daily life, work, or cultural practice, with a nuance of continuity and purpose.
The act of creating or founding an organization, institution, or system for the first time. Emphasizes the initial creation from nothing, rather than reorganizing something existing.

glosses: to control, to restrain; to win, to dominate
to control, to restrain, to hold back
to win, to dominate, to gain control of
explanations: To restrain or check someone or something, preventing them from acting freely. Often used for physically or verbally stopping someone.
To gain victory or dominance over something, especially in competitive or strategic contexts.
The formal act of creating and putting into effect laws, regulations, standards, or official rules. Used specifically for legal and regulatory contexts.
The act of stopping or restraining someone from doing something, typically by physical intervention or verbal command. Often used when preventing someone from acting rashly or dangerously.

glosses: dried bonito shavings, shaved dried fish
explanations: Thin shavings of dried fish, most commonly bonito (katsuobushi), used as a topping or for making dashi stock. A staple ingredient in Japanese cooking.
The earlier version or form that something evolved from. Used for organizations, institutions, products, or concepts that were later reorganized, renamed, or transformed into their current form.
Refers to something that has already been mentioned or discussed earlier in a text or speech. A formal, written-style expression commonly used in academic papers, reports, and official documents.
A person skilled in swordsmanship. Can refer to historical swordsmen, modern kendo practitioners, or fictional sword-wielding characters.

glosses: to strip, to peel off, to tear off
to strip off, to peel off, to tear off
explanations: To forcefully remove something that covers or clings to a surface — such as skin, bark, clothing, paint, or a mask. Implies a rougher, more forceful action than simply peeling.

glosses: to calculate, to figure out, to deduce
explanations: To arrive at a result through calculation, reasoning, or analysis. Often used when determining a number, identity, cause, or answer from available data.

The act of joining or becoming a member of a group, organization, plan, or service. Commonly used for formal memberships such as insurance, unions, international organizations, and subscription services.

The person who causes harm or damage to another. Used in legal, news, and general contexts to identify the party responsible for causing injury, damage, or wrongdoing. The opposite of {被害者|ひがいしゃ} (victim).
Describes conditions, quality, or environments that are extremely bad or substandard. Stronger than simply 'bad' — implies conditions that are seriously inadequate or harmful.

glosses: appreciation, thanks for someone's effort or hard work
explanations: Words or actions expressing gratitude and recognition for someone's hard work, effort, or service. Directed toward those who have exerted themselves, acknowledging their labor with warmth.

glosses: cross (shape), crucifix shape, plus sign shape
explanations: The shape formed by two lines crossing at right angles, like a plus sign (+). Named because it resembles the kanji {十|じゅう}. Used for the shape itself, not specifically the Christian cross (though it can refer to that too).
The beneficial effect or power that something has, especially regarding medicine, hot springs, food, or other health-related substances. Often seen on product labels and at hot spring facilities.

A secondary or supplementary title that appears alongside the main title of a book, article, film, or other work. Provides additional context or clarification for the main title. Not to be confused with movie subtitles ({字幕|じまく}).

glosses: Japanese haute cuisine, traditional Japanese cooking
explanations: High-end traditional Japanese cooking, or a restaurant specializing in such cuisine. Originally meant 'cutting and boiling' — the two fundamental techniques of Japanese cooking. Now refers to upscale Japanese restaurants where the chef prepares dishes at a counter or in a refined setting.
The initial publication or launch of a periodical such as a magazine, newspaper, or journal. Refers specifically to the first issue, not to publishing in general.

An artificially created or recorded sound used in film, television, theater, radio, video games, and other media to enhance the production. Includes everything from footsteps and explosions to ambient background noise.
A person of great courage and bravery. In modern usage, strongly associated with the 'hero' character class in Japanese RPGs, anime, and fantasy stories — the chosen protagonist who fights evil.
Physical movement or motion of a person, animal, or thing.
Changes, developments, or activity in a situation — such as market trends, political movements, or social changes. Used to describe shifts and emerging patterns.

The act of assembling and organizing people, resources, or forces for a particular purpose. Originally a military term, now widely used for gathering large numbers of people for events, projects, or causes.

glosses: winning and losing, victory and defeat
winning and losing, victory and defeat, the outcome
explanations: The result or outcome of a competition, expressed as the combined concept of winning and losing. Often used when discussing whether outcomes matter, the nature of competition, or results in general.
A supernatural being that has transformed or shapeshifted — ghosts, spirits, and creatures from Japanese folklore that take on different forms. Derived from {化|ば}ける (to transform).
Used figuratively for a person with extraordinary, almost inhuman abilities or characteristics — often in admiration of exceptional talent or physical capability.

glosses: block, section, lot, plot of land, partition
explanations: A defined section or division of land, space, or area that has been marked off for a specific purpose. Used for land parcels, parking spaces, city blocks, and other partitioned areas.
The act of including or encompassing everything within a certain scope. Used as a noun meaning 'comprehensiveness' or as a modifier ({包括的|ほうかつてき}) meaning 'comprehensive' or 'all-inclusive.'
The act of wrapping or packaging goods, especially for protection, presentation, or sale. Also refers to the packaging material or wrapping itself.

glosses: to wrap up, to envelop, to enfold
explanations: To completely wrap or enclose something, surrounding it entirely. Used both literally (wrapping an object) and figuratively (enveloping someone in warmth, kindness, or atmosphere).

glosses: counter word, counter suffix, numerical classifier
explanations: A grammatical term for the suffixes attached to numbers when counting things in Japanese. Different counters are used depending on what is being counted — flat things, long things, people, animals, etc. Also called {数|かぞ}え{方|かた} informally.
Describes food, especially eggs, that is not fully cooked through. The most common usage refers to soft-boiled or runny eggs.
Describes fruit or produce that has not yet fully ripened. Can also be used figuratively for a person who is still immature or not fully developed in skill.
The southernmost point of the Earth, or the Antarctic region in general. Used in geographic, scientific, and general contexts.

A book published as a single, independent volume rather than as part of a series, magazine, or periodical. In manga culture, refers to the collected volumes that compile chapters originally serialized in magazines.
The act of wagering money or valuables on games of chance. Carries a somewhat rougher, more informal tone than ギャンブル.
Figuratively, any action or decision that involves significant risk and uncertain outcome.
Answering a question or request right away without hesitation or delay.
A kitchen, especially a professional or commercial one in a restaurant, hotel, or institution. More formal and technical than 台所.

glosses: to be torn off; to come apart; to break into pieces
to be torn off, to come apart, to break into pieces
to break apart, to scatter (of clouds, etc.)
explanations: Something separates or breaks apart on its own, or as a result of force. Often used for paper, cloth, rope, or similar materials that tear or come apart.
Used figuratively or descriptively for things like clouds breaking apart in the sky.
An abbreviation of 原子爆弾. Refers to the nuclear fission bombs, especially those dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in 1945.
An abbreviation of 原子力発電所. Refers to facilities that generate electricity using nuclear fission.
An attack made in response to an enemy's attack. Used in military, sports, debate, and figurative contexts.

glosses: reversal; inversion; to flip; to reverse
explanations: Turning something to its opposite state — flipping an image, reversing a direction, or inverting a position. Used for physical rotation as well as abstract reversals of situation or trend.

glosses: to manage; to supervise; to run (an event)
to manage, to supervise, to preside over, to run
explanations: To take charge of and manage an event, ceremony, organization, or process. Implies being the person in overall control who makes sure everything runs smoothly.
The act of formally acquiring or obtaining something such as a license, qualification, right, or property. Used in official, legal, and business contexts.
The act of accepting or taking in something — ideas, cultures, changes, or situations. Often used in academic, psychological, and cultural contexts.

glosses: wanting to snack; feeling peckish; mouth feels lonely
wanting to eat something, feeling peckish, mouth feels lonely
explanations: The feeling of wanting to put something in your mouth — not because of real hunger, but out of boredom, habit, or craving. Literally "mouth-lonely," it describes the urge to snack or have something to munch on.

glosses: to become old; to grow worn; to age
to become old, to grow worn, to age, to look dated
explanations: To show signs of age and use. Describes objects, buildings, or styles that have become worn, faded, or outdated over time.
Officially calling people together for a meeting, assembly, or duty. Often used for legislative sessions, military conscription, and formal gatherings.

glosses: historic site, historical ruins, historic monument
explanations: A site of historical significance, such as ancient ruins, castle remains, battlefields, or other places where important historical events occurred. In Japan, can also refer to officially designated cultural properties.
A secret word or phrase used to identify allies or gain entry. Historically used in military and security contexts.
A phrase adopted as the guiding principle or shared goal of a group or movement.
Feeling sorry for someone else's suffering or misfortune. Can imply genuine empathy or, depending on context, condescending pity.

glosses: prestigious institution, elite school, renowned organization
explanations: A family with a long and illustrious lineage, known for wealth, influence, or accomplishment across generations.
A school, company, sports team, or other organization with a long tradition of excellence and high reputation.
Widely known and respected for excellence or notable qualities. Carries a literary and dignified tone.

glosses: reigning; ruling; to reign; to dominate
explanations: To hold supreme authority or dominant position. Originally refers to a monarch's rule, but widely used figuratively for anyone or anything that holds an unchallenged top position.

glosses: to govern; to administer; to be in charge of
to govern, to administer, to be in charge of, to preside over
explanations: To have official authority and responsibility over a particular function, domain, or area. Often used for formal, institutional, or physiological roles.

glosses: various kinds; all sorts; each type
various kinds, all sorts, each type
explanations: Refers to a variety of different kinds or types. Used as a modifier before nouns to mean 'various' or 'of all kinds.'

glosses: command; order; signal; word of command
command, order, signal, word of command
explanations: A verbal command or signal given to a group to coordinate action. Commonly used in military drills, school assemblies, sports, and other organized group activities.
Formally refusing to acknowledge or accept something as true. Commonly used in legal, political, and official contexts.

glosses: to blow into; to instill; to record (audio)
to blow into, to blow in
to instill, to put (ideas) into someone's head
explanations: Wind, air, rain, or snow entering a space through an opening. Used both transitively (blow air into something) and intransitively (wind blows in).
To influence someone by repeatedly telling them something, often with the implication of manipulation or indoctrination.
To record sound onto a medium. Used for recording music, voice tracks, or audio.

glosses: to drive out; to throw out; to produce (a result)
to drive out, to throw out, to kick out
to produce, to achieve (a record, score, or result)
explanations: To forcefully expel someone from a place. Carries a rough, aggressive nuance.
To achieve a notable result through effort. Used in sports, business, and competitive contexts for impressive numbers or records.

glosses: to summon; to call over; to send for
to summon, to call over, to send for
explanations: To have someone come to where you are by calling or requesting them. Implies the person summoned travels to the speaker's location.

glosses: to dislike; to be reluctant; to shun
to dislike, to be reluctant, to shun
explanations: To feel aversion toward something and wish to avoid it. Carries a literary or formal tone compared to everyday words like {嫌|きら}う. Often used with abstract nouns like {苦労|くろう} (hardship) or {手間|てま} (effort).

glosses: to be contrary to; to violate; to go against
to be contrary to, to contradict, to go against
explanations: To be in opposition to a principle, expectation, or standard. Used with に to mark the thing being contradicted.
To break or act contrary to a rule, law, or agreement. Common in legal and formal contexts.

glosses: to bend backward; to warp; to curve
to bend backward, to arch back
to warp, to curve, to buckle
explanations: For a person or body part to bend or lean backward, forming an arch shape.
For a flat object such as wood or paper to become curved or bent out of its original flat shape, typically due to heat, moisture, or age.

glosses: to cancel; to call off; to abandon (a plan)
to cancel, to call off, to abandon
explanations: To decide not to go through with a plan, event, or action that was previously intended. Implies a deliberate decision to stop before something has begun.

glosses: to possess; to haunt; to be obsessed
to be obsessed with, to be gripped by
explanations: For a spirit, ghost, or supernatural entity to attach itself to a person or place. The person or thing possessed is marked with に.
Used figuratively for an idea, emotion, or obsession that takes hold of someone and won't let go, as if one were possessed.

glosses: to win; to gain; to earn (popularity, fame)
to win, to gain, to earn
explanations: To acquire or earn something positive such as popularity, fame, sympathy, or acclaim. Almost always used with abstract nouns denoting favorable reception.

glosses: to conform to; to be based on; to be suited to
to conform to, to be based on, to be suited to
explanations: To be in accordance with or adapted to a particular situation, reality, or standard. Takes に to mark the thing conformed to.

glosses: joining a group, team, or troupe
explanations: The act of formally becoming a member of an organized group such as a sports team, theater troupe, or youth organization. The group joined is marked with に.
Death that occurs immediately, without any interval of survival. Used in news reports about accidents, in medical contexts, and in gaming.
The formal act of ascending to a throne, especially the Japanese imperial throne. Used primarily in historical and political contexts.
The clear, viscous liquid surrounding the yolk of an egg, which turns white when cooked. Used in cooking and scientific contexts.
The yellow, nutrient-rich center of an egg. Used in cooking and scientific contexts.
The earliest form or model from which later versions are developed or derived. Emphasizes the concept of an original design or pattern that serves as a basis for copies or variations.

glosses: original plan; draft proposal; original concept
explanations: The initial version of a plan, bill, or proposal before revisions are made. Common in legislative and organizational contexts.
The original idea or story that a creative work (manga, anime, film) is based on, credited to the person who conceived it.
A vast expanse of uncultivated, undeveloped land. Evokes images of untamed natural landscapes such as grasslands, plains, or scrubland.

glosses: approach to a shrine or temple
explanations: The road or path leading from the entrance to a Shinto shrine or Buddhist temple. Often lined with shops, torii gates, or stone lanterns.
A handheld optical instrument with two lenses for viewing distant objects, used for birdwatching, sports events, concerts, and stargazing.

glosses: being banned from a place; barred entry
being banned from a place, barred entry
explanations: A colloquial abbreviation of {出入|でい}り{禁止|きんし} (prohibited from entering and leaving). Means being permanently banned from a shop, restaurant, bar, or other establishment due to bad behavior.
A general term for southern areas or the direction of south. Often refers to Southeast Asia or the tropical regions south of Japan in historical and geographic contexts.
Consisting of only one kind, element, or component. Emphasizes uniformity or the absence of variety or complexity.

glosses: single item; a la carte; individual product
single item, a la carte, individual product
explanations: An individual item sold or ordered separately, not as part of a set, combo, or bundle. Commonly used in restaurants and retail contexts.

glosses: exhibiting; displaying at an exhibition or trade show
exhibiting, displaying at an exhibition or trade show
explanations: The act of presenting products, artworks, or other items at an exhibition, trade fair, or show. Refers to both the act of exhibiting and participation as an exhibitor.

glosses: interest rate hike; raising interest rates
interest rate hike, raising interest rates
explanations: An increase in interest rates, typically by a central bank as a monetary policy tool. Frequently appears in economic news and financial discussions.
Literally a flag raised in rebellion. Almost exclusively used in the fixed expression {反旗|はんき}を{翻|ひるがえ}す (to raise the flag of rebellion), meaning to rebel or revolt against authority.

glosses: misfortune; bad luck; calamity; unlucky age
explanations: Ill fortune or disaster that befalls someone, often thought to have a supernatural or karmic cause.
Specific ages in Japanese superstition considered prone to misfortune (yakudoshi). Traditionally 25, 42, and 61 for men; 19, 33, and 37 for women.

glosses: myriad; eight million; innumerable (especially of gods)
explanations: An extremely large, uncountable number. Most famously used in the Shinto concept of {八百万|やおよろず}の{神|かみ} (eight million gods / myriad deities), expressing the belief that divine spirits reside in all things.
Relating to the public sphere, government, or matters open to general knowledge. Contrasts with private or unofficial matters.

glosses: entering a war; joining a battle; participating in a contest
entering a war, joining a battle
joining a competition, entering a contest
explanations: The act of a country or military force entering an ongoing war or armed conflict.
Used figuratively for entering a competition, tournament, or any competitive situation. Common in sports, gaming, and business contexts.
Responding argumentatively or defiantly to someone of higher status such as a parent, teacher, or boss. Viewed negatively in Japanese culture as disrespectful behavior.

glosses: running about in confusion; being in a panic
running about in confusion, being in a panic, going back and forth in disorder
explanations: To rush around aimlessly in a state of confusion or panic, unable to decide what to do. Literally means going right and going left — i.e., running in every direction.

glosses: to pity; to feel sorry for
to pity, to feel sorry for
to find something moving, to feel pathos
explanations: To feel compassion or sympathy for someone in a difficult or unfortunate situation.
To be emotionally moved by the beauty or sadness of something, with a sense of poignancy.
Describes a situation or event that brings joy or is cause for celebration. More formal and literary than うれしい.

glosses: to chew thoroughly; to savor; to reflect deeply on
to chew thoroughly, to bite down on
to savor, to reflect deeply on, to take to heart
explanations: To chew food carefully and repeatedly, savoring its taste.
To think carefully about the meaning or significance of something, letting it sink in emotionally.

glosses: to name; to give a name to
to name, to give a name to, to call
explanations: To assign a name to a person, place, thing, or concept. Used for the act of choosing and bestowing a name.
To formally exchange documents, contracts, or promises between parties. Implies a mutual, official exchange.

glosses: to compete for; to pay attention to
to compete for, to scramble for, to vie for
to pay attention to, to take seriously, to deal with
explanations: Multiple parties trying to obtain the same thing. Implies rivalry or contention.
To respond to or engage with someone or something. Most commonly used in the negative form {取|と}り{合|あ}わない (to not take seriously, to ignore).

glosses: to suck up; to absorb; to blot
to suck up, to absorb, to blot
to drain, to siphon off, to exploit
explanations: To draw liquid or moisture into something by suction or absorption.
To take away someone's energy, wealth, or resources gradually. Used figuratively.

glosses: to pose a question; to question; to ask
to pose a question, to ask, to question
explanations: To direct a question at someone, often with the nuance of prompting thought or seeking a deeper answer. Can also mean to address a question to the public or society at large.

glosses: to present; to exhibit; to show
to exhibit, to show, to assume (an appearance)
explanations: To formally present or offer something to someone, such as a gift or a document. Literary and formal.
To display a certain state, appearance, or condition. Used in written and formal contexts.

glosses: to come together; to be combined; to merge
to come together, to be combined, to merge
explanations: For multiple things to join, combine, or come together into one. The intransitive counterpart of {合|あ}わせる.

glosses: to enclose; to fence in; to keep (a mistress)
to enclose, to fence in, to pen
to keep, to shelter, to hide away
explanations: To surround an area with a fence, wall, or barrier to contain or protect what is inside.
To keep someone (such as a mistress) in a separate residence, or to hide or shelter someone or something away.

glosses: to plan; to attempt; to aim for
to plan, to scheme, to plot
to attempt, to aim for, to strive for
explanations: To devise a plan or strategy to achieve a goal. Can carry a negative nuance of scheming.
To try to bring about or promote a particular outcome. Common in formal and written contexts.
The act of coughing, or the sound produced by coughing. A common symptom of colds and respiratory illness.
A square pit cut into the floor of a traditional Japanese house, used for heating and cooking. Charcoal or wood is burned in it, and a pot can be hung above it.
The nut of an oak tree. A familiar sight in autumn in Japan, often collected by children.

glosses: arena, playing field, stage for competition
explanations: The circular clay platform where sumo wrestling bouts take place. Made of packed earth and marked with straw bales.
Used figuratively to mean a place or context where competition or negotiation takes place.
A mythological creature that drinks the blood of the living. Widely used in fiction, anime, manga, and horror.

glosses: highlight, masterpiece, most impressive part, showstopper
explanations: The most outstanding or impressive part of a performance, work, or event. Often used as a predicate: ～は{圧巻|あっかん}だ.
Physical force applied to press or compress something. Used in medical and physical contexts.
Figurative pressure exerted on people, organizations, or economies. Implies restricting freedom or causing strain.
Force per unit area applied to a surface. Used in scientific, technical, and everyday physical contexts.
Social, political, or organizational pressure exerted to influence decisions or behavior.
Official relations between countries at the government level. Commonly appears in news about international politics.
A bond issued by a national government to finance public spending. A key instrument in government finance.

glosses: domestic production, domestically made, made in Japan
explanations: Products or goods produced within the country. In Japan, often implies higher quality or safety and is used as a selling point, especially for food.
A state of severe financial difficulty or want. More formal and emphatic than {貧乏|びんぼう}.
A legally registered mark, name, or symbol that identifies a product or company and distinguishes it from others.
A state where two or more things match, agree, or are in conformity with each other. Used for opinions, conditions, evidence, etc.
Stubbornly holding on to one's opinion, method, or position and refusing to change. Usually carries a negative nuance.
The act of looking back on past events or experiences. Often used in the context of exhibitions, memoirs, and reviews.
A technical drawing or plan showing the design of a building, machine, or other structure. Used in architecture, engineering, and construction.
Skills, knowledge, or cultural accomplishments considered befitting a well-bred or cultured person.
The quality of having good manners and behaving with appropriate restraint and decorum.
Formally entering an institution such as a care home, nursery, detention center, or research facility. Used for long-term or official placement, not casual visits.

glosses: entire area, whole region, full extent
explanations: The complete area or range of a given territory, zone, or domain. Often used with geographic or administrative regions.
Combining multiple elements to create something new. Used in chemistry for chemical synthesis, in technology for image/sound compositing, and more broadly for artificial or synthetic products.
Going to the same place with someone, typically in an official or semi-formal context. Implies being part of a group or escorting someone.

glosses: same year, same class, same cohort
explanations: People who entered a company, school, or organization in the same year. An important concept in Japanese workplace culture, where cohort bonds are strong.
Aligning the timing or data of two or more systems. Used in computing, engineering, and telecommunications.
The act of giving a name to a person, place, product, or other entity. Often used for formal or significant naming events.
The official or formal name of an organization, product, place, or concept. More formal than {名前|なまえ} and typically refers to the established name of something rather than a person's name.
Formally accepting and processing an application, complaint, or official document. Used in legal, administrative, and bureaucratic contexts.
Everyday spoken language as opposed to literary or written language. In Japanese linguistics, contrasts with {文語|ぶんご} (classical/literary language).

Characteristic of traditional Japanese aesthetics, design, cuisine, or culture. Used as a modifier to describe things made in or inspired by Japanese traditions, as opposed to Western-style ({洋風|ようふう}).
Abbreviation of {国際連合|こくさいれんごう}. The international organization established in 1945 to promote peace, security, and cooperation among nations.
