Lacking meaning, purpose, or value. Used to describe actions, words, or situations that serve no useful purpose.
A story or analogy used to explain or illustrate a point. The story itself serves as a comparison or metaphor for the real topic.

The act of fleeing from confinement, captivity, or a place where one is expected to stay. Used for escaping from prison, military desertion, or animals running away. Composed of 脱 (escape, remove) + 走 (run).

A far-fetched or unreasonable argument used to justify oneself or win a debate unfairly. Carries a strongly negative nuance. Composed of 屁 (fart) + 理屈 (logic), literally 'fart logic' — logic that stinks.

glosses: to hold a grudge; to bear a grudge
explanations: To harbor resentment over something that happened in the past. The 根 (root) metaphor suggests the grudge is deeply rooted and persistent. Conjugates as a godan verb (持つ).
A person who uses magic. Commonly appears in fairy tales, fantasy stories, and games. Composed of 魔法 (magic) + 使い (user). Can refer to both male and female magic users.
A violent disturbance by a group of people, typically directed against authority or in protest. Composed of 暴 (violence) + 動 (movement). Used in news reporting and historical contexts.

glosses: having an idea; clue; something that comes to mind
explanations: A vague idea or recollection about something, often used when someone might know the cause, location, or person involved. Frequently used with ある (to have) or ない (to not have).
The state of remaining the same without change. Used for abstract concepts like truths, principles, and values that do not change over time. Composed of 不 (not) + 変 (change).

A person who has just joined a company. In Japan, most new employees start in April after graduating from university. Composed of 新入 (newly entering) + 社員 (company employee). Often abbreviated to 新人 in casual speech.

An extremely brief moment in time. Originally a Buddhist term for the shortest possible unit of time. Used in literary and dramatic contexts to describe a fleeting instant, often at a critical or climactic point.

glosses: to approach; to come near; to draw close
explanations: To move physically closer to someone or something. Can also be used figuratively for approaching a topic or person emotionally. An intransitive godan verb with the ～に particle marking the target.
Agreeing immediately without hesitation, as if answering 'yes, yes' (saying はい twice). Used to describe enthusiastic or unhesitating acceptance of a request or proposal.

glosses: street corner; corner of a town
explanations: A corner where streets meet in an urban area. Also used more broadly to mean 'around town' or 'in the streets,' suggesting an everyday urban setting.
Items that are indispensable for daily life, travel, work, or a specific purpose. Composed of 必需 (indispensable) + 品 (goods). Often appears in lists and recommendations.

A traditional Japanese percussion instrument made from a wooden body with animal skin stretched over both ends. Used in festivals, shrine rituals, performing arts, and modern ensemble performances. Composed of 和 (Japanese) + 太鼓 (drum).

glosses: excelling in two roles or fields simultaneously
explanations: A sword-fighting style using a sword in each hand. Famously associated with the legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi.
By extension, a person who handles two different roles, skills, or positions at the same time. Widely popularized in modern usage by baseball player Ohtani Shohei, who pitches and bats.

glosses: breaking off a friendship; severing ties
explanations: Completely ending a friendship or personal relationship. A decisive, permanent break rather than a temporary falling out. Composed of 絶 (sever) + 交 (association).

A state of physical exhaustion, loss of appetite, and general malaise caused by prolonged exposure to summer heat and humidity. A common condition in Japan's hot and humid summers. Composed of 夏 (summer) + バテる (to be worn out).

glosses: house-sitting; looking after the house while others are away
explanations: Staying at home to watch over the house or office while others are out. Also refers to the person who stays behind. Composed of 留守 (absence from home) + 番 (watch/guard).
Making a strong impression; leaving a vivid memory. Used to describe scenes, words, performances, and experiences that stand out. Composed of 印象 (impression) + 的 (adjectival suffix).
Doing something covertly, without others knowing. Used as a な-adjective to describe secret actions or operations.
A person sent on a covert mission, especially in the Edo period. Refers to agents employed by the shogunate or feudal lords to gather intelligence or conduct surveillance.
Having qualities traditionally associated with an ideal man — courage, decisiveness, strength of character, and reliability. Can describe both men and women when they display such qualities.

glosses: to buy up; to corner the market; to hoard
explanations: To purchase all or most of a particular product, either to monopolize supply or out of panic. Often used negatively to describe hoarding behavior during shortages or speculative buying.
An area of land that is lower than the surrounding terrain, often near rivers or the coast. Prone to flooding. The opposite of 高地 (highland). Composed of 低 (low) + 地 (ground).
Viewing or photographing distant objects using lenses or optical equipment. Composed of 望 (gaze/hope) + 遠 (distant). Most commonly used in compound words related to optics and photography.

glosses: breaking off (an engagement or deal); falling through
breaking off an engagement, deal, or negotiation; falling through
explanations: The collapse or cancellation of an agreed-upon arrangement, especially a marriage engagement or business deal. Composed of 破 (break) + 談 (talk/discussion). Implies that something that was being discussed or agreed upon has been called off.

glosses: chance encounter; fateful meeting; serendipitous connection
explanations: An unexpected but significant encounter with a person, place, or thing, often implying a sense of destiny or fate. Has a romantic or poetic nuance, suggesting the meeting was meant to be.

A sustained conflict or power struggle between groups. Often used for gang wars, political power struggles, or labor disputes. Composed of 抗 (resist) + 争 (contend). Implies organized, ongoing conflict rather than a single incident.

glosses: condolence; mourning; grief for the deceased
explanations: Expressing sorrow and sympathy for someone who has passed away. A formal word used in official statements, funeral settings, and memorial contexts. Composed of 哀 (sorrow) + 悼 (mourn).

glosses: raindrops falling from eaves or rooftops; dripping rain
explanations: Water dripping from the edge of a roof or eaves during or after rain. Can also refer to the sound or traces left by such dripping. Written as 雨垂れ in full kanji. A word with poetic and seasonal associations.

glosses: the prosperous must decline; all glory is fleeting
explanations: A Buddhist-derived four-character idiom expressing the idea that those who flourish will inevitably fall. One of the most famous phrases from the Tale of the Heike. Composed of 盛者 (the prosperous) + 必衰 (must decline).

One of Japan's most prestigious literary awards, established in 1935 in honor of the writer Akutagawa Ryuunosuke. It is awarded biannually for the best work of serious literary fiction by a new or emerging author, published in a literary magazine.

One of Japan's most prestigious literary awards, established in 1935 in honor of the writer Naoki Sanjuugo. It is awarded biannually for the best work of popular fiction, including mystery, historical, and entertainment novels.

glosses: debut work; maiden work; first work
explanations: An artist's or author's first published or released work. Used for novels, films, music albums, and other creative works.
The practice of interpreting the positions and movements of celestial bodies to predict events and understand personality traits. Distinct from astronomy, which is a natural science.

glosses: aspiration; accidental swallowing into the airway
aspiration; accidental inhalation of food or liquid into the airway
explanations: The unintentional entry of food, liquid, or other material into the trachea and lungs instead of the esophagus. A common medical concern especially among elderly people.
A diplomatic representative of a country, ranking below an ambassador. Historically the chief representative sent to countries with which full ambassadorial relations had not been established.
The very highest or most excellent degree of something. Used to describe something that has reached the pinnacle of quality, status, or importance.
An immeasurably long span of time, or something that lasts forever. Originally a Buddhist term referring to the infinite past or future, now used more broadly in literary and formal contexts.

glosses: blood pressure monitor; blood pressure gauge
explanations: A medical device used to measure blood pressure. Available in both professional clinical models and home-use digital versions.

glosses: severe cold; bitter cold; extreme cold
explanations: Extremely harsh cold weather or temperature. Used to describe the most severe winter conditions.

glosses: drafting; drawing up a plan or proposal
drafting; drawing up; preparing a proposal or plan
explanations: The act of creating a draft of a plan, proposal, bill, or official document. Commonly used in business and government contexts.

glosses: portrait of a beautiful woman; bijin-ga
explanations: A genre of Japanese art, particularly in ukiyo-e woodblock prints, depicting beautiful women. The subjects are often courtesans, geisha, or fashionable women of the era.

glosses: musical staff; sheet music with staff notation
musical staff; staff notation; sheet music
explanations: The set of five horizontal lines used in Western music notation on which notes are written. Also refers to blank staff paper or printed sheet music using this notation system.

glosses: woolen fabric; wool textile; woolen goods
explanations: Fabric or textiles woven from wool yarn. Includes various types of wool cloth used for clothing, blankets, and other products.
A single non-moving image, as opposed to video or animation. Used in technical and media contexts to distinguish photographs or screenshots from moving images.

glosses: rapid approach; quick closing of distance
suddenly becoming close; rapid development of a relationship
explanations: A physical object or person approaching rapidly. Used for vehicles, aircraft, or other objects moving quickly toward something.
A sudden deepening of a personal or diplomatic relationship. Often used in gossip media for romantic relationships or in news for political relations between countries.
Fighting or competition at very close range, where opponents are in direct physical proximity. Used in military, sports, and gaming contexts.

glosses: fever caused by illness; fever from disease
explanations: An elevated body temperature resulting from illness or disease. Distinguished from fever caused by external factors like heat exhaustion.
A container or structure for storing water. Found on building rooftops, underground, or as standalone tanks for water supply, fire prevention, or emergency use.
Thick, muddy waste material, especially the sediment that accumulates in sewage treatment plants, rivers, or industrial processes. Also used for contaminated mud from disasters.

glosses: supplementary budget; revised budget; amended budget
explanations: A budget that modifies the original annual budget, typically passed to fund unexpected expenses such as disaster relief, economic stimulus measures, or policy changes that arise during the fiscal year.

glosses: top-tier; world-class; superb; of the highest caliber
explanations: Exceeding even first-rate quality. Used to describe people, skills, products, or organizations that are among the very best in their field.
A vehicle powered by an electric motor using energy stored in rechargeable batteries, as opposed to a conventional internal combustion engine vehicle.
An ethnic group that constitutes a smaller proportion of a country's total population compared to the majority group. Often discussed in contexts of cultural preservation, rights, and diversity.

glosses: head-on contest; direct confrontation; fair and square fight
explanations: A straightforward, direct contest without tricks, evasion, or indirect tactics. Implies facing a challenge or opponent head-on with full force and sincerity.
Plants that grow naturally at high altitudes, typically above the tree line. They are adapted to harsh conditions including cold temperatures, strong winds, and intense sunlight.

glosses: missed delivery notice; absence notification slip
explanations: A slip left by a delivery driver when the recipient is not home. It contains information for scheduling a redelivery, including a tracking number and contact details.

glosses: hearing a hundred times; hearing something many times
explanations: Hearing about something repeatedly from others rather than experiencing it firsthand. Almost exclusively used in the proverb {百聞|ひゃくぶん}は{一見|いっけん}にしかず (seeing once is better than hearing a hundred times).

glosses: instant adhesive; super glue; instant-bonding glue
explanations: A type of adhesive that bonds surfaces together very quickly, typically within seconds. The most common type is cyanoacrylate-based adhesive.

glosses: to humor someone; to try to please; to curry favor
to humor someone; to try to please; to curry favor with
explanations: To act in a way designed to make someone happy or to get on their good side, often by flattering them or doing what they want. Can have a slightly negative connotation of being insincere.
Describes someone who endures hardship or frustration without giving up. Emphasizes inner strength and the ability to keep going over a long period.
The act of publicly proposing or advocating an idea, theory, or policy. Often used in academic, political, or intellectual contexts where someone puts forward a new concept.

glosses: excellent idea; brilliant plan; bright suggestion
explanations: A particularly good or clever idea or plan. Often used when someone comes up with an unexpectedly effective solution.
Describes something that shows visible signs of age or wear. Used as a pre-noun modifier (the past-tense form of the verb {古|ふる}びる, functioning adjectivally).
The act of formally giving something (rights, authority, points, qualifications) to someone. Used in official, administrative, and business contexts.
The period of heavy traffic and crowded transportation that occurs when large numbers of people travel to their hometowns during major holidays such as New Year, Obon, and Golden Week.
A person who does not belong to a particular group, organization, or area, and therefore has no right to be involved or to enter.
A strong insult for someone considered useless, irresponsible, or morally worthless. Often used by frustrated family members or in dramatic contexts.

glosses: to break into a run; to run out; to dash off
to break into a run; to start running; to dash off
to run out (of a place); to rush out
explanations: To suddenly begin running, often triggered by urgency, excitement, or alarm.
To run out from inside a building or enclosed space.

glosses: restless; fidgety; bustling; unable to settle down
explanations: Describes a state of being unable to relax, constantly feeling rushed or agitated. Can describe either a person's temperament or a hectic atmosphere.
Describes a way of doing things that is methodical, unpretentious, and involves sustained effort rather than shortcuts or flashy methods.
Describes talent, ability, or quality that is clearly above the ordinary level. A somewhat literary or formal way to express admiration for someone's outstanding qualities.
A casual, somewhat childlike expression for being extremely hungry. Often used lightheartedly.

glosses: bearing fruit; fruition; coming to fruition
explanations: The process of a plant producing fruit.
Efforts, plans, or work producing successful results. Used figuratively to describe when sustained effort finally pays off.
The act of creating or drawing up a plan, proposal, or strategy. Used in business, government, and project management contexts.

glosses: to force; to compel; to coerce
explanations: To make someone do something against their will, or to impose something unwanted on someone.
A color between yellow and green, like the color of new leaves in spring or a lime. One of the traditional Japanese color names and one of the standard crayon colors.
A physical object that blocks passage or movement. Also used in sports for hurdles or obstacles in a course.

glosses: classification; type; category; sorting by kind
explanations: The act of classifying items by type, or the resulting categories. Commonly used in administrative, technical, and organizational contexts.

glosses: recapture; recovery; taking back by force
explanations: The act of recovering something that was taken or lost, often implying forceful or determined action. Used in military, sports, and political contexts.

glosses: to distract oneself; to take one's mind off something
explanations: To do something in order to divert one's attention from worry, sadness, boredom, or discomfort.

glosses: running with all one's might; strong run
running with all one's might; powerful run; strong performance (in a race)
explanations: Running as hard as one can, giving maximum effort in a race. Often used in sports commentary to praise a runner's determined effort.
Transferring an unused balance, amount, or entitlement to the next period. Commonly used in accounting, finance, and for things like unused vacation days or data allowances.
Describes a situation where one entity controls something exclusively, shutting out others. Often used in business and economic contexts.

glosses: each to their own; everyone is different
each to their own; everyone has their own way; to each their own
explanations: A four-character compound expressing that different people have different approaches, opinions, or styles. Literally "three people, three ways."

glosses: cherry blossom pink; pale pink; blush pink
explanations: A soft, pale pink color reminiscent of cherry blossoms. One of the traditional Japanese color names, widely associated with spring.

glosses: trifling errand; small bit of business
trifling errand; small bit of business; minor task
explanations: A vague, self-deprecating way to refer to an errand or task one needs to attend to, without specifying the details. Often used as a polite excuse to avoid explaining what one is doing.
A very deep, dark shade of blue, darker than ordinary navy. Commonly used for suits, school uniforms, and formal clothing.

glosses: change of direction; shift in course; about-face
change of course; shift in policy or approach
explanations: Physically turning to go in a different direction, as with a vehicle or person.
A figurative change in strategy, policy, or life direction.

glosses: decisive action; carrying out resolutely; pushing through
explanations: Carrying out a plan or action with determination, especially when there is opposition or difficulty. Implies boldness and resolve.
The general category of fruits in the citrus family, including oranges, lemons, grapefruits, and mandarins.
The sequence of events or background leading to a particular situation. Used when explaining how something came about.
Difficulties or complex factors involved in a situation, often implying interpersonal friction or complicated relationships.

glosses: to throw at; to hurl at
to throw at; to hurl at; to fling at
explanations: To throw something forcefully toward a target, often with hostile or aggressive intent. Can also be used figuratively for words or insults.

glosses: to look down on; to make light of
to look down on; to make light of; to belittle
explanations: To treat something or someone as unimportant or insignificant. Often used in formal or written contexts to describe disrespect or undervaluation.
A standalone residential building, as opposed to an apartment or condominium. Common in real estate and housing contexts.

glosses: to be relieved; to feel reassured
explanations: To experience a feeling of relief after worry or anxiety has been resolved. Commonly used to describe the emotional release when a feared outcome does not occur.

glosses: person of Japanese descent; Japanese emigrant or descendant
explanations: A person of Japanese ancestry living outside Japan, including Japanese emigrants and their descendants. Often used in the context of communities in Brazil, the United States, Peru, and other countries.

glosses: legitimate son; male heir; eldest legitimate son
explanations: The eldest son born to the legal wife, who has the right of succession. A historical and legal term often encountered in discussions of Japanese feudal history, samurai families, and inheritance.

glosses: to visit a shrine or temple to worship
to visit a shrine or temple to worship; to pay one's respects at a sacred place
explanations: To go to a Shinto shrine or Buddhist temple for the purpose of prayer, worship, or paying respects. A central cultural practice in Japanese life.

glosses: personal delivery; handing over directly; hand delivery
explanations: The act of giving something directly to someone by hand, rather than through mail or an intermediary.
The formal act of transferring ownership, rights, or property from one party to another. Used in legal, business, and financial contexts.
The person or side that wins a competition, battle, or contest. Used in sports, games, elections, and figurative contexts.

glosses: head; leader; top official; head of state
explanations: The top leader or leaders of a country, organization, or political party. Frequently used in political and diplomatic contexts.
A professional who adjusts the pitch and tone of pianos and other keyboard instruments to ensure correct intonation.
Relating to or requiring expert knowledge in a particular field. Describes things that are not general but belong to a specific area of expertise.
A traditional Japanese storehouse with thick earthen walls designed to be fireproof and protect valuables, foodstuffs, and heirlooms. A distinctive feature of traditional Japanese architecture.
The act of giving concrete form to an abstract idea, ideal, or concept. Often used in formal or literary contexts to describe making something tangible.
A financial instrument representing a loan made by an investor to a borrower, typically a government or corporation. The issuer pays interest and returns the principal at maturity.

glosses: to take lightly; to underestimate; to not take seriously
explanations: To fail to recognize the difficulty or seriousness of something, or to look down on someone's ability. A common idiomatic expression used as a warning or criticism.

glosses: veterinary hospital; animal clinic; vet's office
explanations: A medical facility that provides healthcare for animals, especially pets. The standard term used in Japan for a veterinary practice.
The period or condition following a surgical procedure. Used in medical contexts to describe recovery, complications, or care after an operation.

glosses: sense of shame; modesty; feelings of embarrassment
explanations: The innate feeling of shame or embarrassment that prevents a person from behaving in an improper or indecent manner. A psychological and moral concept.
Not accurate or exact. Used to describe information, data, measurements, or statements that contain errors or lack precision.

A continuous downward movement in numbers, quality, or performance, visualized as a line on a graph sloping down from left to right. Used for economic indicators, sales, population, and other measurable trends.

glosses: to finish a race; to run to completion
to finish a race; to run the entire course; to complete a race
explanations: To run or complete a race from start to finish, especially a long-distance race like a marathon. Can also be used figuratively for completing something challenging from beginning to end.
A competition in which participants race to see who is the fastest, typically on foot. Used for track events, horse racing, and other speed competitions.
Indicates that the speaker cannot explain the reason for something. Expresses puzzlement about why a situation exists or an event occurred.
Having a refined, elegant, or fashionable quality. Used to describe clothing, decor, restaurants, and overall aesthetic sense.
Having a sophisticated sense of humor or cleverness in expression. Describes remarks, behavior, or naming that show intelligence and taste.

The third-largest and southwesternmost of Japan's four main islands. It includes the prefectures of Fukuoka, Saga, Nagasaki, Kumamoto, Oita, Miyazaki, and Kagoshima. Known for its hot springs, volcanoes, and distinct regional cuisine.
So terrible or extreme as to be frightening or shocking. Used to describe scenes, situations, or experiences of extreme severity.
Of extraordinary intensity or ferocity, often describing battles, competition, or struggles that push beyond normal limits.
A formal term for an older person, typically referring to those aged 65 and over. Widely used in official, medical, and media contexts.
A sweet potato that has been slowly roasted, traditionally sold by street vendors in autumn and winter. A beloved Japanese comfort food.
Lacking a regular pattern or consistency. Often used as a な-adjective to describe schedules, habits, or patterns that are not consistent.
An item that has been lost by its owner. A formal term used in official, legal, and transportation contexts such as train stations and police offices.

glosses: insurance money; insurance payout; insurance benefit
explanations: The money paid out by an insurance company when a claim is made, such as after an accident, illness, or death.

glosses: complete defeat; total loss; utter defeat
explanations: A thorough, decisive defeat with no redeeming factors. Often used in sports and competitions.
Valuable possessions or financial resources owned by a person, company, or organization. Used broadly in financial, legal, and everyday contexts.
Something happening suddenly and without warning. Often used for accidents, incidents, or events that occur unexpectedly.
Relating to or occurring once a year. Used as a prefix or modifier in formal and business contexts.
The number of years one has been in a position, organization, or academic program.
Describes someone behaving completely unaffected or unbothered by something that would normally cause distress, embarrassment, or lingering effects.
Describes a complete recovery from illness or a total forgetting of something, with no trace remaining.

glosses: feeling of helplessness; sense of powerlessness
explanations: The emotional state of feeling unable to do anything or make a difference. Often experienced in the face of overwhelming circumstances.
The initial teaching or introduction to a skill, art, or discipline. Implies personal, hands-on guidance from someone experienced.

glosses: person who has experienced hardship; self-made person
explanations: Someone who has gone through significant difficulties and hardships in life. Often carries a positive nuance of resilience and maturity gained through struggle.

glosses: half a month; about two weeks
explanations: A period of approximately fifteen days, or half of a calendar month.
A fixed expression consisting of four kanji characters, often derived from classical Chinese. These are a distinctive feature of the Japanese language and are commonly tested in school examinations.
An honorific term used to refer to the recipient's company in written correspondence such as business letters, emails, and job application documents.

glosses: book design; bookbinding; book cover design
explanations: The overall design and physical production of a book, including the cover, binding, paper choice, and layout. In modern usage, often refers specifically to the cover and jacket design.

glosses: examination room; consulting room; doctor's office
explanations: The room in a hospital or clinic where a doctor examines and consults with patients.
The structural frame surrounding a window, including the sill and casing.

glosses: giving directions; showing the way; guiding someone
explanations: The act of showing someone how to get to a destination, or a person or thing that serves as a guide.

glosses: short essay; essay (for exams or applications)
explanations: A brief essay, typically written as part of university entrance exams or job applications in Japan. Usually requires the writer to present and argue a position on a given topic.
A fortified structure or walled enclosure built for military defense. Used for both Japanese and foreign fortifications.

glosses: book spine; spine of a book
explanations: The narrow side of a book visible when it is shelved, typically displaying the title, author, and publisher.

glosses: to defeat; to beat; to overcome
explanations: To win decisively against an opponent in a competition, battle, or contest. Emphasizes a clear, forceful victory.
The act of cutting off or blocking the flow or passage of something, such as electricity, sound, light, or access.
A break or pause in the middle of an activity, event, or period. Can refer to a literal rest period or a temporary lull in something ongoing.
A period at the beginning of employment during which a new employee's performance and suitability are evaluated. Also used for trial periods of products or services.

glosses: rejection (of an application); not being hired; not being adopted
explanations: The result of not being selected in a job application, proposal, or submission. The opposite of being accepted or hired.
The origin or provider of information. Used in journalism, research, and general contexts to refer to where information comes from.

glosses: periodic medical checkup; regular health screening
explanations: A routine medical examination conducted at regular intervals to monitor health and detect problems early. Includes both general health checkups and specialized screenings.
A young tree grown from seed or cutting, typically ready for transplanting. Used in gardening, forestry, and agriculture.
Something received in return for good deeds or effort. A positive outcome that comes as a result of one's actions.
Negative consequences that come as a result of bad deeds or wrongdoing. Often carries a sense of karmic justice.
A disease caused by pathogenic microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites that can spread from person to person or through other means of transmission.
A building with only one floor, as opposed to a multi-story structure. Common in residential architecture, especially in suburban and rural Japan.
Describes something so common that it is unremarkable or uninteresting. Often carries a slightly dismissive or negative nuance, implying a lack of originality or distinction.
An area that cannot be seen from a particular viewpoint, such as a driver's blind spot or an area not covered by a security camera.
A figurative gap or weakness in a plan, system, or defense that has been overlooked or is difficult to notice.

glosses: reaching a stopping point; settling down
reaching a stopping point; settling down; coming to a stage
explanations: The state of having completed a phase of work or a situation reaching a point where one can pause. Implies that while things are not fully finished, a natural break has been reached.
The act of thinking deeply and carefully about philosophical, abstract, or complex matters. Implies sustained, serious intellectual reflection rather than casual thinking.
The act of looking back on and recalling past events or experiences, often with a sense of nostalgia or emotion. A literary and somewhat formal word.
The qualities, feelings, or instincts associated with being a mother, including the natural drive to nurture and protect one's children.

glosses: noisy; tumultuous; in an uproar; agitated
explanations: Describes a state of noisy commotion or agitation, typically involving a group of people or a place that has become disturbed by an unexpected or shocking event.
Describes something impressively bright, distinguished, or praiseworthy. Used for achievements, records, futures, and other things worthy of admiration.

glosses: to one's heart's content; fully; as much as one likes
explanations: Doing something without restraint or limit, to the full extent of one's desire. Implies freedom to enjoy or act without holding back.
Describes a person who is generous and open-handed, especially with money. Can be used as a noun (a generous person) or as a na-adjective (generous).
Additional notes or comments appended to a document, form, or record for supplementary information. Commonly seen as a section heading on official forms and documents.

The mathematical operation of rounding a number to the nearest whole number or specified decimal place. Literally means 'discard four, enter five' — values below five are rounded down and values of five or above are rounded up.
A formal written document submitted to one's employer to officially notify them of one's intention to resign. In Japan, this is a binding notification that cannot be withdrawn once accepted.

glosses: supporting an entire group; being a fan of all members
explanations: In idol and entertainment fandom, the practice of supporting and cheering for an entire group or unit rather than having a single favorite member. The term comes from thinking of the group as a 'box' (unit) to support.

glosses: the original (document); original copy; master copy
explanations: The authentic, first-created version of a document, as opposed to copies, duplicates, or translations. Used in legal, administrative, and publishing contexts.
A general term encompassing both pottery (earthenware/stoneware) and porcelain. Refers to objects made from clay that are shaped and fired in a kiln.
Skillful physical feats performed for entertainment, such as juggling, tightrope walking, or other circus-like performances requiring exceptional dexterity or balance.
The illegal hunting, capturing, or killing of wild animals, especially protected or endangered species. Also includes hunting without a license or outside permitted seasons.
A watercraft capable of operating underwater. Used primarily in military contexts, but also for research and exploration vessels.
A large warship designed to serve as a mobile airbase, carrying and launching military aircraft. An abbreviation of {航空母艦|こうくうぼかん}.
A culture different from one's own. Often used as a modifier in compounds relating to cross-cultural experiences, understanding, and exchange.

glosses: teacup saucer; coaster for a teacup
explanations: A small saucer or coaster placed under a Japanese teacup to catch drips and protect the surface beneath. Typically made of wood, lacquer, or bamboo.

glosses: articles of incorporation; company charter; bylaws
explanations: The foundational legal document of a corporation that sets out its purpose, structure, and rules of governance. Required when establishing a company in Japan.

glosses: damage report; report to the police
damage report; crime report; report filed with the police
explanations: A formal report submitted to the police notifying them that one has been the victim of a crime or has suffered damage or loss. Filing this report is the first step in a police investigation.
The seat or compartment from which a pilot operates an aircraft, or more broadly, the control position in any vehicle or craft.

glosses: defaulting on a debt; skipping out on a bill
defaulting on a debt; non-payment; skipping out on a bill
explanations: The act of deliberately failing to pay a debt, loan, or bill. Implies intentional avoidance of payment rather than inability to pay.
A small, simple meal as opposed to a full course. Often refers to sandwiches, onigiri, or other quick fare served at cafes, airports, and convenience stores.
A person's identity, including their name, address, occupation, and family background. Often used in the context of verification, investigation, or guaranteeing someone's character.
Land that belongs to or is under the control of a country or ruler. Used in political, historical, and legal contexts to refer to sovereign territory.
The act of restricting someone's freedom of action or movement, whether physically, socially, or emotionally. Often used for controlling behavior in relationships or oppressive rules.

glosses: view; prospect; outlook; scenery from a high point
explanations: The view or panorama visible from an elevated or open location. Emphasizes the breadth and quality of what can be seen.

glosses: complete set; full kit; everything needed
explanations: A full set of items that together form a complete collection or kit. Used when referring to all the necessary items for a particular purpose.

glosses: wild beast; ferocious animal; beast of prey
explanations: A large, dangerous animal such as a lion, tiger, or bear. Used in contexts involving zoos, wildlife, and figurative descriptions of fierceness.
A facility where convicted criminals are confined as punishment. A somewhat formal or literary word for prison.

glosses: crown prince; heir to the throne
explanations: The son of an emperor or king who is next in line to inherit the throne. In Japan, this title refers specifically to the heir apparent of the Emperor.

glosses: loss of contact; being out of touch
loss of contact; being out of touch; no communication
explanations: A state in which someone cannot be reached and no news or communication comes from them. Used when contact with a person has been completely lost.

glosses: a pause; a milestone; a break
a pause; a milestone; a break; a stopping point
explanations: A natural stopping point or milestone in a task, project, or period of time. Used when something reaches a convenient or logical break.
A place in a body of water where the depth is shallow, such as a sandbar in the sea or a shallow stretch of a river that can be waded across.

glosses: negligence; neglect; procrastination; laziness in duty
explanations: Failure to carry out one's duties or responsibilities properly due to laziness or carelessness. Often used in formal or professional contexts as a criticism.

glosses: cold treatment; inhospitable reception; being treated poorly
explanations: Being treated coldly or unfavorably, especially in a professional or social setting. The opposite of preferential or warm treatment.
Working for oneself rather than being employed by a company. Encompasses freelancers, shop owners, and independent professionals.
Calling out names or numbers to check attendance, typically in military, school, workplace, or emergency contexts.
People coming together and cooperating for a common purpose, especially in the face of adversity or to achieve a shared goal.

glosses: no vacancy; fully booked; all rooms occupied
explanations: A state in which all rooms in a hotel, inn, or similar facility are occupied and no more guests can be accommodated.
Not definite or reliable; lacking certainty. Used for situations, information, or outcomes that cannot be predicted or depended upon with confidence.

glosses: to do one's best; to give it one's all
to do one's best; to give it one's all; to exert all one's effort
explanations: To put forth maximum effort toward a goal. A strong, determined expression often used in formal speeches, sports, and professional contexts.

glosses: to thank someone for their effort; to show appreciation for hard work
to thank someone for their effort; to show appreciation for hard work; to reward with kind words
explanations: To express gratitude or appreciation for someone's labor, effort, or service. Typically directed from an equal or superior toward someone who has worked hard.

glosses: to feel dizzy; to be dazzled; to be blinded
to feel dizzy; to have one's head spin
to be dazzled; to be blinded; to lose one's judgment
explanations: To experience a sensation of dizziness or lightheadedness, often from looking down from a height or standing up suddenly.
To have one's vision or judgment impaired, either by bright light or figuratively by greed, desire, or temptation.

glosses: lucky charm; good-luck item; talisman; auspicious object
explanations: An object believed to bring good fortune. In Japanese culture, this includes items like daruma dolls, beckoning cats (maneki-neko), and certain foods served at New Year.

glosses: prison break; jailbreak; escape from prison
explanations: The act of escaping from a prison or jail. Used in news reports, crime fiction, and historical accounts.
The act of confining someone in prison, typically as punishment for a crime. A formal term used in legal and news contexts.

glosses: driving the wrong way; going against traffic
driving the wrong way; going against traffic; wrong-way driving
explanations: Driving or running in the opposite direction of the designated flow, especially on highways or one-way roads. A serious traffic violation that frequently makes the news in Japan.

glosses: dejection; depression; being dispirited; low spirits
explanations: A state of having lost one's enthusiasm or motivation, feeling downcast or demoralized. A four-character compound expressing deep discouragement.

glosses: innocent look; feigning ignorance; nonchalant expression
innocent look; nonchalant expression; feigning ignorance; acting as if nothing happened
explanations: A facial expression or demeanor that conceals one's true feelings or knowledge of something, pretending that nothing unusual has occurred.
Maintaining a calm, unperturbed demeanor in a situation where most people would be flustered, embarrassed, or upset. Often implies a surprising or even brazen level of composure.
The maximum speed legally permitted on a road or in a given area. Also used more broadly for speed restrictions on data transfer, machinery, etc.

To stir or mix something by moving it around vigorously, typically with a utensil or by hand. Used for cooking (stirring ingredients), mixing liquids, or figuratively for throwing things into disorder.
The practice or industry of hunting whales. A historically and politically significant topic in Japan, where whaling has a long cultural tradition. Composed of 捕 (catch) + 鯨 (whale).

A room with Western-style flooring (hardwood, carpet, etc.) and furnishings such as beds and chairs, as opposed to a traditional Japanese-style room with tatami mats. Composed of 洋 (Western/ocean) + 室 (room).
The part of a telephone that you hold to your ear and speak into. By extension, also used for the handset of a landline phone as a whole. Composed of 受 (receive) + 話 (speech) + 器 (device).
A television or radio station; the organization or facility that produces and transmits broadcast content. Composed of 放送 (broadcasting) + 局 (bureau/station).

glosses: on a completely different scale; orders of magnitude different
explanations: Describes something that differs enormously in scale, degree, or level — literally 'different digit/column,' meaning the number of digits is different. Used to emphasize how dramatically one thing surpasses another.
A state of strained or poor relations between people, especially family members, friends, or colleagues. Composed of 不 (not) + 仲 (relationship/terms).
A site where minerals, metals, or other geological materials are extracted from the earth. Composed of 鉱 (ore/mineral) + 山 (mountain).

glosses: first ten days of a month; early part of a month
explanations: The first third of a month, roughly days 1-10. Part of a three-way division of the month into 初旬 (early), 中旬 (mid), and 下旬 (late). Composed of 初 (beginning) + 旬 (ten-day period).

glosses: to wash off; to rinse away
explanations: To remove dirt, soap, or other substances by rinsing with water. A compound verb formed from 洗う (to wash) + 流す (to flush/drain away). Can also be used figuratively for washing away feelings or memories.
A strong feeling of dislike, repulsion, or moral disapproval toward something or someone. Composed of 嫌悪 (disgust/aversion) + 感 (feeling).

glosses: feeling of discomfort; unpleasant feeling; displeasure
explanations: An unpleasant or uncomfortable sensation, whether physical (nausea, irritation) or emotional (annoyance, displeasure). Composed of 不快 (unpleasant) + 感 (feeling).

A medicated adhesive patch applied to the skin to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, or treat injuries. In modern Japanese, this most commonly refers to pain-relief patches available at pharmacies. Composed of 湿 (moist) + 布 (cloth).

The act of copying or imitating someone or something, whether in art, behavior, or technique. Often carries a neutral or slightly negative nuance, suggesting a lack of originality. Can be used as a suru-verb. Composed of 模 (model/pattern) + 倣 (emulate).
The quantity of matter in a body, a fundamental property in physics. Distinguished from weight, which varies with gravity. Composed of 質 (quality/substance) + 量 (quantity).

Something out of the ordinary or abnormal, often implying a sudden or alarming change. Used for natural disasters, health problems, political upheavals, or any unexpected development. Composed of 異 (different/unusual) + 変 (change).

glosses: to demolish; to tear down; to pull down
explanations: To deliberately destroy a building or structure, typically as part of a planned demolition or redevelopment. A compound verb formed from 取り (taking action) + 壊す (to break/destroy).

glosses: exerting oneself; rousing oneself to action
explanations: Spending more money than usual, often as a special treat or gesture of generosity. The most common modern usage.
Summoning up energy, courage, or determination to tackle something. Composed of 奮 (rouse/stir up) + 発 (emit/express).

A strong desire to achieve something, especially power, wealth, or status. Unlike the English word 'ambition,' 野心 often carries a negative or suspicious nuance — implying aggressive, self-serving, or potentially unscrupulous motives. Composed of 野 (wild/field) + 心 (heart).

glosses: tough; tenacious; resilient; strong and flexible
explanations: Describes something that is both strong and flexible, able to withstand stress without breaking. Used for physical materials, bodies, or figuratively for mental fortitude and willpower. Composed of 強 (strong) + 靭 (tough/pliant).
Lacking compassion or mercy; showing no pity. Used to describe people, actions, or abstract forces (like fate or nature) that are unforgiving. Composed of 無 (without) + 慈悲 (mercy/compassion).

glosses: to gasp; to pant; to struggle
to gasp; to pant; to breathe hard
to struggle; to suffer under hardship
explanations: To breathe with difficulty, as from physical exertion, pain, or illness.
To be in a state of difficulty or distress, struggling under the weight of problems such as poverty, debt, or oppression. A figurative extension of the physical gasping sense.

glosses: fortune; luck; one's fate or destiny
explanations: The course of one's luck or fortune, especially as predicted by horoscopes, fortune-telling, or divination. Often used in the context of forecasts about how lucky or unlucky someone will be. Composed of 運 (fortune/luck) + 勢 (force/trend).
A preliminary version of a document, plan, or law that is subject to revision. Commonly used in legal, political, and business contexts. Composed of 草 (grass/rough) + 案 (plan/idea).
A venue designed for athletic competitions and sporting events. Can refer to both large stadiums and smaller athletic facilities. Composed of 競技 (competition/athletic event) + 場 (place).
The act of avoiding or shunning something one dislikes or finds distasteful. Used for both physical avoidance and psychological aversion.
In legal contexts, the process of disqualifying or requesting the removal of a judge or official due to bias or conflict of interest.

glosses: behind something; in the shadows; cover
behind something; in the shadow of an object; cover
explanations: The area hidden behind an object, where one cannot easily be seen. Often used to describe hiding or observing from behind objects. Composed of 物 (thing/object) + 陰 (shadow/shade).

glosses: roundabout approach; indirect way of doing something
explanations: A longer, indirect route taken instead of the most direct path, whether by necessity (road closure) or by choice.
A figurative detour — taking a longer or less efficient approach to achieving a goal. Can imply either inefficiency or a valuable learning experience.

glosses: way of speaking; manner of speech
way of speaking; manner of speech; how one talks
explanations: The style, tone, or manner in which a person speaks. Encompasses word choice, speed, intonation, and overall delivery. Composed of 話し (speaking) + 方 (way/method).

glosses: to take on; to shoulder; to burden oneself with
explanations: To take on a heavy responsibility, burden, or problem — often more than one should or can handle. A compound verb formed from 背負う (to carry on one's back) + 込む (into/deeply). Almost always used figuratively for emotional, financial, or social burdens.
A deep feeling of hostility or ill will toward someone or something. Derived from the verb 憎む (to hate). Stronger and more sustained than 嫌い (dislike).
The very best quality available. Composed of 極 (extreme) + 上 (upper/top). Used to describe premium goods, food, or services that are of the highest grade.
Describes something that feels out of date, behind the times, or no longer in style. Carries a negative connotation — the speaker finds the thing undesirably old.
Describes a smell or atmosphere that feels stagnant or old, as if something has been sitting for too long.
An absorbent garment worn by babies or those who are incontinent. Originally from むつき (swaddling cloth) with the honorific prefix お. Both disposable (紙おむつ) and cloth (布おむつ) types exist.

A traditional Japanese soup made with dashi broth, lightly seasoned with soy sauce and salt. Unlike miso soup, it has a clear, transparent broth. Typically served in a lacquered bowl as part of a formal or semi-formal Japanese meal.

glosses: to be greedy; to want too much
to be greedy; to want too much; to be grasping
explanations: To try to get more than one's fair share or more than is reasonable. Composed of 欲 (desire) + 張る (to stretch/extend). Often used as a warning or criticism.

glosses: difference (in price or amount); balance; margin
explanations: The numerical difference between two amounts, prices, or values. Composed of 差 (difference) + 額 (amount). Commonly used in financial and business contexts.
Something that a person is deliberately keeping from others. Composed of 隠す (to hide) + 事 (thing/matter). Implies a personal secret that the person does not want revealed.

Describes treating someone with careful politeness and respect, especially in formal situations. Implies a deliberate, attentive manner of showing respect. Often used to describe the way someone declines, greets, or treats guests.

glosses: to push aside; to shove out of the way
explanations: To physically move someone or something out of one's path by pushing. A compound of 押す (to push) + のける (to move aside).
To disregard or overcome opposition, objections, or rivals in order to proceed. Used figuratively for pushing past obstacles.

glosses: flash of inspiration; sudden idea; stroke of genius
explanations: A sudden, intuitive idea or insight that comes to mind without deliberate thought. Derived from the verb ひらめく (to flash, to strike upon an idea).

Describes something that appeals to or is characteristic of ordinary people, as opposed to being elite or high-class. Often used positively to praise affordability, approachability, or a lack of pretension.

glosses: dual use; multipurpose; serving double duty
dual use; serving two purposes; multipurpose
explanations: Using one thing for two or more purposes, or something designed to serve multiple functions. Composed of 兼 (to combine/double as) + 用 (use). Can be used as a noun or a suru-verb.

glosses: advance payment; prepayment; paying in advance
explanations: Payment made before goods are delivered or services are rendered. Composed of 前 (before) + 払い (payment). The opposite of 後払い (payment after receipt).

glosses: land reclamation; clearing land for cultivation
explanations: The act of clearing untouched or wild land to make it suitable for farming or other productive use. Composed of 開 (to open) + 墾 (to cultivate). Used as a noun or suru-verb.

A male relative who is like an older brother but not by blood — typically a spouse's older brother, or a stepbrother who is older. Composed of 義 (righteousness/adopted) + 兄 (older brother). A formal term used in writing and official contexts.

glosses: set phrase; template text; boilerplate; stock phrase
explanations: A fixed, standardized piece of text used repeatedly in similar situations. Composed of 定型 (fixed form) + 文 (text/sentence). Common in business emails, official documents, and digital communication.
A person who has fled from custody, punishment, or a dangerous situation. Composed of 逃亡 (flight/escape) + 者 (person). Used in legal, news, and narrative contexts.
A coin made of silver or a coin with silver content. Composed of 銀 (silver) + 貨 (currency/coin). Used in historical, numismatic, and literary contexts.

glosses: muddy stream; turbid torrent; raging muddy waters
explanations: A fast-flowing body of water that is murky with mud and debris, typically caused by heavy rain, flooding, or a natural disaster. Composed of 濁 (muddy/turbid) + 流 (flow/current).

glosses: maneuvering; managing; conduct in social situations
fight scene; sword-fighting scene; stage combat
explanations: The way a person handles themselves, navigates situations, or manages interactions — especially in business or politics. Implies skillful or strategic behavior.
A choreographed fight scene in kabuki, film, or theater. Originally from kabuki terminology for on-stage combat.

glosses: manuscript paper; Japanese writing grid paper
explanations: Paper printed with a grid of squares, each designed to hold one character. The standard format has 400 squares (20 columns × 20 rows). Used for writing essays, compositions, and manuscripts in Japanese schools and by authors.
A party or gathering held to welcome a new member, colleague, or guest. Composed of 歓迎 (welcome) + 会 (gathering). Very common in Japanese workplace and school culture.
The physical effect of electric current passing through the body. Composed of 感 (feel/sense) + 電 (electricity). Used as a noun or suru-verb. Ranges from a minor jolt to a fatal shock.
Describes thinking, knowledge, or character that lacks depth or substance. Composed of 浅 (shallow) + 薄 (thin). A distinctly negative, critical term used in formal or literary contexts.

glosses: hairdressing; hair styling; grooming one's hair
explanations: The act of arranging or styling hair to make it neat and presentable. Composed of 整 (arrange/put in order) + 髪 (hair). Used as a noun or suru-verb.
Indicates that a product contains no added fragrance or perfume. Composed of 無 (without) + 香料 (fragrance/perfume). Common on product labels for cosmetics, detergents, and personal care items.

The demand for goods and services within a country's own economy, as opposed to demand from exports. Composed of 内 (internal) + 需 (demand). A key economic term used in news, policy discussions, and business.

A person who lacks courage, determination, or backbone. Composed of 意気地 (spirit/guts) + なし (without). Used as both a noun (coward) and a na-adjective (cowardly). A common insult or self-deprecating expression.

glosses: limited express ticket; express surcharge ticket
explanations: A supplementary ticket required in addition to a base fare ticket to ride a limited express (特急) train in Japan. Composed of 特急 (limited express) + 券 (ticket). Without this ticket, passengers cannot ride reserved or non-reserved cars on limited express services.

A party held at the end of the year, typically in December, where coworkers, friends, or club members gather to celebrate and forget the troubles of the past year. Literally 'forget the year gathering.' A deeply ingrained custom in Japanese workplace and social culture.
Describes a choice, action, or result that is free from risk or objection—not outstanding but unlikely to cause problems. Often used when recommending a conservative or middle-of-the-road option.
A water-based skincare product applied to the face after washing to hydrate and prepare the skin for further care. A staple in Japanese skincare routines for both men and women.

glosses: abstinence from alcohol; prohibition of alcohol
abstinence from alcohol; giving up drinking
explanations: The act of refraining from drinking alcohol, either temporarily or permanently, often for health reasons or personal discipline.
A law or regulation banning the sale or consumption of alcohol. Used historically to refer to alcohol prohibition movements or policies.
Indicates that a state continues unexpectedly up to the present moment. Often carries a sense of surprise or frustration that something has not yet changed. Frequently used with negative predicates.

An unnecessary addition that spoils or detracts from what was already complete. From a Chinese fable in which a man, having drawn a snake faster than anyone else, ruined his picture by adding legs to it. Literally 'snake legs.'
Confections that are baked in an oven, such as cookies, cakes, madeleines, and similar items. Contrasts with {生菓子|なまがし} (fresh confections) which are not baked or have a short shelf life.
Indicates that an action should be carried out swiftly and without unnecessary delay. A formal, written-register word commonly found in official notices, instructions, and business communication.

glosses: bargain item; sale item; special-offer product
explanations: A product being sold at a reduced price during a special sale or promotion. Composed of {特売|とくばい} (special sale) + {品|ひん} (item).

glosses: second generation; successor; the second to hold a title or position
explanations: The second person to hold a particular name, title, or leadership position, especially in family businesses, traditional arts, or hereditary roles. Composed of {二|に} (two) + {代目|だいめ} (generation-counter).

A type of mochi made by kneading mugwort (よもぎ) into glutinous rice dough, giving it a distinctive green color and herbal aroma. Often filled with sweet red bean paste. A traditional springtime confection.

The act of following or conforming to a standard, rule, or authority. Often used in technical, legal, and business contexts to indicate that something meets or follows a particular specification or guideline.

glosses: short sentence; short passage; brief text
explanations: A sentence or passage that is short in length. Often used in language learning, exams, and writing exercises to describe brief pieces of text.
Describes technology or methods that work without physical contact, such as contactless payment systems, sensors, or thermometers. Composed of {非|ひ} (non-) + {接触|せっしょく} (contact).

glosses: to push away; to reject coldly
to push away; to shove off
to reject coldly; to cast off; to refuse to help
explanations: To physically push someone or something away from oneself with force.
To emotionally distance oneself from someone by refusing their pleas, requests, or dependence. Used figuratively to describe a cold or detached attitude.
The amount of space inside a container or enclosed area, measured in cubic units. Used in technical, scientific, and everyday contexts to describe how much a container can hold.
The process of applying color to fabric, thread, or other materials using dye. Used for textile production, traditional crafts, and artistic purposes.
The technique of applying a stain to biological specimens such as cells or tissues to make structures visible under a microscope.
The condition of being unable to conceive a child despite regular attempts. Used in medical and general contexts. Composed of {不|ふ} (non-) + {妊|にん} (pregnancy).
A reduction in interest rates, typically by a central bank as a monetary policy measure. Composed of {利|り} (interest) + {下|さ}げ (lowering).
The process or industry of making paper from raw materials such as wood pulp. Composed of {製|せい} (manufacture) + {紙|し} (paper).

The act of entering a venue again after having left, such as a concert hall, stadium, theme park, or exhibition. Often subject to specific rules or restrictions. Composed of {再|さい} (again) + {入場|にゅうじょう} (entry).

A supernatural invocation intended to bring harm, misfortune, or suffering upon someone. Also used figuratively to describe a persistent negative influence or bad luck that seems to follow a person or place.

One of the three categories of Japanese honorific language ({敬語|けいご}). Polite language uses forms like です and ます to show general politeness toward the listener, without specifically elevating or humbling anyone. It is the most commonly used type of {敬語|けいご}.
The act of reading text out loud, as opposed to reading silently. A common practice in Japanese schools and language learning.
A mistake or deficiency caused by failing to attend to something that should have been handled. Implies that the error was due to carelessness or insufficient attention rather than inability.
The original published version of a book or other printed work. In book collecting, first editions can hold significant value. Composed of {初|しょ} (first) + {版|はん} (edition/printing).
A problematic aspect or shortcoming of something, especially one that prevents it from being ideal. Composed of {難|なん} (difficulty) + {点|てん} (point).

glosses: in name only; nominal; only in title
explanations: Describes something or someone that holds a title, name, or label but lacks the substance, authority, or quality that the name implies. Carries a critical or dismissive nuance.

glosses: paternal side; father's side (of the family)
paternal side; father's side of the family
explanations: Refers to relatives, lineage, or characteristics coming from the father's side of the family. Used when distinguishing between maternal and paternal family lines.
The second-born daughter in a family. Used in formal contexts such as official documents, introductions, and family registers.
A room or building where prisoners are kept. Often evokes a traditional or historical image of confinement, such as cells with bars.

glosses: large grain; large drop; large-sized (fruit, bead, etc.)
explanations: Describes something that comes in individual units (grains, drops, berries, etc.) that are notably large in size. Often used as a modifier with の.

glosses: matching set; complete set; uniform appearance
explanations: A group of items or people that are matched or coordinated in appearance. Also used to describe the quality or caliber of a group.
A Shinto ritual performed by a priest to cleanse people, places, or objects of impurities, evil spirits, or bad luck. Commonly performed at shrines for various occasions.
The person officially registered as the representative of a household, particularly in administrative and legal contexts such as the resident register ({住民票|じゅうみんひょう}).
The tall tower at an airport from which air traffic controllers direct the movement of aircraft on the ground and in the air.

glosses: sea surface; surface of the sea
explanations: The surface of the ocean or sea, as observed from above or at water level.
The average level of the sea's surface, used as a baseline for measuring elevation. Often appears in the compound 海面上昇 (sea level rise).

glosses: ancient document; historical document; old manuscript
explanations: Official or private documents from past eras, preserved as historical records. Includes letters, decrees, contracts, and other written materials from pre-modern Japan.
The standard layout or template for writing documents, letters, or forms. Refers to both the structure of the document and blank forms to be filled in.
Unusually fast growth or expansion, typically used for businesses, economies, or industries. Can also be used with する as a verb.

glosses: warming up; idling to warm up (an engine)
explanations: Warm air, especially as a meteorological term referring to a warm air mass or warm front.
The act of running an engine at idle to bring it to operating temperature before driving. Also written as 暖機.

glosses: baby talk; child language; infant speech
explanations: Simplified words and expressions used by or with small children. Includes words like わんわん (doggy), ぶーぶー (car), まんま (food), and other childish vocabulary.
Being attached to or working exclusively for a particular organization, person, or group. Used as a modifier with の to describe someone or something assigned on a dedicated basis.

glosses: guardian deity; patron saint; protective god
explanations: A god or divine being believed to watch over and protect a person, place, or group.
Used figuratively for a person who serves as the key protector or last line of defense, especially in sports (e.g., a star goalkeeper).
An animal that naturally preys on or threatens another species in the wild.
A person or thing that one finds impossible to deal with or defeat. Used casually to describe someone or something that is one's biggest weakness.
The amount or proportion of sugar contained in food or drink. Also used loosely to refer to sugar or sweets in general, especially when talking about dietary intake.

glosses: nursing; looking after (a sick or injured person)
nursing; tending to; looking after (someone sick, injured, or intoxicated)
explanations: The act of caring for someone who is ill, hurt, or incapacitated, especially providing immediate or personal assistance. Often used for informal caregiving rather than professional medical care.
The state of being completely still or stationary, without any movement. Used in both everyday and scientific/technical contexts.
The area of sea adjacent to a country's coast over which it exercises sovereignty. Under international law, this extends up to 12 nautical miles from the baseline.
The value or result gained from an action or effort. Often used in set phrases to express whether something was worthwhile or had the desired effect.

glosses: mental arithmetic; mental calculation; calculating in one's head
explanations: Performing mathematical calculations without using a calculator, pen and paper, or abacus — purely in one's mind.
The state of dormancy that certain animals enter during winter to conserve energy, characterized by lowered body temperature and reduced metabolism.
Used figuratively for a person or organization that is inactive or idle for an extended period.

glosses: attic; loft; space under the roof
explanations: The space between the ceiling of the top floor and the roof of a building. May be used for storage or converted into a living space.

glosses: mountain stream; mountain torrent; brook in a valley
explanations: A stream flowing through a mountain valley or gorge. Often associated with clear water, natural scenery, and outdoor activities like fishing or hiking.
The sovereign ruler of an empire. Used primarily for foreign emperors (Roman, Chinese, etc.) and historically for the Chinese-style title. For the Japanese emperor, 天皇 is the standard term.

glosses: kingdom; realm ruled by a king or queen
explanations: A country or state governed by a monarch (king or queen). Used in the official names of countries such as the United Kingdom.
Used figuratively to describe a region or field dominated by a particular thing, or a place strongly associated with something.

glosses: slight bow; nod of acknowledgment; greeting nod
explanations: A light, quick bow or nod of the head used as a casual greeting, acknowledgment, or sign of politeness. Less formal than a full bow (お辞儀).

glosses: entry into a country; immigration (at a border)
explanations: The act of entering a country, particularly the formal process of passing through immigration control at an airport or border crossing.
A polite way of addressing or referring to a group of people. More formal than みなさん, commonly used in announcements, speeches, and formal writing.

glosses: everywhere; all over the place; wherever you go
explanations: Indicates that something exists or occurs in every location or in many different places.

glosses: to face; to confront; to be confronted with
explanations: To find oneself dealing with a difficult situation, problem, or challenge head-on. Typically used for serious issues such as crises, hardships, or important decisions.

glosses: to overcome; to conquer; to surmount
explanations: To successfully deal with and get past a difficulty, weakness, or obstacle through effort and determination.
Describes a person or animal that follows instructions or authority without resistance. Can be used positively (well-behaved) or negatively (too submissive).
A visible board, post, or symbol that provides information, directions, or warnings. Most commonly refers to traffic signs and road markers.
An expression of sympathy offered to someone who has lost a loved one. The お prefix makes it polite. Used both as a noun and in set phrases when offering condolences.

glosses: nape of the neck; back of the neck
explanations: The area at the back or side of the neck, from the base of the skull down to the shoulders.

glosses: calling someone by name without an honorific
explanations: The practice of addressing someone by their name alone, without attaching an honorific suffix such as さん, くん, or ちゃん. This is considered casual or intimate, and can be rude when used with someone of higher status or someone you are not close to.

One of the main categories of Japanese honorific language (keigo). Humble language lowers the speaker's own actions to show respect to the listener or the person being discussed. Examples include いたす (humble form of する) and まいる (humble form of 行く/来る).
The punctuation mark (.) used to end a sentence, primarily in Western-language contexts. In Japanese typography, the equivalent is the 句点 (くてん).
Used figuratively to mean putting a definitive end to something, such as a relationship, conflict, or era. Almost always appears in the phrase 終止符を打つ.
A strong, unpleasant smell. Used for serious or offensive odors rather than mild unpleasantness.

glosses: by a hair's breadth; in the nick of time
by a hair's breadth; in the nick of time; narrow escape
explanations: Describes a situation where something is avoided or achieved with an extremely slim margin. Often used for near-misses and last-second saves.
The process of losing power, wealth, or status, falling from a position of prosperity or prominence. Used for families, dynasties, nations, and organizations.
Describes an environment or atmosphere that is loud, bustling, and lacking in calm. Carries a slightly more literary or formal feel than うるさい.
A social gathering of former classmates or schoolmates, typically organized years after graduation to reconnect.
A formal organization of graduates from a particular school that maintains connections among alumni.
A tall mirror in which one can see one's entire body from head to toe. Used for checking one's appearance before going out.

A developmental stage in which a child or adolescent defies authority and resists parental control. Japanese parenting discourse distinguishes two main phases: the first around age 2-3 and the second during puberty.
A device or service that automatically answers phone calls and records messages when the recipient is unavailable. In modern usage, often refers to the voicemail function on mobile phones.

glosses: departure from a country; leaving a country
explanations: The act of leaving one's country or the country one is currently in, especially passing through official border or immigration controls at an airport or port.

An old-fashioned or literary way of saying thirty years of age. In modern usage, it often appears in casual conversation with a slightly humorous or dramatic tone, especially when talking about turning thirty as a milestone.
A number that has two digits, i.e., from 10 to 99. Often used to describe quantities, percentages, or scores reaching the double-digit range.
A title for a feudal lord or person of high rank in historical Japan. In modern usage, it appears in historical dramas, period fiction, and humorous contexts.
An old-fashioned or humorous way for a wife or servant to refer to the master of the household.
The act of loading goods or cargo onto a vehicle, ship, or other transport. Also refers to the cargo capacity of a vehicle.

glosses: fresh cream; heavy cream; whipping cream
explanations: Cream made from milk fat that has not been processed with additives or plant-based substitutes. Used in cooking, baking, and as a topping for desserts and drinks.
A polite, euphemistic term for a restroom or bathroom, commonly seen on signs in public buildings, department stores, hotels, and restaurants.

glosses: color scheme; color combination; color arrangement
explanations: The selection and arrangement of colors used together in design, art, fashion, or interior decoration.
Deep, warm feelings of love and care directed toward someone or something, especially those who are weaker or in need of protection. Carries a gentler, more nurturing nuance than 愛.

glosses: to resist; to oppose; to defy
to resist; to oppose; to put up resistance
to feel reluctant; to have reservations about
explanations: To actively fight against or refuse to accept a force, authority, or situation. Can be physical resistance or abstract opposition.
To feel a psychological aversion or discomfort toward something. Used when something goes against one's feelings or values.

glosses: a bow; a nod of greeting
a bow; a nod of greeting; a polite bow
explanations: A single bow made as a greeting, expression of thanks, or show of respect. Describes a brief, formal bowing gesture.

A fixed combination of words whose meaning cannot be easily deduced from the individual words. In Japanese grammar education, this term refers specifically to multi-word expressions with established figurative meanings.
The muscles of the abdomen. Often used in fitness and health contexts.
Short for the exercise that works the abdominal muscles. Used colloquially to refer to the exercise itself.

glosses: blank space; blank column; empty field
explanations: An unfilled space on a form, test, or document where information is to be written. Commonly encountered on application forms, exams, and surveys.
The state of having passed a set time limit or deadline. Used for food expiry dates, visa expirations, contract deadlines, and similar time-bound items.

glosses: route map; transit map; network map
explanations: A diagram showing the routes of trains, buses, or other transportation lines. Especially common for railway and subway systems in Japan.

glosses: to let die out; to use up; to run out of
to let die out; to extinguish; to discontinue
to run out of; to use up the supply of
explanations: To allow something to come to an end or cease to exist, often through neglect or inaction. Used for traditions, lineages, fires, and other things that can be maintained or lost.
To use up or fail to maintain a stock of something. Often used in the negative form to mean keeping a constant supply.
The second planet from the sun, often visible as the brightest object in the morning or evening sky. Also called the morning star or evening star.

glosses: true story; real account; factual story
explanations: A story or account based on events that actually happened, as opposed to fiction. Often used in titles of books, movies, and TV shows.
Physical movement of one's body. Most commonly used in the negative form to describe being unable to move due to being trapped, crowded, or otherwise constrained.
Weak, self-pitying complaints or expressions of helplessness. Carries a negative nuance of complaining without trying to solve the problem.

glosses: first of all, before anything else
first of all; before anything else; first and foremost
explanations: Indicates doing something before anyone or anything else, often implying urgency or strong priority.
A volcano that is currently active or has the potential to erupt. Japan has over 100 active volcanoes, making this an important term in geography and disaster preparedness.
A white line painted on surfaces such as roads, train platforms, and sports fields. In Japan, commonly associated with platform safety lines at train stations and road markings.
The mental strength to face difficult, frightening, or risky situations without flinching. Often refers to a bold, fearless disposition.
A small, narrow street or pathway, especially in traditional neighborhoods or historic districts. Often appears in place names throughout Japan, particularly in Kyoto.
The force or energy that drives something forward, either literally (physical propulsion) or figuratively (the force behind progress, change, or growth).
The act of creating a work together with one or more other people. Commonly used for songs, artworks, scripts, and other creative outputs.
A wound caused by a pointed object piercing the skin. Used in medical, news, and crime contexts.

glosses: copy; duplicate; record kept for reference
explanations: A copy or duplicate of a document, receipt, or record kept for one's own reference. Common in business and administrative contexts.
A person or thing held in reserve, ready to step in when needed. Used in sports for substitute players and in other contexts for backups.

glosses: to eat; to drink; to wear (honorific)
explanations: An honorific verb used to describe someone of high status eating or drinking. More elevated than {食|た}べる or {飲|の}む.
An honorific verb for wearing clothes or accessories. Often heard in retail settings as お{召|め}しになる.
An honorific verb meaning to summon or call someone. Used in formal or historical contexts.
The act of depositing money into a bank account or entrusting luggage or belongings to a storage service. Common in banking and travel contexts.

glosses: attendance record; roll book; attendance register
explanations: A book or record used to track attendance, especially in schools and classrooms. The teacher typically calls roll and marks attendance in this record.

The formal act of lending something to someone, often with the expectation of return. Used in official, institutional, and business contexts for equipment, scholarships, and other items provided on loan.

glosses: care facility; welfare institution; protective care home
explanations: A facility that provides care and protection for children, the elderly, or people with disabilities who need support. In the context of children, it refers to what is commonly called a children's home or orphanage.
A gender-inclusive term for all siblings. Used in formal and official contexts to explicitly include both male and female siblings, unlike the more common {兄弟|きょうだい} which can be ambiguous.
To wind something back to an earlier position. Originally used for tape and film, now also used figuratively for going back in time or reversing progress in digital contexts.
A person who directs the creative aspects of a performance, especially in theater, opera, and stage productions. Responsible for the artistic vision, staging, and direction of actors.
The state of being in violation of or contrary to the constitution. A key term in Japanese legal and political discourse, especially regarding Article 9 and other constitutional debates.
