Controlling one's desires, especially regarding food, drink, and lifestyle habits. Exercising discipline for the sake of health.
The clarity and sharpness of one's pronunciation when speaking. Originally a term from kabuki theater, now widely used in everyday language.
To sleep longer than intended, especially past the time one should wake up. Can also be used as a noun meaning 'oversleeper' or 'oversleeping.'
A priest who serves at a Shinto shrine, performing rituals, prayers, and ceremonies. The head priest of a shrine.
The upper part of the leg between the hip and the knee.

glosses: to chase; to run after; to pursue
explanations: To run after someone or something in order to catch them. Used for physical pursuit of people, animals, or objects.
To pursue something abstract such as a dream, goal, or ideal.

glosses: freshly baked; freshly grilled; just out of the oven
explanations: Describes bread, pastries, or grilled items that have just been cooked and are still hot. Often used as a modifier with の.
Describes food that has just been deep-fried and is still hot and crispy. Often used as a modifier with の.

glosses: prepared side dish; ready-made dish; deli food
explanations: Cooked dishes sold ready to eat, typically found at supermarkets, department store basements (depachika), and specialty shops. Includes items like fried chicken, salads, simmered vegetables, and more.

glosses: casual speech; informal language; peer language
explanations: Informal speech used between equals or close friends, as opposed to polite or honorific language. Characterized by plain verb forms and casual vocabulary. Often discussed in the context of Japanese social hierarchy and age relationships.

glosses: to age; to grow old; to look older
explanations: To show signs of aging in one's appearance. Often used to describe someone who looks older than their actual age or who has visibly aged.

glosses: to enter someone's house; to go up into
to enter; to go into someone's house
explanations: To enter someone's home or a building, especially without much formality or without being properly invited. Can carry a nuance of making oneself at home or barging in.

glosses: as much as possible; to the utmost
as much as possible; to the utmost; to the best of one's ability
explanations: An adverb meaning to do something to the greatest extent possible. Often used when expressing effort to achieve or avoid something.

glosses: to accomplish; to carry through; to complete
explanations: To see a task or challenge through to completion, especially one that was difficult. Emphasizes perseverance and finishing what was started.

glosses: just in case; to be safe
just in case; to be safe; as a precaution
explanations: Used when doing something as a precautionary measure, even though it may not be strictly necessary. Expresses the idea of being careful or thorough.
The act of opening a sealed letter, package, or container. Used as a suru verb.
The state of being thoroughly wet, typically from rain or water. Used as a noun or as a na-adjective with の.
Rain that falls during autumn, or the rainy period in autumn (typically September to October in Japan). Also refers to the autumn rain front (秋雨前線).

glosses: to get through; to overcome; to pull through
explanations: To survive or overcome a difficult situation, crisis, or challenge. Emphasizes managing to escape or endure something tough.

glosses: to load; to load up; to pack into
explanations: To load cargo, luggage, or goods into a vehicle, container, or ship.
The formal act of presenting a gift, award, or certificate to someone. More formal than simply giving.

glosses: lucky day; auspicious day; most favorable day
explanations: The most auspicious day in the traditional Japanese six-day calendar cycle (六曜 rokuyo). Considered the best day for weddings, business openings, and other important events.

glosses: unlucky day; inauspicious day; most unfavorable day
explanations: The most inauspicious day in the traditional Japanese six-day calendar cycle (六曜 rokuyo). Weddings, celebrations, and business openings are typically avoided on this day.
Figuratively refers to trouble, conflict, or disruption in relationships or situations. Most commonly used in the expression 波風を立てる (to stir up trouble).
The literal meaning of waves and wind on the sea.
The process of preparing or developing land for construction, including leveling, filling, and converting raw land into usable building sites.
A close, friendly relationship, especially one built over time through mutual interaction. Often used with the na-adjective pattern 懇意な or the pattern 懇意にする.
An earnest, emotional plea or request, often made from a position of weakness or desperation. Stronger and more emotional than a simple request.

glosses: each time; every time; on each occasion
explanations: Every time a particular situation occurs, the action is performed anew. Emphasizes repeated action in response to recurring events.

glosses: to be found; to be noticed
to be found; to be noticed; to be seen
explanations: To come into view or to be found when looking. Often used in the negative (見当たらない) to mean something cannot be found.

glosses: grilling on a wire net; net-grilled
grilling on a wire net; net-grilled; grilled over an open flame on a rack
explanations: A cooking method where food is placed on a wire mesh or grill rack and cooked over direct heat, typically charcoal. Also refers to food prepared this way.

glosses: distrust; feeling of mistrust; sense of distrust
explanations: A feeling of not being able to trust someone or something. Often used in discussions about relationships, politics, or institutions.
Indicates that something is more or less than what would be expected given the circumstances. Often expresses mild surprise.
Used after a clause to mean 'considering that...' or 'for...' — the result is unexpected given the premise.

glosses: permanent; standing; regular; always set up
explanations: Describes facilities, exhibitions, or organizations that exist on a permanent or ongoing basis, as opposed to temporary ones.

glosses: soon; in the near future; shortly
soon; in the near future; shortly; coming soon
explanations: Refers to an upcoming date or time in the near future. Often used in announcements and notices.

glosses: utility charges; public service fees; utility bills
explanations: Fees for essential public services such as electricity, gas, water, and telecommunications.

glosses: free sample; trial product; sample product
explanations: A product given away free of charge for promotional purposes so that potential customers can try it before purchasing.

glosses: analogy; inference by analogy; analogical reasoning
explanations: The process of reasoning from known similarities to infer additional similarities. Drawing conclusions about something based on its resemblance to something else.

glosses: to bend backward; to lean back; to throw back one's body
to warp; to curl up; to bend
explanations: To arch or bend the body backward. Can also describe an arrogant posture of leaning back with one's chest out.
For objects like paper, wood, or metal to bend or curl due to heat, moisture, or other forces.

glosses: celebratory toast; victory drink; celebratory cup
explanations: A drink raised in celebration of an achievement, victory, or happy occasion. The act of drinking to celebrate.

glosses: respect for the aged; honoring the elderly
explanations: The concept and practice of showing respect and care for elderly people. Also appears in the name of the national holiday 敬老の日.

glosses: self-assertion; asserting oneself; standing up for oneself
explanations: The act of expressing one's own opinions, desires, or rights. Can be viewed positively (as healthy assertiveness) or negatively (as being pushy or selfish), depending on context.

glosses: thoroughly; from beginning to end; completely; through and through
explanations: An emphatic expression meaning to do something consistently and completely, without wavering or compromising, from start to finish.

glosses: the sun sets; it gets dark
the sun sets; it gets dark; evening falls
explanations: Describes the sun going down and daylight fading. A natural, everyday expression for sunset and the onset of evening.

glosses: verbal message; word left with someone
verbal message; message left with someone; errand
explanations: A message entrusted to someone to pass along to a third party. Can also refer to sending something via another person.
The state of not meeting standards of cleanliness or hygiene. Describes conditions or practices that could be harmful to health.
The seat in a vehicle where the driver sits. In Japan, this is on the right side of the car.

glosses: interception; intercepting attack; counterattack against an approaching enemy
explanations: A military or defensive action to intercept and engage incoming enemies, missiles, or aircraft before they reach their target.
The place someone is going to or planning to go to. Used for both physical travel destinations and figurative destinations such as career paths.
The side that faces or is across from a given point. Used for physical locations, directions, and figurative opposites.

glosses: in a meeting; during a meeting
explanations: Indicates that someone is currently attending a meeting and is unavailable. Commonly seen on signs and used as a status indicator.
Successfully completing a task, mission, or goal from start to finish. Implies determination and effort in seeing something through.
Describes something that continues over a long period without interruption or decline. Widely used in discussions of development, growth, and environmental policy.
The medical specialty dealing with pregnancy, childbirth, and diseases of the female reproductive system. Also refers to the hospital department or clinic specializing in this field.
A harmful substance produced by living organisms such as bacteria, plants, or animals. Used in both scientific and everyday contexts.
Clothing designed for manual labor or physical work. Includes uniforms worn at factories, construction sites, and other workplaces where durability and practicality are important.
Natural leather made from animal hide, as opposed to synthetic or artificial leather. Used as a material descriptor for bags, shoes, wallets, and other goods.
A board where messages can be left for others. Originally referred to physical boards at train stations or public places. Now also used for online message boards and forums.

glosses: to sob; to weep quietly; to sniffle while crying
explanations: To cry softly with intermittent catching of breath. Describes a restrained, quiet form of weeping rather than loud wailing.

glosses: combustible material; burnable trash; flammable item
explanations: Materials that can burn. In everyday Japanese life, most commonly refers to burnable garbage in the context of waste sorting.
The act of removing stains from clothing or fabric, or a product used for that purpose.

glosses: passenger ship; cruise ship; ocean liner
explanations: A ship designed primarily for carrying passengers, including ferries and cruise ships.

glosses: boarding a ship; embarkation; getting on a boat
explanations: The act of getting on a ship or boat. Used for ferries, cruise ships, and other watercraft.
The folder or location where incoming email, messages, or notifications are stored. Standard terminology in email and messaging applications.

glosses: as expected; just as predicted; as anticipated
explanations: Indicates that something turned out the way it was predicted or expected beforehand.
A system where access to a place, service, or organization is restricted to registered members. Common for clubs, restaurants, gyms, and online services.
Traditional Japanese paper printed with colorful patterns such as flowers, geometric designs, or seasonal motifs. Used for origami, crafts, and decorative purposes.
To raise and train a wild animal until it becomes accustomed to humans. Can also be used figuratively to mean bringing someone under control.

glosses: memorial toast; offering a drink in memory of the deceased
explanations: A solemn toast made at funeral gatherings or memorial services to honor someone who has passed away. Unlike a celebratory toast, it is quiet and respectful.

glosses: self-support; supporting oneself; making one's own living
explanations: Earning one's own livelihood without depending on parents, the government, or others for financial support.
A shop that sells souvenirs, local specialties, and gifts, typically found at tourist destinations, train stations, and airports.

glosses: kelp stock; kombu broth; dashi made from kelp
explanations: A cooking stock made by soaking or simmering dried kelp (kombu) in water. One of the fundamental bases of Japanese cuisine, prized for its umami flavor.

glosses: no matter what; at all costs; by any means
explanations: Expresses strong determination to achieve something regardless of obstacles or difficulty.

glosses: regarding as important; placing importance on
regarding as important; placing importance on; emphasizing
explanations: The act of treating something as significant or giving it priority. Used in formal and written contexts.

glosses: Japanese text; writing in Japanese; Japanese-language document
explanations: Text written in Japanese, as opposed to text in other languages. Used especially in translation and document contexts.
A local tax levied on individuals based on their income and place of residence. In Japan, it is paid to the prefecture and municipality where one lives.

glosses: gangster; yakuza member; organized crime member
explanations: A person involved in organized crime. Often used as a synonym for yakuza in media and popular culture.
A person who leads an immoral or dissolute lifestyle. The original meaning before it became associated primarily with organized crime.
A medicine or substance that counteracts the effects of poison or a toxic substance.

glosses: event hall; exhibition space; event floor
explanations: A designated area in a department store or commercial building used for special events, exhibitions, and seasonal sales.

glosses: fixed assets; real property; immovable property
explanations: Long-term tangible assets such as land, buildings, and equipment that are not easily converted to cash. In Japanese tax law, also refers specifically to the property subject to fixed asset tax.

glosses: another day; some other time; in the future
explanations: Refers to an unspecified day in the future. A formal, literary expression used in writing and polite speech.
The process of cutting logs into boards, planks, or other usable lumber. Also refers to the industry or business of processing raw timber.
The minimum amount of energy the body needs to maintain basic life functions at rest, such as breathing, circulation, and cell production.
A person who has legally adopted a child and taken on the role of parent. Used in both legal and everyday contexts.
The capacity to appreciate beauty, morality, and intellectual values. Often used in educational contexts to describe the cultivation of a well-rounded emotional and aesthetic sense.

glosses: a gift received; a present sent to one
explanations: A gift or present that has been sent or brought to someone. Often implies food gifts or seasonal gifts received from others.

glosses: with all one's strength; with full force
with all one's strength; with full force; as hard as one can
explanations: Using the maximum amount of physical or mental effort. Describes putting everything one has into an action.

glosses: pivotal; vital; of central importance; crucial
explanations: Describes something that is of key importance, occupying a central or essential position. A formal, written word.
A numerical measure of a person's intellectual ability as determined by standardized testing. Abbreviated as IQ.
A disease or condition for which there is no known cure. A literary and somewhat formal expression.

glosses: mouthful; with one's mouth full; filling the mouth
explanations: A quantity of food that fills the mouth, or the state of having one's mouth packed full.
Water that has been boiled and then allowed to cool to a drinkable temperature. Considered safe and gentle for babies and for brewing fine tea.
A small ceramic vessel used to cool boiling water to the ideal temperature before pouring it over tea leaves, especially for high-quality green teas like gyokuro.

glosses: extremely busy; pressure of business; being overloaded with tasks
explanations: A formal word describing a state of being overwhelmed with work or having too many things to attend to.

glosses: the way there; outbound route; the route going to a destination
explanations: The route or journey taken when going to a destination, as opposed to the return trip.
Describes behavior, appearance, or attitudes that seem inappropriately young or lacking in maturity for the person's age. Generally carries a negative nuance.
The systematic process of changing someone's beliefs or way of thinking through coercion or repetition. Also used loosely to describe being heavily influenced by media, advertising, or a person.

glosses: from the bottom of one's heart; sincerely
from the bottom of one's heart; sincerely; truly
explanations: Expresses that a feeling or action comes from genuine, deep emotion rather than being superficial or performative.

glosses: to devote oneself; to work diligently
to devote oneself; to work diligently; to strive
explanations: To dedicate oneself wholeheartedly to study, training, or self-improvement. Originally a Buddhist term meaning ascetic practice.

glosses: full amount; total sum; entire amount
explanations: The complete monetary amount without any deduction or reduction.

glosses: all; any of them; both; each
all; any of them; both; each one
explanations: Refers to every item or person in a group without exception. Used to make a statement that applies equally to all members of a set.
Describes a person, offer, or situation that seems untrustworthy or too good to be true. Conveys a gut feeling of distrust.
Describes thinking, behavior, or a person guided by reason rather than emotion or impulse.
Describes a person or entity that lacks physical strength or the power to influence a situation. Can refer to physical weakness or to inability to make a difference.
Romantic feelings directed at someone who does not return them. A common theme in Japanese pop culture, literature, and everyday conversation.

glosses: superb view; breathtaking scenery; spectacular landscape
explanations: An outstandingly beautiful natural or scenic view that takes one's breath away.
Describes a personality trait of being timid, reluctant to speak up, or uncomfortable in social situations.

glosses: visiting a shrine, temple, or grave; paying one's respects
visiting a shrine, temple, or grave; paying one's respects; pilgrimage
explanations: The act of visiting a Shinto shrine, Buddhist temple, or family grave to pray, make offerings, or pay respects. A routine part of Japanese cultural life.
The act of stealing merchandise from a retail store. Also refers to the person who shoplifts.
Describes an atmosphere, mood, or feeling that feels weighed down and uncomfortable. Can refer to the air, a silence, or an emotional state.

glosses: bad influence; harmful effect; adverse impact
explanations: A negative effect that something has on a person, situation, or environment.
Done with conscious intent rather than by accident or coincidence.
Unable to make decisions promptly or firmly. Describes a person who hesitates and wavers when choices need to be made.
Describes speech or language ability that is smooth and natural, without hesitation or awkwardness.
The state of doing something knowingly and purposefully, especially in legal or formal contexts. Contrasted with negligence or accident.
Following or relating to the established forms, styles, or standards of a past era, especially in art, music, or literature.
Conforming to a well-known, conventional pattern. Can carry a slightly negative nuance of being predictable or outdated.
The sound made by an animal, bird, or insect. Covers all animal vocalizations from chirping to roaring.
A significant point in time that marks a change or transition, such as graduation, a birthday, or the end of a fiscal year.
Describes a person or action characterized by paying close attention and taking care to avoid mistakes or danger.
Describes a situation or circumstance that works out well or is advantageous for someone.
The act of trying to persuade someone to join, buy, or participate in something. Often used for sales pitches, religious recruitment, or membership drives.
Not treating people or things equally or justly. Describes situations, rules, or treatment that favor one side over another.

glosses: show of hands; raising one's hand
explanations: The act of raising one's hand to vote, ask a question, or indicate agreement. Used in meetings, classrooms, and assemblies.
A feeling of active ill will or opposition toward someone or something.
Describes a reaction or response that happens instantly and without conscious thought, like a physical reflex.

glosses: unexpectedly; suddenly; out of the blue
explanations: Describes something that happens without warning or preparation, catching someone off guard.
The Japanese concept of wholehearted, selfless hospitality — anticipating a guest's needs and providing care with sincerity and attention to detail.
A soft, watery dish made by cooking rice with extra water until it breaks down. Traditionally served to the sick, infants, and as a light meal.

glosses: gaze; look; eyes; way of looking
explanations: The expression or quality of someone's eyes as they look at something. Often implies emotional depth or a particular attitude conveyed through one's eyes.
Physically damp or having too much moisture in the air or on a surface.
Figuratively, describes a mood, atmosphere, or topic that is depressing or somber.

glosses: poor work; bad piece; flop; mediocre creation
explanations: A piece of art, writing, film, or other creative work that is considered to be of low quality.
The same size as the actual person or object being represented.
Figuratively, describes a way of living or expressing oneself without exaggeration, pretense, or trying to appear bigger or better than one really is.
A cord or string threaded through eyelets in a shoe to fasten it.
A photograph one takes of oneself, typically with a smartphone held at arm's length or using a selfie stick.
Shoes designed for physical activity, sports, or casual wear. In school contexts, often refers to the white shoes worn for PE class.

glosses: person sensitive to the cold; someone who feels the cold easily
explanations: Describes someone who tends to feel cold more than others and is quick to bundle up or seek warmth.

glosses: person sensitive to the heat; someone who feels the heat easily
explanations: Describes someone who tends to feel hot more than others and is quick to seek cool air or remove layers.

glosses: morning person; early riser type; morning-oriented
explanations: A person or lifestyle pattern characterized by waking up early and being most productive in the morning hours.

glosses: best time to see; peak viewing season
best time to see; peak viewing season; in full bloom/color
explanations: The optimal time to view something, especially flowers, autumn leaves, or other natural scenery at their most beautiful.
A Japanese liqueur made by steeping unripe green plums (ume) in shochu or white liquor with rock sugar. Sweet with a fruity, tart flavor.

glosses: tumult; hustle and bustle; noise; clamor
explanations: Loud, chaotic noise or commotion, especially associated with crowded places or busy environments.
The sale of goods in large quantities, typically to retailers rather than directly to consumers.
The formal transfer of rights, authority, or property from one party to another.

glosses: to pity; to feel compassion for
to pity; to feel compassion for; to sympathize with
explanations: To feel sorrow or sympathy for someone in a difficult or unfortunate situation.

glosses: sudden memory lapse; momentary forgetting; mental blank
explanations: The experience of suddenly being unable to recall something you normally know well. A temporary lapse rather than genuine forgetting.

glosses: bottom futon; mattress futon; futon mattress
explanations: The futon placed on the floor to sleep on, as opposed to the top futon (comforter) placed over the body. Part of the traditional Japanese bedding set.
To cook food by submerging it in hot oil. Written with the kanji {揚|あ} to distinguish from other verbs read あげる.
The process of learning and refining a skill through repeated practice. Emphasizes sustained, disciplined effort over time.

glosses: to roast; to parch; to toast
to roast; to parch; to toast; to pan-fry (dry)
explanations: To cook by heating in a dry pan without oil, causing ingredients to become crisp and fragrant. Used for nuts, seeds, beans, and similar ingredients.
The designed sequence of movements and steps in a dance, performance, or musical number. Also refers to the act of creating such movements.

glosses: every other day; alternate days; every two days
explanations: A pattern of doing something on alternating days, skipping one day in between.
A deliberate course of action or method devised to achieve a particular goal. Often used in formal or policy-related contexts.
Having two layers, levels, or aspects. Describes something that is doubled or exists in two overlapping forms.
The fleshy back part of the lower leg, between the knee and the ankle.
Existing in very small numbers or quantity, making something valuable or hard to find.
The process of growing in power, influence, or prosperity. Often used to describe the rise of civilizations, industries, or movements.

glosses: light eater; small appetite; eating sparingly
explanations: The tendency to eat only small amounts of food. Describes someone who naturally doesn't eat much.
Relating to or occurring in ordinary daily life. Describes things that are part of one's regular, unremarkable routine.

glosses: not fully convinced; not satisfied; still having doubts
not fully convinced; unconvinced; not satisfied; still having doubts
explanations: A feeling of lingering doubt or dissatisfaction, even after receiving an explanation. Something doesn't quite sit right.
The first or most basic level of something, especially in education. Refers to the foundational stage before advancing to higher levels.

glosses: training; apprenticeship; learning a trade; completing a course of study
explanations: The process of learning skills and knowledge through practical training, especially in a craft, trade, or profession. Emphasizes the learning and mastery aspect.

glosses: non-urgent; not pressing; not immediately necessary
explanations: Describing something that does not require immediate attention or action. Almost always used in the pair {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}.
Describing a material or substance that is physically hard, firm, and not easily deformed. Used as a technical or descriptive term for material properties.
Financial or moral support given to help an organization, event, or cause. Often used in the context of membership or sponsorship of associations.
Paper manufactured using Western methods, as opposed to traditional Japanese washi. The standard paper used for printing, writing, and everyday purposes.
The act of not agreeing to or not accepting a proposal, request, or situation. A formal expression of refusal or objection.

glosses: just as you say; exactly right
just as you say; exactly as you say; you're absolutely right
explanations: A polite expression used to agree wholeheartedly with what someone has said. The respectful form of その{通|とお}り.

glosses: shameless; brazen; impudent; having no sense of shame
explanations: Lacking any feeling of shame or embarrassment about one's actions or behavior, especially when such behavior is considered morally wrong or socially unacceptable.

glosses: no matter what; by all means
no matter what; by all means; at any cost
explanations: Expresses strong determination to achieve something regardless of obstacles or circumstances. Emphasizes the speaker's unwavering resolve.

glosses: crucial moment to persevere; time to hang in there
crucial moment to persevere; time to stand firm
explanations: A critical point where one must endure hardship or exert maximum effort. Implies that giving up now would waste previous effort, so one should push through.

glosses: to appear; to show oneself; to come into view
explanations: Describes someone or something becoming visible, often after being absent, hidden, or anticipated. Used for both physical appearances and figurative emergence.

glosses: to meet face-to-face; to see each other
to meet face-to-face; to see each other in person
explanations: Describes meeting someone in person, often implying a direct encounter rather than a planned meeting. Can carry a nuance of awkwardness or inevitability when the encounter is unwanted.

glosses: to feel refreshed; to cheer up
to feel refreshed; to cheer up; to feel better
explanations: Describes a feeling of emotional relief or brightening, as if clouds have cleared from one's mood. Used when gloom, stress, or worry lifts.

glosses: to get ahead of; to beat someone to it
to get ahead of someone; to beat someone to it; to forestall
explanations: To do something before someone else can, gaining an advantage. Often used when someone acts first in a competitive or time-sensitive situation.

glosses: a touch of anxiety; a slight unease
a touch of anxiety; a slight unease; a lingering worry
explanations: A faint but persistent feeling of worry or concern. The word {一抹|いちまつ} means "a trace" or "a touch," so the expression conveys a small but nagging sense of unease.
A person who lives in a particular place. A formal term used in legal, administrative, and official contexts, as opposed to the more everyday word {住民|じゅうみん}.
The act of making information available to the public or to relevant parties. Commonly used in legal, corporate, and government contexts where transparency is required.

glosses: to work hard; to put in effort
explanations: The standard expression for sweating physically, whether from heat, exercise, or nervousness.
Figuratively, to exert oneself or work hard at something, implying hands-on labor rather than directing from above.

A very tall building, typically in a major city. The kanji literally mean "sky-scraping tower" ({摩|ま} rub/scrape + {天|てん} sky/heaven + {楼|ろう} tower). A somewhat literary or dramatic word compared to the more neutral {高層|こうそう}ビル.

glosses: temple or shrine seal; red-ink stamp
temple or shrine seal; red-ink stamp of visitation
explanations: A calligraphic inscription with a red seal stamp given at Buddhist temples and Shinto shrines as proof of one's visit. Typically written by hand in ink with the temple or shrine name, the date, and the deity's name, accompanied by a vermillion seal.

glosses: purse snatching; bag snatching; snatch theft
explanations: The crime of grabbing someone's bag or belongings and running away, typically committed on the street. Also refers to the person who commits this crime.

glosses: not so much; not particularly; not to that extent
explanations: Used with a negative predicate to indicate that something does not reach the expected degree. Slightly more formal and literary than そんなに or それほど.

glosses: hanging advertisement in a train; overhead transit ad
explanations: An advertisement poster hung from the ceiling of a train car, positioned at eye level for standing passengers. A distinctive feature of Japanese public transportation.

glosses: don't be absurd; that's out of the question
don't be absurd; that's out of the question; not at all
explanations: An emphatic denial or humble refusal used when someone suggests something the speaker considers unthinkable, excessive, or undeserved. Often used to modestly deflect praise or decline an offer.

glosses: to be on edge; to be anxious (watching)
to be on edge; to watch nervously; to be anxious
explanations: A state of nervous tension while watching something unfold, especially when the outcome is uncertain or someone might fail or get hurt. Often describes the feeling of an observer rather than the person involved.

glosses: drifting ashore; washing up; being carried to shore
explanations: The arrival of something at a shore after drifting on water. Used for both objects (debris, driftwood) and people (castaways, refugees) that reach land after being carried by ocean currents.
Describes something or someone that arouses suspicion or doubt. Often used in the context of suspicious behavior, unidentified persons, or doubtful circumstances.
The process of roasting raw materials by applying dry heat, most commonly associated with coffee beans but also applicable to tea leaves and other foods. A key step that develops flavor and aroma.

glosses: state of emergency; emergency situation; crisis
explanations: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action. Used both for official government declarations and for general emergencies in everyday contexts.
The act of bringing a chaotic or problematic situation under control. Often used when a situation has spiraled out of hand and needs to be contained or resolved.
The state of a machine, factory, system, or facility being active and functional. Also used for the operation of workers in terms of working hours or labor.
An established set of technical requirements or criteria that products, services, or processes must meet. Used for industrial standards, quality standards, and technical specifications.
Acts of kindness and generosity toward those in need, especially organized charitable activities. Often used as a modifier before other nouns to describe charitable events or organizations.
A person who systematically gathers and keeps items of a particular type, such as art, stamps, coins, or antiques. Implies a serious, dedicated hobby or profession.
A systematic survey of the public's views on political, social, or other issues. Typically conducted by news organizations, government agencies, or research institutions.
The branch of mathematics dealing with shapes, sizes, positions, and properties of space. Also used in compound forms to describe geometric patterns and designs.

glosses: to shine brilliantly; to sparkle; to gleam
to be radiant; to be brilliant (figurative)
explanations: To emit or reflect bright, radiant light. A compound verb combining {光|ひか}る (to shine) and {輝|かがや}く (to sparkle), creating an intensified meaning of brilliant luminosity.
Used figuratively to describe something or someone that stands out with exceptional beauty, talent, or achievement.

glosses: jumping to conclusions; hasty understanding; premature assumption
explanations: Understanding or concluding something too quickly without fully hearing or considering all the facts. Often leads to misunderstanding.

glosses: excuse; evasion; pretext; talking one's way out
explanations: An attempt to avoid responsibility or blame through words, excuses, or explanations that deflect the issue. Carries a negative connotation — the excuse is seen as dishonest or inadequate.

glosses: to indicate; to point to; to suggest
to point to; to indicate; to show
to indicate; to suggest; to point to (abstract)
explanations: To physically point at or toward something to identify it. A compound of {指|さ}す (to point) and {示|しめ}す (to show).
To show or suggest a direction, conclusion, or meaning in an abstract sense. Common in academic, analytical, and news contexts.

glosses: shoe blister; chafing from shoes; shoe sore
explanations: A blister, sore, or abrasion on the foot caused by friction from ill-fitting or new shoes. A common problem when breaking in new footwear.
Light exercises performed before physical activity to prepare the body, prevent injury, and improve performance. A standard part of physical education and sports in Japan.
An island with no permanent human residents. Often evokes images of tropical adventures or survival scenarios, and is a popular topic in hypothetical questions and games.
The act of guiding or leading people to a specific place or in a desired direction. Often used for crowd control, traffic, or emergency situations.
Leading someone toward a particular conclusion or action, sometimes with manipulative intent. Also used in science for electromagnetic induction.
Suggesting bad fortune or an unfavorable outcome. Used to describe signs, omens, events, or feelings that foreshadow something bad.

glosses: to endure; to conceal oneself; to reminisce
to endure; to bear; to put up with
to conceal oneself; to hide; to do something secretly
explanations: To patiently withstand hardship, pain, or difficult circumstances without complaining.
To act stealthily or keep something hidden from others. The root meaning behind the word ninja (忍者).
To fondly recall or yearn for the past, a person, or a place. Often literary.
Making something lighter, less severe, or less burdensome. Used for taxes, workloads, pain, and other burdens.
A level or grade between beginner and advanced. Used in education, language study, sports, and product classifications.

glosses: nursing; caring for a sick person
explanations: Taking care of someone who is ill, including staying by their side, helping with meals, and attending to their needs. Typically done by family members or close people rather than professional nurses.
The head of a group, especially in hierarchical organizations like yakuza, gangs, or traditional trades. Also used casually to describe someone who acts as the leader of a group.

glosses: empty shell of a person; lifeless state
explanations: The shed skin of an insect or snake. Literally, the shell left behind after a creature has emerged from it.
A person who has lost their energy, spirit, or motivation and seems hollow or absent. Used figuratively.
Comfortable, refreshing sleep. Often used in health and wellness contexts to describe high-quality sleep.
A group within a larger organization that shares common interests or follows a particular leader. Most commonly associated with political factions within Japanese political parties.
The age at which a person is considered old enough for romance or marriage, or the age of puberty and adolescence when one becomes self-conscious.
Used to indicate an approximate age or the age at which something typically happens.
Weather conditions, especially clear and pleasant weather. Often used as a suffix to describe a perfect day for a particular activity.
Waiting to see which way things go before committing. Used in the expression 日和見 (opportunism, fence-sitting).
A person who is truthful and sincere. Can be used positively (praising honesty) or with a nuance of being naive or too trusting.
A formal prenominal modifier meaning 'further' or 'even greater.' Always appears directly before a noun.

glosses: to be completely ruined; to fall into ruin
to be completely ruined; to fall into ruin; to become desolate
explanations: To become thoroughly devastated, dilapidated, or desolate. A compound of 荒れる (to become rough/ruined) and 果てる (to reach the end), emphasizing completeness of ruin.

glosses: topcoat; final coat of paint or plaster
explanations: The outermost layer of paint, lacquer, or plaster applied over a base coat.
Attempting to conceal a mistake or wrongdoing, often making the situation worse. Used in the expression 嘘の上塗り (piling lies upon lies).

glosses: to become blurry; to become vague
to become blurry; to become out of focus
to become vague; to become unclear
explanations: For vision, images, or outlines to become unclear or indistinct.
For ideas, memories, distinctions, or boundaries to become unclear or indistinct. Used figuratively.

glosses: compensation; covering a loss; filling a gap
compensation; covering a loss; filling a shortfall
explanations: Making up for a deficit, loss, or shortage, especially financially. Used in business, finance, and administrative contexts.
All matters and aspects of a given situation. Most commonly used in the expression 準備万端 (fully prepared), meaning everything is ready.
A person who avoids work or effort. Can also refer to the animal sloth, which is named for its perceived laziness.
A small, round, hard piece of candy meant to be sucked rather than chewed. A traditional Japanese confection that comes in various flavors.
A religious ceremony or act of worship. Used for Christian church services as well as worship in other religions.
Wine made from green or yellow grapes, or from dark grapes with the skins removed. A common beverage in restaurants and at home.

glosses: love and hate; mixed feelings of love and hatred
explanations: The coexistence or interplay of love and hatred, often directed at the same person or thing. Used in literary and emotional contexts.
Lines that run in the same direction and never intersect. A geometry term.
A situation where two sides cannot reach agreement, like parallel lines that never meet. Used figuratively for negotiations or discussions that go nowhere.

glosses: buying and eating food on the go
buying and eating snacks on the go; eating while walking
explanations: The act of buying food at shops or stalls and eating it on the spot or while walking. Often associated with children buying snacks on the way home from school.

glosses: New Year's Eve bell; bell rung 108 times on New Year's Eve
explanations: The Buddhist temple bell rung 108 times at midnight on New Year's Eve. The 108 rings represent the 108 earthly desires (bonnō) in Buddhist teaching, and the ringing is believed to purify the listener of these desires for the new year.

glosses: opening to the public; public release
opening to the public; making available to the general public
explanations: Making a place, event, or resource accessible to the general public, as opposed to being restricted to specific groups. Used for buildings, facilities, data, or events.
The practice or products aimed at making skin lighter, brighter, or more even-toned. A major category in the Japanese cosmetics industry.

glosses: refusing to give up; being a poor loser
refusing to give up; being a poor loser; not accepting defeat gracefully
explanations: Stubbornly refusing to accept an inevitable outcome or admit defeat. Literally 'bad at the moment of death,' from the Buddhist concept of dying peacefully.

glosses: finishing a race; running the full course
finishing a race; completing the full course
explanations: Successfully running or driving the entire distance of a race. The emphasis is on completing the course rather than winning.

glosses: scheduled time; fixed time; appointed time
explanations: The predetermined or officially scheduled time for something to happen, especially for transport departures, meetings, or events.

glosses: racking one's brains; taking great pains
racking one's brains; taking great pains; devoting oneself to
explanations: Worrying intensely and devoting great mental effort to solving a problem or achieving something. Literally 'rotting the heart/mind' from the strain of thinking.

glosses: heavy responsibility; important duty; important post
explanations: A position or duty that carries significant responsibility and weight. Used formally to describe roles that require great commitment.

glosses: handy; simple; convenient; easy to use
explanations: Simple and convenient, requiring little effort or complexity. Used to describe methods, tools, or procedures that are straightforward and practical.
The act of combining various elements into a unified whole, or an adjective-like use meaning comprehensive or all-encompassing.
Describes a state of receiving actions or influence from others rather than taking initiative. Used for attitudes, behavior, or approaches that lack proactivity.
Describes someone who is very careful and alert to potential dangers or risks. Implies a habitual tendency to be on guard.

glosses: bulleted list; itemized list; listing by items
explanations: A way of writing that presents information as a series of separate points or items, each on its own line. Common in business documents, presentations, and instructions.

glosses: conditional; with conditions; with strings attached
explanations: Describes something that is granted or valid only under certain conditions or restrictions, not unconditionally.

glosses: mutual aid; helping each other; cooperation
explanations: The act of people helping one another, especially in difficult times. Emphasizes reciprocity and community spirit.
The Japanese comma (、), used to separate clauses and items in a sentence. One of the two basic punctuation marks in Japanese writing, alongside the period ({句点|くてん}).

glosses: rice cooked in a small pot
rice dish cooked in a small iron pot; pot rice
explanations: A Japanese dish where rice is cooked with various toppings such as chicken, mushrooms, and vegetables in an individual-sized iron or ceramic pot. Popular as a specialty dish at train stations and restaurants.
A building with many stories, typically used for offices, apartments, or hotels. Generally refers to buildings over ten stories tall.
The process of removing color from fabric, paper, or other materials using chemicals or sunlight. Also used for teeth whitening.
Having something under one's exclusive control or use. Used in legal, business, and everyday contexts to describe taking or holding sole possession of a space, resource, or market share.
Gold in its purest form without alloy metals mixed in. In the jewelry industry, 24-karat gold (99.99% purity) is considered pure gold.

glosses: seal of approval; firm guarantee; confident endorsement
explanations: Originally referred to a large round seal resembling a drum. Now used figuratively to mean a strong personal guarantee or confident recommendation, typically in the expression {太鼓判|たいこばん}を{押|お}す.
A four-sided geometric shape with equal sides but non-right angles, resembling the shape of a water chestnut ({菱|ひし}). Used in mathematics, design, and everyday descriptions.

glosses: tea cakes; snacks served with tea
tea cakes; tea sweets; snacks served with tea
explanations: Sweets or light snacks that are served alongside tea, especially during the tea ceremony or when entertaining guests. Typically Japanese confections but can include Western-style sweets.

glosses: plain food; simple diet; frugal meals
explanations: A diet consisting of simple, unrefined, or modest food without luxury items. Can be used positively to suggest a healthy, natural diet or negatively to suggest poverty.

glosses: to take pains; to make great effort
to take pains; to make great effort; to go to trouble
explanations: An idiomatic expression meaning to exert considerable effort or go through hardship for someone or something. Implies the work is demanding and requires dedication.
The literal meaning of fracturing a bone in one's body.
Using someone or something excessively or mercilessly, pushing beyond reasonable limits. Can refer to overworking people, straining the body, or wearing out equipment.

glosses: neckline; collar area; front of the neck
explanations: The area around the collar or neckline of a garment, or the part of the body near the throat that clothing covers. Also used in idiomatic expressions.

glosses: tone of voice; tone of speech
tone of voice; tone of speech; manner of speaking
explanations: The way someone speaks in terms of their intonation, rhythm, and emotional quality. Refers to the overall feel or mood conveyed through speech.
Having many functions or superior capabilities. Used to describe products, devices, software, or materials that offer advanced features beyond basic models.

glosses: luxuriant growth; lush vegetation; thick growth
explanations: The state of plants growing thickly and abundantly, creating dense vegetation. Used for both natural wilderness and overgrown gardens.
A large structure with blades that rotate in the wind, used historically for grinding grain or pumping water, and now for generating electricity. Distinct from the toy pinwheel ({風車|かざぐるま}).

glosses: luxury item; luxury goods; non-essential item
explanations: An expensive or extravagant item that is not a necessity but a desirable indulgence. Contrasted with daily necessities.

glosses: to crawl out; to creep out
to crawl out; to creep out; to emerge by crawling
explanations: To move out of an enclosed or confined space by crawling. Used for insects, babies, or people in tight spaces. Can also be used figuratively for emerging from a difficult situation.
Thin lenses placed directly on the surface of the eye to correct vision. Available in soft and hard types, as well as disposable and extended-wear varieties.

glosses: apparition; phantom; supernatural being in disguise
explanations: A supernatural transformation, especially in folklore where animals or spirits change into human form. Distinct from the common reading へんか (change), this reading specifically refers to magical or supernatural transformation.
A being that has transformed itself, such as a fox or raccoon dog in Japanese folklore that has taken human form.

glosses: to come along; to arrive; to show up
to come (of a time, season, or event)
explanations: Someone or something comes to a place, with a nuance of finally arriving or appearing. Often used for people visiting or arriving at a location.
A time period, season, or event arrives or approaches. Used for abstract things that come with the passage of time.

glosses: to avoid; to evade; to avert
to avoid; to evade; to avert; to circumvent
explanations: To take action to prevent an undesirable outcome or to stay away from a dangerous or problematic situation. Used for both physical and abstract avoidance.

glosses: club; hobby group; association of enthusiasts
club; hobby group; association of like-minded people
explanations: An informal group or club of people who share a common interest or hobby. Less formal than an official organization but more structured than a casual gathering.

glosses: well-bred; well-raised; from a good family
well-bred; well-raised; from a good upbringing
explanations: Describes someone whose manners, behavior, and character reflect a good upbringing and family background. Implies refinement, politeness, and good values instilled during childhood.

glosses: kun'yomi + on'yomi reading of a kanji compound
explanations: A way of reading a two-kanji compound where the first character uses kun'yomi (Japanese reading) and the second uses on'yomi (Chinese-derived reading). Named after the word {湯桶|ゆとう} (hot water pitcher), which is itself read this way.
A small cart that is pushed by hand, used for transporting goods, gardening materials, or other items. Includes wheelbarrows, handcarts, and similar manually-pushed vehicles.

glosses: leased land; rented land; land held on lease
explanations: Land that is rented from a landowner for use, typically for building a house or business. The tenant has the right to use the land but does not own it.

glosses: sound of wings; flapping or buzzing sound of wings
explanations: The sound made by the wings of birds or insects in flight. Can refer to flapping, beating, or buzzing sounds depending on the creature.

glosses: powerful person; person in power; ruler
explanations: A person who holds political, social, or economic power. Used to describe leaders, politicians, or anyone wielding significant authority over others.
A system where customers or visitors must make a reservation in advance and walk-ins are not accepted. Common for restaurants, clinics, salons, and specialty shops in Japan.
A short musical tune played at train stations to signal that a train is about to depart. A distinctive feature of Japanese rail culture, with many stations having unique melodies.

glosses: tactile paving; Braille block; textured ground surface indicator
explanations: Yellow raised blocks installed on sidewalks, train platforms, and public spaces to guide visually impaired people. Invented in Japan in 1965 and now used worldwide.
A credit card payment method where the cardholder pays a fixed monthly amount regardless of total purchases. Short for リボルビング{払|ばら}い. Known for accumulating high interest charges.

glosses: bulk purchase; lump-sum purchase; buying in one go
explanations: Purchasing goods or services all at once rather than in installments or separately. Used both for buying large quantities at a discount and for paying the full price upfront.

glosses: steep slope; steep gradient; steep incline
explanations: A sharply angled slope or grade, used for roads, hills, railways, and roofs. Indicates a significant change in elevation over a short distance.
A machine used to cut grass on lawns and fields. Available in push, riding, and robotic varieties.

A legally required registration system for bicycles in Japan. A numbered sticker is attached to the bicycle frame, linking it to the owner's personal information in a police database. Helps identify stolen bicycles and verify ownership.

A legal and commercial term for non-alcoholic drinks other than milk and dairy beverages. Includes sodas, juices, sports drinks, tea, and water. Commonly seen on vending machines and product labels in Japan.

glosses: I appreciate the offer, but...; thank you, but...
explanations: A polite expression used to decline an offer, invitation, or suggestion while acknowledging the other person's kindness or effort. Shows gratitude before delivering a refusal.
A numerical index that combines temperature and humidity to express how uncomfortable the weather feels. Commonly referenced in Japanese weather forecasts during summer months.
The metabolic process of breaking down stored body fat for energy. A key concept in fitness, dieting, and health discussions.
The ball-and-socket joint connecting the thigh bone to the pelvis. One of the largest and most important joints in the body, supporting body weight and enabling walking.

Classes or lessons conducted with the teacher and students physically present in the same location, as opposed to online or remote learning. Became a frequently used term during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

An organization of graduates of a school, college, or university that maintains connections between former students and supports the institution. Common for universities, high schools, and some middle schools in Japan.
A paper form used to write down and submit orders, commonly found in restaurants (especially sushi-go-round and izakaya), shops, and businesses.

A physical object or structure designated for preservation due to its historical, artistic, or cultural significance. Includes buildings, paintings, sculptures, crafts, and archaeological artifacts. Designated under Japan's Law for the Protection of Cultural Properties.

glosses: net content; net weight; net volume
explanations: The amount of product inside a package, excluding the weight of the container or packaging itself. Printed on food labels, beverage bottles, and product packaging as required by law.

glosses: claw crane game; claw machine; UFO catcher
explanations: An arcade game where players use a joystick to maneuver a mechanical claw to grab prizes such as stuffed animals, figures, or snacks. A staple of Japanese game centers.
A business, shop, or facility closing temporarily outside of its regular closing days. May be due to owner illness, maintenance, weather, or special circumstances.
Preserving food or other materials by keeping them at freezing temperatures. A common household technique and also used industrially and in medicine.
Physical work that does not require heavy lifting, specialized skills, or strenuous effort. Commonly used in job listings for warehouse sorting, packaging, labeling, and similar tasks.

glosses: new market entry; entering a new market or industry
explanations: When a company or individual enters an industry, market, or field for the first time. A key concept in business strategy and economics.
A triangular drafting tool used for drawing straight lines and angles. In Japan, students typically use a set of two: one with 30-60-90 degree angles and one with 45-45-90 degree angles.
The percentage of a country's or region's consumption of a particular resource that is produced domestically. Most commonly discussed in relation to food supply in Japan.

glosses: freedom of speech; freedom of expression
explanations: The right to express one's opinions and ideas without government censorship or restriction. Guaranteed by Article 21 of the Japanese Constitution.
Describes a situation, plan, or condition that is not yet settled and may change. Used for circumstances that remain uncertain or are still developing.
A person with specialized technical knowledge and skills, working in fields such as engineering, IT, manufacturing, or applied sciences.

glosses: flat-rate system; subscription plan; fixed-price plan
explanations: A pricing system where the customer pays a fixed amount for unlimited or specified use of a service, regardless of actual usage. Common for streaming services, mobile phone plans, and all-you-can-eat/drink services.
A small plate used to take portions from shared dishes when eating with others. Essential in Japanese dining culture where food is often served communally.

glosses: passing the buck; shifting blame; blame-shifting
explanations: The act of attributing one's own responsibility or fault to someone else. A negative behavior often criticized in workplace and interpersonal relationships.
Describing a person who predominantly uses their right hand for tasks like writing, eating, and throwing. Also used as a noun to mean a right-handed person.

glosses: rear-end collision; running into the back of another vehicle
explanations: A traffic accident where one vehicle crashes into the back of the vehicle ahead of it. One of the most common types of traffic accidents.

glosses: being filled with; permeation; being full of
explanations: A state where something fills a space completely. Used for gases, smells, emotions, and atmospheres that spread throughout and occupy an entire area.
The administrative office responsible for managing the operations of an organization, committee, or event. Handles logistics, communication, and day-to-day coordination.

glosses: pouring drinks for someone; serving alcohol
explanations: The act of pouring alcoholic beverages (especially sake or beer) into someone else's glass as a social courtesy. A key element of Japanese drinking culture, particularly in business and formal settings.
The overall shape and build of a person's body. Used to describe someone's physical appearance in terms of build rather than specific features.
A place far from urban centers with limited access to services and infrastructure. Often used in policy and medical contexts to describe areas with insufficient facilities.
A value passed to a function, method, or command. In programming, the input data that a function receives to produce a result. Also used in mathematics for the independent variable of a function.

glosses: Kinki region; Kansai area of Japan
explanations: A geographic region in the central part of Japan's main island, encompassing Osaka, Kyoto, Hyogo, Nara, Shiga, Wakayama, and Mie prefectures. The traditional name for what is now more commonly called Kansai.

glosses: to drink together; to exchange cups
to drink together; to exchange cups of sake
explanations: To share drinks with someone, each person pouring for the other. Implies a warm, convivial atmosphere of mutual drinking.
Describing speech, writing, or a person that is annoyingly moralistic or lectures others about how they should behave. Has a negative connotation.

glosses: unloading; unloading cargo from a vehicle
explanations: The act of removing goods or cargo from a truck, ship, or other transport vehicle. A common logistics and delivery term.
The process of securing money for a business, project, or organization. Includes bank loans, investment, crowdfunding, and other methods of raising capital.
The process of demolishing and rebuilding existing structures in an area, typically to modernize or revitalize an urban district. A major topic in Japanese urban planning.

glosses: pay stub; salary statement; pay slip
explanations: A document from an employer showing the breakdown of an employee's pay, including base salary, deductions for taxes and insurance, overtime pay, and net amount.
A meeting held at fixed intervals, such as weekly, monthly, or quarterly. Used in workplaces, government bodies, and community organizations.

glosses: group customers; tour group; group visitors
explanations: A group of people visiting or using a service together, often on a package tour or organized trip. Common in tourism, restaurant, and hotel contexts.

glosses: road construction; road work; road repairs
explanations: Construction or maintenance work being done on a road. Includes repaving, pipe installation, bridge repairs, and other infrastructure work that affects traffic.

glosses: matter of concern; issue of worry
matter of concern; issue of worry; point of concern
explanations: A specific issue or problem that causes anxiety or requires attention. Commonly used in business, policy, and project management contexts to list potential risks or problems.
A device or app that counts the number of steps a person takes. Used for health and fitness tracking.

glosses: complete set of volumes; all volumes
explanations: The entire set of volumes in a series, such as a manga, novel series, or encyclopedia. Frequently used when buying or discussing the full collection.

glosses: basis for judgment; information for decision-making; deciding factor
explanations: Data, facts, or other information used as the basis for making a decision or forming a judgment. Often used in business and analytical contexts.
Lacking compassion or sympathy. Describes people, actions, or situations that show no warmth or consideration for others' feelings.

glosses: contribution of an article; written submission
explanations: The act of writing and submitting an article, essay, or other piece of writing to a newspaper, magazine, journal, or website. Also refers to the submitted piece itself.
An attack coming toward a location, especially by enemy forces or a natural disaster such as a typhoon or earthquake. Implies the threat is approaching from outside.
A violent criminal act, especially murder or a vicious attack. Used in news reports and formal contexts to describe serious violent crimes.

glosses: later; shortly; in due course; at a later date
explanations: Indicates that something will be communicated, decided, or done at a later time. Formal and commonly used in business correspondence and official notices.

glosses: substitution; assignment; plugging in a value
explanations: In mathematics, replacing a variable with a specific value. In programming, storing a value in a variable. A fundamental concept in both fields.
A temporary stop or suspension of an activity, service, or operation. Implies the activity may resume later, unlike permanent discontinuation.
The legal right to possess, use, and dispose of property. A fundamental concept in law covering both physical property and intellectual property.

glosses: urban area; built-up area; city center; downtown area
explanations: An area within a city or town where buildings, shops, and residences are densely concentrated. Contrasts with residential suburbs, industrial zones, or rural areas.
The very latest and most technologically advanced version of something. Used as a noun or prenominal modifier to describe equipment, facilities, or systems.

A formal addressing suffix written on letters and envelopes when the recipient is an organization, company, or department rather than a specific individual. Equivalent to placing 'Dear [Organization]' on correspondence.
The percentage of people who support or approve of a political leader, party, or policy. A key metric in political polling and news reporting.

glosses: extra charge; premium; surcharge; additional percentage
explanations: An additional amount added on top of a base price or wage, expressed as a percentage. Common in pricing, overtime pay, and insurance contexts.

glosses: to delay; to postpone; to put off; to set back
explanations: To make something happen later than originally planned or scheduled. Can refer to deliberately pushing back a schedule or causing something to be late.
Tools and equipment used in farming and agriculture, such as hoes, sickles, plows, and rakes. Includes both traditional hand tools and modern implements.
A situation that was not predicted or planned for. Used in formal contexts when discussing risk management, emergency preparedness, and crisis response.
A formal term for duty or responsibility, especially one that comes with a role or position. Stronger and more formal than {義務|ぎむ}.

glosses: clearing up; settling (a relationship or past issue)
explanations: The financial process of settling accounts, paying off debts, or dissolving a business by selling off its assets.
Figuratively, putting an end to a relationship, situation, or past issue by resolving it completely.
Describes fast, agile movements or quick responses. Used for both physical speed and quickness of reaction or decision-making.

glosses: total destruction by fire; burned to the ground
explanations: A building or structure being completely destroyed by fire, with nothing salvageable remaining.
A general term for negotiable financial instruments such as stocks, bonds, and other tradeable assets.

glosses: to foam; to bubble; to froth
to foam; to bubble; to froth; to lather
explanations: For a liquid or substance to produce foam, bubbles, or froth. Used for beer, soap, waves, and other substances.
The continent of North America, typically referring to the United States, Canada, and Mexico.
The person who conducts an interview, typically in job recruitment or academic admissions contexts.

glosses: to take someone out; to bring someone along
to take someone out; to lead someone outside; to bring someone along
explanations: To take a person (or sometimes a pet) from one place to another, typically from indoors to outdoors or from home to somewhere else.

glosses: opposite shore; far bank; other side
opposite shore; far bank; other side (of a river, lake, etc.)
explanations: The shore or bank on the opposite side of a body of water such as a river, lake, or strait.

glosses: one side; single side; one face
explanations: One side or face of a flat object, as opposed to both sides. Used for paper, discs, tape, and other flat items.
A sale event where goods are offered at reduced prices, typically at a store or market.
The beginning of someone's career or public recognition, or the initial launch of a product onto the market.
A wide, deep ceramic spoon commonly used for eating ramen, Chinese soups, and similar dishes. Short for 散蓮華.
The lotus flower, which holds symbolic significance in Buddhism. Often seen in Buddhist art and temple decorations.

glosses: all year round; throughout the year
all year round; throughout the year; year-round
explanations: For the entire duration of a year, without seasonal interruption.
A category of household waste that can be incinerated, as defined by municipal garbage collection systems in Japan. Includes paper, food scraps, and certain plastics.
One of the three main categories of keigo (polite language) in Japanese. Honorific language elevates the actions or state of the person being spoken about, showing respect toward them.
Something appearing or occurring frequently. Often used in academic and test-preparation contexts for vocabulary, questions, or patterns that come up repeatedly.

glosses: critical condition; on the verge of death
explanations: A medical state where a person's condition is extremely serious and death is imminent. Used specifically for life-threatening situations.
Activities and strategies designed to increase sales of a product or service. An abbreviation of 販売促進.
A tendency to forget things easily, or a medical condition involving memory loss. Used both colloquially for everyday forgetfulness and clinically for amnesia.
The process of brewing sake or other alcoholic beverages. Also refers to the industry and businesses involved in sake production.
An educational institution that is privately funded and operated, as opposed to public or national schools. Also refers to private education as a sector.
Goods and materials provided to people affected by disasters, wars, or other emergencies. Includes food, water, medicine, blankets, and other essentials.

glosses: tolerance; permissible amount; allowable limit; capacity
explanations: The maximum amount or degree that can be accepted, tolerated, or handled. Used in technical, medical, and everyday contexts.

glosses: to hear; to come to one's ears
to hear; to happen to hear; to come to one's ears
explanations: To hear something, often incidentally or without actively trying. Implies information reaching you through conversation, rumor, or media rather than direct experience.
So outstanding that there is no equal in the world. A literary term most commonly used to describe beauty.
One's spouse's father, or a stepfather. The 義理 prefix indicates a family relationship by marriage rather than blood.
A person who works compulsively and excessively, or the state of being addicted to work. A calque of the English word 'workaholic.'
A dated term for diseases that commonly affect adults, such as diabetes, hypertension, and heart disease. Now officially replaced by 生活習慣病 (lifestyle-related disease) in Japan since 1996.

glosses: government offices; public agencies; government bodies
explanations: A collective term for national government agencies and local government offices. Encompasses both central government ministries and local municipal offices.

glosses: to restrain; to suppress; to control
to restrain; to suppress; to control; to curb
explanations: To hold back, limit, or keep something in check. Used for controlling emotions, growth, spending, inflammation, and other things that might otherwise increase or spread.

glosses: to overwhelm; to overpower; to dominate
explanations: To surpass or defeat decisively by having far greater power, skill, numbers, or intensity. Often used in passive form to express being overwhelmed.
The activity or sport of riding horses. Also used to refer to equestrian activities in general.
A person who is engaged to be married. Used for both men and women.

glosses: asking and answering oneself; self-questioning; inner dialogue
explanations: The act of posing questions to oneself and attempting to find answers, often when facing a dilemma or reflecting deeply on something.

glosses: optimism; taking a hopeful or positive view
explanations: The attitude of expecting favorable outcomes or seeing the bright side of situations. Often contrasted with {悲観|ひかん} (pessimism).
An introductory section at the beginning of a book or document, typically written by the author to explain the purpose, scope, or background of the work.
Text added after the main body of a document or message. Also used as a suru verb meaning to add a supplementary note.
The state of something losing its validity or effectiveness, such as a license, contract, or passport expiring.
A general term for any textile or material spread on the floor for comfort, decoration, or protection. Includes rugs, carpets, mats, and similar coverings.
A device or mechanism used to hold things together or in place, such as clasps, clips, buckles, or latches.
A formal suggestion or recommendation, typically made by an expert, committee, or advisory body to those in authority. More formal and weighty than a casual suggestion.
Remaining signs or evidence that something happened or existed. Often used when examining a scene or situation for clues about what occurred.

glosses: absence without notice; unauthorized absence from work
explanations: Being absent from work without informing one's employer or obtaining permission beforehand. A serious workplace infraction in Japan.
The reproductive unit of a plant, containing the embryo and stored nutrients. A more formal or scientific term compared to the everyday word {種|たね}.

glosses: ladies and gentlemen; everyone; you all
explanations: A formal term of address used to speak to a group of people, especially in speeches, addresses, or written appeals. Has a somewhat old-fashioned or authoritative tone.
A metallic substance made by combining two or more metals, or a metal with another element, to achieve desired properties such as increased strength or corrosion resistance.
Rare, naturally occurring metallic elements with high economic value, such as gold, silver, and platinum. Also used to refer to jewelry and accessories made from these metals.

glosses: hiding; lying low; going into concealment
explanations: The act of hiding oneself or remaining concealed, especially to avoid detection by authorities.
A period during which a disease or condition is present but not yet showing symptoms.
A cylindrical container used to store tea leaves, typically made of metal, wood, or ceramic. Keeps tea fresh by protecting it from air and moisture.
People who belong to the same generational cohort or are roughly the same age. Used to describe shared experiences, perspectives, or connections among people of similar age.
The larger form of a letter in alphabets that distinguish between two cases, such as A, B, C in the Latin alphabet. Contrasted with {小文字|こもじ} (lowercase).

glosses: unhealthy; unwholesome; bad for one's health
explanations: Describing a state, habit, or condition that is harmful to physical or mental health, or a person who is not in good health.

glosses: Japanese sweets shop; traditional dessert café
explanations: A shop or café specializing in traditional Japanese sweets and desserts such as anmitsu, shiruko, and mochi. Often serves tea alongside the sweets.

glosses: height of prosperity; heyday; peak; zenith
explanations: The period when something or someone is at the peak of power, popularity, or success.
A publication issued separately from a main series, such as a special edition of a magazine or an appendix published as its own volume.
A formal gathering held to celebrate an achievement, milestone, or special occasion such as a promotion, anniversary, or award.
The process of making operations, systems, or organizations more efficient and logical, often by eliminating waste or unnecessary steps. In business, can also imply downsizing.
Acting on one's own initiative or judgment without being told or forced to do so. Emphasizes willingness and self-motivation.

glosses: early to bed, early to rise
early to bed, early to rise; keeping early hours
explanations: The habit of going to bed early and waking up early. Considered a virtuous and healthy lifestyle in Japanese culture.

glosses: candy sculpture; sugar craft; candy art
explanations: The art of shaping heated candy or sugar into decorative figures such as animals, flowers, or other designs. A traditional Japanese craft often demonstrated at festivals.

glosses: outdoors; open air; in the field
explanations: An open area outside of buildings, often implying natural or unroofed settings. Used as a modifier for activities, events, or locations that take place outside.

glosses: appointment; promotion; recruitment to a position
explanations: Selecting and appointing someone to an important position, especially recognizing talent and giving them responsibility. Often implies promoting someone based on merit rather than seniority.
Food that accompanies the main staple (typically rice in Japanese cuisine). Includes dishes like fish, meat, vegetables, and soup that are eaten alongside the staple grain.

glosses: non-regular employee; contract worker; part-time staff
explanations: The act of entrusting a task or responsibility to someone.
An employee hired on a contract basis, often a retired person rehired at reduced pay and hours. Common in Japanese government offices and companies.

glosses: starvation; death from hunger; starving to death
explanations: Dying as a result of prolonged lack of food. Used both literally and occasionally figuratively to express extreme hunger.
A state where something becomes too hot, beyond the normal or safe temperature range.
A situation, competition, or trend that has intensified beyond reasonable levels. Commonly used for economic bubbles, media frenzies, or competitive escalation.
The quality of being based on facts and evidence rather than personal feelings or opinions. Valued in academic, journalistic, and legal contexts.

glosses: peer pressure; pressure to conform; conformity pressure
explanations: Social pressure exerted by a group on individuals to align their behavior, opinions, or attitudes with the group's norms. A frequently discussed concept in analyses of Japanese society.
A person of learning and knowledge who engages in critical thinking and intellectual discourse, often influencing public opinion through writing or commentary.
A meal or snack eaten late at night, typically after dinner. Often refers to food eaten while studying or working late.
Treating someone or something better than others, often through special benefits, privileges, or consideration. Used as a suru verb.

glosses: good omen; auspicious sign; lucky sign
explanations: A sign or event believed to foretell something good. Used in both traditional and modern contexts.

glosses: abandoned house; dilapidated building; ruined house
explanations: A house or building that has been abandoned and fallen into disrepair. Often used in the context of rural depopulation or horror settings.

glosses: intense pain; sharp pain; severe pain
explanations: Extremely strong physical pain. Describes pain that is sudden, sharp, or overwhelmingly intense.

glosses: old wound; old scar; past disgrace
past disgrace; old scandal; skeleton in the closet
explanations: A physical wound or scar from the past that has healed but may still cause occasional pain or discomfort.
A past mistake, scandal, or shameful event that one would rather keep hidden. Figurative usage.
The act of buying and selling goods, or running a business. A somewhat traditional word that conveys the spirit of Japanese merchant culture.
The tangible result or product of work, especially in business, project management, or research contexts.
The state of not wearing shoes or socks, with feet directly touching the ground.
Used in the pattern 〜も{裸足|はだし}で{逃|に}げる to mean someone is so skilled that even a professional would run away barefoot in defeat.

glosses: dead word; obsolete word; dead language
explanations: A word or expression that was once commonly used but is no longer current. Often said humorously about slang or trends that have fallen out of fashion.
A language that is no longer spoken as a native language by any community, such as Latin or Ancient Greek.

glosses: wide range; extensive area; broad scope
explanations: A large area or scope, whether physical, conceptual, or in terms of impact. Often used as a no-adjective to modify nouns.
The Japanese language and literature from the Heian period through the early modern period. A required subject in Japanese high schools.
Any text written in an older form of a language.

glosses: dismissal; removal from office; relief of duty
