in turn; one after another; in order; sequentially
explanations: Doing something in a fixed order, with each person or thing taking their turn one at a time.
The quality of being unique or distinctive, having characteristics that set something apart from others.

glosses: odd; bizarre; peculiar; outlandish; absurdly strange
explanations: Describes something that is strange in a way that is often comical or absurd. Implies something is laughably or ridiculously weird.

glosses: to write incorrectly; to misspell; to make a writing mistake
to write incorrectly; to misspell; to make a writing error
explanations: To make a mistake while writing, such as writing the wrong character, spelling something incorrectly, or writing the wrong number.

glosses: to be exaggerated; to have embellishments added
to be exaggerated; to have embellishments added; to grow in the telling
explanations: Describes how a story or rumor gets embellished and exaggerated as it is passed from person to person, gaining details that were not in the original.

glosses: karuta; Japanese card game; playing cards (traditional)
explanations: A traditional Japanese card game in which players compete to quickly grab cards that match a clue read aloud. Also refers to the cards themselves.
Describes something that has no apparent end or limit, either literally (in physical extent) or figuratively (in duration, scope, or intensity).

glosses: to be bossed around; to be jerked around; to be at someone's mercy
to be swung around; to be tossed about physically
to be bossed around; to be at someone's mercy; to be jerked around
explanations: To be physically whirled or swung around.
To be forced to act according to someone else's whims or demands, often causing stress and exhaustion.
The act of moving personnel to different positions or departments within an organization, or rearranging the placement of objects.

glosses: free diving; skin diving; diving without equipment
free diving; skin diving; diving without breathing apparatus
explanations: The practice of diving underwater without scuba gear or other breathing equipment, relying only on holding one's breath.

glosses: to intersect; to cross; to crisscross
explanations: Describes lines, roads, or paths meeting and crossing each other at a point. Used for both physical objects like streets and abstract things like gazes or opinions.

glosses: to boil; to reach boiling point
to be in an uproar; to be boiling with excitement or anger
explanations: A liquid is heated to the point where it turns into vapor and bubbles vigorously. Used literally for cooking and science.
Figuratively describes a situation where emotions, public opinion, or an atmosphere becomes intensely heated or agitated.

glosses: to supervise; to oversee; to manage
to direct (a film, play, or sports team)
explanations: To watch over and manage people or work to ensure things are done properly. Used in workplaces, organizations, and institutional contexts.
To serve as the director of a movie, theatrical production, or as the manager/coach of a sports team.

glosses: to operate; to run; to manage
to operate; to run; to manage (an organization or event)
explanations: To manage the ongoing operation of an organization, business, event, or system, ensuring it functions smoothly. Focuses on the day-to-day running and administration.

glosses: to support; to cheer; to root for
to cheer; to root for; to support (a team or person)
to support; to back up; to send reinforcements
explanations: To encourage and show support for someone, typically at a sporting event or competition, by cheering, clapping, or shouting.
To provide help or assistance to someone, either through encouragement or by sending additional people or resources.

glosses: to observe; to watch closely; to examine carefully
explanations: To look at something attentively and systematically in order to learn about it. Used in scientific, educational, and everyday contexts for careful examination of people, nature, or phenomena.

glosses: to photograph; to film; to shoot
to photograph; to take a picture
to film; to shoot (video or movie)
explanations: To capture a still image using a camera or smartphone.
To record moving images for a film, video, TV program, or other media production.

glosses: to edit; to compile; to put together
explanations: To select, arrange, revise, or process material (text, video, images, etc.) into a finished form. Covers editing of written works, video, audio, and digital content.

glosses: to understand; to acknowledge; to roger
to understand; to comprehend; to grasp
to acknowledge; to agree; to roger
explanations: To understand the content or meaning of something that has been communicated.
Used as an acknowledgment that one has understood a request or instruction and will comply. Commonly used as a short reply meaning 'understood' or 'got it.'

glosses: to criticize; to critique; to censure
explanations: To express disapproval of or point out faults in someone or something. Can range from constructive critique to harsh censure, depending on context.

glosses: to command; to conduct; to lead
to command; to direct; to lead (a group or operation)
to conduct (an orchestra or musical ensemble)
explanations: To lead and give directions to a group of people in an organized activity, such as military operations, emergency response, or projects.
To lead a musical performance by directing the musicians with gestures, typically using a baton.

glosses: to travel overseas; to go abroad
to travel overseas; to go abroad; to cross the sea
explanations: To travel to a foreign country, especially by crossing an ocean or sea. A formal word used in official, legal, and news contexts.

glosses: to pass; to elapse; to progress
to progress; to develop (of a condition or process)
explanations: Describes time passing or a period going by.
Describes how a condition, illness, or situation develops over time. The noun form {経過|けいか} is commonly used for the course or progress of something.

glosses: to pack in a box; to box up
explanations: To place items into a box for storage, shipping, or presentation. Also used as a noun to describe items that have been boxed.
To tap or rap on a door to announce one's presence or ask for permission to enter.
In baseball, to hit ground balls or fly balls to fielders during practice. The person hitting is called the ノッカー.

glosses: appetizer (served at a bar or izakaya); pushing out
appetizer; small dish served automatically at an izakaya or bar
explanations: A small dish of food that is served automatically when you sit down at an izakaya or bar, similar to a cover charge. The customer does not order it.
The act of pushing or thrusting something outward. Also used in sumo wrestling for a technique of pushing the opponent out of the ring.

glosses: curse; divine punishment; wrath of a spirit or deity
explanations: Supernatural punishment or misfortune believed to be caused by an angry god, spirit, or deceased person. A core concept in Japanese folk religion.
Negative consequences resulting from a past action, used figuratively without literal supernatural meaning.

glosses: military strength; troop strength; armed forces
military strength; troop strength; number of soldiers
explanations: The size or strength of military forces, typically measured in number of troops or overall combat capability.

glosses: polar region; arctic or antarctic area
explanations: The regions around the North Pole or South Pole, characterized by extreme cold and ice.

glosses: green vegetables; leafy greens; fresh produce
explanations: A collective term for fresh green vegetables, especially leafy ones. Somewhat old-fashioned but still used, particularly in market and cooking contexts.

glosses: last departure; last service (train, bus, flight, etc.)
explanations: The final scheduled departure of a train, bus, or other transport for the day. The opposite of {始発|しはつ} (first departure).

glosses: allied nation; ally; member state of an alliance
explanations: A country that is part of a formal alliance, especially a military or political one.

glosses: death from illness; dying of disease
explanations: Death caused by illness or disease, as opposed to death by accident, violence, or old age.

glosses: hair dye for gray hair; gray hair coloring
hair dye for gray/white hair; the act of dyeing gray hair
explanations: A product or process specifically for coloring gray or white hair. Distinct from fashion hair coloring, which is done for style rather than to cover aging.

glosses: falling object; fallen debris; dropped item
explanations: An object that has fallen or may fall from a height. Commonly used in safety warnings, traffic reports, and construction contexts.

glosses: the underworld; the realm of the dead; Hades
the underworld; the realm of the dead; the afterlife
explanations: The world of the dead in Buddhist and Japanese folk belief. The place where souls go after death.

glosses: feeding animals; giving food to animals or fish
explanations: The act of feeding animals, whether pets, livestock, or wild animals. Often seen on signs prohibiting feeding.

glosses: armaments; military equipment and preparations; arms buildup
explanations: Military equipment, weapons, and the state of being prepared for war. Often used in discussions of defense policy and international security.
An extremely small particle, often invisible to the naked eye. Used in scientific, environmental, and everyday health contexts.

glosses: head family; founding school; grand master's house
founding school; the originating lineage of a traditional art
explanations: The main branch of a family, as opposed to cadet or branch families. The family that holds the lineage and inheritance.
The original or authoritative school of a traditional Japanese art such as tea ceremony, flower arrangement, or martial arts. The grand master who heads such a school.
A substance, typically a liquid, that dissolves another substance (the solute) to form a solution. Water is the most common solvent.

glosses: messenger; orderly; person who carries orders
explanations: A person tasked with delivering orders or messages, especially in a military context. Also refers to the act of conveying orders.
Having the shape of a rod or stick. Used as a noun or with の to modify another noun.

glosses: altruism; selflessness; putting others' interests first
explanations: The principle or practice of caring about the welfare of others, even at a cost to oneself. The opposite of egoism.
A traditional Japanese unit of volume equal to approximately 1.8 liters. Still commonly used for measuring sake and rice.
A clever or cunning plan to achieve a goal, often with a negative connotation of manipulation or deceit.
A position that is both forward and to the side. Used for giving directions and describing spatial relationships.

glosses: weekly; held every week; regular weekly event
explanations: Something that takes place on a regular weekly basis. Most commonly used for meetings, reports, and other recurring business activities.

glosses: outdoor activities; activities held outdoors; field activities
explanations: Activities conducted outside, especially organized educational, recreational, or military activities in natural settings.
A government institution responsible for manufacturing coins and medals. In Japan, the Japan Mint is headquartered in Osaka.

glosses: three-person discussion; three-way conversation; trilateral talk
explanations: A formal discussion or conversation among exactly three people. Often used for published interviews or panel discussions featuring three participants.

glosses: algae; seaweed and related organisms as a biological group
explanations: A broad category of photosynthetic organisms that live in water, ranging from microscopic single-celled organisms to large seaweeds. A scientific classification term.
Intended for visual enjoyment rather than practical use. Used to describe plants, fish, and other items kept primarily for their beauty.

glosses: to carry out thoroughly; to see through to the end
to carry out thoroughly; to see through to the end; to accomplish completely
explanations: To persist with something from start to finish without giving up, ensuring complete execution of a plan, belief, or course of action.

glosses: to persist with; to stick to; to carry through
to persist with; to stick to; to carry through to the end
explanations: To maintain a stance, belief, or course of action without yielding, no matter what obstacles arise. A compound verb combining {貫|つらぬ}く (to pierce/persist) and {通|とお}す (to pass through/continue).

The tendency to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen. Also used as a philosophical term for the doctrine that the world is fundamentally bad or that evil outweighs good.
The act of leaving active military duty, either upon completing one's term of service or being discharged.
Used for military equipment such as ships, aircraft, or weapons systems that are taken out of active service.
A formal prayer or ritual performed to ask for divine blessing, healing, protection, or other spiritual favor. Often performed by a priest or religious practitioner at a shrine or temple.
A performer of manzai, a traditional form of Japanese stand-up comedy performed by a duo consisting of a straight man (tsukkomi) and a funny man (boke).
A warm, deep red color tinged with orange, named after the dye obtained from the roots of the madder plant ({茜|あかね}). Especially associated with the color of the sky at sunset.
A vivid, bright shade of red. One of Japan's traditional colors, historically associated with nobility and high rank.

glosses: honorarium; monetary reward; remuneration for services
explanations: A payment given as thanks for a service rendered, such as a lecture, consultation, or other professional contribution. Distinct from a regular salary or fee.

glosses: thank-you party; appreciation gathering; farewell party for teachers
explanations: A party held by students or their parents to express gratitude to teachers, typically at the time of graduation. Also used more broadly for any gathering organized to thank someone.
A state that remains unchanged over time, without fluctuation or variation. Often used in scientific and technical contexts to describe systems or processes in equilibrium.

glosses: inside the premises; on the grounds
inside the premises; on the grounds; within the property
explanations: The area within the boundaries of a piece of land or property. Used to describe the interior space of a compound, campus, building site, or other defined area.
A sturdy table or surface used for performing manual work, crafting, cooking preparation, or other hands-on tasks.
Describes a state where things or people follow proper order and rules. Used for situations, behavior, or environments that are neat, systematic, and well-regulated.
The lowest surface of an object, container, or geometric shape. Used both in everyday contexts (the bottom of a box) and in mathematics (the base of a solid figure).

glosses: multi-layered; multilevel; having many layers or strata
explanations: Having or consisting of multiple layers, levels, or strata. Used for physical structures, coatings, and abstract concepts like social hierarchy.

glosses: each section; each department; each part
each section; each department; all departments
explanations: Every department or division within an organization. Used in business and organizational contexts.
Every individual part or component of a machine, structure, or system.

A student who transfers into a school, university, or program partway through, typically entering at a year other than the first. Common in the Japanese university system where students from junior colleges or technical colleges transfer into the third year of a four-year university.

glosses: school dismissal time; time to go home from school
explanations: The designated time at which students are expected to leave school and head home. In Japan, this is often set by the school and may vary by season.
A school that admits only female students. Can refer to any level from elementary through university, though most commonly refers to middle schools and high schools.

glosses: use-by date; expiration date; period of validity for use
explanations: The date or period up to which a product can be safely or effectively used. Commonly applied to medicines, cosmetics, and other non-food products.
The evolutionary process by which organisms better adapted to their environment tend to survive and produce more offspring. The central mechanism of Charles Darwin's theory of evolution.

glosses: consolation money; reward for service; gratuity
explanations: A monetary payment given to thank or reward someone for their hard work, long service, or hardship. Often paid as a lump sum upon leaving a position or completing a difficult task.
A compensation system where pay is calculated based on individual performance, sales results, or output rather than a fixed salary. Common in sales and real estate.

glosses: water bus; river bus; sightseeing ferry
explanations: A passenger boat that operates on a regular route along rivers or waterways, functioning like a bus on water. Used for both transportation and sightseeing.

The set of documents required for an application, such as to a school, university, or for a patent. Typically includes application forms, transcripts, personal statements, and other supporting materials.

glosses: non-aggression pact; anti-war treaty; treaty renouncing war
explanations: A treaty in which signatory nations agree not to use war as an instrument of national policy. Most commonly refers to the Kellogg-Briand Pact of 1928.

An entrance examination for students seeking to transfer into a university or school at a year other than the first. In Japan, this typically allows students from junior colleges or technical colleges to enter the third year of a four-year university.

glosses: highest price; record high; peak value
explanations: The highest price or value that something has reached, especially in financial markets. Used for stock prices, currency exchange rates, commodity prices, and other measurable values.

glosses: highest amount; maximum sum; record amount
explanations: The largest monetary amount in a given context, such as a budget, salary, damage assessment, or transaction. Used for absolute amounts of money rather than market price fluctuations.

glosses: one or the other; either; whichever
explanations: A formal pronoun used to select one item from a set of options, meaning 'one of' or 'either one.' More literary than どれか or どちらか, and commonly found in written documents and official instructions.
Emphasizes that something happens only once and cannot be repeated, often carrying a sense of preciousness or urgency about a unique opportunity.
The state or act of consuming an excessive amount of a beverage, most commonly alcohol. Very common in everyday conversation, especially when describing hangover-related situations.

glosses: nominally; in name only; on paper
explanations: Describes something that is true only in name or on official records, while the actual situation is different. Frequently used in business and politics to contrast titles or statuses with real power or function.

glosses: automatic withdrawal; automatic debit; direct debit
explanations: A banking arrangement where recurring payments such as rent, utilities, or subscriptions are automatically deducted from a bank account on a set schedule.

glosses: exam question; test question; examination problem
explanations: The individual questions or problems that appear on a test or examination. Widely used in educational contexts from school tests to university entrance exams.

glosses: drill practice; repetitive practice; repeated exercise
explanations: A learning method based on performing the same action or exercise many times to build skill or commit something to memory. Commonly applied in education, music, sports, and language learning.

glosses: the whole world; the entire world; worldwide
explanations: Refers to the totality of the world without exception, emphasizing global scope. Often used in news reporting and statements about worldwide events, populations, or distributions.

The systematic process of ensuring that a product or service meets defined standards of quality, or a formal guarantee that a product will perform as expected. Widely used in manufacturing and business contexts.
The branch of medicine dealing with the musculoskeletal system, including bones, joints, and muscles. In Japanese, this term refers specifically to orthopedics, not cosmetic surgery.
An updated or revised version of a published work such as a book, textbook, dictionary, or manual, incorporating corrections or new content compared to earlier printings.

glosses: all at once; in one go
explanations: A slightly casual way of saying 'once' or 'one time,' more colloquial than 一度 or 一回. Particularly common in Kansai dialect but widely understood throughout Japan.
Used in the pattern 一遍に to mean doing something all at once rather than in stages or portions, such as carrying everything in a single trip or eating all the food at the same time.
A small pocket of fluid that forms under the skin, typically caused by burns, friction, or sunburn. A very common everyday health term in Japanese.

glosses: to keep running; to continue running
to keep going; to keep pushing forward (figurative)
explanations: To physically continue running without stopping, as in a marathon, a chase, or sustained exercise over a period of time.
Used metaphorically to describe persisting in one's efforts, staying at the forefront, or continuing to strive toward a goal without giving up.

glosses: formally; on paper; as a formality; in form
explanations: Indicates that something is true in terms of official form or procedure, often implying that the reality may differ from what records or paperwork show. Common in business, legal, and bureaucratic contexts.

glosses: hair texture; hair quality; hair type
explanations: The inherent characteristics of a person's hair, such as whether it is straight, curly, thick, thin, oily, or dry. Commonly discussed in beauty, salon, and hair care contexts.
The elected head of a Japanese prefecture (県), responsible for governing prefectural affairs. Japan has 43 prefectures designated as 県, each headed by a 県知事.
A self-contained section of a larger musical work such as a symphony, sonata, or concerto, each with its own tempo, key, and character. Referred to by number (第一楽章, 第二楽章, etc.).
Fish that has not been cooked or preserved, eaten fresh and uncooked. A staple of Japanese cuisine, appearing in dishes such as sashimi and sushi.

glosses: by-election; special election (to fill a vacancy)
explanations: An election held to fill a seat in a legislative body that has become vacant due to the death, resignation, or disqualification of the incumbent. Common in Japanese political news coverage.

glosses: question (on a test or survey); query; problem (set for answering)
explanations: A question that has been deliberately composed and presented for someone to answer, typically on an examination, questionnaire, or survey. More formal than 質問 and implies intentional design.

glosses: as before; as previously; same as before
explanations: Indicates that something continues or should continue in the same manner as it was before a change or event. Slightly more formal than 今まで通り.

glosses: as usual; as before; same as always
explanations: Expresses that something should stay or will stay the same as it has been up to now, emphasizing continuity and the absence of change. Very natural in both spoken and written Japanese.

glosses: to get an idea; to find inspiration; to conceive of an idea
explanations: To arrive at a creative concept or idea, often by drawing on an external source of inspiration such as a real event, another work, or a personal experience. A somewhat literary expression used in artistic and intellectual contexts.

glosses: while driving; while in motion; while running (of a vehicle)
explanations: Describes the state of a vehicle being in motion on the road or tracks. Frequently seen on safety signs and in traffic regulations, and almost always refers to vehicles rather than people.

glosses: appeal; persuasive power; ability to attract (customers, attention)
explanations: The power of a product, advertisement, or message to attract attention and persuade consumers. A marketing and business term widely used in discussions of advertising strategy and branding.
A device that controls the flow of water in plumbing, such as a kitchen or bathroom faucet. More technical than the everyday word 蛇口, and commonly used in product catalogs and plumbing contexts.

glosses: magma; molten rock beneath the earth's surface
explanations: Extremely hot molten rock found deep beneath the earth's surface, particularly under volcanoes. When it reaches the surface during an eruption, it is called 溶岩 (lava).

glosses: promotion in rank; advancement to a higher grade
explanations: Moving up to a higher rank or grade within a structured ranking system, particularly in martial arts, traditional arts, or civil service classifications. Distinct from 昇進, which refers to corporate promotions.
An interrogative word used to ask which month of the year something occurs in or relates to. One of the most basic question words for dates in Japanese.
The act of locking a door, gate, or other opening. Used in formal and written contexts more than everyday speech.

glosses: inside the building; within the facility
explanations: The interior of a large building such as a museum, hotel, library, or theater. Often used in signs and announcements.

glosses: entering a store; admission to a restaurant
explanations: The act of entering a commercial establishment such as a shop or restaurant. Common in service-industry contexts.

glosses: scrap of paper; slip of paper
explanations: A small or insignificant piece of paper. Can be neutral (a memo or note) or dismissive (implying something is worthless).
A notebook or book specifically intended for writing a daily diary. Refers to the physical object rather than the content.

glosses: chest area; bosom; the area around the upper chest and neckline
explanations: The front of the body around the upper chest, especially where clothing opens or closes. Often refers to the area visible at the neckline of clothing.
The front part of the throat, from the base of the chin to the upper chest. Used both literally and in many figurative expressions.
A person who translates written text from one language to another. Distinguished from an interpreter, who works with spoken language.
A person who subscribes to or regularly purchases a newspaper, magazine, or other publication. Also used for digital subscriptions.
A person who is learning or studying something. Commonly used in educational and language-learning contexts.
An award given for achievement in literature. Japan has many prestigious literary awards that receive significant media attention.

glosses: newcomer award; rookie of the year award
newcomer award; best new talent award; rookie of the year
explanations: An award given to a promising newcomer in a field such as literature, music, film, or sports.
Something attached to the outside of a device or system rather than being built in. Very common in technology contexts for peripherals and accessories.

glosses: rain shelter; rain guard; rain cover
explanations: Something that provides protection from rain — a shelter, awning, cover, or other structure or device that keeps rain off.

glosses: the genuine article; authentic product from its place of origin
explanations: A product that comes from its recognized place of origin or production, guaranteeing authenticity and quality.
A state of mutual hostility or opposition between people who should normally get along. Often used for conflicts within families, organizations, or between allies.
An alphanumeric code that identifies a specific model or version of a product. Essential for ordering replacement parts, comparing products, or seeking support.

glosses: top rank; first place; head of a class or group
chief; head (of a diplomatic mission or organization)
explanations: The highest-ranking position in an academic class, examination, or organizational hierarchy.
The leading member of a group, especially in diplomatic or governmental contexts.

glosses: chapel; prayer hall; place of worship
explanations: A building or room used for Christian worship services or prayer. Can refer to a standalone chapel or a worship space within a larger building like a university or hospital.
A question or test format where the answer is chosen from a set of options rather than written freely. Common in standardized testing.
The continuous, unceasing change of circumstances and fortune. Conveys a sense of impermanence and the inevitability of change.
In Buddhist terminology, the cycle of death and rebirth through the various realms of existence.

glosses: running the full distance; completing a course
running the full distance; covering the entire course
explanations: Successfully running or traveling the entire length of a route or course. Used for races, road trips, and challenging journeys. Implies endurance and accomplishment.

glosses: to fail to write; to make a mistake in writing
to fail to write; to miss writing; to make a mistake in writing
explanations: To either miss the opportunity to write something down, or to make an error while writing. A compound verb combining {書|か}く (to write) with the auxiliary {損|そこ}ねる (to fail to do, to miss doing).
Having or evoking a feeling of romance, idealism, or sentimental beauty. Used for people, settings, experiences, and attitudes.

glosses: one-upmanship; asserting social dominance; showing off superiority
explanations: The behavior of trying to establish oneself as superior to others in conversation or social situations, often through subtle boasting, name-dropping, or belittling others' achievements. A modern buzzword in Japanese social commentary.
A professional who evaluates the authenticity, quality, or value of items such as real estate, art, antiques, or gemstones. Often a licensed or certified profession in Japan.

glosses: to be compatible; to go well together
to be compatible; to get along well; to be a good match
explanations: Describes a natural compatibility between people, things, or combinations. Can refer to personal relationships, food pairings, technology compatibility, and more.

glosses: quick-witted; sharp-minded; quick on the uptake
explanations: Describes a person who thinks fast, understands quickly, and responds well in the moment. A common and natural-sounding compliment.

glosses: to make worse; to aggravate; to complicate
explanations: To cause an illness, situation, or relationship to become more difficult or severe through neglect, mishandling, or stubbornness.

glosses: cheap item; low-quality goods; bargain stuff
explanations: An inexpensive item, typically implying poor quality. Often used with a negative connotation to suggest something is cheaply made or not worth buying.

glosses: guaranteed quality; certified; of proven merit
explanations: Describes something or someone whose quality, skill, or authenticity has been officially or widely recognized. Used to vouch for the excellence of a person's abilities or the quality of an item.

glosses: cram school; tutoring school; after-school study school
explanations: A private supplementary school where students attend after regular school hours to prepare for entrance exams or improve academic performance. A central part of the Japanese education system.
The area in the immediate surroundings of a particular location. Slightly more formal than 近く and often used in written or semi-formal speech.
A word or phrase specific to a particular field or profession that may not be readily understood by people outside that field.

glosses: gift certificate; gift voucher; merchandise coupon
explanations: A prepaid voucher that can be exchanged for goods at participating stores. Commonly given as gifts for celebrations, rewards, or prizes in Japan.
A small inflamed bump on the skin, especially on the face. Refers both to individual pimples and to acne as a condition. Very common in everyday conversation about skin care.

The person who created the original work that a movie, anime, drama, or other adaptation is based on. Frequently used in discussions about manga-to-anime adaptations, novel-to-film adaptations, and similar contexts.

glosses: either way; in any case; regardless; no matter which
explanations: Used to indicate that the outcome or conclusion remains the same regardless of which option is chosen. Functions as a sentence-initial or mid-sentence connector.

glosses: to some extent; even a little
to some extent; even a little; at least somewhat
explanations: An adverbial expression meaning 'even if only a small amount' or 'to whatever extent possible.' Used to express that even a minimal degree of something is sufficient or relevant.

glosses: at top speed; in a huge rush; extremely fast
explanations: A train service faster than a regular express. Originally referred to the first Shinkansen services.
Used figuratively to describe doing something at maximum speed or completing a task in an extremely short time.

glosses: start of the rainy season; onset of tsuyu
explanations: The official beginning of the rainy season (梅雨) in Japan, typically announced by the Japan Meteorological Agency around early to mid June. Marks the transition into weeks of frequent rain.

glosses: the four cardinal directions; all directions
east, west, south, and north; the four cardinal directions
explanations: The four main compass directions considered as a set. Literally lists them in the Japanese order: east, west, south, north.
Used figuratively to mean 'in every direction' or 'all over the place.'

glosses: to be caught in a trap; to fall for a trick
to be caught in a trap; to be snared
to fall for a trick; to be deceived; to be trapped
explanations: Literally, to be caught in a physical trap set for animals.
Figuratively, to fall for someone's scheme, plot, or deception.

glosses: to leave; to exit; to withdraw
to leave; to exit; to withdraw from a place
explanations: To leave a room, building, meeting, or event. More formal than 出る and implies an orderly or deliberate departure.

glosses: to suffocate; to choke; to asphyxiate
explanations: To be unable to breathe due to obstruction of the airway or lack of oxygen, potentially leading to death. Used both for literal suffocation and figuratively for feeling stifled.

glosses: harmful substance; hazardous material; toxic substance
explanations: A substance that can cause harm to humans, animals, or the environment. Commonly used in environmental, health, and safety contexts.

glosses: as one wishes; as one pleases
as one wishes; as one pleases; freely; to one's heart's content
explanations: Describes doing something exactly the way one wants, without restriction or compromise. Conveys a sense of freedom and satisfaction.

glosses: change of seasons; seasonal transition; turning point between seasons
explanations: The transitional period when one season shifts to the next. In Japan, these transitions are culturally significant and are closely associated with changes in health, wardrobe, and diet.

glosses: misjudgment; miscalculation; wrong assumption; mistaken expectation
explanations: A situation where one's prediction, expectation, or assessment turns out to be wrong. Often used when plans fail because the initial assumptions were incorrect.

glosses: merciless; ruthless; relentless; without mercy or compassion
explanations: Describes a person, action, or situation that shows absolutely no mercy or leniency. Emphasizes the complete absence of compassion or forgiveness.

glosses: now on sale; currently available for purchase
explanations: Indicates that a product, ticket, or item is currently being sold. Very commonly seen on signs, advertisements, and product packaging.
Living to an old age; having a long lifespan. Used both as a noun describing longevity and as a na-adjective describing someone or something that is long-lived.

glosses: acceleration; rate of change of velocity
explanations: A physics term for the rate at which the speed of an object changes over time. Also used figuratively to describe the increasing pace of change.

glosses: incompatible; don't get along; not a good match
explanations: Describes people, things, or situations that do not work well together. Used for interpersonal relationships, food combinations, technology compatibility, and more.
Describes pulling, pushing, or doing something with physical force and determination.
Describes approaching something or someone with assertive, relentless energy. Often used for someone who is pushy or forward in social situations.

glosses: to choke; to be overwhelmed by a smell or taste
to choke violently; to cough and gag
to be overwhelmed by a strong smell or atmosphere
explanations: To choke so intensely that one cannot stop coughing, often due to smoke, strong smells, or food going down the wrong way.
To feel stifled or overpowered by an intense fragrance, heat, or humidity. Often used to describe being enveloped by thick, heavy air.

glosses: whichever is fine; any one will do
whichever is fine; any one will do; it doesn't matter which
explanations: Used to express indifference about a choice, indicating that any option among a set is acceptable. Can convey flexibility, indecision, or lack of preference.

glosses: to change one's attitude; to shift one's stance; to alter one's demeanor
explanations: To noticeably change how one behaves toward someone or something. Often implies a sudden or calculated shift, such as becoming friendlier after learning someone is important, or becoming cold after a disagreement.

glosses: to prohibit; to ban; to forbid
explanations: To officially or authoritatively prevent something from being done. Used for rules, laws, regulations, and formal restrictions.

glosses: to execute; to carry out; to put into practice
explanations: To actually do something that was planned or decided. Emphasizes taking concrete action rather than just thinking or talking about it.

glosses: to commute to school; to attend school
to commute to school; to attend school regularly
explanations: To travel to school on a regular basis. Refers to the daily journey between home and school, not the act of studying there.

glosses: to exaggerate; to overstate; to embellish
explanations: To represent something as greater, more extreme, or more important than it actually is. Used for both intentional and unintentional exaggeration in speech, writing, or artistic expression.
The act of accepting, receiving, or admitting someone or something. Used for people (refugees, patients, students) as well as abstract concepts (proposals, conditions).

glosses: innocent and carefree; naive and open; artless
innocent and carefree; naive and open; artless; unaffected
explanations: Describes a personality that is naturally cheerful, open, and free of guile or pretense. Often used as a compliment for people (especially children and young women) who are unselfconsciously honest and sunny in disposition.

glosses: to be fully equipped; to have everything in place
to be fully equipped; to be fully furnished; to have everything in place
explanations: To have all necessary equipment, facilities, or conditions thoroughly prepared and available. Often describes buildings, facilities, or systems that lack nothing.

glosses: oral examination; oral test; viva voce
explanations: An examination conducted verbally rather than in writing. The examinee answers questions spoken by the examiner. Common in academic settings such as graduate school defenses and professional licensing.

glosses: hair dye; hair coloring; the act of dyeing hair
explanations: Refers to both the product used to color hair and the act of dyeing one's hair. A compound of {髪|かみ} (hair) and {染|そ}め (dyeing).

glosses: brave and fierce; valiant; dauntless; bold in battle
explanations: Describes someone who is both courageous and ferocious, typically in the context of fighting or facing danger. Combines the ideas of bravery and fierceness.

glosses: bold; daring; fearless; nerves of steel
explanations: Describes someone who remains calm and unshaken in situations that would frighten or intimidate most people. Emphasizes mental fortitude and composure under pressure rather than physical bravery.

glosses: current affairs; current events issues; topical issues
explanations: Issues and topics being discussed in the news and public discourse at the present time. Often refers to questions about current events in tests and examinations.
The seat(s) in the back of a vehicle, especially a car. Distinguished from the front passenger seat and the driver's seat.

glosses: research student; non-degree research student; auditing researcher
explanations: A student affiliated with a university or research institution who conducts research under a professor's guidance but is not enrolled in a formal degree program. Common as a preparatory step before entering a Japanese graduate school.

glosses: to go to kindergarten; to go to nursery school
to go to kindergarten; to go to nursery school; to attend preschool
explanations: To go to a kindergarten ({幼稚園|ようちえん}) or nursery school ({保育園|ほいくえん}). Used for the daily act of a child going to their preschool facility.
Physically narrow or cramped, describing roads, spaces, or areas that are too small or confined for comfortable use.
Figuratively describes a person's perspective or thinking as limited, intolerant, or lacking breadth.

glosses: smooth, soft skin; mochi-like skin; flawless complexion
explanations: Skin that is smooth, soft, and plump like freshly pounded mochi (rice cake). A complimentary term for beautiful, blemish-free skin.

glosses: bravery in battle; martial valor; military prowess
explanations: Courage and skill displayed in warfare or combat. Specifically refers to valor demonstrated through martial deeds.

glosses: to be shrewd; to slyly take advantage
to be shrewd; to be calculating; to slyly take advantage; to look out for oneself
explanations: To cleverly and often shamelessly take advantage of a situation for one's own benefit. Implies a mix of shrewdness and cheekiness — the person manages to come out ahead while others might not notice or can only shake their heads.
A garden or green space built on the roof of a building. Found on department stores, office buildings, and residences, providing a place to relax or grow plants in urban areas.

glosses: improved model; improved type; upgraded version
explanations: A modified version of a product, machine, or system that has been enhanced or upgraded from the original. Commonly used in technical and commercial contexts.

glosses: start of sales; launch; going on sale
start of sales; launch; going on sale; release
explanations: The beginning of selling a product to the public. Used for commercial product releases, ticket sales, and other sales events.

glosses: presence (at a scene); being on-site; sense of being there
presence at a scene; being on-site; attending in person
sense of being there; realism; immersiveness
explanations: The act of being present at a particular location, especially an official or important scene such as a crime scene or event.
The quality of making someone feel as if they are actually present at a scene. Most commonly used in the compound {臨場感|りんじょうかん}.

The act of including or encompassing something within a larger whole. Used in academic, social policy, and logical contexts to describe how broader categories contain narrower ones, or how society includes diverse groups.

glosses: to return home; to come home; to go home
explanations: To go back to one's home, especially after work, school, or going out. Refers specifically to returning to one's own residence.

glosses: to release; to set free; to liberate
explanations: To free someone or something from confinement, restriction, oppression, or an unpleasant state. Used both literally (releasing a prisoner) and figuratively (freeing from stress or obligations).

glosses: to contradict; to be inconsistent; to be contradictory
explanations: To be logically incompatible or inconsistent with something else. Used when two statements, facts, or actions cannot both be true or coexist.

glosses: to oppose; to conflict; to confront
to oppose; to conflict; to confront; to be at odds
explanations: To be in opposition or conflict with another party, idea, or position. Implies two sides standing against each other, whether in opinions, interests, or physical confrontation.

glosses: to continue; to occur in succession; to be consecutive
explanations: For events, actions, or things to follow one after another without interruption. Emphasizes the unbroken sequence or series nature of occurrences.

glosses: to be patient; to endure; to persevere
explanations: To bear a difficult or unpleasant situation with patience, without complaining or giving up. Implies active endurance over a period of time.

glosses: to watch; to view (TV, video, media)
to watch; to view; to watch and listen to (TV, video, media)
explanations: To watch and listen to broadcast or recorded media such as television programs, videos, or online content. Combines seeing ({視|し}) and hearing ({聴|ちょう}).

glosses: to equip; to attach; to put on (equipment, device)
to equip; to attach; to put on; to install
explanations: To put on or attach equipment, a device, or gear to a person or object. Used for functional items like helmets, lenses, parts, or devices, not for everyday clothing.

glosses: to beautify; to glorify; to romanticize
to glorify; to romanticize; to idealize
explanations: To make something more physically attractive or clean. Often used for environmental improvement or cleaning up public spaces.
To present something in a more favorable light than reality, glossing over negative aspects. Often used critically to suggest someone is distorting the truth.

glosses: to occur frequently; to happen repeatedly
explanations: For events, especially undesirable ones like accidents, crimes, or problems, to happen with high frequency. Almost always used for negative occurrences.

glosses: to protrude; to stand out; to excel
to protrude; to jut out; to stick out
to stand out; to excel; to be outstanding
explanations: For something to extend outward or project beyond a surface or boundary. A physical protrusion.
To be notably superior or prominent compared to others. Used to describe exceptional performance, talent, or characteristics.

glosses: to devise; to come up with an idea; to find a way
to devise; to come up with a creative solution; to find a way; to think of a good idea
explanations: To use ingenuity and creative thinking to find a better way of doing something or to solve a problem. Implies thoughtful effort and resourcefulness.

glosses: to permeate; to penetrate; to spread into
to permeate; to soak in; to seep through
to spread; to take hold; to become established
explanations: For a liquid or substance to gradually soak into or pass through something. Physical permeation.
For ideas, customs, values, or practices to gradually become widely known and accepted in society or a group.

glosses: to spread; to become widespread; to become popular
to spread; to become widespread; to become popular; to come into wide use
explanations: For something — typically a product, technology, practice, or idea — to become widely used or adopted across a society or group. Implies reaching a broad audience.

glosses: to achieve; to accomplish; to attain
explanations: To successfully complete or reach a goal, target, or objective that required effort. Implies a deliberate pursuit that has been fulfilled.

glosses: used bookstore; secondhand bookshop; antiquarian bookshop
explanations: A store that sells used, secondhand, or rare and antique books. More formal and literary than the everyday term.

glosses: to slander; to defame; to libel
to slander; to defame; to libel; to speak ill of
explanations: To make false or malicious statements about someone that damage their reputation. A formal term often used in legal and media contexts.

glosses: to rely on; to depend on; to count on
explanations: To trust and depend on someone or something for help, support, or guidance. Implies confidence that the person or thing is reliable.
A parting greeting used when saying goodbye, especially when the separation may be for a long time or permanent. In everyday casual speech, shorter forms like じゃあね or バイバイ are more common.
The polite form of {名前|なまえ} (name), formed by adding the honorific prefix お. Used when asking about or referring to someone else's name in polite or formal situations.

glosses: to lighten the mood; to ease the atmosphere
to lighten the mood; to ease the atmosphere; to break the ice
explanations: To make a tense, awkward, or formal atmosphere more relaxed and comfortable, typically through humor, a friendly remark, or warm behavior.
The humble (謙譲語) form of {会|あ}う (to meet). Used to lower oneself when speaking about meeting someone of higher status, such as a client, superior, or respected person.

glosses: mere; just; ordinary; nothing special; only
explanations: Used before a noun to indicate that something is nothing more than what is stated — it is ordinary, unremarkable, or should not be taken as anything special.

glosses: this and that; various things; in various ways
this and that; various things; one thing and another
explanations: Refers to multiple unspecified things, topics, or matters being considered, discussed, or dealt with.

glosses: shameful; unsightly; disgraceful; embarrassing to look at
explanations: Describes behavior, appearance, or situations that are embarrassing, undignified, or socially unacceptable — something one would be ashamed to show to others.

glosses: vegetarian diet; plant-based eating; eating vegetables
explanations: A diet centered on vegetables and plant-based foods, excluding or minimizing meat and fish.

glosses: farewell gift; parting gift; going-away present (often money)
explanations: A gift, typically money in an envelope, given to someone who is moving away, transferring to another workplace, or embarking on a long journey.
An organized group of people walking together in formation, typically in a ceremonial, military, or protest context.

glosses: hot and humid; high temperature and high humidity
explanations: Describes weather or climate conditions characterized by both high temperatures and high humidity levels.

glosses: working hours; labor hours; hours of work
explanations: The total amount of time an employee spends working, often discussed in the context of labor law, workplace reform, or work-life balance.

glosses: captain (of an aircraft); pilot in command
explanations: The chief pilot who has overall responsibility for an aircraft and its crew during a flight.

glosses: voter turnout; voting rate; percentage of eligible voters who cast ballots
explanations: The proportion of eligible voters who actually vote in an election, expressed as a percentage.
The quality or degree to which a substance is poisonous or harmful to living organisms.

glosses: expert; knowledgeable person; person of insight
explanations: A person with knowledge, insight, or expertise in a particular field, often cited in news reports or academic discussions.

glosses: religious precepts; commandments; moral or religious rules
explanations: Rules of conduct prescribed by a religion, particularly the disciplinary rules observed by Buddhist monks and nuns, or more broadly, any set of religious commandments.
A ship designed primarily for transporting goods and materials rather than passengers.
A form of gymnastics combining dance, ballet, and gymnastics with the use of apparatus such as ribbons, hoops, balls, clubs, and ropes.
A name that identifies a person, including both given names and family names. Used especially in contexts discussing names as a category or system.

glosses: polling place; polling station; voting site
explanations: A designated location where voters go to cast their ballots during an election.

glosses: within the deadline; before the expiration
within the deadline; within the time limit; before expiration
explanations: Within the specified time period or before a deadline passes. Used for deadlines, validity periods, and expiration dates.

glosses: single color; monochrome; solid color; one color
explanations: Consisting of only one color, without patterns, gradients, or multiple hues.
Refers back to something that was mentioned or described earlier in a text or document.

glosses: beautiful appearance; fine view; aesthetic appeal
beautiful appearance; fine view; scenic beauty; aesthetic appeal
explanations: The beautiful visual appearance of a place, building, or area, especially as something to be preserved or maintained.

glosses: vanishing like clouds and mist; disappearing without a trace
vanishing without a trace; disappearing completely; melting away like clouds and mist
explanations: Describes something — typically worries, doubts, plans, or opposition — that disappears completely, as if evaporating like clouds and mist.

glosses: overtime work; work beyond regular hours
overtime work; work beyond regular hours; excess duty
explanations: Work performed beyond the standard or legally mandated working hours, especially in a formal or administrative context.

glosses: spiritual sensitivity; psychic ability; sixth sense for the supernatural
explanations: The ability to sense or perceive spirits, ghosts, or supernatural phenomena.
A sudden flash of insight or creative inspiration, as if coming from a higher source.

glosses: mutual assistance; mutual aid; helping each other
mutual assistance; mutual aid; community help
explanations: The concept of people in a community or group helping each other, particularly in times of disaster or difficulty. Often discussed as one of three pillars of disaster response alongside self-help and public assistance.

glosses: mutual aid; mutual support; mutual assistance
mutual aid; mutual support; reciprocal assistance
explanations: The principle of members of a group supporting each other, especially as an organizing principle for cooperatives, insurance systems, and social organizations.
The concept and practice of preventing traffic accidents and ensuring safe conditions on roads and at intersections.

glosses: dust; fine particles; particulate matter; airborne dust
explanations: Very small solid particles suspended in the air, often a health or safety concern in workplaces and environments.

glosses: mentioned above; as stated above; aforementioned
mentioned above; as stated above; the foregoing
explanations: Refers back to something that has been stated or described earlier in the same text, particularly in formal or academic writing.

glosses: note; annotation; explanatory remark; added comment
explanations: A brief written explanation or comment added to a text, document, or map to clarify or supplement the main content.
A casual sweatshirt or jacket with a hood, popular as everyday wear.

glosses: every time; whenever; each time that
explanations: Used after a verb in dictionary form or a noun to indicate that something happens on every occasion of the stated action or event.

glosses: at the same time; simultaneously; also
at the same time; also; as well
explanations: Two or more events happening at the same moment or in parallel.
Used to add another characteristic or aspect, meaning 'and also' or 'while being.'

glosses: headlong; straight ahead; at full speed
explanations: Moving directly toward something without hesitation or deviation, often with great speed or single-minded determination.
Describes leaving or acting quickly, often because one feels uncomfortable, awkward, or eager to get away from a situation.
Used mostly in negative sentences to mean 'nothing in particular' or 'not especially.' Occasionally appears in questions asking if there is anything noteworthy.

glosses: to be dumbfounded; to be stunned; to be taken aback
explanations: To be so surprised by something unexpected that one is momentarily speechless or unable to react.

glosses: price drop; decline in price; depreciation
explanations: A decrease in the price or value of goods, stocks, property, or other assets.
A bag used to carry purchased goods, whether a reusable bag brought from home or a bag provided at a store.

glosses: trash bag; garbage bag; rubbish bag
explanations: A bag used for collecting and disposing of garbage. In many Japanese municipalities, designated bags must be purchased and used for trash collection.

glosses: to feel unwell; to be in bad condition; inconvenient
to feel unwell; to feel sick
to be in bad condition; to not work properly
explanations: Describes a person who is not feeling well physically. A common, polite way to express illness.
Describes a machine, device, or situation that is not functioning correctly.
Describes a situation that is troublesome or difficult to deal with.

glosses: excuse me, but...; pardon me, but...
explanations: A polite phrase used before asking a personal question, making a request, or saying something that might seem rude. It softens what follows.

glosses: to turn one's attention to; to look toward
to look toward; to turn one's eyes to
to turn one's attention to; to pay attention to; to focus on
explanations: To physically direct one's gaze toward something.
To direct one's awareness or interest toward an issue, topic, or aspect. The figurative meaning is more common.

glosses: to get on track; to get going smoothly
to get on track; to get into full swing; to start running smoothly
explanations: Used when a project, business, plan, or activity passes its initial difficulties and begins to operate steadily and successfully.

glosses: moving in; transfer (to a new school, area, etc.)
moving in; registering as a new resident
transfer; transferring in (to a new school or workplace)
explanations: The act of officially moving into a new municipality or area and registering at the local ward or city office.
Entering a new school or organization as a transfer, not from the beginning.
A different plan or proposal offered as a substitute when the original one is rejected or deemed inadequate.

glosses: suspect; person suspected of a crime
explanations: A legal term for a person who is suspected of having committed a crime but has not yet been formally charged. Used in police and legal contexts.
A formal instruction or notification issued from a higher authority (government ministry, company headquarters, etc.) to subordinate bodies or personnel.

glosses: just after a bath; fresh from the bath
explanations: The state or moment immediately after getting out of a bath or hot spring. Also used as a modifier for things used or done right after bathing.
The act of laughing at or making fun of oneself. Can be a coping mechanism, social strategy, or expression of humility.
A state of inactivity in biological organisms (plants, animals, seeds) during unfavorable conditions.
Used figuratively for accounts, companies, or organizations that exist but are not currently active.
A solid layer of rock beneath soil and loose material. The geological foundation.
Used figuratively for a firm, unshakeable foundation of support, often in political or business contexts.
A system of government in which the head of state is elected or appointed rather than inheriting the position, and sovereignty rests with the people.

glosses: freedom of expression; freedom of speech
explanations: The right to express ideas, opinions, and information freely through speech, writing, art, and other media. A fundamental right guaranteed by Article 21 of the Japanese Constitution.

glosses: to keep in one's heart; to harbor secretly
to keep in one's heart; to harbor secretly; to hold inside without telling anyone
explanations: To keep feelings, thoughts, intentions, or memories hidden inside oneself without expressing or sharing them.
Favoring reform, new ideas, or modern approaches. Describes people, ideas, policies, or attitudes that embrace change and advancement.

glosses: ginjo sake; premium sake brewed from highly polished rice
explanations: A grade of Japanese sake made from rice that has been polished to remove at least 40% of the outer layer. Known for its fruity aroma and clean, refined flavor.

glosses: branches and leaves; minor details; nonessentials
explanations: The branches and foliage of a tree or plant.
Figuratively, the trivial or secondary aspects of something, as opposed to the main point or trunk (the core issue).
Rock or mineral from which metal or valuable minerals can be extracted. A key term in mining and geology.
The act of sticking or affixing something (a stamp, sticker, label, patch, etc.) onto a surface. A formal word commonly used in official and administrative contexts.

glosses: time deposit; fixed-term deposit; term savings
explanations: A type of bank deposit where money is deposited for a set period of time at a fixed interest rate. Early withdrawal typically incurs a penalty or reduced interest.

glosses: exactly; that's right; just as you say
explanations: Used to affirm that what someone said is correct. A common and direct way to express agreement.

glosses: suddenly stopping; coming to a complete halt
explanations: Describes something fitting, matching, or hitting a target with perfect accuracy.
Describes something ceasing abruptly and completely, such as rain stopping or a noise ending.

glosses: delivery; something delivered; gift sent to someone
explanations: An item that is delivered or sent to someone, often a gift or package. Implies a personal or thoughtful delivery rather than commercial shipping.

glosses: family; clan; school (of an art or discipline)
school; group of disciples (in an art or discipline)
explanations: A family group or clan sharing a common ancestor or family name. Often used in historical or formal contexts.
A group of practitioners or disciples under one master, especially in traditional arts like sumo, rakugo, tea ceremony, or martial arts.

glosses: to make clear; to reveal; to clarify
explanations: To bring something to light or make a fact, truth, or situation clearly known. Often used in formal or investigative contexts.

glosses: to make fun of; to look down on; to belittle
explanations: To treat someone as slightly stupid or inferior, often with a condescending attitude. Implies a mild but insulting degree of mockery.

glosses: to let flutter; to let wave; to stream (hair, flag, etc.)
to let flutter; to let wave; to stream
explanations: To cause or allow something light — such as hair, a flag, a scarf — to wave or flutter in the wind. The causative form of なびく.

glosses: making transparent; increasing transparency or openness
explanations: The process of making something more open, visible, or accountable. Most commonly used in the context of governance, business, or organizational processes.

glosses: triple time; waltz time; three-beat rhythm
three essential qualities; the complete package
explanations: A musical time signature with three beats per measure, as in a waltz.
Used figuratively to describe three important qualities that together make something or someone ideal. Most commonly appears in the expression {三拍子|さんびょうし}{揃|そろ}う (all three qualities are present).

glosses: if anything; rather; if forced to choose
explanations: Used to express a mild preference or tendency when choosing between two options. Softens a statement by implying the speaker is making a qualified judgment rather than a strong assertion.

glosses: freshly picked; freshly made; just harvested
explanations: The act of collecting money owed, especially debts. Can imply aggressive or persistent collection efforts.
Describes something that has just been picked, caught, or made. Emphasizes freshness.

glosses: to laugh heartily; to roar with laughter
to laugh heartily; to roar with laughter; to laugh boldly
explanations: To laugh in a big, bold, uninhibited way. Implies a spirited, generous personality.
A device for taking photographs. An older or more formal word for camera, now largely replaced by カメラ in everyday speech.
A number less than zero. Used in mathematics and science contexts.

glosses: Japanese rendering of classical Chinese text (kanbun)
Japanese rendering of classical Chinese text; kanbun written in Japanese word order
explanations: A version of a classical Chinese (kanbun) text that has been rearranged into Japanese word order and supplemented with Japanese grammatical elements, making it readable as Japanese prose.

glosses: for one's own exclusive use; personal; private
explanations: Something designated for or reserved for one person's use only. Used as a noun or as a modifier with の.
The grammatical form used to ask questions. In Japanese, this typically involves adding か at the end of a sentence or using rising intonation.

glosses: to be in an awkward position; to have no standing; to lose face
explanations: Describes a situation where someone's position, reputation, or dignity is undermined, leaving them with no way to justify or defend themselves.
A pleasant or refreshing coolness, as of the air or a surface.
An attitude of emotional detachment, lack of warmth, or chilly reception toward someone.
A person who has acquired specialized practical skills, especially in manual or technical work. Used in formal and official contexts.

glosses: to begin writing; to start writing
explanations: To start the act of writing — a letter, essay, novel, or any text. A compound verb formed from {書|か}く and {始|はじ}める.

glosses: to have a keen nose; to sniff out; to be shrewd at detecting
to have a keen nose; to sniff out; to be shrewd at detecting opportunities or information
explanations: To use one's intuition or shrewdness to detect something, especially business opportunities, trends, or information that others miss. A figurative expression using the nose as a metaphor for intuition.

glosses: visible; visual; within the range of sight
visible; visual; able to be seen
explanations: Describes something that can be seen with the eyes. Most commonly used as a prefix in compound words related to visibility and optics.

glosses: to rest one's elbows on (a table); to prop one's chin on one's elbow
explanations: The action of placing one's elbows on a surface such as a table. In Japanese culture, this is generally considered bad manners, especially while eating.
A track and field event in which athletes throw a spear-shaped implement (javelin) as far as possible.

glosses: to soak in water; to immerse in water
explanations: To place something in water and leave it submerged, typically for cleaning, softening, or preparation purposes.

glosses: to pour one's passion into; to devote oneself passionately
explanations: To dedicate one's energy and enthusiasm wholeheartedly to a pursuit or cause.
Refers to the middle level in a ranking or classification, especially in education where it denotes secondary-level schooling.
Fiber produced through chemical processes rather than from natural sources. Includes materials like polyester, nylon, and acrylic.

glosses: debtor; person who owes a debt
explanations: A person or entity that owes money or has a financial obligation to another party. A formal legal and financial term.

glosses: to be late; to arrive late; to be tardy
explanations: To arrive after the expected or scheduled time, particularly for school, work, meetings, or appointments.

glosses: to be absent; to miss (class, a meeting)
to be absent; to miss; to not attend
explanations: To fail to attend or be present at a scheduled event such as class, a meeting, or a ceremony.
A person who consistently puts in effort and works hard. Used as a compliment describing someone's character.
A situation of serious difficulty, misfortune, or unfavorable conditions. Often used in contexts of overcoming challenges.
A cluster of people gathered around something of interest, such as a street performance, an accident scene, or a shop display.

glosses: water jug; pitcher; water container for tea ceremony
fresh water container for tea ceremony
explanations: A container for pouring water, typically a jug or pitcher used at the dining table.
A lidded ceramic vessel used in the Japanese tea ceremony to hold fresh water for replenishing the kettle and rinsing the tea bowl.
Having a smooth, shiny surface or appearance. Used for hair, skin, lacquerware, and similar objects.
Having a vibrant, attractive appearance that suggests health, youth, or sensual beauty.

glosses: to stand out; to excel; to surpass others
explanations: To be markedly superior to others in ability, skill, or achievement. A literary and somewhat elevated expression.
A feeling of self-worth and dignity. Can be positive (healthy self-respect) or negative (excessive pride that prevents asking for help or admitting fault).

A traditional wooden townhouse typically found in Kyoto and other old cities, characterized by a narrow street-facing frontage and deep interior extending back from the street. Historically used as both a shop and residence.
The quality or degree of being comfortable and pleasant. Formed from the na-adjective {快適|かいてき} with the nominalizing suffix さ.
The freezing compartment of a refrigerator, or a standalone freezer unit. Used for storing frozen food and making ice.

glosses: traditional age counting; East Asian age reckoning
explanations: A traditional system of counting age in which a person is one year old at birth and gains a year every New Year's Day, rather than on their birthday.
The set of implements used in the Japanese tea ceremony, including the tea bowl, whisk, scoop, and other items.

glosses: to be convinced; to be satisfied; to make sense
to be convinced; to be satisfied with an explanation; to make sense
explanations: To reach a state of understanding and acceptance about something. Often used when an explanation finally makes sense or when one is satisfied with the reasoning behind something.

glosses: to be stylish; to be fashionable; to dress up
to be stylish; to be fashionable; to be chic
explanations: To have a refined, tasteful, or fashionable quality. Most commonly used in its past participle form しゃれた as a modifier.

glosses: chorus; hook; climax of a song
explanations: The most memorable, emotionally intense part of a song, typically the chorus or hook. A term widely used in the Japanese music industry.
A brief meeting held at the start of the workday or school day for announcements, coordination, and team alignment.

glosses: profit margin; profit rate; rate of return
explanations: The ratio of profit to revenue or investment, expressed as a percentage. A key metric in business and finance.
An area designated as safe from danger, such as a disaster evacuation zone or a protected area in a conflict.
A raised or marked area in the middle of a road where pedestrians can safely wait while crossing, or where tram passengers board.
A loss recorded in a competition when a participant cannot compete, whether due to injury, absence, or disqualification, without an actual match taking place.

glosses: stage greeting; in-person appearance by cast and crew
stage greeting; in-person appearance by cast and crew at a screening or performance
explanations: An event where the director, actors, and other members of a film, play, or other production appear in person on stage to greet the audience, typically before or after a screening.

glosses: to be refined; to be polished; to be sophisticated
to be refined; to be polished; to become sophisticated
explanations: To be made more elegant, tasteful, or polished through improvement or cultivation. Most commonly appears in the past participle form {洗練|せんれん}された as a modifier meaning 'refined' or 'sophisticated.'
A loss in a competition resulting from committing a foul or rules violation, rather than being outperformed.

glosses: seventy percent in bloom; nearly full bloom
explanations: A stage of flowering when approximately 70% of the blossoms have opened. Part of the cherry blossom scale used in weather forecasts and hanami planning.
A category of Japanese sweets made by steaming dough or batter, often containing bean paste or other fillings.

glosses: respectfully yours; yours sincerely (formal letter closing)
explanations: A formal closing phrase used at the end of a letter, paired with the opening {謹啓|きんけい}. More formal than {敬具|けいぐ}.

glosses: respectfully (formal letter opening); Dear Sir or Madam
respectfully; with great respect (formal letter opening)
explanations: A highly formal opening phrase used at the beginning of a letter. Literally means 'I respectfully state.' Always paired with the closing {敬白|けいはく}.

glosses: to one's heart's content; as much as one likes
to one's heart's content; as much as one likes; to the fullest
explanations: Doing something freely and fully, without holding back or worrying about limits. Used when someone can do as they please without restraint.
The surface or edge created when something is cut. Used for physical cuts on objects, food, or materials.
A figurative way of looking at or approaching a topic or problem. Commonly used in discussions, presentations, and analysis.

glosses: to pass down (a story) by word of mouth; to hand down orally
to pass down by word of mouth; to hand down orally through generations
explanations: To transmit stories, legends, history, or traditions by telling them from one generation to the next. Emphasizes the oral nature of the transmission.
A fee charged on top of the base price for extra services, options, or upgrades. Commonly encountered in travel, dining, and service industries.
A disciplinary measure in which a student is temporarily barred from attending school due to misconduct. The student remains enrolled but cannot attend classes for a specified period.

glosses: social contribution; contributing to society; community service
explanations: Activities or efforts that benefit society at large, including volunteer work, charitable giving, and corporate social responsibility. A key concept in Japanese corporate and civic culture.
Running at a quick pace, faster than walking but not necessarily sprinting. Often used as a command in military or gym contexts.
Doing something in a hurried manner, often skipping details. Commonly used figuratively to describe a brief or superficial treatment of a topic.
A strength-training exercise in which one hangs from a bar and pulls oneself up until the chin is above the bar. A standard fitness exercise.
The state of being suspended or hanging from something. Used in technical or descriptive contexts.

glosses: information board; guide board; directory sign
explanations: A board or sign that provides directions, maps, or information to visitors. Commonly found at stations, parks, tourist spots, and public buildings.
A three-dimensional representation of a person, animal, or figure, created by carving, casting, or sculpting. Includes both traditional and modern sculptural works.
Something that has never happened or existed before. Literally means 'empty before' — nothing like it has come before. Often used with の as a modifier.

glosses: horse racing ticket; betting slip; racing bet
explanations: A ticket purchased to bet on horse races, representing a wager on which horse or combination of horses will win, place, or show. Horse racing is one of the few forms of legal gambling in Japan.

glosses: intellect; mental ability; brainpower; intellectual power
explanations: The power or capacity of the mind to think, reason, and understand. Refers to cognitive ability as a resource or strength.

glosses: vintage item; antique; something old and valued
vintage item; antique; aged item of value
something old and worn; dated item
explanations: An object that has aged over many years and is valued for its age, history, or craftsmanship. Can refer to wine, furniture, instruments, and other collectibles.
Used humorously or self-deprecatingly to describe something that is simply old, outdated, or showing its age.

glosses: bridge of the nose; nose ridge
explanations: The line running from between the eyes down to the tip of the nose. A key feature in descriptions of facial appearance, especially in discussions of beauty and cosmetics.

glosses: demolition; teardown; pulling down a building
explanations: The act of deliberately destroying a building or structure in order to remove it. Commonly refers to planned demolition of old buildings to make way for new construction.
The state of a building, road, or other structure currently being constructed. Commonly seen on signs at construction sites.

glosses: customer-service smile; fake professional smile; business smile
explanations: A smile put on for professional or business purposes rather than genuine emotion. Often used to describe the polite but insincere smiles of salespeople, service staff, or hosts/hostesses.
A bowl of rice topped with sliced pork, typically seasoned with a sweet soy-based sauce. A popular and affordable Japanese fast-food dish.

glosses: Hyakunin Isshu; one hundred poems by one hundred poets
Hyakunin Isshu; anthology of one hundred poems by one hundred poets
explanations: A classical Japanese anthology of one hundred waka poems, each by a different poet, compiled by Fujiwara no Teika in the 13th century. Also refers to the traditional card game based on these poems.
Money offered as a prize for winning a contest or competition, or as a reward for information or the capture of a wanted person.

glosses: storytelling performance; kōdan; dramatic narrative recitation
kōdan; traditional storytelling performance; dramatic narrative recitation
explanations: A traditional Japanese performing art in which a solo performer narrates historical tales, war stories, or dramatic episodes, punctuating the story by striking a small wooden table with a fan. One of Japan's major oral storytelling traditions.

glosses: smoking seat; smoking section; smoking area seating
explanations: A designated seat or section in a restaurant, café, or other establishment where smoking is permitted. Has become increasingly rare in Japan due to anti-smoking legislation.
Decorative items made with precious metals and gemstones, such as rings, necklaces, bracelets, and earrings. A formal term for jewelry as a product category.

glosses: sense of dynamism; vitality; lively energy
sense of dynamism; feeling of vitality; lively energy
explanations: An impression or feeling of vigorous movement, energy, and liveliness. Used to describe art, performances, writing, music, and anything that conveys a powerful sense of life and motion.
The decoration and furnishing of the inside of a room or building. In Japanese, used broadly to refer to furniture, decor items, and the overall design of indoor spaces.

glosses: steep slope; steep hill; steep incline
explanations: A road or path with a sharp incline or decline. Used for slopes that are notably steep and difficult to climb or descend.
A narrow, raised beam used in gymnastics. The gymnast performs acrobatic moves, jumps, and poses while balancing on the beam. Also found in school gym equipment.
