Reading text quickly by scanning rather than reading every word carefully. The literal image is of reading 'diagonally' across the page rather than line by line.
The practice of attaching the honorific suffix さん to a person's name when addressing or referring to them. Indicates a basic level of politeness and respect.
Political positions or groups that advocate for social equality, progressive reform, or socialism. Can refer to individuals, parties, or ideological positions.
The left side of a formation — the left field position in baseball, or the left flank in military formations.

glosses: peak hours; rush hours; busy time period
explanations: The time of day when a place, service, or transportation system is most crowded, such as morning and evening commuting hours.

glosses: scattered; dispersed; spread out here and there
explanations: The state of things being spread out over an area rather than concentrated in one place. Used for physical locations, settlements, objects, or abstract things like information.

glosses: synthetic fiber; chemical fiber; man-made fiber
explanations: Fiber produced through chemical processes rather than occurring naturally. Includes both fully synthetic fibers like polyester and nylon, and semi-synthetic fibers like rayon.

glosses: large number of people; large group
large number of people; large group; big party
explanations: A group consisting of many people, often used when discussing logistics like restaurant reservations, event planning, or transportation.
A simple rice porridge made with seven spring herbs, traditionally eaten on January 7th to pray for good health throughout the year and to rest the stomach after New Year's feasting.
A matter or incident that requires attention or is under consideration, especially in legal, administrative, or official contexts.

glosses: detention center; internment camp; concentration camp
explanations: A facility where people are confined, either for detention, internment, or imprisonment. Can refer to various types of facilities from refugee camps to wartime concentration camps.
A small stream flowing through a mountain valley, often rocky and surrounded by vegetation.
A low-lying wet area with standing water and vegetation.

glosses: just; only; mere; slight; a tiny bit of
explanations: Emphasizes that something is very small in amount, degree, or significance. Always precedes a noun or quantity expression.

glosses: only one person; all alone; just one person
explanations: Emphasizes that there is just a single person, often conveying loneliness, uniqueness, or the surprising smallness of the number.

glosses: see you later; bye then; well then, goodbye
explanations: A casual parting greeting used among friends, family, and peers. Implies the expectation of meeting again.

glosses: change of season; seasonal transition; turning of the seasons
explanations: The period when one season transitions into the next, often associated with changes in weather, wardrobe, and daily routines.

glosses: radiation exposure; being exposed to radiation
explanations: Exposure to ionizing radiation, whether from nuclear accidents, medical procedures, occupational hazards, or atomic weapons. Written with the kanji {曝|ばく} (exposure) to distinguish from {被爆|ひばく} (being bombed).

glosses: Golden Week; late-April to early-May holiday period
explanations: A cluster of national holidays from late April to early May, typically spanning April 29 through May 5. One of Japan's three major vacation periods alongside New Year and Obon.

glosses: depending on the case; in some cases; possibly
explanations: Used to introduce the possibility that something may happen under certain circumstances. Indicates that the outcome depends on the specific situation.

glosses: to make plans; to set up a schedule; to plan ahead
explanations: To create or arrange a plan or schedule for future activities. The verb {立|た}てる here means to set up or establish.
The act of handing something over from one party to another. Used for physical objects, documents, property, or responsibilities.

glosses: to weave in; to factor in; to incorporate
to weave in; to work into fabric
to factor in; to incorporate; to take into account
explanations: To incorporate threads, patterns, or designs into woven fabric.
To include or integrate something (such as expectations, risks, or information) into a plan, calculation, or assessment. Commonly used in business and finance.

glosses: natural trait; inherent quality; one's own
natural trait; inherent quality; innate characteristic
explanations: A quality, ability, or characteristic that someone naturally possesses. Almost always used in a positive sense to describe admirable traits that come naturally to a person.
The act of critically examining and evaluating one's own actions, beliefs, or shortcomings. Can refer to personal reflection or to a formal practice in organizational or political contexts.

glosses: mediation; intercession; putting in a good word
explanations: The act of using one's connections or influence to help arrange something for someone else. Often implies pulling strings or making introductions on someone's behalf.
A person who is skilled at speaking, negotiation, or persuasion.

glosses: frank advice; candid counsel; honest admonition
explanations: Honest, straightforward advice given out of genuine concern for someone, even if it is difficult to hear. Often implies the advice is unpleasant but well-intentioned.

glosses: paramedic; emergency medical technician; emergency responder
explanations: A member of an emergency medical team who responds to emergencies and provides pre-hospital medical care. In Japan, these personnel are typically affiliated with the fire department.

glosses: advance reservation; advance booking; prior reservation
explanations: A reservation or booking made ahead of time, as opposed to a walk-in or same-day arrangement. Emphasizes that the booking is made before the event or visit.

glosses: detractor; fault-finder; someone who constantly criticizes
explanations: A person who professionally or habitually analyzes and evaluates works, ideas, or situations. Can refer to professional critics in fields like literature, art, or politics.
A person who tends to find fault with others or with things in general. Used with a somewhat negative connotation.

glosses: viewer; appreciator; person who appreciates art or performances
explanations: A person who views, listens to, or appreciates artistic works such as paintings, music, films, or performances. Emphasizes the act of aesthetic appreciation rather than passive observation.

glosses: founding; original construction (of a temple or shrine)
explanations: The original construction or founding of a building, temple, shrine, or institution. Primarily used for historical and religious structures, emphasizing the first creation rather than later renovations.

glosses: overcrowded schedule; packed schedule; jam-packed timetable
explanations: A schedule that is excessively full, with too many activities or commitments crammed in. Implies an unhealthy or stressful level of busyness.

glosses: to lend a hand; to help out
explanations: To offer practical assistance to someone with a task or problem.

glosses: to get involved in; to try one's hand at; to lay a hand on
to get involved in; to try one's hand at
to lay a hand on; to resort to violence
to make a move on; to make advances toward
explanations: To start doing something new or to venture into an unfamiliar area.
To physically strike or harm someone.
To attempt a romantic or sexual approach toward someone.
Describes a soft, rounded body type in an affectionate or neutral way.

glosses: to be utterly dumbfounded; to be completely appalled
explanations: An intensified form of {呆|あき}れる, expressing extreme exasperation or disbelief at someone's behavior or a situation.
Describes behavior, actions, or manner that is rough, aggressive, or lacking in gentleness.
Describes fruit or crops that have not fully ripened.
Describes a person whose skills, knowledge, or character are not yet fully developed.
Describes a situation, problem, or condition that is critical and demands urgent attention.
Describes a person's facial expression or demeanor as deeply serious or troubled.
Describes something that is newly produced, caught, or harvested and not yet spoiled or stale.
Describes an experience, idea, or impression that feels new and stimulating.
Describes a person, event, or circumstance that is favored by good fortune.
A casual first-person plural pronoun typically used by males.

glosses: young man; big brother (to a stranger)
explanations: An affectionate and casual way to address or refer to one's older brother.
Used by children to address an unfamiliar young man in a friendly way.
Describes something that has great value, significance, or consequence.
A highly formal and humble first-person plural pronoun used in business and service contexts.
Describes someone whose conduct and manners are proper and refined.

glosses: to build up one's expectations; to get one's hopes up
explanations: To let one's anticipation or hopes grow larger.

glosses: to bring out someone's talent; to draw out ability
explanations: To help someone discover or develop their latent abilities.
Doing something regularly and carefully in small, consistent actions rather than all at once.

glosses: to listen carefully; to strain one's ears
explanations: To concentrate intently on hearing a sound, often in a quiet environment.

glosses: to watch; to view (a performance, show, or spectacle)
to watch; to view (a performance, film, show, or spectacle)
explanations: To watch something as a spectator, particularly performances, movies, plays, and other forms of entertainment.

glosses: ordinary means; simple method (almost always used in the negative)
explanations: Refers to a straightforward or conventional approach. Almost exclusively used in the pattern {一筋縄|ひとすじなわ}ではいかない, meaning something cannot be handled in the usual way.

glosses: who (very polite); may I ask who you are
explanations: A very polite way to ask someone's identity, typically used by receptionists, on the phone, or when answering the door.

glosses: to feel uneasy; to have a bad feeling; to feel anxious
explanations: To experience an intuitive sense of unease or foreboding, as if one's chest is restless.

glosses: to exert power; to wield influence; to show its force
explanations: To demonstrate or exercise great power, strength, or effectiveness.

glosses: to convince; to persuade; to make someone understand
to convince; to persuade; to make someone understand and accept
explanations: The causative form of {納得|なっとく}する, meaning to make someone reach a state of understanding and acceptance.

glosses: Spartan-style; very strict training or education
explanations: Refers to an extremely strict, demanding approach to teaching or training, derived from the historical city-state of Sparta.
A person who is extremely reluctant to spend money.
The medical or formal term for the process of giving birth.
A person or entity that is owed money or has a legal right to demand payment.
A dream that appears to predict or foresee a future event.
Minute particles of dirt, dust, or debris. A literary or formal word for dust.
Used metaphorically, especially in Buddhist or literary contexts, to refer to the mundane world and its troubles.
Marrying again after a divorce or the death of a spouse.
The same item appearing or being counted more than once, whether in data, schedules, or registrations.
A measurement on the Japanese seismic intensity scale indicating how strongly an earthquake is felt at a specific location.
Dark, heavy clouds that produce rain.
A burning sensation in the chest caused by stomach acid rising into the esophagus.
An extremely high-pitched, piercing voice or scream, often associated with fear or distress.

glosses: legs and lower back; lower body strength
explanations: The legs and lower back considered as a functional unit, especially regarding physical strength and mobility.
The total amount of rain, snow, or other water falling from the sky, measured in millimeters.
The act of cutting grass or weeds, typically with a mower or sickle.

glosses: puttering in the garden; casual gardening
explanations: Casual, leisurely gardening done as a hobby, such as weeding, planting, or trimming.
The process of signing up as a member of a website, service, or organization.

glosses: mixed hot pot; assorted ingredients cooked in broth
explanations: A hot pot dish where various ingredients such as seafood, meat, tofu, and vegetables are simmered together in broth.
A test result indicating that the tested substance or condition was not detected.
A personality trait characterized by passivity, introversion, or a gloomy disposition.
The obligation or practice of keeping information private, especially in professional or legal settings.
The ability or quality of producing original, creative ideas.
A small portable timepiece carried in a pocket, typically on a chain.

glosses: would still be acceptable; comparatively better; at least
explanations: Presents a more tolerable scenario to contrast with the actual, worse situation. Implies grudging acceptance of one thing but rejection of another.

glosses: as needed; as required; as necessary; when the need arises
explanations: Used to indicate that something should be done when the situation calls for it, not automatically or always.

glosses: to rest one's chin on one's hand; to prop up one's cheek with one's hand
explanations: A pose where one rests the cheek or chin on the palm with the elbow on a surface, often indicating boredom or daydreaming.

glosses: simple repetitive work; routine task; menial work
explanations: Work requiring little thought or skill that involves repeating the same actions.
Work that primarily requires physical strength and effort, such as construction or farming.
Paper manufactured from recycled waste paper rather than virgin pulp.
An artistic technique for creating the illusion of depth and distance on a flat surface.

glosses: in other words; to put it another way; that is to say
explanations: A sentence connector used to rephrase or restate what was just said in different words.
Describes two things so deeply connected that they cannot be considered separately.

glosses: by today; within the day; before the day is over
explanations: A formal way of saying something must happen or be completed before the current day ends.
A short, memorable phrase used in advertising, marketing, or to represent a person, company, or product.

glosses: nothing ventured, nothing gained; go for it and accept whatever happens; give it a shot
explanations: A proverb encouraging bold action despite uncertain outcomes — charge forward even if you might fail.
The process of making something even and consistent by eliminating peaks and valleys in workload, production, or distribution.

glosses: behind someone's back; in secret; covertly
behind the scenes; out of the spotlight
explanations: Doing something secretly or without the knowledge of the person involved, often with negative implications.
Working or contributing quietly without public recognition, often with positive implications.
the state of lasting or continuing for a long time without change or interruption
the side that is to the left when facing forward
the day of the week between Saturday and Monday
a fine mesh net hung over a sleeping area to keep out mosquitoes and other insects

glosses: to get along well; to hit it off; to be compatible
explanations: to have a natural affinity or compatibility with someone, sharing similar tastes, interests, or temperament
the common people of a nation or state, especially in a political or collective sense
reading something while skipping over parts, either to save time or because of lack of interest in certain sections

glosses: boxed; packed in a box; sheltered; overprotected
explanations: describing an item that comes packaged in a box, typically implying higher quality or a gift presentation
describing a person, especially a young woman, who has been raised in a sheltered, protective environment with little exposure to the outside world
the ability to remember or the state of remembering something; a sense of having experienced something before
a written record made as a reminder or for reference
the plural form of それ, referring to multiple items or concepts that are near the listener or previously mentioned in conversation
the amount of money paid or required in exchange for goods or services
the negative consequences or sacrifices incurred as a result of an action or choice
a method of selling goods or services where orders are placed remotely, by mail, phone, internet, or other means, without face-to-face interaction
the buying and selling of goods or services over the internet

glosses: visit to the United States; visiting America
explanations: a trip or official visit to the United States, especially by a political leader or delegation
a person of exceptional courage, strength, or boldness, especially in a historical or literary context
someone who is audaciously bold, uninhibited, or larger-than-life in personality

glosses: donation (to a temple or shrine); religious offering
explanations: the act of donating money, goods, or land to a temple, shrine, or other religious institution

glosses: sense of impermanence; feeling of transience
explanations: an awareness or emotional sense that all things are fleeting and nothing lasts forever, a key concept in Japanese aesthetics and Buddhist philosophy
tofu that has been frozen and then dried, resulting in a spongy, shelf-stable food that absorbs flavors well when reconstituted
the group of Japanese dialects spoken in the Kanto region, including Tokyo and surrounding prefectures
the physical telephone device or handset, as distinct from the service or act of calling

glosses: to drag in; to pull in (physically)
to drag into; to draw into (figuratively)
explanations: to forcefully pull or drag something or someone into a place
to involve someone in a situation, conflict, or trouble, often against their will
ground meat made from a blend of beef and pork, commonly used in Japanese cooking
a body type characterized by being thin or lean, as a natural physical constitution
a room or building used for storing and preserving items, especially collections at museums, archives, or libraries

glosses: August; the eighth month in the traditional Japanese calendar
explanations: The traditional Japanese name for the eighth month, originally from the old lunar calendar where it fell roughly in September. Now used as an elegant or literary name for August.

glosses: one month; a period of one month
explanations: A duration of one month. An alternative reading of {一月|いちがつ}, distinct from いちがつ (January) and いちげつ.

glosses: biological father; birth father; one's real father
explanations: One's father by blood, as opposed to a stepfather or adoptive father. Used in formal or legal contexts.
A formal telegram sent to offer congratulations, typically for weddings, promotions, or other celebrations. Still used in Japan for ceremonial occasions even in the digital age.
A formal telegram sent to express condolences upon someone's death. A customary practice in Japan when one cannot attend a funeral in person.

glosses: stationing of troops; garrison; military encampment
explanations: The act of stationing military forces at a particular location, or the state of troops being stationed there. Can also be used as a suru verb.
The outermost or farthest part of something, especially in anatomy or biology.
Something unimportant or insignificant, not central to the main issue.
Physical performances requiring agility and balance, such as tightrope walking or trapeze acts. Also used figuratively for risky or precarious feats.

glosses: complement; a word or phrase that completes the meaning of a predicate
explanations: A grammatical term for a word or phrase needed to complete the meaning of a verb, adjective, or other predicate. In Japanese grammar, it typically refers to elements marked by particles that are required by the verb.

glosses: 5-7-5 syllable pattern; the metrical structure of haiku
explanations: The syllable pattern of 5-7-5 morae that forms the basis of haiku and the opening verse of renga. Also used loosely to refer to haiku or haiku-like composition.

glosses: mug; a large cup with a handle, typically used without a saucer
explanations: A loanword from English "mug." Refers to a large, sturdy drinking cup with a handle, commonly used for coffee, tea, or other hot beverages.

glosses: railway overpass; elevated railway bridge over a road
explanations: The act of defending or protecting, especially in sports like boxing or basketball. Also used figuratively for being emotionally guarded.
A bridge or viaduct where railway tracks pass over a road. Unique to Japanese usage of the English word.
The act or state of bending or curving, used for physical objects, roads, rivers, and in anatomy for joint flexion.
The act of taking off clothes. Often used in reference to changing rooms at baths, pools, or medical facilities.
A man with attractive physical features. Somewhat literary or formal compared to everyday terms like イケメン.

glosses: ear, nose, and throat department; ENT; otorhinolaryngology
explanations: The medical specialty dealing with conditions of the ear, nose, and throat, or the hospital department that handles these. Short for {耳鼻咽喉科|じびいんこうか}.

glosses: appearance on the market; circulation; availability
appearance on the market; availability; circulation of goods
explanations: The state of products, especially seasonal foods, becoming widely available in stores and markets.

glosses: fiercely; furiously; with great force or intensity
explanations: Describes doing something with fierce intensity, violent energy, or unstoppable force. Often used with と as {猛然|もうぜん}と.

glosses: military service; serving in the army; following the troops
military service; accompanying the army; serving at the front
explanations: Serving in or accompanying a military force, especially in wartime. Used for both soldiers and non-combatants (journalists, nurses) who accompany troops.
The state of not being determined, fixed, or regular. Used in both everyday and technical contexts including grammar and mathematics.

glosses: receiving a decoration; being awarded a medal
receiving a decoration; being awarded a medal or order of merit
explanations: The act of receiving an official decoration, medal, or badge of honor, typically from a government or official body.
The former Japanese academic title roughly equivalent to associate professor. Officially replaced by {准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ} in 2007, but still widely understood and occasionally used.

glosses: faction; school of thought; sect; group of followers
explanations: A group of people sharing common beliefs, methods, or allegiance to a particular leader. Used for political factions, artistic schools, religious sects, and similar groups.

glosses: minting; coinage; the manufacture of coins and medals
explanations: The process of producing coins, medals, and similar metal items. Most commonly encountered in the compound {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく} (the Mint).

glosses: discharge from military service; leaving the armed forces
explanations: The act of being released or dismissed from military duty. Used for both voluntary and involuntary separation from the military.
The act of dispatching a telegram or cable message. A formal, somewhat historical term still encountered in literature and news reporting.
A very humble expression meaning "I have heard and understood" or "acknowledged." Used in formal business communication to confirm receipt or understanding of a message.

glosses: to fall behind; to be outdone by
to fall behind someone; to be outperformed; to be left in the dust
explanations: An idiomatic expression meaning to be surpassed or outpaced by someone. Literally means "to bow to someone's trailing dust" — the image of following behind someone's carriage and being covered in their dust.

glosses: to end one's life; to take a life
to end one's life; to take one's own life; to kill
explanations: To bring about death, either one's own or another's. When used reflexively ({自|みずか}ら{命|いのち}を{絶|た}つ), it is a euphemism for suicide. Can also refer to killing another person or creature.

glosses: to paint in kumadori style; to shade; to tinge
to paint lines on the face in kabuki style; to apply kumadori makeup
to shade; to tinge; to color the edges or surroundings
explanations: To apply the distinctive bold face-painting used in kabuki theater, with colored lines that follow the contours of the face.
To add color or shadow around the edges of something, often used poetically for natural scenes like autumn leaves or sunset colors.

glosses: endless; no end to it; boundless
endless; no end to it; there is no limit
explanations: Expresses that something has no clear stopping point or that it is pointless to continue because there is no end in sight. Often used when one could keep doing something indefinitely but decides it is futile.

glosses: refill; refill type; for refilling purposes
explanations: A product sold specifically to refill an existing container, rather than buying a new container each time. Very common for household products like shampoo, detergent, and soap.

glosses: top earner; primary breadwinner; biggest moneymaker
explanations: The person or thing that earns the most money in a family, company, or group. Can refer to a person, a product, or a business division.

glosses: shaving; the act of shaving one's beard
explanations: The act or routine of shaving facial hair.
A tool used for shaving, including both manual razors and electric shavers.
A group of people gathered to watch an event, performance, or spectacle. Emphasizes the collective nature of the group rather than individual viewers.
Refers to the surface of a table or desk, or something designed for use on a table. Very commonly used as a modifier for compact products meant to sit on a desk or table.
Figuratively refers to something that exists only in discussion or theory, not in practice. Often used in the phrase {卓上|たくじょう}の{空論|くうろん} (armchair theory).

glosses: full house; large turnout; packed audience
explanations: A situation where a venue is filled to capacity or nearly so, especially for a performance, event, or show. Carries a positive connotation of success and popularity.

glosses: crisply; with a firm, fresh texture
alertly; briskly; in a sharp and focused manner
explanations: Describes a pleasantly crisp and firm texture, especially for vegetables and food.
Describes someone becoming alert, pulling themselves together, or acting in a composed and focused way.

glosses: including the whole family; as families together
including the whole family; involving entire families; as families together
explanations: Describes a relationship or activity that involves not just individuals but their entire families. Often used for friendships or social interactions where whole families participate together.

glosses: membership card; member's ID; member's pass
explanations: A card or document that proves someone is a member of an organization, gym, club, or service. Can be physical or digital.

glosses: progress report; interim report; status update
explanations: A report on the current status and progress of a project, treatment, investigation, or ongoing matter. Common in business, medical, and official contexts.
A deep, dark shade of brown, like the color of something slightly scorched. One of the standard Japanese color terms.
A household where both partners work and earn income. A frequently discussed topic in Japanese society regarding work-life balance, childcare, and economic trends.

glosses: soaked in sweat; drenched with sweat
soaked in sweat; drenched with sweat; covered in perspiration
explanations: The state of being thoroughly covered or soaked in sweat, typically from physical exertion or heat.

glosses: health promotion; health improvement; enhancing one's health
explanations: The active pursuit of better health through exercise, diet, lifestyle changes, or public health policies. Used both for individual efforts and government or organizational initiatives.

glosses: self-deprecating joke; self-mocking humor; material making fun of oneself
explanations: A joke or humorous anecdote where the speaker makes fun of themselves, their own failures, appearance, or shortcomings. A common comedic technique in Japanese culture.
The act or habit of staying at home for extended periods rather than going out. Can be voluntary (enjoying home time) or due to circumstances like bad weather, illness, or social restrictions.
A stationery item that applies a thin strip of opaque white film to cover mistakes in handwriting or printing, allowing the user to write over the corrected area.

glosses: business alliance; operational partnership; business tie-up
explanations: A cooperative arrangement between companies to collaborate on specific business operations, share resources, or jointly develop products or services. Less binding than a merger or acquisition.

glosses: first appearance; debut performance; first time appearing (in a show, film, etc.)
explanations: The first time a person appears in a particular show, film, play, or other performance. Often used in entertainment news.

glosses: rebirth; new life; renewal; starting fresh
explanations: The state of being reborn or starting over in a new form. Often used figuratively for organizations, teams, or nations that have undergone a major transformation.
Used as a prefix meaning newly born or newly created, especially in compound words.
Physical injury or harm to the body. Used in both general and medical contexts.
In legal contexts, the crime of deliberately causing physical injury to another person. A key term in Japanese criminal law.

glosses: futile effort; like talking to a wall
futile effort; pointless action; like talking to a wall; having no effect
explanations: An idiomatic expression meaning that one's efforts or words have no effect whatsoever, like trying to drive a nail into rice bran — it goes in but has no hold.

glosses: sutra chanting; reading of Buddhist scriptures
sutra chanting; reading of Buddhist scriptures aloud
explanations: The practice of chanting or reading Buddhist sutras aloud, typically performed by monks during religious ceremonies, funerals, and memorial services.
A person who has joined or subscribed to a service, organization, insurance plan, or similar group. Used widely in insurance, telecommunications, and membership contexts.
A formal or literary word for birth, used especially when referring to the birth of notable or historical figures. Often appears in contexts such as anniversaries and commemorations.
A person who undergoes testing or participates in a scientific experiment, clinical trial, or psychological study. Used in academic and medical contexts.

glosses: director (of a museum, library, or similar institution)
director; head (of a museum, library, hall, etc.)
explanations: The person in charge of running a public institution such as a museum, library, art gallery, or cultural hall. The {館|かん} refers to the building or institution.

glosses: for a while; briefly; for the time being
explanations: A formal or literary adverb meaning for a short period of time. Used in written language and formal speech, often in official announcements or literary contexts.

glosses: memorial service; consoling the spirits of the dead
consoling the spirits of the dead; memorial
explanations: The act of honoring and consoling the spirits of deceased persons, especially those who died in war, disasters, or tragic events. Central to Japanese memorial culture.
A medical facility specializing in dental care. In Japan, most dental practices are small private clinics rather than large hospital departments.

glosses: all show and no substance; failing to live up to one's reputation
all show and no substance; failing to live up to one's sign
explanations: Describes a situation where the outward appearance, reputation, or advertising does not match the actual quality or reality. Literally means the signboard has fallen over — the impressive facade has collapsed.

glosses: to be out of breath; to pant
to be out of breath; to pant; to gasp for air
explanations: To become breathless from physical exertion such as running, climbing, or heavy exercise. Often used in the て-form ({息|いき}を{切|き}らして) to describe someone's state while doing something.
An exceptional prize awarded above or outside the regular ranking system. Used for lotteries, competitions, raffles, and other contests where a particularly noteworthy prize is given.
Parking a vehicle in a location or manner that violates traffic laws. A common urban issue in Japan where street parking is heavily regulated.
A formal document or strategy outlining the objectives, methods, timeline, and financial projections for a business venture or project. Used in corporate, governmental, and nonprofit contexts.

glosses: launching a publication; publishing (a new periodical or series)
explanations: The act of starting to publish a new magazine, journal, newspaper, or book series. Focuses on the initial launch rather than ongoing publication.
A small container, typically made of gelatin, enclosing a dose of medicine in powder or liquid form.
A small sealed container or pod used in various contexts, such as capsule hotels, time capsules, or space capsules.
A person who is traveling or on a trip. Covers both leisure tourists and general travelers.
The set of documents required when applying for a job, contest, grant, or program. Typically includes a resume, cover letter, and any additional required materials.
The act of sexual reproduction in animals. A scientific and neutral term used in biology, zoology, and nature documentaries.
Large crystals of pure sugar, clear or white, used especially in making fruit liqueurs, preserved fruits, and traditional sweets. Dissolves slowly, making it ideal for infusions.

glosses: extension and remodeling; renovation and expansion
extension and remodeling; renovation and expansion (of a building)
explanations: The combined processes of adding to and remodeling an existing building. Covers both making the building larger (extension) and modifying its existing structure (remodeling).
The physical and biological surroundings in their unaltered state, including ecosystems, landscapes, waterways, and wildlife habitats. Frequently used in environmental discussions and policy.
Describes a person who is impervious to embarrassment or criticism, acting without shame even when their behavior is clearly inappropriate. Literally means 'the skin of one's face is thick.'

glosses: all of them; every one; any of them
explanations: Refers to every item in a group without exception, emphasizing that the same quality or condition applies to each one.
The act of staying somewhere overnight, whether at a hotel, a friend's house, or a workplace. Often used in compound expressions related to travel or work schedules.

glosses: on the occasion of; when; at the time of
explanations: A formal expression used to mark a significant occasion or important moment as the context for what follows. Attaches to nouns or verb dictionary forms.
The color blue. In Japanese color terminology, {青|あお} covers a broad range from blue to blue-green, and {青色|あおいろ} specifies the color itself as a noun.
A proposal to change or modify an existing plan, bill, or document. Used in legislative, business, and general contexts when suggesting changes to something already drafted.

glosses: final reckoning; overall settlement; grand summing-up
final settlement of accounts; overall accounting
explanations: The comprehensive closing of all accounts at the end of a fiscal period, covering all transactions.
A figurative comprehensive review or final assessment of a period of effort, a series of events, or an entire endeavor.
The act of applying color to something, whether literally (painting, dyeing, food decoration) or figuratively (adding character or flair to something).
Describes a surface or texture that is free of bumps, roughness, or irregularities. Used in technical, scientific, and descriptive contexts.
The quality of being concrete, tangible, or having a specific form, as opposed to being abstract or conceptual.
In art, refers to representational or figurative work that depicts recognizable subjects, as opposed to abstract art.
Hair that has been woven or braided into a pattern. Refers to any style of braiding, including single braids, twin braids, and French braids.

glosses: something extraordinary; something serious; an extreme situation
explanations: Refers to an unusually significant or extreme circumstance. Often used in conditional sentences to express that only under exceptional conditions would something happen.

glosses: as one wishes; at one's will; freely
as one wishes; at one's will; at one's pleasure
explanations: Describes doing something exactly as one wants, having full control over a situation or being able to act without restriction.
The company or person who receives a contract directly from the client and takes primary responsibility for a project. May subcontract portions of the work to other companies.
In grammar, the form of a verb, adjective, or sentence that expresses a positive statement, as opposed to the negative form.
In grammar, the verb form used to give direct commands or orders. In Japanese, formed by changing the verb ending (e.g., {食|た}べろ, {行|い}け).

glosses: beef (or pork) and egg rice bowl
explanations: A rice bowl dish topped with sliced beef or pork simmered with onions in a sweet soy-based broth, then bound with beaten egg. Named in contrast to {親子丼|おやこどん}, which uses chicken and egg.
A rice bowl topped with three different colored toppings, typically scrambled egg (yellow), seasoned ground meat (brown), and green vegetables such as blanched spinach or green beans.

glosses: once in a lifetime; a unique and unrepeatable occasion
explanations: Describes something that happens only once in one's entire life, or an opportunity so rare that it should be treated with great importance.
A type of insurance where premiums are paid but no money is returned if no claim is made during the coverage period. The premiums are essentially "thrown away" if the insured event does not occur.

glosses: client; requester; person who makes a request
explanations: The person or party who makes a formal request or commissions work from a professional or service provider. Commonly used in legal, business, and professional contexts.
Indicates any and all locations without restriction. Used to express that something exists everywhere or that one can go to any place.
A very polite or honorific way to refer to a person. Used to show respect, especially when referring to someone of high status or someone else's family member.
Oil extracted from the seeds of the camellia plant (Camellia japonica). Traditionally used in Japan for hair care, skin care, and cooking. Valued for its moisturizing properties.

glosses: geisha house; establishment that houses and manages geisha
geisha house; establishment that manages geisha
explanations: A house or establishment where geisha live and train. The okiya owns the geisha's kimono and accessories, arranges their engagements, and manages their careers. The proprietress is called okāsan (mother).

glosses: lapis lazuli blue; deep azure; ultramarine blue
explanations: A vivid, deep blue color reminiscent of the gemstone lapis lazuli. One of Japan's traditional color names, evoking a rich, jewel-like blue.

glosses: supporter; person in favor; those who agree
explanations: A person who agrees with or supports a proposal, opinion, or course of action. Used in discussions, voting, and debates.

glosses: flagship store; signature shop; star establishment
explanations: A shop or restaurant that serves as the representative or most prominent establishment in a group, area, or brand. The store that best represents the brand's identity.

glosses: to give a brief notice; to say a word of warning; to let someone know beforehand
to give a brief notice; to say a word beforehand; to give a heads-up
explanations: To briefly inform someone before doing something, out of courtesy or as a formality. Implies notifying rather than asking for permission.

glosses: as of; with this; effective from
explanations: A very formal expression used to indicate a point in time or event that marks a transition, ending, or official change. The polite form of をもって.
A form of corporate management in which the founding family or their relatives hold controlling positions and ownership. Common in both small businesses and large corporations in Japan.

glosses: to bite into; to cling to tenaciously
to bite into; to sink one's teeth into
to cling to; to stick with tenaciously
explanations: To bite down hard on something, gripping it with the teeth. Used for physically biting into food or objects.
To hold on to something with determination and refuse to let go. Used figuratively for clinging stubbornly to a task, goal, or opportunity.
The act of ending a conflict or dispute and establishing peaceful relations. Often used in historical and formal contexts for the settlement of wars, feuds, or diplomatic disputes.
Having the appearance, atmosphere, or characteristics of a foreign country. Used to describe architecture, food, fashion, or scenery that evokes a distinctly non-Japanese feel.
A secret plan devised to achieve a particular goal, typically involving deception or manipulation. Carries a negative connotation of underhanded scheming.
The beginning or introductory part of a piece of writing, speech, musical composition, or other work. The section that sets the stage before the main content begins.

glosses: how many times; how many fold
explanations: An interrogative expression asking about a multiple or ratio. Used to ask how many times greater, larger, or more something is compared to a reference point.
Used emphatically to express that something is much greater in degree or quantity, without asking a literal question.
Advocating or pursuing rapid, fundamental change, especially in politics or social systems. Often implies going further or faster than the mainstream considers reasonable.
An initial, unrefined version of a plan, proposal, or document that serves as the basis for further discussion and revision. Often the first stage in a formal planning process.

glosses: to win through; to survive to the end
to win through; to survive to the end; to advance by winning
explanations: To keep winning through successive rounds of competition and advance to the end. Also used figuratively for overcoming a series of challenges to achieve final success.

glosses: to be exceptional; to be extraordinary
to be exceptional; to be extraordinary; to be outstanding
explanations: To deviate from the ordinary level or standard, being far above average. Almost always used in the past participle form 並外れた as a modifier meaning 'extraordinary' or 'exceptional.'

glosses: this person and that; anyone and everyone
this person and that; anyone and everyone; whoever
explanations: Refers indiscriminately to various people without specifying who. Often used with なく or かまわず to express doing something without regard to who is involved.
A stand or holder designed to support a candle or multiple candles. Encompasses both simple single-candle holders and ornate multi-branched candelabras.

A language learned after one's native language, either through formal education or living in a community where it is spoken. In linguistics, distinguished from a 'foreign language' by the degree of exposure and use in daily life.
A condiment made by mixing roasted sesame seeds with salt. Commonly sprinkled on rice, onigiri, and other Japanese dishes.
Used to describe hair that is a mixture of black and white, resembling the appearance of sesame salt. Refers to greying hair that has not yet turned fully white.

glosses: when the time comes; when the opportunity arises
when the time comes; when the opportunity arises; at the right moment
explanations: An expression meaning to wait for an appropriate moment before taking action. Implies patience and timing rather than immediate action.

glosses: general; broad; sweeping; comprehensive in outline
explanations: Covering the main points without going into detail. Describes an overview or summary that captures the big picture rather than specifics.
The area or direction that is lower in position. Used for physical location (below something) and for abstract concepts like downward trends in data or economics.
Lacking thoroughness or completeness in execution. Describes actions, measures, or attitudes that fall short of being fully carried out or properly implemented.

glosses: stirring; slight movement of the body
stirring; slight movement of the body; fidgeting
explanations: A small, often unconscious movement of the body, such as shifting one's weight, squirming, or fidgeting. Most commonly used in the negative — 身じろぎもしない or 身じろぎもせず — to describe someone remaining perfectly still.

glosses: oracle; divine message; revelation from a god
explanations: A message believed to come from a deity, delivered through a medium, priest, or other intermediary. Refers both to the message itself and to the act of receiving such a message.

glosses: out of office; not in power; independent
out of office; in opposition; not in power
explanations: Being outside the ruling party or government. Used in politics to describe parties or politicians who are not currently in power.
Being outside of official or institutional organizations. Used for scholars, researchers, or professionals who work independently rather than within established institutions.
A distance that falls between short and long range. Used in athletics (middle-distance running), military contexts (missile range), transportation, and general descriptions of distance.

glosses: nonpartisan; independent; not affiliated with any political party
explanations: Not belonging to or supporting any particular political party. Used to describe both politicians who run without party affiliation and voters who do not consistently support one party.
The southern part of Europe, typically including countries such as Italy, Spain, Portugal, and Greece. Used in geography, travel, cuisine, and cultural discussions.

glosses: to trust; to rely on; to have confidence in
explanations: To place trust or confidence in a person, organization, or thing, believing they are reliable and dependable.

glosses: to reserve; to book; to make a reservation
explanations: To arrange in advance to secure a place, service, or item, such as a hotel room, restaurant table, or appointment.

glosses: to end; to finish; to conclude
to end; to finish; to conclude; to be completed
explanations: To come to an end or bring something to completion. Used for events, programs, processes, and periods of time.

glosses: to practice; to train; to rehearse
explanations: To repeat an activity or skill in order to improve at it. Used for practicing musical instruments, sports, languages, and other skills.

glosses: to come and go; to go back and forth
to come and go; to go back and forth; to travel between
explanations: To move repeatedly between two places, or to have regular interaction with someone involving visits in both directions.

glosses: to read too much into; to overinterpret
to read too much into; to overinterpret; to overthink the meaning of
explanations: To interpret something more deeply than intended, finding hidden meanings or implications that may not actually be there.

glosses: to be dry and refreshing; to be cheerful and open
to be dry and refreshing; to be pleasantly dry
to be cheerful and open; to be frank and easygoing
explanations: Describes weather or air that is dry and pleasant, with no humidity. Often used to contrast with the muggy climate typical of Japanese summers.
Describes a person's personality or manner as straightforward, not holding grudges, and having a bright, uncomplicated disposition.

glosses: to get irritated; to feel a flash of anger
to get irritated; to feel a flash of anger; to be offended
explanations: To feel a sudden, sharp pang of irritation or anger in response to something someone said or did. The reaction is typically immediate and involuntary.

glosses: inconvenient; not a good time; unfavorable
inconvenient; not a good time; to have a scheduling conflict
explanations: Used when a proposed time or arrangement does not work for someone due to their circumstances or schedule.
Used when a situation, fact, or outcome is unfavorable or embarrassing for someone, often something they would rather hide.

glosses: convenient; a good time; to be available
explanations: Used when a proposed time or arrangement works well for someone.
Describes something that works in someone's favor, often with a negative nuance suggesting the person is being selfish or only considering their own benefit.
The construction of large structures such as ships, buildings, bridges, or monuments. Emphasizes the scale and significance of what is being built.

glosses: front line; battle front; war front
explanations: The area where opposing military forces engage in combat. Also used figuratively for the front line of any competitive or challenging endeavor.

glosses: second rank; stylish; thanks for the hard work (internet slang)
second (in a sequence); B; the second of the ten Heavenly Stems
stylish; tasteful; chic; having a certain charm
thanks for the hard work (internet slang)
explanations: The second item in the traditional East Asian ordering system (the Heavenly Stems). Used to label items as 'B' in contracts, forms, and legal documents.
Describes something that has a subtle, refined elegance or charm. Often used for experiences, places, or things that are pleasantly understated.
Short for お{疲|つか}れ (otsukaresama), used online to express thanks or acknowledgment, especially at the end of a gaming session or collaborative work.
The top of a mountain or a prominent pointed section of a mountain range.
The blunt back edge of a sword or knife, opposite the cutting edge.
A piece of wood, paper, or other material bearing writing, used as a sign, label, or notice.
A card used in traditional Japanese card games such as karuta or hanafuda.
A paper or wooden charm distributed at temples and shrines, believed to offer divine protection.

glosses: to be orderly; to be neat and organized
to be orderly; to be well-organized; to be neat and tidy
explanations: Describes a state where things are arranged in proper order, neatly and systematically. Used for physical spaces, processes, arguments, and behavior.

glosses: plot; storyline; outline of a story
explanations: The sequence of events and narrative structure of a story, play, film, or other narrative work.

glosses: last place; dead last; the bottom
last place; dead last; the bottom; the worst position
explanations: The very last position in a ranking, race, competition, or group. A casual, somewhat humorous word.
A navigational instrument that uses a magnetized needle to indicate direction. Also used figuratively to mean a guiding principle or moral compass.

glosses: to leave alone; to leave undisturbed
to leave alone; to leave undisturbed; to let be
explanations: To refrain from disturbing or interfering with someone or something, leaving them in their current state out of consideration or care.

glosses: to ship directly; to send straight
to ship directly; to send straight to the destination
explanations: To send goods or products directly from the source (producer, factory, farm) to the customer or destination without going through intermediaries.

glosses: enemy camp; enemy lines; opponent's territory
explanations: The camp, territory, or position occupied by the enemy or opposing side. Used in military, sports, and board game contexts.

glosses: word meaning; sense of a word
word meaning; sense; definition of a word
explanations: The meaning or semantic content of a word. A technical term used in linguistics, lexicography, and language study.
A line made up of connected straight segments that change direction at each point. Most commonly encountered in the term {折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ (line graph).
A genetic tendency to develop allergic conditions such as eczema, asthma, and hay fever. In everyday Japanese, most commonly refers specifically to atopic dermatitis (atopic eczema).

glosses: last quarter moon; waning half-moon; third quarter
explanations: The phase of the moon approximately one week after the full moon, when the left half of the moon is illuminated (as seen from the Northern Hemisphere).
Moral goodness and integrity of character. A central concept in Confucian and Buddhist ethics, referring to the inner quality of a morally admirable person.
Kindness, benevolence, or benefit bestowed by someone, especially someone in a position of authority or spiritual power.

glosses: to take one's leave; to depart (formal)
to take one's leave; to depart; to excuse oneself (formal)
explanations: To politely leave a place after a visit or meeting. A formal and literary expression for departing.
An elevated area used for speaking, performing ceremonies, or placing offerings. Also used as a suffix in compound words referring to specific types of platforms or elevated areas.
Used as a suffix meaning 'world' or 'community' in compounds referring to professional or artistic circles.

glosses: moon age; lunar age; age in months (of a baby)
moon age; lunar age; number of days since the new moon
age in months (of a baby or infant)
explanations: The number of days elapsed since the last new moon, used to describe the current phase of the moon.
The age of a baby measured in months rather than years. Commonly used in childcare and pediatric contexts.
A quality of having rich, layered meaning beneath the surface. Used to describe words, expressions, art, or actions that carry more significance than is immediately apparent.
The act of protecting or shielding something or someone from danger, damage, or attack. Often used in technical, military, or safety contexts.
A general term for bladed weapons, especially Japanese swords and other edged weapons. Used broadly to refer to swords as a category, in historical, cultural, and collector contexts.
A region that has lost a significant portion of its population, typically due to migration to urban areas. A major social issue in rural Japan.
Suddenly losing consciousness and falling down. Can be used literally for medical fainting or figuratively to express extreme shock or surprise.

glosses: brethren; siblings from the same parents
explanations: People who share the same nationality or ethnic background. Used in formal or patriotic contexts to emphasize shared national identity.
People born of the same parents, or more broadly, people who share the same origin or bond. A literary or elevated usage.
A report or publication issued once a month, typically summarizing activities, data, or progress over the preceding month. Common in business and government contexts.
The state of continuing to exist after others have disappeared, been destroyed, or become obsolete. Used for physical objects, systems, customs, and abstract things.
The upward force exerted by a fluid on an object immersed in it. A fundamental concept in physics, also used more broadly to describe the ability of something to float.

glosses: all talk; lip service; empty words
explanations: Describes someone who says things they don't mean or makes promises they won't keep. The words are superficial, coming only from the lips without genuine feeling or intent to act.

glosses: outside the venue; out of bounds; off the field
explanations: The area outside the designated playing field, arena, or venue. Used in sports (especially sumo and martial arts), events, and figuratively for actions that go beyond the expected scope.
A large, impressive residence. Often used as a suffix attached to a family name to refer to that person's residence, or independently to denote a grand house.

glosses: temple and shrine stamp book; goshuin book
explanations: A special accordion-fold booklet used to collect goshuin — calligraphic stamps and inscriptions given at Buddhist temples and Shinto shrines as proof of visit and prayer.
Something that has gone missing or been lost. A somewhat old-fashioned or literary word, still used in everyday speech in some regions and in certain set phrases.
A person who governs or rules over a territory or people. Used in historical, political, and academic contexts to refer to those who hold governing power.
A person who is perverse, contrary, or twisted in personality — someone who deliberately goes against the grain, sees things negatively, or refuses to go along with others out of stubbornness.

glosses: adhesion; sticking fast; becoming firmly attached
fixation; being stuck on an idea; rigid attachment
explanations: The state of something being firmly stuck or attached to a surface. Used in technical, scientific, and mechanical contexts.
Being psychologically fixated on something — unable to let go of a particular idea, method, or way of thinking.
A chemical substance used to kill bacteria and germs on surfaces, wounds, or skin. Includes both liquid antiseptics for wounds and disinfectant solutions for cleaning.

glosses: labor cost; processing fee; wages for work
labor cost; processing fee; wages for work done
explanations: The charge for labor or craftsmanship in manufacturing, repair, or processing work. Distinct from material costs, this covers the cost of the human work involved.
In baseball, a player who is sent in to run the bases in place of another player, typically to take advantage of superior speed.
Staying in a place for an extended period, as opposed to a short visit. Used for travel, immigration, work assignments abroad, and accommodation contexts.

glosses: year by year; every year; with each passing year
explanations: Indicates something that happens each year, or a gradual change that progresses with each passing year.

glosses: wrong prediction; unexpected outcome; contrary to expectations
explanations: When the actual result differs from what was predicted or expected. Can describe a pleasant or unpleasant surprise.
The juice squeezed from lemons, used in cooking, drinks, and as a seasoning. Can refer to both freshly squeezed juice and bottled lemon juice.

glosses: upper level; upper tier; high position
upper level; upper tier; upper row
explanations: The upper section of something divided into levels, such as a shelf, display case, or seating area.
In martial arts (especially kendo), the stance where the sword or weapon is held high above the head, ready to strike downward.

glosses: appraisal certificate; expert evaluation document; authentication certificate
explanations: An official document produced by a qualified expert that certifies the value, authenticity, or quality of an item. Used for jewelry, art, real estate, and forensic evidence.
A central virtue in Confucian ethics, representing kindness, compassion, and love toward others. One of the five Confucian virtues and a fundamental concept in East Asian moral philosophy.
An item that has been found by someone after being lost by its owner. A legal/administrative term used in contexts involving police, lost-and-found procedures, and the law.

glosses: bar district; drinking quarter; street of bars
explanations: An area or street concentrated with bars, izakaya, and other drinking establishments. A characteristic feature of Japanese urban nightlife.
The traditional craft of dyeing fabric using indigo plant extract, producing distinctive deep blue colors. Also refers to the fabric or products dyed by this method.
A waterproof garment worn to protect against rain. Originally referred to a cape-style garment introduced by Portuguese missionaries, now used broadly for any rain gear.

glosses: incense; fragrant substance burned for its scent
explanations: Aromatic materials, typically in stick or cone form, burned to produce pleasant fragrance. Used in religious ceremonies, meditation, and as home fragrance.

glosses: flowering plants; flowers and grasses; herbaceous flowers
explanations: A general term for herbaceous plants that produce flowers, as opposed to trees or shrubs. Often used when talking about gardens, fields, or nature in general.

glosses: playground; play area; place to play or have fun
explanations: A place where children play or where adults go for entertainment. Can refer to both a physical playground with equipment and a general area for recreation.

glosses: empty can; used beverage or food can
explanations: A can that has been emptied of its contents. Commonly encountered in the context of recycling and litter.

glosses: narrow path; narrow road; narrow lane
explanations: A path or road that is narrow. Can refer to physical narrow paths in nature or between buildings, as well as appearing in literary and cultural contexts.
The act of entrusting someone with authority, responsibility, or a task. Commonly used in legal and business contexts for formal delegation of powers.

glosses: celebrity; famous person; notable figure; prominent individual
explanations: A person who is widely known and recognized, typically for their achievements, status, or public presence. More formal than casual terms for famous people.
Providing expert instruction or guidance, especially in traditional arts, martial arts, or specialized skills. Carries a nuance of mentorship and hands-on teaching.

glosses: similarity (in geometry); having the same shape but different size
explanations: The state of being similar or alike in appearance, form, or nature. Used in both everyday and technical (especially mathematical) contexts.
A mathematical term describing geometric figures that have the same shape but may differ in scale. Two figures are similar if their corresponding angles are equal and sides are proportional.
An elevated, literary term for a pleasant, noticeable fragrance. Often used to describe the aroma of flowers, tea, wine, or food in refined or written contexts.

glosses: suppression; subjugation; gaining control by force
explanations: Using force or authority to bring a situation, area, or group under control. Often used in military, security, and sports contexts.
A heavy outer garment worn over other clothing for warmth. A somewhat literary or old-fashioned word, now largely replaced by コート in everyday speech.

glosses: municipalities; cities, wards, towns, and villages
explanations: A collective term for the four types of local government units in Japan: cities (市), special wards (区), towns (町), and villages (村). Used to refer to local municipalities as a group.
A serious misfortune or disaster, often with a sense of being brought by fate or forces beyond human control. More literary and weighty than everyday words for trouble.

glosses: mixed ground meat; ground meat blend of beef and pork
explanations: Ground meat that combines beef and pork, typically in roughly equal proportions. A staple in Japanese home cooking, used for hamburger steaks, meatballs, and other dishes.

glosses: sweet vinegar pickle; food pickled in sweetened vinegar
explanations: Vegetables, fish, or other ingredients preserved by soaking in a mixture of vinegar and sugar. A common side dish and garnish in Japanese cuisine.

glosses: anime adaptation; making something into an anime
explanations: The process of adapting a work (typically a manga, light novel, or game) into an anime series or film. A very common term in Japanese pop culture discussions.

glosses: maintenance cost; upkeep expenses; running cost
explanations: The ongoing expenses required to keep something in working condition or operational state, such as a building, vehicle, or organization.
A person whose role is to show visitors around, provide directions, or guide people to their seats at events or facilities.

glosses: sole of the foot; bottom of the foot
explanations: The underside of the foot. Commonly referenced in contexts of health, massage, reflexology, and physical sensation.

glosses: evil deed; wrongdoing; wicked act; misconduct
explanations: Morally wrong or wicked actions. A somewhat formal and literary word used to describe seriously bad behavior or immoral conduct.

glosses: reliance; dependence; basing (an argument or action) on something
explanations: The act of relying on or basing something upon a particular foundation, source, or authority. A formal, academic word often used in scholarly, legal, and analytical writing.

glosses: agreement; written agreement; memorandum of understanding
written agreement; memorandum of understanding; accord document
explanations: A formal written document recording the terms agreed upon by two or more parties. Less binding than a full contract but carries legal and moral weight.

glosses: very rich person; wealthy individual; millionaire
explanations: An intensified form of 金持ち (rich person), emphasizing extreme wealth. Colloquial and commonly used in everyday conversation.

glosses: blankly; with a puzzled look; dumbfounded
blankly; with a puzzled look; dumbfounded; looking bewildered
explanations: Describes a facial expression of blank confusion or bewilderment, as when someone doesn't understand what is happening. The person stares with wide, uncomprehending eyes.

glosses: gaping; open-mouthed; with mouth wide open in surprise or shock
explanations: Describes the state of having one's mouth open wide, typically from shock, surprise, or disbelief. A vivid mimetic expression.

glosses: reading and study of texts; close reading
reading and studying texts closely; close reading; textual study
explanations: The careful reading and analysis of texts, especially in an academic or classroom setting. Often involves translating, interpreting, and discussing the meaning of texts.

glosses: thin round slicing; cutting into thin rounds
thin round slicing; cutting into thin rounds; cross-cutting into thin circles
explanations: A cooking technique of cutting cylindrical vegetables (like green onions, cucumbers, or carrots) crosswise into thin round slices. One of the basic Japanese cutting techniques.

glosses: new town; planned residential community; housing development
explanations: A large-scale planned residential area built as a self-contained community, typically in suburban areas. In Japan, refers specifically to the massive housing developments built during the rapid economic growth period to accommodate urban population expansion.
Physical or mental endurance and the ability to sustain prolonged effort. From English 'stamina.'
Describes something or someone that is fresh, new, or full of youthful energy. From English 'fresh.' Often used for new employees, fresh produce, or a refreshing impression.

Selfish attitude or behavior that prioritizes one's own desires over others. From English 'ego.' Carries a strongly negative connotation in Japanese, closer to 'selfishness' than the neutral psychological sense.
A piece of hard candy or boiled sweet. From English 'candy.' In Japanese, this word typically refers to hard candies specifically, as opposed to chocolate or other confections.
The profession, practice, or industry of gathering, writing, and reporting news. From English 'journalism.' Can also refer to the media world collectively.
The practice of caring for one's skin through cleansing, moisturizing, and applying various products. From English 'skin care.'

glosses: winter clothes; winter clothing; winter wardrobe
explanations: Clothing worn during the cold winter months. Also refers to winter uniforms at schools or workplaces that have seasonal uniform changes.
The act of changing one's clothing, especially in formal or institutional contexts such as hospitals, sports facilities, or workplaces.
The length of an animal's body, typically measured from head to tail (or from snout to tail base for mammals). A standard measurement used in zoology, wildlife descriptions, and nature documentaries.
The point where something begins, such as a line, route, or process. Used in mathematics, geography, and general contexts.

glosses: tenant; shop or business renting space in a building
explanations: A shop, restaurant, or business that rents space within a larger building such as a department store, shopping mall, or office building. From English 'tenant.' In Japanese, this word emphasizes the commercial tenant rather than residential renters.
A large, open-topped bag with parallel handles, used for carrying everyday items. From English 'tote bag.'
Essential inorganic nutrients such as calcium, iron, and zinc needed by the body. From English 'mineral.' In Japanese, most commonly used in the context of nutrition and health.

glosses: diligent; attentive; industrious; meticulous in small matters
explanations: Describes a person who is conscientious and thorough in their efforts, particularly in everyday tasks, communication, or personal care. Often used as praise for someone who pays careful attention to detail in daily life.

glosses: bullying; harassment; persistent picking on someone
explanations: Repeated, often petty mistreatment or harassment of someone, typically by a person in a position of power or seniority. Derived from the verb いびる (to bully; to torment).
The muscles of the back, including the latissimus dorsi and erector spinae. Used in fitness, anatomy, and physical therapy contexts.
A threaded metal fastener used with a nut to join parts together. From English 'bolt.'
The SI unit of electrical potential difference. From English 'volt.'

glosses: tank; container for storing liquids or gases
explanations: A large container for storing liquids such as water, gasoline, or gas. From English 'tank.'
An armored combat vehicle. From English 'tank.'
A thick sauce or spread into which food is dipped before eating. From English 'dip.' Common in the context of party food and snacking.
A system of physical exercises designed to strengthen the body's core muscles, improve flexibility, and enhance overall body awareness. Named after Joseph Pilates, who developed the method.

glosses: rising in the world; achieving success in life
rising in the world; worldly success; social advancement
explanations: Achieving success and social status through one's own efforts. A four-character compound combining {立身|りっしん} (establishing oneself) and {出世|しゅっせ} (getting ahead in the world). Historically an important ideal in Japanese society.
A shop that specializes in selling fresh meat. {精肉|せいにく} refers to dressed meat (meat that has been cut and prepared for sale), and {店|てん} means shop.

glosses: flower vase; vessel for flower arrangement
explanations: A container used for displaying flowers, particularly in the context of {華道|かどう} (Japanese flower arrangement / ikebana). Can range from simple vases to elaborate ceramic or bamboo vessels.

glosses: clerical work; office work; administrative tasks
explanations: Routine administrative tasks such as data entry, filing, correspondence, and document preparation. A compound of {事務|じむ} (office affairs; clerical duties) and {作業|さぎょう} (work; tasks).

glosses: Koshien (baseball stadium); the national high school baseball tournament
Koshien Stadium; the national high school baseball tournament held there
explanations: Hanshin Koshien Stadium in Nishinomiya, Hyogo Prefecture. Home of the Hanshin Tigers professional baseball team and, more importantly in cultural terms, the venue for Japan's national high school baseball tournaments. By extension, 甲子園 often refers to the tournaments themselves, which are a major cultural event.

glosses: gap; opening; crevice; space between things
explanations: A narrow space or opening between objects, surfaces, or structures. Also used figuratively to mean a gap in defenses, security, or relationships.
The process of sinking or settling downward. Used in scientific and technical contexts for geological subsidence, the settling of particles in liquid, or the sinking of land.
A color that is a blend of blue and purple, leaning more toward the blue end. A compound of {青|あお} (blue) and {紫|むらさき} (purple).

glosses: attic; space above the ceiling; ceiling cavity
explanations: The space between the ceiling and the roof of a building. Used for storage, running wires and ducts, or insulation. A compound of {天井|てんじょう} (ceiling) and {裏|うら} (behind; reverse side).
The direction from which the wind is blowing. A compound of {風|ふう/かぜ} (wind) and {向|こう} (direction). Also used figuratively to mean the direction of public opinion or the trend of a situation.

Groups of young people who ride motorcycles or cars in a reckless and noisy manner, often violating traffic laws. They are known for modified vehicles, loud exhaust pipes, and group rides through city streets, especially at night.
A part of text, data, or content being accidentally left out or missing. Used for errors in documents, printed materials, or data sets.
Leaving or falling behind from a group, competition, race, or course of study. Implies being unable to keep up.
An error in printed or published text where a wrong character, letter, or word appears. Originally referred to errors in typesetting but now also covers digital text errors.
Areas characterized by fields, farms, and open land, as opposed to urban areas. Evokes a sense of peaceful, agricultural landscape.
Used attributively to describe things associated with an idealized countryside life, often with literary or aesthetic overtones.
An organized association of groups, nations, or individuals united for a common purpose. Used for international organizations, sports leagues, and professional associations.
A person or entity that holds power and exercises control over others, whether in politics, society, or a more abstract or figurative sense.
A person who is easily frightened or lacks courage. Carries a negative, often contemptuous nuance when used to describe someone directly.
Red spots, bumps, or irritation that appear on the skin, usually as a symptom of illness, allergy, or other medical condition.
The act of hiding and waiting to surprise or attack someone. Used in military, criminal, and everyday contexts such as waiting to catch someone off guard.
Not fitting or suitable for a particular purpose, situation, or standard. Used in formal contexts to indicate that something does not meet the required criteria.

Acting freely without being bound by rules, conventions, or others' expectations. Can describe a personality, lifestyle, or creative style. Generally positive or neutral, though it can imply recklessness depending on context.

glosses: to clam up; to keep silent; to refuse to speak
explanations: To deliberately stop talking or refuse to discuss something, typically because of fear, secrecy, or reluctance to reveal information.
A type of blood cell that is part of the immune system, responsible for fighting infections and foreign substances in the body.
A compiled list of specialized terms with their definitions, typically found at the end of a textbook, manual, or technical document.
Items bought at a travel destination to bring back as gifts or keepsakes. Encompasses food, crafts, and other local specialties typically sold at tourist spots and stations.

glosses: travel stories; tales from a trip
explanations: Stories and anecdotes that someone brings back from a journey to share with others. The word treats these stories as a kind of intangible souvenir.
A guest of high status or importance, treated with special respect. Used in formal and diplomatic contexts for VIP visitors.

glosses: member store; affiliated shop; participating merchant
explanations: A store or business that has joined a particular network, franchise, or payment system. Commonly used for shops that accept specific credit cards, electronic money, or belong to a franchise chain.
A smooth white surface used for writing with dry-erase markers. Standard equipment in offices, classrooms, and meeting rooms in Japan.
A machine that converts electrical energy into mechanical motion. Used broadly for electric motors in appliances, vehicles, and industrial equipment.

A traditional Japanese-style apron that covers the front of the body, typically made of thick cotton or denim. Associated with sake breweries, soba shops, and traditional crafts. Distinct from the Western-style apron (エプロン).
Describes someone or something that appears too serious to the point of being stiff, boring, or annoying. Carries a critical or mocking nuance, suggesting the seriousness is excessive or pretentious.
The quality of being serious, honest, and hardworking. Formed by adding the nominalizing suffix さ to the na-adjective 真面目. Generally positive, highlighting reliability and conscientiousness.

glosses: to improve; to enhance; to raise
explanations: To cause something to improve or reach a higher level. Used for skills, quality, performance, efficiency, and other measurable attributes. The causative form of 向上する, emphasizing that someone or something actively brings about the improvement.

glosses: the aftertaste lingers; the impression remains
the aftertaste lingers; the impression remains; the resonance stays with you
explanations: Describes the lingering emotional or sensory impression left after experiencing something — a piece of music, a film, a meal, or a conversation. Expresses that something continues to resonate in one's mind or heart.
Describes the natural process of a memory becoming less clear or vivid over time. Used for personal memories, collective memory, and historical awareness.

glosses: to pin a crime on someone; to frame someone
to pin a crime on someone; to frame someone; to shift the blame
explanations: To make someone else take the blame for something they did not do. Literally means to "put guilt/crime on top of someone." Used for both serious criminal framing and everyday blame-shifting.

glosses: conveniently; luckily; as suits one's purposes
self-servingly; in a way that suits one's own interests
explanations: Things working out in a way that happens to suit the situation or the person. Can be genuinely positive.
Interpreting or arranging things to serve one's own convenience or advantage. Carries a critical nuance, suggesting someone is being selectively convenient.

glosses: immediately before; just before; right before
explanations: At the very last moment before something happens. Emphasizes how close in time something is to a reference event.
In a manner that is fitting, correct, and well-suited to the situation. Used in formal and professional contexts to describe actions done the right way.
Describes things made or arranged in the traditional Japanese manner, as opposed to Western style. Commonly used for toilets, rooms, clothing, and architecture.

glosses: disappointment; letdown; falling short of expectations
disappointment; letdown; something that fails to meet expectations
explanations: Describes a situation, result, or thing that does not live up to what was hoped for or expected. Used both as a noun and as a modifier with の.
Describes a face or person that shows no visible emotion or reaction. Can describe a temporary state or a habitual demeanor.

glosses: look in one's eyes; gaze; expression of the eyes
look in one's eyes; gaze; the way someone's eyes appear
