Any living organism that inhabits the ocean, from microscopic plankton to whales.
An animal that eats both plant and animal matter.
Western art music in the tradition of composers such as Bach, Mozart, and Beethoven, as well as the broader genre encompassing orchestral, chamber, and operatic works.

glosses: various places around the world; all over the world
explanations: Many different locations throughout the world, emphasizing geographical spread.
An educational system in which boys and girls attend separate schools or classes.

glosses: excellent work; outstanding piece; prize-winning entry
explanations: A work of particularly high quality, especially one that receives recognition in a competition or exhibition.
A gift or celebration given to someone who has moved into a new home.
A person who frequently acts silly or comical to amuse others.
A three-dimensional shape with six rectangular faces, like a box or brick.
Medication used to lower high blood pressure.
The practice or science of slowing, preventing, or reversing the effects of aging on the body.

glosses: portrayal of inner feelings; psychological depiction
explanations: The literary or artistic technique of depicting a character's thoughts, emotions, and psychological state.

glosses: chanting of poetry; recitation of Chinese and Japanese poems
explanations: The traditional art of reciting classical Chinese or Japanese poetry in a melodic, chanting style.

glosses: fine article; excellent product; quality piece
explanations: An item of notably good quality, whether a piece of art, a literary work, or a well-crafted product.

glosses: efficiently; deftly; in a well-organized manner
explanations: Doing something in a smart, organized way that gets good results without wasting time or effort.

A mineral deposit formed by dripping water in caves, typically made of calcium carbonate. The term covers both formations hanging from the ceiling (stalactites) and those rising from the floor (stalagmites).
ceasefire; truce; armistice

glosses: peace; peace treaty; reconciliation (between warring parties)
explanations: peace; peace treaty; reconciliation (between warring parties)
abundant; ample; plentiful; rich
protrusion; jutting out; projecting
standing out; being conspicuously prominent
transport; conveyance; carrying (to a destination)

glosses: lovely; pretty; sweet; charming (in a delicate way)
explanations: lovely; pretty; sweet; charming (in a delicate way)
pitiful; pitiable; poor (evoking sympathy)
riverbank; riverside

glosses: chief; head (of a station, office, or bureau)
explanations: chief; head (of a station, office, or bureau)
police inspector
paint; coating; varnish
constant; continual; unceasing; persistent
reef; rocky reef; submerged rocks
dance; dancing (especially formal or artistic)

glosses: steel frame; steel beam; structural steel
explanations: steel frame; steel beam; structural steel
worldly; secular; mundane
the world; society; common customs
wind speed; wind velocity
rainfall; amount of rain; precipitation
flower garden
a beautiful, paradise-like place

glosses: oral argument; debate; speech (in a formal setting)
explanations: oral argument; debate; speech (in a formal setting)
champion; conqueror; ruler; dominant figure
the state of things overlapping, piling up, or being layered on top of each other
multiple events or circumstances happening at the same time or in succession
a deep, often solemn or profound feeling of joy and happiness
lacking fairness or justice, especially in how people or situations are treated
a point where two or more lines, paths, or things cross each other

glosses: military strategy; art of war; tactics
explanations: the art and science of warfare, including strategy, tactics, and martial philosophy
the act of secretly taking something that belongs to someone else, especially in a legal or formal context
a formal announcement made to the public by a government body, court, or organization
a floor of a building that is below ground level

glosses: historical research; verification of historical accuracy
explanations: the process of researching and verifying historical facts, especially to ensure accuracy in creative works
a room or space where an artist works, especially a painter
a hit in baseball where the batter circles all the bases and scores a run
a rough, weak quality in a voice, as from a sore throat or overuse
loss of clarity in print, writing, or images, often from ink running low or age
the state or policy of not possessing, using, or allowing nuclear weapons

glosses: under renovation; being remodeled; closed for refurbishment
explanations: a state where a building, store, or facility is currently being renovated or remodeled

glosses: abandoned dog; stray dog (that was abandoned)
explanations: a dog that has been abandoned by its owner and left to fend for itself
a political party that opposes the ruling party or government

glosses: garbage truck; collection vehicle; refuse truck
explanations: a vehicle used to collect and transport waste, recyclables, or other materials

glosses: tail fin; embellishments; exaggerations added to a story
embellishments; exaggerations; additions to a story
explanations: the fin at the tail end of a fish
extra details or exaggerations added when retelling a story, making it bigger than it actually was

glosses: point of similarity; resemblance; common feature
explanations: a specific aspect or feature in which two or more things are similar
a train car or vehicle designated as smoke-free
a person who designs and arranges dance movements for performances
any work that has been published and distributed, including books, journals, and periodicals
any material that has been printed, including books, flyers, pamphlets, and postal printed matter
a small vessel used to serve warmed or room-temperature sake, typically narrow-necked and ceramic

glosses: death with dignity; natural death without life-prolonging treatment
explanations: allowing a terminally ill patient to die naturally by forgoing or withdrawing life-prolonging medical treatment
the act of loading goods or cargo onto a vehicle, ship, or container
the quality of being refined, polished, and tastefully elegant

glosses: tens of times; dozens of times as much
explanations: a multiplier roughly in the range of ten to ninety-nine times, used to express a large but imprecise difference in scale
tending to obey or yield to others without resistance, often implying excessive passivity

glosses: first thing in the afternoon; 1 PM; right after lunch
first thing in the afternoon; right after lunch
explanations: the earliest time slot in the afternoon, typically meaning 1 PM or immediately after the lunch break

glosses: negative example; someone whose bad behavior serves as a lesson in what not to do
explanations: A person whose bad qualities or mistakes can teach others what to avoid. The concept originated in Mao Zedong's political theory and is now widely used in everyday Japanese to describe someone who serves as a cautionary example.

glosses: the back (of a building); rear side; back area
explanations: The physical area behind a building or structure. Used to describe the rear or back side of locations, typically in giving directions or describing spatial relationships.

glosses: bottled (goods); something preserved or stored in a bottle or jar
explanations: Food or other items preserved in glass bottles or jars. Refers both to the preserved goods themselves and to the method of preservation. Commonly associated with homemade jams, pickles, and preserved fruits.

glosses: swimming stroke; swimming style; swimming technique
explanations: The technique or style of swimming, particularly in the context of competitive or instructional swimming. The four standard competitive strokes are freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly.

Ritual or spiritual impurity in the Shinto and traditional Japanese cultural context. Associated with death, blood, illness, and moral transgression. Distinct from the homographic word {汚|よご}れ, which refers to physical dirt.

glosses: application (of ointment, cream, paint, etc.); spreading on a surface
explanations: The act of applying a substance (typically medicine, ointment, or cream) to a surface, especially skin. A formal or technical term commonly found in medical instructions and pharmaceutical labeling.
The mutual connection or structural relationship between two or more things. A formal, academic term frequently used in scholarly writing and research to describe how phenomena are linked.

glosses: bolt of cloth; roll of fabric (especially for making kimono)
explanations: A bolt or roll of fabric, standardized at approximately 36 cm wide and 12 meters long, traditionally used for making Japanese garments such as kimono, yukata, and obi.

glosses: horse riding; being mounted on horseback; a mounted rider
explanations: The state of being mounted on horseback, or a person riding a horse. Used primarily in historical and cultural contexts relating to warfare, ceremonies, and traditional events.

glosses: arms and armor; weapons and military equipment
explanations: A collective term covering weapons, armor, and other military equipment, especially from the samurai era. Includes both offensive items (swords, spears) and defensive items (armor, helmets).

glosses: royal authority; sovereignty of a king; monarchical power
explanations: The political authority and sovereign power exercised by a king or monarch. Used in historical discussions, political analysis, and comparative government.

glosses: alms; charitable donation; offering (especially to Buddhist monks or temples)
explanations: Charitable giving or almsgiving in the Buddhist tradition. In modern Japan, most commonly refers to the monetary offering given to Buddhist monks for conducting funerals, memorial services, and other ceremonies.

glosses: rapeseed; canola; the seeds of the rape plant
explanations: The seeds of the rape plant (Brassica napus), widely cultivated for producing cooking oil. The bright yellow blossoms of the rapeseed plant are an iconic symbol of spring in Japan.
A state of deep, absorbed thinking. A literary and formal word used in written language and narratives to describe someone lost in profound thought.

glosses: nasal medicine; nose drops; nasal spray
bribe; hush money; a small sweetener to win someone over
explanations: Medicine applied to or through the nose, including nasal drops, sprays, and ointments for treating nasal congestion, allergies, and related conditions.
An informal term for a bribe or small payment to win someone's favor. The figurative meaning comes from the image of making someone inhale something pleasant to sway them.
A color intermediate between blue and green, corresponding to teal or cyan in English. Distinguished from both pure blue ({青|あお}) and pure green ({緑|みどり}).

glosses: residual heat; remaining warmth; lingering heat
explanations: Heat that remains in an object, vessel, or space after the heat source has been removed. Commonly referenced in cooking to describe using lingering heat to finish cooking food.
Vigorous and spirited exertion toward a goal. A formal word carrying a stronger sense of determined striving than simple effort, often used in business speeches and formal correspondence.

glosses: selling price; retail price; sale price
explanations: The price at which a product or service is offered to the end consumer. Distinguished from cost price and wholesale price, and commonly seen in retail, business, and consumer contexts.

glosses: study desk; writing desk (especially for children)
explanations: A desk specifically designed for studying, typically purchased for children entering elementary school. A traditional milestone purchase in Japanese family life, often given by grandparents as a school-entrance gift.

glosses: palanquin; sedan chair; a covered litter carried on poles by bearers
explanations: A traditional Japanese conveyance consisting of a cabin mounted on horizontal poles, carried by two or more bearers. Used primarily during the Edo period for transporting nobility and wealthy individuals.
An abbreviation combining Japan/Japanese and England/English. Most commonly refers to the Japanese-English language pair in the context of dictionaries, translation, and language study.

glosses: sense of expectation; feeling of anticipation
explanations: The subjective feeling or atmosphere of expecting something good or exciting to happen. Often used to describe the mood surrounding an upcoming event, product release, or change.

glosses: passenger; person on board (an aircraft, ship, or vehicle)
explanations: A person who has boarded or is aboard a plane, ship, or other transport. Formal in register, used in official announcements, news reports, and aviation/maritime contexts.

A department within a company or organization that handles administrative tasks such as facilities management, office supplies, internal communications, and other support functions that do not fall under a specific business division.

The quality of being short-lived, fragile, or impermanent. Derived from the i-adjective はかない, this nominal form captures the aesthetic and emotional weight of impermanence, a concept deeply embedded in Japanese culture and literature.
A simple sugar (monosaccharide) found naturally in fruits, honey, and some vegetables. It is one of the sweetest natural sugars and is widely used in the food industry.
A piece of material that forms part of a larger structure or product. Used in construction, engineering, and manufacturing to refer to individual components such as beams, panels, or frames.
A person who worships a deity, religious figure, or spiritual entity. Used in religious and historical contexts.
A person who deeply admires or reveres another person, ideology, or movement. Can carry a slightly intense connotation.
A test or question format in which the examinee selects one correct answer from several options. Standard terminology in education and certification examinations in Japan.

glosses: complete game (baseball); pitching a full game
complete game; pitching a full game without being relieved
explanations: In baseball, when a starting pitcher pitches the entire game without being replaced by a relief pitcher. A notable achievement that demonstrates stamina and consistent performance.

glosses: higan service; Buddhist memorial service held during the spring and autumn equinoxes
explanations: A Buddhist ceremony held during the week centered on the spring equinox (around March 20) and autumn equinox (around September 23). Families visit graves, make offerings, and hold memorial services for the deceased during this period.

glosses: chief editor; manager; person in charge
chief editor; managing editor; editorial director
explanations: The person who oversees and directs the editorial work of a publication such as a newspaper, magazine, or journal.
A senior staff member or executive responsible for managing a project, department, or organization. Used as a job title in government and some companies.

glosses: connection port; connector; outlet; junction point
explanations: A physical opening or fitting where something can be connected, such as a pipe fitting, electrical port, or cable connector. Used in plumbing, electronics, and general infrastructure.

glosses: service entrance; staff gate; side entrance
explanations: A secondary entrance to a building, facility, or compound used for everyday access by staff, deliveries, and authorized visitors, as opposed to the formal main entrance.
A thin slice of tissue, material, or specimen prepared for examination under a microscope. Standard terminology in biology, medicine, and materials science.
The point where a line or curve crosses an axis on a graph. In the equation y = mx + b, the value b is the y-intercept.

The combination of simultaneously sounded musical notes to produce chords, and the study of how chords progress and relate to each other. The standard Japanese term for Western musical harmony as a theoretical discipline.

glosses: public order and morals; public policy
public order and morals; public policy and good morals
explanations: A legal and social concept referring to the fundamental moral and ethical standards of society. In Japanese law, acts that violate public order and morals may be deemed void. Frequently encountered in contracts, terms of service, and legal discussions.

glosses: oligopoly; market domination by a small number of firms
explanations: An economic condition in which a market is controlled by a small number of companies or sellers. A key concept in economics and competition law.

glosses: without a match; by default; walkover
explanations: The principle or state of not engaging in war or combat. Used in political and historical contexts to describe anti-war positions or treaties.
In sports and competitions, winning or losing without the match actually taking place, typically because an opponent withdraws or fails to appear.

glosses: conductor wire; lead wire; flow line
conductor wire; lead wire; electrical lead
flow line; traffic flow; route of movement
explanations: A wire or cable that conducts electricity from one point to another. Used in electronics, physics, and electrical work.
The path or route along which people or things naturally move through a space. Used in architecture, retail design, and urban planning to describe how foot traffic flows.

glosses: power map; balance-of-power diagram; map showing spheres of influence
explanations: A visual representation or figurative description of how power, influence, or market share is distributed among competing entities. Used in politics, business, and sports to show the relative strength and territory of different groups.
A broad, all-encompassing view or reference work that covers an entire subject area. Often used as part of a book title or publication name to indicate comprehensive coverage.

glosses: volunteer; willing participant; person who steps forward
explanations: A person who voluntarily offers to participate in or support an activity, cause, or movement. Emphasizes the person's own initiative and willingness rather than being assigned or obligated.

glosses: combined volume; omnibus edition; bound collection
explanations: A single volume that combines multiple separately published books, issues, or installments into one binding. Common in publishing for collecting magazine issues, manga volumes, or multi-part works.

The quality of being openly and shamelessly direct, without attempting to hide one's true feelings, intentions, or the graphic nature of something. Often carries a negative connotation of being inappropriately frank or crude.
A written piece presenting opinions and arguments on a topic, especially in a newspaper or magazine. Often refers to the editorial section or a signed opinion column.
A formal discussion or argument on a subject, presenting reasoned opinions and analysis.

glosses: assignment; submitted item; deliverable; thing to be submitted
explanations: Documents, homework, reports, or other items that must be turned in to a teacher, employer, or authority. Commonly used in school and workplace contexts to refer to items with submission deadlines.

glosses: treating as one's own; appropriation for personal use
treating as one's own property; personal appropriation; privatization for personal benefit
explanations: The act of treating something that belongs to an organization, the public, or others as if it were one's personal property. Strongly negative connotation, implying abuse of position or authority.

glosses: infarction; blockage of a blood vessel
explanations: A medical condition in which a blood vessel becomes blocked, cutting off blood supply to tissue and causing cell death. Most commonly encountered in the terms for heart attack and stroke.

glosses: head temple; main temple of a Buddhist sect
explanations: The principal temple of a Buddhist denomination or sect, which serves as the administrative and spiritual center overseeing all branch temples in the sect's network.

A special postcard sent to friends, relatives, and business contacts to convey New Year's greetings. Sold by Japan Post with lottery numbers printed on them. Tradition calls for them to arrive on January 1st.

glosses: restoration of honor; rehabilitation of reputation
restoration of honor; rehabilitation of one's reputation; vindication
explanations: The process of restoring a person's or organization's good name and reputation after it has been damaged by scandal, false accusations, or wrongdoing.
Damage to physical property such as vehicles, buildings, or objects, as opposed to personal injury. Commonly used in insurance, legal, and accident contexts.

glosses: birds and beasts; wildlife; wild birds and mammals
explanations: A collective term for wild birds and mammals. Used in literary, legal, and environmental contexts to refer to wildlife in general.
A camera lens with a long focal length that magnifies distant subjects, making them appear closer. Used in photography for wildlife, sports, and portrait work.

glosses: illustration; plate; figure; printed image in a publication
explanations: An illustration, photograph, diagram, or other visual image printed in a book, magazine, or other publication. Often refers specifically to full-page or high-quality reproductions.

glosses: ordinary profit; recurring profit; ordinary income
explanations: A key financial metric in Japanese corporate accounting that represents a company's profit from its regular business operations plus financial activities, before extraordinary items and taxes. Widely used in Japanese business reporting.
Medicine for treating symptoms of the common cold, such as fever, cough, runny nose, and sore throat. A formal term used in medical and pharmaceutical contexts.
A general term for sugars as a category, including monosaccharides, disaccharides, and oligosaccharides. Commonly seen on food labels and in nutritional contexts.

glosses: frontispiece; title page illustration; opening illustration
explanations: An illustration on or facing the title page of a book, or the opening illustration of a chapter or section in a manga, magazine, or publication.

glosses: dedication; offering; donation (to a shrine or temple)
dedication; offering; donation to a shrine, temple, or authority
explanations: The formal act of offering or dedicating something — such as money, goods, or artworks — to a shrine, temple, or person of high status. Implies respect and reverence.
The process of heating clay, ceramics, bricks, or similar materials at high temperatures in a kiln to harden and strengthen them. A fundamental step in pottery and ceramic production.

glosses: women's association; women's group; ladies' club
explanations: A local community organization of women, traditionally focused on neighborhood activities, welfare, cultural events, and social support. A longstanding feature of Japanese community life, though membership has been declining.

glosses: plunge pool; basin at the foot of a waterfall
explanations: The deep pool of water formed at the base of a waterfall by the force of the falling water. A natural feature found at many famous waterfalls.

glosses: the military; military establishment; armed forces leadership
the military; military establishment; military leadership
explanations: The military as an institution or political force, especially its leadership and decision-making apparatus. Often used in historical and political contexts to refer to the military establishment's influence on government.

glosses: waterfall meditation; waterfall ascetic practice; standing under a waterfall as spiritual training
explanations: A form of ascetic practice in which a person stands or sits under a waterfall, enduring the cold water as a means of spiritual purification and mental discipline. Rooted in Shinto and Buddhist traditions.

glosses: famous waterfall; noted waterfall; celebrated waterfall
explanations: A waterfall renowned for its beauty, size, or historical significance. Japan officially recognizes a list of one hundred famous waterfalls.

glosses: bisque firing; unglazed pottery; plain grilling
explanations: Pottery that has been fired without glaze, or the first firing of clay before glazing. The resulting ware is porous and has a rough, natural texture.
Cooking food, especially seafood or vegetables, by grilling without added sauce, seasoning, or oil, to bring out the ingredient's natural flavor.
A part of speech that expresses emotion, surprise, greeting, or response, functioning independently from the sentence structure. Examples in Japanese include ああ, おい, まあ, and えっ.

glosses: wealthy merchant; great merchant; powerful trader
explanations: A very rich and influential merchant, especially one from the Edo period or earlier Japanese history. Implies not just wealth but also social influence and often cultural patronage.

glosses: civilian control of the military; civil supremacy over the armed forces
explanations: The principle that elected civilian leaders, not military officers, have ultimate authority over military decisions and policy. A cornerstone of democratic governance.

A ship or boat powered by a steam engine. While modern vessels are rarely steam-powered, the word persists in historical and literary contexts and is still used loosely to mean a large passenger ship.

glosses: harmful animal; pest animal; nuisance wildlife
explanations: An animal that causes damage to crops, livestock, property, or human safety. Used in agricultural, environmental, and municipal contexts to refer to wildlife that creates problems for human activities.
The state of having no information about a person's location or condition. Used in news reports, missing persons cases, and disaster contexts.
A dictionary that provides English translations and explanations for Japanese words. The counterpart to an English-Japanese dictionary ({英和辞典|えいわじてん}).
The tendency to think and act based only on one's own perspective and interests, without considering others. Used both as a psychological term and in everyday criticism of selfish behavior.

glosses: kitchen work; cooking and kitchen chores
explanations: Work done in the kitchen, including cooking, washing dishes, cleaning, and food preparation. Refers to the everyday domestic labor of meal-related tasks.

glosses: fulfillment of a long-cherished wish; realization of a dream
explanations: The achievement of something one has wished for or worked toward over a long period. A four-character compound with a celebratory and somewhat formal tone.

glosses: discipline committee member; public morals officer
discipline committee member; public morals committee member
explanations: A student or official responsible for enforcing rules of conduct, dress codes, and general discipline. Most commonly refers to a student role in Japanese schools where members monitor compliance with school rules.
A system of government in which a single ruler or small group holds absolute power without constitutional or democratic constraints. Used in historical, political, and academic contexts.

glosses: formation of public opinion; shaping public opinion
explanations: The process by which collective attitudes and beliefs about social or political issues are formed, influenced, or changed. A key concept in media studies and political science.

Japan's public health insurance program for residents who are not covered by employer-based insurance. Administered by municipal governments and mandatory for all eligible residents, including self-employed workers, students, and retirees.

A system of supervised release in which offenders live in the community under the guidance of a probation officer rather than serving time in prison. Applies to both those given suspended sentences and those released on parole.

glosses: no passage; road closed; traffic prohibited
explanations: A prohibition on passage through a particular road, path, or area. Seen on road signs, barriers, and announcements about road closures due to construction, disasters, or events.
A formal presentation of research findings, typically given at academic conferences, seminars, or within a university or research institution. A core activity of academic and scientific life.
An organization formed by individuals or businesses who pool resources and share profits for mutual benefit. Common in agriculture, fishing, consumer goods, and credit unions in Japan.

glosses: redeeming one's reputation; clearing one's name
redeeming one's reputation; clearing one's name; restoring one's honor
explanations: Recovering from a damaged reputation through subsequent good performance or actions. Despite being technically a misuse of {挽回|ばんかい} (which means to recover something good), this phrase is widely used and accepted in modern Japanese.

glosses: new religious movement; new religion; newly established religious group
explanations: A religious organization founded in relatively recent times, typically from the 19th century onward. In Japan, the term covers a wide range of groups from mainstream organizations with millions of members to smaller, controversial sects.
A legal entity organized for the purpose of generating profit for its owners or shareholders. Includes stock companies, limited liability companies, and other business entities in Japanese law.
The technology that enables computers to identify and convert printed or handwritten text into digital data. Widely used in document scanning, translation apps, and automated data entry.
A medical procedure in which medication or fluid is delivered directly into a vein using a needle or catheter. One of the most common medical procedures encountered at hospitals and clinics.

glosses: frequency of occurrence; frequency of appearance
explanations: How often something appears or occurs within a given context. Used in statistics, linguistics, science, and data analysis to measure how common a particular item or event is.

glosses: outgoing call history; sent message log
explanations: A record of calls made or messages sent from a phone or device. A standard feature on mobile phones and communication apps.

The cosmetic effect of making skin appear lighter, more even-toned, or more luminous. A major concept in the Japanese beauty and skincare industry, referring to products that reduce spots, freckles, and dullness.
Actions taken after an event, incident, or main process to address remaining issues, clean up, or resolve consequences. Used in business, administrative, disaster management, and technical contexts.

glosses: relative position; spatial relationship; positional relationship
explanations: The way two or more things are positioned relative to each other in space. Used in geometry, geography, urban planning, and everyday descriptions of how things are arranged.
A residential facility exclusively for female students or workers. Common at universities, companies, and boarding schools in Japan.

glosses: pest control; prevention and extermination of pests or diseases
explanations: The combined activities of preventing and eliminating harmful insects, animals, weeds, or plant diseases. A standard term in agriculture, forestry, and public health.

glosses: curriculum; course of study; academic program
explanations: The organized plan of subjects and content that students follow at a school or university. Defines what is taught, in what order, and how much time is allocated.

glosses: chivalry; heroic spirit; gallantry; sense of justice and honor
explanations: The spirit of standing up for the weak and fighting against injustice, often at personal risk. A virtue associated with warriors, outlaws, and heroic figures in Japanese and Chinese cultural traditions.

glosses: items resolved; matters decided by vote
items resolved; matters decided by vote; resolutions
explanations: Specific items or matters that have been formally decided upon through a vote or resolution, typically in a meeting, assembly, or legislative body. A standard term in parliamentary and corporate governance.
The act of an insider—typically an employee or member of an organization—reporting illegal activities, fraud, safety violations, or other misconduct to external authorities or the public.
The costs incurred for medical treatment, including hospital fees, doctor visits, medication, and related healthcare services.

glosses: after-the-fact report; reporting after the fact
explanations: Notifying or reporting something to the relevant person or authority after it has already happened, rather than seeking prior approval or giving advance notice.
Dividing or distributing something—typically money, costs, or quantities—proportionally according to a set ratio or standard.

glosses: character of an area; nature of a locality
explanations: The distinctive qualities, atmosphere, or social characteristics of a particular place or neighborhood. Encompasses factors like safety, demographics, culture, and general reputation.
Rising to a higher position or rank, especially in a professional or official context. Implies a prestigious or honorable advancement.

glosses: nepotism; cronyism; favoritism based on personal connections
explanations: The practice of giving unfair advantages—such as jobs, contracts, or opportunities—to relatives, friends, or acquaintances rather than selecting people based on merit.
A collective term for seeds, bulbs, and young plants used for propagation in agriculture, horticulture, and forestry.

glosses: kitchen counter; cooking counter; food preparation surface
explanations: A flat work surface in a kitchen used for preparing and assembling food. In professional kitchens, it may refer to a dedicated preparation station.
The act of expressing one's thoughts, feelings, personality, or identity through words, actions, art, fashion, or other means.
An exaggerated, conspicuously large yawn, often implying boredom, extreme sleepiness, or lack of interest.
The act of drawing or pulling something or someone inward, or attracting people into a place, event, or situation.
The installation of utility connections—such as electricity, water, gas, or internet—from the main line to a building.
A reservation made on the same day it is to be used, as opposed to booking in advance. Common for restaurants, hotels, medical appointments, and event tickets.
The sound produced when pressing keys on a keyboard. A common topic in discussions about mechanical keyboards, office etiquette, and shared workspaces.

glosses: stain removal; the act of removing stains
explanations: The process of removing stains from clothing, fabric, or other surfaces.
A product or tool designed for removing stains, such as a cleaning solution or stain-removing pen.
Damage, irritation, or wear caused by repeated rubbing or friction on a surface. Applies to skin (chafing), fabric (wear), or other materials.

The building or section within a Buddhist temple complex where meals are prepared and where the resident priest and their family live. It serves as both a kitchen and a private residence area within the temple grounds.

glosses: home study; studying at home; home learning
explanations: Academic study done at home, including homework, self-study, and review outside of school. Often discussed in the context of children's education and study habits.

glosses: embellishment; exaggeration added to a story
explanations: The fin located at the tail end of a fish, used for propulsion and steering. Also called the caudal fin in scientific contexts.
Figuratively, extra details or exaggeration added when retelling a story or rumor, making it bigger or more dramatic than it actually was.
The outward display or communication of one's emotions through facial expressions, voice, body language, words, or behavior. Used in both everyday and academic (psychology/education) contexts.

glosses: financial situation; state of one's wallet
financial situation; state of one's purse; how much money one has
explanations: An informal, somewhat literary way to describe one's current financial condition, especially how much spending money one has on hand. Literally refers to the state of one's breast pocket (where money was traditionally kept).
Falling within the amount of money that has been allocated or planned for a particular purpose. Used for personal spending limits as well as business and project budgets.

glosses: fish dish; fish cuisine; seafood cooking
explanations: Any dish or course made primarily with fish. Encompasses a wide range of Japanese and international preparations, from raw sashimi to grilled, simmered, and fried fish dishes.
The quality of seeming unnatural, forced, or contrived. Describes something that feels off or doesn't flow naturally—applied to behavior, speech, appearance, or situations.

glosses: social education; community education; lifelong learning
explanations: Education that takes place outside the formal school system, including adult learning, community programs, libraries, museums, and public lectures. In Japan, it is a recognized category of education supported by law and local government.

An inherent tendency or disposition toward a particular state, behavior, or outcome. More formal and analytical than the base word {傾向|けいこう}, often used in academic, scientific, or philosophical discussion.
The process by which a society or economy transforms from primarily agricultural to one dominated by industry and manufacturing. Used in historical, economic, and policy discussions.
The quality or degree of being connected or pertinent to something. Used in formal, academic, and legal contexts to describe the logical or factual connection between things.
Materials and substances occurring in nature that can be exploited for economic gain, such as minerals, water, forests, and fossil fuels.

glosses: taxi en route to pick up a passenger; dispatched taxi
explanations: A taxi that has been called and is on its way to the customer's location. Displayed on the taxi's roof sign or meter to indicate it is not available for street hails.
An electronic screen for displaying visual output from a computer, phone, or other device.
An arrangement of goods, artwork, or items for viewing, as in a shop window or museum.

glosses: to click (a mouse button or link)
explanations: To press and release a mouse button, or to tap/select a link or button on a digital interface.
The act of ending an authenticated session on a computer, website, or application. The opposite of signing in or logging in.
A disposable napkin made of paper, commonly provided at restaurants, cafes, and fast-food establishments.

glosses: to use a metaphor; to liken; to compare figuratively
explanations: To express something by comparing it to something else in a figurative way. Often used in literary criticism, rhetoric, and academic writing.
The quality of being true, genuine, or authentic. Used in legal, academic, and philosophical contexts to evaluate whether something corresponds to reality.
The legal or contractual right to be the sole entity permitted to do, sell, or use something within a specified scope.
A small shop specializing in selling cigarettes, tobacco products, and often stamps and prepaid cards. A traditional feature of Japanese neighborhoods, though declining in number.
A delivery service that uses motorcycles to transport documents and small packages quickly, especially in urban areas where traffic congestion makes car delivery slow.

glosses: sphere of influence; territory; domain of power
explanations: The geographical or conceptual area over which a nation, organization, or individual exercises dominant influence or control.
A transition from one scene to another in a film, play, novel, or other narrative work. Also used figuratively to describe an abrupt shift in a situation or conversation.

glosses: facing mirrors; two mirrors placed opposite each other
explanations: Two mirrors positioned face-to-face so that they reflect each other, creating an infinite regression of images. Used practically to see the back of one's own head, and metaphorically in literature and culture.
A fermented mixture of rice bran, salt, and water used as a pickling medium for vegetables. The paste is maintained and reused over months or years, developing complex flavors.

glosses: in fog; in a fog; groping in the dark
in a fog; groping in the dark; uncertain
explanations: Literally being inside fog, with poor visibility.
Figuratively, a state of confusion or uncertainty where the way forward is unclear.

A mineral or organic material valued for its beauty, durability, and rarity, suitable for use in jewelry. Specifically refers to the highest-value category of stones such as diamonds, rubies, sapphires, and emeralds.

glosses: driving lane; travel lane; cruising lane
explanations: The left lane (in Japan) of a multi-lane road or expressway, intended for normal-speed driving. Contrasted with the passing lane.
The rightmost lane (in Japan) of a multi-lane road or expressway, designated for overtaking slower vehicles. Drivers are expected to return to the travel lane after passing.
A delivery or shipping service scheduled for the afternoon time slot. Used in logistics and postal contexts.
A flight or transportation service departing in the afternoon.

glosses: offering advice; counsel; recommendation to a superior
offering advice; counsel; making a recommendation to a superior
explanations: The act of respectfully offering advice, suggestions, or recommendations to someone in a higher position. A formal term implying a degree of deference.
The act of quelling unrest, rebellion, or disturbance and restoring a state of peace and order. A formal term used in historical, military, and political contexts.

glosses: win by default; walkover; forfeit win
explanations: A victory achieved without playing or competing, because the opponent withdrew, failed to appear, or was disqualified.

glosses: sewing tools; sewing kit; sewing supplies
explanations: A collection of tools and materials used for sewing by hand or machine, including needles, thread, scissors, pins, and a thimble.

glosses: stupid-looking face; idiotic expression; dopey face
explanations: A face or facial expression that looks foolish, absent-minded, or vacant. Used as an insult or in humorous self-deprecation.

glosses: warding off bad luck; evil-averting charm
explanations: The practice of warding off misfortune, or a charm or ritual performed for that purpose, especially during unlucky years.

glosses: night of the full moon; harvest moon
explanations: The fifteenth night of the eighth month in the traditional lunar calendar, celebrated as a moon-viewing occasion. By extension, the full moon itself.
A mountain of great height, typically above the tree line. Used in geography, ecology, and mountaineering contexts.
Bonds issued by national or local governments to finance public spending. Also refers to the resulting public debt.
The person who controls or manages an operation from behind the scenes. Often implies the top figure in an organization, especially one with shady or informal power structures.
The act of succeeding to a position, right, obligation, or property from a predecessor. Used primarily in legal and formal contexts.
The act of killing insects, especially harmful ones. Most commonly encountered as part of compounds like insecticide or bug spray.
The physical remains of a deceased person or animal. A formal, literary word used especially in news reports and written language.
The act of moving to and settling in a new or undeveloped area, especially for farming or development purposes.
Managed or operated by the government, as opposed to private enterprise.
A channel or ditch running alongside a road or building to carry away rainwater and wastewater.
A cow raised primarily for milk production, as opposed to beef cattle.

glosses: sense of deprivation; feeling of being deprived
explanations: The psychological feeling that something one is entitled to or accustomed to has been taken away.

glosses: Western tableware; Western-style dishes and utensils
explanations: Tableware designed in Western style, including plates, knives, forks, spoons, and glasses, as distinct from traditional Japanese tableware.
A traditional ceremony in which a newborn baby is brought to a Shinto shrine for the first time, typically around one month after birth, to pray for the child's health and protection.
A person who trades in stocks, commodities, or other markets, especially one who takes risks hoping to profit from price fluctuations.
Walking at a speed faster than normal pace, often as a form of exercise.
A gait of a horse between a walk and a canter, in which diagonal pairs of legs move together.

glosses: unlucky day (except around noon); inauspicious day in the rokuyo calendar
explanations: One of the six days in the traditional rokuyo calendar cycle, considered generally unlucky except for the period around noon. Associated with fire-related misfortune.
The sudden cessation of heart function, in which the heart stops pumping blood effectively. A life-threatening medical emergency.
A product manufactured in large quantities using standardized processes, as opposed to handmade or custom-made items.
A bag filled with ice or cold water, applied to the body to reduce swelling, cool fever, or treat injuries.

glosses: indoor shoes; house slippers; indoor footwear
explanations: Footwear worn exclusively indoors, such as slippers for the home or designated shoes worn inside schools and workplaces.

glosses: tissue paper; nose paper; handkerchief paper
explanations: Soft paper used for blowing one's nose. An older word for what is now commonly called tissue.
A vehicle used for transporting goods and cargo, whether a railway freight car or a road vehicle.
The residence of an emperor or empress. In Japan, specifically the palace of the Japanese emperor.
A person or party who sells goods or services.
A person or party who buys goods or services.
A town that developed around a post station on one of the Edo-period highway routes, providing lodging and services for travelers.

glosses: adjournment, breaking up, dispersal (of a meeting or gathering)
explanations: The formal ending and dispersal of a meeting, assembly, or gathering.
An order issued by the Cabinet to implement laws, ranking below legislation but above ministerial ordinances in Japan's legal hierarchy.
A written or inscribed charm believed to ward off evil, illness, or misfortune through spiritual power.

glosses: day-trip hot spring, hot spring for day use
day-trip hot spring, hot spring bath for day use
explanations: A hot spring facility that can be enjoyed without an overnight stay, allowing visitors to bathe and return home the same day.

glosses: sorcery, black magic, spell, curse technique
explanations: The practice of using supernatural or spiritual means—such as incantations, rituals, or cursed objects—to influence events or harm others.
The last day of an event, period, exhibition, sale, or scheduled activity.
A device that removes impurities from tap water to make it cleaner and safer for drinking.
A young bird that has recently hatched or has not yet learned to fly.
A financial company that buys, sells, and trades stocks, bonds, and other securities on behalf of clients.

glosses: miso-pickled food, food preserved in miso paste
explanations: Vegetables, fish, or meat that have been pickled or marinated in miso paste, both as a preservation method and for flavor.

glosses: younger-brother figure, junior (in a close relationship)
explanations: A person who is treated like or regarded as a younger brother, especially in a close mentoring or friendship relationship, though not related by blood.
A cooperative financial institution that serves members within a specific local area, providing savings accounts, loans, and other banking services primarily to small businesses and individuals.

glosses: intermediate color, neutral color, muted tone
explanations: A color that falls between two primary or contrasting colors, or a subdued, grayish tone that is neither vivid nor dark—such as beige, mauve, or olive.
A pattern or arrangement where lines, roads, or elements spread outward from a central point, like the spokes of a wheel.

glosses: crawling on the ground; creeping along with one's body close to the surface
explanations: crawling on the ground; creeping along with one's body close to the surface

glosses: the inner palace where the emperor's consorts and attendants lived
the inner palace where the emperor's consorts and attendants lived; imperial harem
explanations: the inner palace where the emperor's consorts and attendants lived; imperial harem

glosses: memorial service; ceremony held to honor and remember the deceased
explanations: memorial service; ceremony held to honor and remember the deceased

glosses: full run-through rehearsal; performing a piece or show from beginning to end without stopping
explanations: full run-through rehearsal; performing a piece or show from beginning to end without stopping

glosses: whiteout; a weather condition where heavy snow or fog reduces visibility to near zero, making it impossible to distinguish the ground from the sky
explanations: whiteout; a weather condition where heavy snow or fog reduces visibility to near zero, making it impossible to distinguish the ground from the sky

glosses: resale prohibited; ban on reselling (especially tickets, limited goods, etc. at a markup)
explanations: resale prohibited; ban on reselling (especially tickets, limited goods, etc. at a markup)

glosses: local industry; industries rooted in a particular region, typically using local resources or traditional skills
explanations: local industry; industries rooted in a particular region, typically using local resources or traditional skills

glosses: body fat percentage; the proportion of fat in one's body weight
explanations: body fat percentage; the proportion of fat in one's body weight

explanations: no admittance; entry prohibited; a sign or rule forbidding people from entering a venue or area

glosses: naming rights; the right to attach a company or brand name to a facility, typically through a sponsorship deal
explanations: naming rights; the right to attach a company or brand name to a facility, typically through a sponsorship deal

glosses: Order of Culture; Japan's highest cultural honor, awarded by the Emperor to individuals who have made outstanding contributions to arts, sciences, or culture
explanations: Order of Culture; Japan's highest cultural honor, awarded by the Emperor to individuals who have made outstanding contributions to arts, sciences, or culture

glosses: to score a win; to chalk up a victory (originally from sumo, now used broadly in sports and competition)
explanations: to score a win; to chalk up a victory (originally from sumo, now used broadly in sports and competition)

glosses: dress-up doll; a doll designed to be dressed in different outfits
(figurative) a person who is dressed up or styled by others without having a say; someone treated as a mannequin
explanations: dress-up doll; a doll designed to be dressed in different outfits
(figurative) a person who is dressed up or styled by others without having a say; someone treated as a mannequin

granularity; level of detail or fineness (in computing, business, and general usage)
explanations: grain size; particle size (in materials science, geology, etc.)
granularity; level of detail or fineness (in computing, business, and general usage)

(rough) oneself; I (dialectal/rough self-reference, contracted from {手前|てまえ})
explanations: (vulgar) you; used as a hostile or contemptuous form of address

glosses: (archaic/literary) you; a formal and respectful second-person pronoun used between men of equal or similar rank
explanations: (archaic/literary) you; a formal and respectful second-person pronoun used between men of equal or similar rank

a base sauce made by combining soy sauce, mirin, and sugar (used in soba, ramen, etc.)
explanations: a comeback; retort; response (especially a witty or quick reply)
returning something; giving back; repayment
a base sauce made by combining soy sauce, mirin, and sugar (used in soba, ramen, etc.)

explanations: samurai residence; the mansion or estate of a warrior-class family, especially during the Edo period

glosses: chemical formula; a symbolic representation of the composition of a chemical compound
explanations: chemical formula; a symbolic representation of the composition of a chemical compound

glosses: inpatient; a patient admitted to and staying in a hospital for treatment
explanations: inpatient; a patient admitted to and staying in a hospital for treatment

splash guard; mudflap; a device that prevents splashing or spattering
explanations: bouncing back; repelling; deflecting something that comes at you
splash guard; mudflap; a device that prevents splashing or spattering

glosses: impact of a projectile; a bullet, shell, or missile hitting its target or landing at a point
explanations: impact of a projectile; a bullet, shell, or missile hitting its target or landing at a point

glosses: sanitary products; menstrual hygiene products such as pads, tampons, and menstrual cups
explanations: sanitary products; menstrual hygiene products such as pads, tampons, and menstrual cups

glosses: chemical weapon; a weapon that uses toxic chemicals to cause harm or death
explanations: chemical weapon; a weapon that uses toxic chemicals to cause harm or death

one's true background or origin becomes known; to be revealed for what one really is (often negative)
explanations: one's true background or origin becomes known; to be revealed for what one really is (often negative)

glosses: hypothetical form; the conditional conjugation form of Japanese verbs and adjectives, used with ～ば to express 'if'
explanations: hypothetical form; the conditional conjugation form of Japanese verbs and adjectives, used with ～ば to express 'if'
