(formal/humble) presenting a gift to a superior; offering something to a person of higher status
explanations: (formal/humble) presenting a gift to a superior; offering something to a person of higher status

glosses: chemical product; chemicals (reagents, industrial chemicals, or synthetic substances used in science, manufacturing, or cleaning)
explanations: chemical product; chemicals (reagents, industrial chemicals, or synthetic substances used in science, manufacturing, or cleaning)

glosses: length of stay (in days); the number of days spent staying at a place, especially for travel or immigration purposes
explanations: length of stay (in days); the number of days spent staying at a place, especially for travel or immigration purposes

glosses: muscular and powerfully built; having a strong, well-developed physique
explanations: muscular and powerfully built; having a strong, well-developed physique
having or showing excessive interest in sexual pleasure
an appreciation of romantic or aesthetic beauty, especially in classical literature
the inability to control the release of urine or feces
a container or utensil used for serving or drinking sake or other alcoholic beverages
an aircraft or vehicle that operates without a human pilot on board
extremely hard and concentrated practice or training, often over a sustained period
a correction or revision of a figure, forecast, or estimate to a higher value
the act of breaking or destroying something by striking it
a type of popular uprising in the Edo period where crowds destroyed the homes and shops of wealthy merchants or officials
the head of a faculty or school within a university

glosses: to drag out; to haul out
to force out; to bring to light
explanations: to forcibly pull something or someone out of a place by dragging
to compel someone to come out or to expose something hidden
a traditional Japanese celebration held on the seventh night after a baby's birth, when the baby's name is formally announced
a traditional Japanese bedding set consisting of a mattress spread directly on the floor and a quilt-like comforter
a surgical procedure to transfer an organ from a donor to a recipient
a method of education where students learn without being physically present at a school or institution
a partial or total inability to hear, ranging from mild hearing loss to complete deafness
medical care focused on comfort and quality of life for patients with terminal illnesses who are nearing death
a non-alcoholic beverage, especially one that is commercially packaged and sold, such as soda, juice, or tea
a female actor who plays a supporting role in a film, television show, or theatrical production
a gas in the atmosphere that traps heat from the sun, contributing to the greenhouse effect and global warming
the branch of knowledge that deals with the physical world, including physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science
the board used to play shogi (Japanese chess), traditionally a thick wooden block with a 9x9 grid
the process of transferring ownership of property or business from the government to the private sector
a mirror designed specifically for applying makeup, often with magnification or built-in lighting
a machine used for printing text or images onto paper or other materials
the part of the autonomic nervous system that activates the body's fight-or-flight response, increasing heart rate, blood pressure, and alertness

glosses: green bean; string bean; snap bean
explanations: the immature pod of the common bean plant, eaten whole as a vegetable

glosses: soda water; carbonated water; sparkling water
explanations: water infused with carbon dioxide gas, producing bubbles
a baseball bat made of metal, typically aluminum alloy, used widely in amateur baseball in Japan
a traditional Japanese celebration held approximately 100 days after a baby's birth, featuring a symbolic first meal ceremony

glosses: to each their own; it depends on the person
to each their own; it depends on the person; everyone is different
explanations: Expresses the idea that opinions, preferences, or circumstances vary from person to person. Used to acknowledge individual differences without passing judgment.
Describes something that has not yet been made public, whether a creative work, research findings, official information, or a product. Used as a noun or a pre-noun modifier with の.

glosses: to equivocate; to be evasive; to speak vaguely
to equivocate; to be evasive; to give a vague answer
explanations: To deliberately avoid giving a clear or direct answer by speaking vaguely or ambiguously. The literal image is of 'muddying one's words,' making them unclear like cloudy water.

glosses: outstanding versatility; working on all fronts
explanations: Describes someone who is active and effective in many areas at once, handling multiple tasks or roles with great energy. Literally 'eight faces and six arms,' evoking a Buddhist deity capable of looking and reaching in all directions simultaneously.

glosses: power saving; low power consumption; energy efficiency
explanations: Refers to reduced electrical power usage, either as a feature of a device or as a mode of operation designed to consume less energy.
The physical force used to pull or tow something, such as a vehicle or load.
The ability of a person, organization, or idea to draw others along and lead progress, used metaphorically.
A business owned and operated by a single individual without forming a corporation. In Japan, this is a specific legal and tax category distinct from a company ({法人|ほうじん}).

glosses: epicenter (the point on the earth's surface directly above the focus of an earthquake)
explanations: The technical term for the point on the ground surface directly above where an earthquake originates. Distinct from the hypocenter ({震源|しんげん}), which is the underground point of origin.

glosses: dialogue skills; ability to engage in productive conversation
explanations: The skill or capacity to communicate effectively through dialogue, including listening, responding thoughtfully, and building mutual understanding. Frequently discussed in education, business, and diplomacy.
The area of the body below the navel. Used in medical, health, and everyday contexts to refer to this specific part of the torso.

glosses: underground; depths of the earth; subterranean
explanations: The deep interior beneath the earth's surface. Often evokes a sense of hidden, unexplored, or mysterious spaces far below ground level.
An extremely polite way to refer to someone's name, used in formal ceremonies, invitations, guest books, and official correspondence. Much more elevated than お{名前|なまえ}.

glosses: unemployed person; person without a job
unemployed person; person without a job or occupation
explanations: A person who currently has no job or occupation. Used in official, statistical, and news contexts. More formal and objective than the colloquial {無職|むしょく}.

glosses: visitor (to a sick or hospitalized person)
visitor to a sick or hospitalized person; well-wisher
explanations: A person who visits someone who is ill, injured, or hospitalized to offer sympathy and encouragement. Visiting the sick (お{見舞|みま}い) is an important social custom in Japan.

glosses: creator; creative artist; originator of creative work
explanations: A person who creates original works, particularly in literature, art, music, or other creative fields. Emphasizes the act of original creation rather than mere production.

A style of writing that uses modern spoken Japanese grammar and vocabulary, as opposed to the classical literary style ({文語体|ぶんごたい}). In Japanese linguistics, this refers specifically to the modern language style that became standard after the Meiji-era language reforms.
The degree to which customers are pleased with a product, service, or experience. A core concept in business management, often measured through surveys and used as a key performance indicator.

glosses: deluxe edition; luxury version; premium edition
explanations: A higher-quality, more elaborately produced version of a book, product, or service, typically featuring additional content, better materials, or special packaging at a higher price.
An activity or entertainment that takes one's mind off worries or boredom. Implies a pleasant, refreshing change of pace rather than deep engagement.

glosses: rural area; county district; area outside incorporated cities
explanations: In Japanese administrative geography, the areas of a prefecture that lie outside incorporated cities ({市|し}). These are the towns ({町|まち}) and villages ({村|むら}) organized under county ({郡|ぐん}) groupings. Often used as a contrast to {市部|しぶ} (urban areas).

glosses: restriction; localization; confinement to a limited area
restriction; confinement; localization to a limited scope or area
explanations: The state of being confined or restricted to a particular area, scope, or range. Often used in medical and technical contexts to describe something that has not spread beyond a limited zone.

glosses: respectfully yours; sincerely (closing of a formal letter)
a deep bow of respect; kowtow
explanations: A very formal closing phrase used in traditional Japanese letter writing, originally meaning 'bowing one's head to the ground.' Paired with {拝啓|はいけい} (Dear Sir/Madam) as the opening.
The original meaning: to quickly touch one's forehead to the ground as a gesture of respect. Now rarely used in this literal sense.

A Buddhist sacred text, originally referring to the recorded teachings of the Buddha. One of the three divisions of the Buddhist canon ({三蔵|さんぞう}). Also used more broadly for the chanting of such texts.
A blood-sucking aquatic or terrestrial worm. In Japan, mountain leeches (ヤマビル) are commonly encountered during hiking in forested, humid areas.
A rich, deep shade of green. Used to describe the color of dense foliage, fabric, paint, and other objects with an intense green hue.

glosses: popular edition; affordable edition; mass-market version
explanations: A lower-priced, widely available edition of a book or publication, designed for broad distribution rather than collectors or specialists. Often smaller in format, with simpler binding.
The formal documents that summarize a company's financial activities, including the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement. Required for corporate reporting and auditing.

glosses: feeling of a narrow defeat; sense of having almost won
feeling of a narrow defeat; sense of frustration from losing by a slim margin
explanations: The particular emotional experience of losing a close contest — a mixture of regret and frustration intensified by the knowledge that victory was within reach.

glosses: to be disliked; to be hated
to be disliked; to be hated; to be detested
explanations: The passive form of {嫌|きら}う (to dislike). Describes being on the receiving end of dislike, aversion, or hatred from others.
Describes effort, devotion, or hard work that does not receive the recognition or reward it deserves. The negative passive form of {報|むく}いる (to reward).
Describes actions or attempts that produce no positive result, emphasizing the emotional sense of wasted effort.

glosses: immigration and emigration; entry and exit of a country
immigration and emigration; entering and leaving a country
explanations: The process of entering and exiting a country, encompassing passport control, visa checks, and border procedures. Commonly encountered at airports and ports.
A felt-padded tool used to wipe chalk from a blackboard. A standard item in Japanese classrooms.
A person who oversees an examination to ensure rules are followed and no cheating occurs. In Japanese educational settings, teachers or designated staff serve this role.

glosses: advisor; counselor; person who gives advice
explanations: A person who provides guidance, suggestions, or recommendations. Used in both formal institutional settings and general contexts.
A nation with dominant economic, military, and political influence on a global scale. Historically used to describe the United States and the former Soviet Union during the Cold War.

A ceremony or event marking a person's transition from one stage of life to another. Originally an anthropological term, now widely used in everyday language for any formative experience that serves as a milestone.

glosses: stopping; halting; staying in one place
explanations: The act of stopping and remaining in one place, especially used for vehicles at designated stops or for things that stay in a fixed position.

glosses: planting; the act of planting trees and plants
explanations: The activity of planting trees, shrubs, and other plants, especially for landscaping, urban greening, or environmental purposes.
The trees, shrubs, and plants that have been planted in a particular area, especially as part of landscaping or urban design.

glosses: grader; scorer; marker; person who grades exams or assignments
explanations: A person who evaluates and scores examinations, assignments, or competitions. Used in educational and competitive contexts.

glosses: approximate number; rough figure; round number
explanations: A number that is not exact but gives a general idea of the quantity. Used in mathematics education, statistics, and everyday reporting when precise figures are unnecessary or unavailable.
The mathematical operation of adding numbers together, or more generally, the act of adding a quantity to another.
An extra amount added to a base price, fee, or score. Common in billing, taxation, and point-based systems.

glosses: lifting a ban; removal of a prohibition
lifting a ban; removal of a prohibition; unbanning
explanations: The act of removing or canceling a previously imposed prohibition or restriction. Used in legal, regulatory, and general contexts.
A mechanical device that moves air, used for ventilation, cooling, drying, or industrial processes. Refers to dedicated blower units rather than household fans.

glosses: passing point; waypoint; checkpoint along a route
explanations: A physical point that one passes through on a route or course, such as in racing, hiking, or navigation.

Figuratively, a point in a process or journey that is not the final destination but merely a stage along the way. Often used to express that a current achievement or situation is just one step in a longer progression.
An organized group of musicians, especially a military band, police band, or marching band. Distinct from rock bands or orchestras.
A condition in which the arch of the foot is flattened so that the entire sole makes contact with the ground. Can cause discomfort when walking or running.

glosses: incineration plant; incinerator facility; waste burning facility
explanations: A facility where waste, garbage, or other materials are burned for disposal. In Japan, municipal incineration plants are a key part of waste management infrastructure.

glosses: power distribution board; electrical panel; switchboard
explanations: A panel or board that distributes electrical power from a main source to various circuits within a building. Contains circuit breakers, switches, and fuses.

glosses: interview survey; hearing investigation; oral inquiry
explanations: A survey or investigation conducted by directly interviewing people. Used in government, academic research, journalism, and workplace contexts to gather firsthand information.

glosses: track and field athlete; athletics competitor
explanations: A person who competes in track and field events such as sprints, distance running, hurdles, jumping, and throwing. Short for {陸上競技選手|りくじょうきょうぎせんしゅ}.
A local community organization at the town or block level that handles neighborhood affairs such as festivals, cleanup activities, and communication with local government.
A creative idea, plan, or device, especially one intended to make something more interesting or entertaining.
Rectangular pieces of pounded rice cake, typically sold in individually wrapped blocks. A staple food especially around New Year.
A voucher or ticket that can be exchanged for goods, services, or another ticket at a designated location.
A ticket or slip confirming a reservation, such as for a restaurant, event, or product pickup.
Equipment and implements used for cleaning, such as brooms, mops, dustpans, and buckets.
A point along the way toward a goal or destination, emphasizing that it is not the final objective but a stage in the process.
The state of living or being present in a place permanently or continuously.
A Buddhist concept meaning unchanging or eternal existence, as opposed to impermanence.

glosses: to be unable to process; to overload mentally
explanations: For an electrical circuit to malfunction due to an unintended connection between conductors, often causing sparks or equipment failure.
Used figuratively to describe someone's brain freezing or becoming overwhelmed by too much information.
The process of becoming colder, used especially in discussions of climate and environmental change.
The release of carbon dioxide and other carbon compounds into the atmosphere, especially from burning fossil fuels.
A facial expression showing displeasure or sulking, with puffed-out cheeks or a disgruntled look.
Sexual passion or carnal desire, often carrying a literary or somewhat clinical tone.
A horse trained and used for military purposes, such as cavalry charges, transport, or battle.

glosses: outside Tokyo; outside the metropolitan area
explanations: Areas outside Tokyo Metropolis, used in administrative, news, and everyday contexts when distinguishing between inside and outside the capital.

glosses: classical allusion; literary reference; historical precedent
explanations: A reference to a classic text, historical event, or well-known story from the literary tradition, especially Chinese classics.
The force that propels an object forward, especially in the context of engines, rockets, and aircraft.
The office or organization responsible for publishing a book, periodical, or document. Commonly printed on the copyright page of Japanese books.

glosses: statute law; enacted law; written law
explanations: Law that has been formally enacted by a legislative body, as opposed to customary law or judicial precedent.
The surface of water as shaped by waves.
In physics, a surface connecting all points of a wave that are in the same phase of oscillation.
The deliberate removal of body hair using various methods such as shaving, waxing, or laser treatment.
The involuntary loss or shedding of hair, often as a medical symptom or side effect of treatment.
The act of violating, trampling upon, or ruthlessly disregarding rights, dignity, or territory. Used primarily in formal and written contexts.
The perception of sounds, especially voices, when no external auditory stimulus is present. A symptom associated with certain psychiatric conditions, extreme fatigue, or stress.
A person who travels from place to place without a fixed home or destination. Can carry a romantic or literary nuance of free-spirited travel, or a more negative sense of aimless roaming.

glosses: amount of exercise; level of physical activity
explanations: The quantity or intensity of physical exercise a person engages in.
In physics, the product of an object's mass and velocity.
A person who provides support, assistance, or backing to a cause, individual, or organization.
An examination held at fixed intervals, especially the midterm and final exams in Japanese schools. Also used for regularly scheduled professional or medical examinations.
The act of adding water to a substance, mixture, or product. Commonly used in cooking, food processing, and chemistry.

glosses: to feel sick; to feel unwell; to feel bad
to feel sick; to feel nauseous; to feel unwell
to feel bad; to feel unpleasant; to be in a bad mood
explanations: To experience physical discomfort such as nausea, dizziness, or general malaise.
To experience an unpleasant emotional state, whether caused by someone's behavior, a situation, or one's own mood.
A measured value that falls outside the normal or expected range. Used in medicine, science, data analysis, and technical fields.
The act of paying back money that has been borrowed. Covers both the ongoing process of making payments and the goal of becoming debt-free.

glosses: water injection; pouring water; filling with water
explanations: The act of pouring or injecting water into something. Used in industrial, agricultural, culinary, and emergency contexts.
Showing resistance or opposition to authority, change, or influence. Describes an attitude or stance of pushing back.

Relating to or guided by sensitivity, emotion, and intuitive perception rather than logic or reason. Often describes an approach to art, design, or communication that emphasizes feeling over analysis.
A polite way to refer to someone else's home. The prefix ご adds respect. Used in business, customer service, and formal speech.
A regular payment made toward insurance, a savings plan, or an installment scheme.
The amount of money risked in a bet or gamble.

glosses: personal belongings; carry-on items; personal effects
explanations: Items that a person carries with them, especially when traveling. Commonly seen on signs and in announcements at airports, stations, and public facilities.
The price of a product, asset, or commodity at this moment. Commonly used in auctions, stock markets, real estate, and online shopping.
The superlative form meaning the most weak. Used to describe the least powerful, least capable, or least strong entity in a group.
The removal of visible body hair at the skin's surface using methods such as shaving, creams, or wax. Unlike laser treatments, this does not destroy the hair follicle.

The government agency responsible for immigration control, visa processing, and residence status management. In Japan, this function is now handled by the Immigration Services Agency ({出入国在留管理庁|しゅつにゅうこくざいりゅうかんりちょう}), established in 2019.
The practice of treating and storing food to prevent spoilage and extend its shelf life. Includes methods such as refrigeration, freezing, drying, canning, and pickling.

glosses: winning streak record; consecutive win record
explanations: A record of consecutive victories in sports, games, or competitions. Refers both to an ongoing streak and to the historical record for most consecutive wins.

glosses: the strongest person; the most powerful
the strongest person; the most powerful individual
explanations: The person who is the strongest or most powerful in a given group, field, or competition. Frequently used in gaming, martial arts, sports, and fiction.
Physical or psychological symptoms that occur when a person stops using a substance they have become dependent on, such as drugs, alcohol, or caffeine.
Used figuratively to describe an intense, uncontrollable urge or longing for something one has been deprived of, such as a hobby, food, or entertainment.
The act of making a reservation or appointment by telephone, or a reservation made in this way.
The design of buildings and structures to withstand earthquake forces, a critical aspect of construction in earthquake-prone Japan.
A designated place for temporarily storing bags, suitcases, or other personal belongings, commonly found in hotels, stations, airports, and event venues.
A store or business that has a partnership or affiliation agreement with another company, often offering special discounts, loyalty points, or shared services.

glosses: end of serialization; conclusion of a series
explanations: The conclusion or discontinuation of a work that has been published in installments, most commonly used for manga series in magazines but also applicable to novels, columns, or web series.
Medical care focused on preventing diseases and maintaining health rather than treating illness after it occurs, including vaccinations, health screenings, and lifestyle guidance.
The practice or process of correcting one's body posture, whether through exercises, devices, chiropractic treatment, or conscious habit changes.

glosses: green car ticket; first-class rail ticket
explanations: A supplementary ticket required to ride in the Green Car (first-class carriage) on JR trains in Japan, purchased in addition to a regular fare ticket.
A ticket or certificate that entitles the holder to a discount, freebie, or special offer, commonly distributed by stores, restaurants, and online services.

glosses: valuables pouch; valuables case; valuables locker
explanations: A container, pouch, bag, or designated storage space for keeping valuable items like wallets, jewelry, and electronics safe, commonly found in gyms, hot springs, and changing rooms.
The process of converting a company or business division into a subsidiary, typically through acquisition of a controlling stake or corporate restructuring.

glosses: right to run for office; eligibility for election
right to run for office; eligibility for election; passive suffrage
explanations: The legal right to stand as a candidate in an election. In Japan, the minimum age for this right varies by office: 25 for the House of Representatives and local assemblies, 30 for the House of Councillors and prefectural governors.

glosses: removal from a register; expulsion from the rolls
explanations: The removal of a person's name from the koseki (family register), which occurs upon death, marriage into another family, or other legal changes in family status.
The removal of a person from an organization's register, such as being expelled from a school, dismissed from a military unit, or struck from a professional registry.

A boxed meal prepared entirely from plant-based ingredients following the principles of shojin ryori (Buddhist vegetarian cuisine), without meat, fish, or strong-smelling vegetables like garlic and onion.

glosses: wasabi pickles; wasabi preserved in sake lees
explanations: A traditional Japanese pickle made by chopping wasabi stems, leaves, and roots and preserving them in sake lees (kasuzuke). A specialty of Shizuoka Prefecture, where most Japanese wasabi is grown.

glosses: hand signal; hand gesture used for signaling
explanations: A signal conveyed by hand movements, used in traffic direction, cycling, military operations, diving, and other situations where verbal communication is difficult or impossible.

glosses: backup power source; emergency power supply
explanations: A secondary power source that activates when the main power supply fails, such as generators, battery packs, or UPS systems, used in buildings, hospitals, data centers, and for disaster preparedness.
The quality or degree of being strange, odd, or peculiar. Formed by adding the nominalizing suffix さ to the na-adjective 奇妙, turning the quality into a measurable or discussable noun.
A driver's license with specific restrictions, most commonly the AT限定 (automatic transmission only) license in Japan, which does not permit the holder to drive manual transmission vehicles.

A document created by a private individual or organization, as opposed to an official or public document issued by a government body. In legal contexts, this distinction is important because forging private documents and public documents carry different penalties.
The structural strength of a building or infrastructure against earthquakes, typically measured and graded according to national building standards.

A pay structure where compensation is determined by individual effort, output, or performance rather than by seniority or fixed salary. Often contrasted with the traditional Japanese seniority-based pay system.

glosses: old school building; former school building
explanations: A school building that has been replaced by a newer one or that is no longer in active use as a school. May still stand as a historical structure, community facility, or demolition candidate.
The decorative paper or cloth that covers the surface of fusuma (Japanese sliding doors), which needs to be replaced periodically as it ages or becomes damaged.
A reckless or foolish act committed because of the impulsiveness and inexperience of youth.

glosses: medium build; average height and weight
explanations: A person of average physique, neither particularly tall nor short, neither thin nor heavy.
The art or technique of engraving, carving, or embossing designs on metal surfaces, including jewelry making and decorative metalwork.

glosses: Buddhist altar fittings; Buddhist ritual implements
explanations: Objects and utensils used in Buddhist worship, including items placed on a home altar or used in temple ceremonies.

glosses: Issun-bōshi; the One-Inch Boy (folk tale character)
a very small person; a tiny person
explanations: A character from a famous Japanese folk tale — a tiny boy the size of one sun (about 3 cm) who goes on adventures and eventually grows to full size after defeating an ogre.
Used figuratively to refer to someone extremely short or small in stature.

glosses: seating order; seating arrangement by rank
explanations: The order in which people are seated, typically determined by rank, seniority, or social status.
A student's ranking position within their class based on academic performance.

glosses: under the floor; crawl space beneath the floor
under the floor; space beneath the floor; crawl space
explanations: The area underneath the floorboards of a building, often used for ventilation, plumbing, or storage in traditional Japanese houses.

glosses: sake lees soup; soup made with sake kasu
explanations: A hearty Japanese soup made with sake lees (the solid residue left after sake brewing), typically containing vegetables, fish, or pork in a miso-based broth.

glosses: glutinous rice flour; sweet rice flour; mochi flour
explanations: Flour made from glutinous rice (mochigome), used to make mochi and other traditional Japanese sweets.

glosses: seasonal rain front; baiu front; rainy season front
explanations: The stationary weather front that brings Japan's rainy season, typically stretching across the country from June to mid-July as warm and cool air masses collide.

glosses: crew member; crew; occupant of a vehicle
explanations: A person who operates or is on board a vehicle, aircraft, or vessel as part of its crew, or more broadly, any occupant of a vehicle.
A professionally licensed architect in Japan, qualified to design buildings and oversee construction projects.

glosses: examination fee; test fee; application fee for an exam
explanations: The fee charged to take an entrance examination, certification test, or other formal exam.

glosses: on a call; busy; in the middle of a phone call
explanations: The state of being engaged in a telephone conversation, or a phone line being in use.
A person who assists a high-ranking official in government, military, or organizational contexts, typically in an advisory capacity.

glosses: communal living; living together; shared living
explanations: A way of life in which people live together in a shared space, cooperating in daily activities and sharing responsibilities.
A printing method using raised metal or wooden type pieces that are inked and pressed onto paper, or the type pieces themselves.

glosses: senior Shinto priest; shrine priest (second rank)
explanations: A Shinto priesthood rank, second in the hierarchy below the chief priest. Responsible for assisting in shrine rituals and administration.

glosses: chivalrous spirit; sense of justice and compassion
chivalrous spirit; sense of honor and compassion for the weak
explanations: A noble character trait of standing up for the disadvantaged and acting righteously, even at personal cost.

glosses: unique; peerless; matchless; one and only
explanations: Having no equal or duplicate; something or someone so special that there is no second.

glosses: illusionism; the art of creating illusions; sleight of hand
illusion technique (in fiction); sorcery; magical deception
explanations: The technique of creating illusions, whether through stage magic, optical tricks, or supernatural means.
In anime, manga, and games, a category of supernatural abilities that manipulate the target's senses or perception.
The state of being chemically unreactive, biologically dormant, or functionally inactive.

glosses: pod; shell; hull (of beans or peas)
explanations: The outer casing of legumes such as peas, beans, and edamame that encloses the seeds.

glosses: perfect freedom; unhindered adaptability; complete flexibility
explanations: The quality of being able to adapt freely and smoothly to any situation without being constrained by rigid rules or fixed thinking.
Buildings or a compound used to house soldiers, particularly in pre-war Japan's imperial military.

glosses: objective viewpoint; viewing something objectively; seeing from a detached perspective
explanations: The act of looking at something — especially oneself or one's own situation — from an impartial, detached standpoint rather than a subjective or emotional one.
The word or phrase listed as the main entry in a dictionary, encyclopedia, or index under which definitions and information are given.
Deep, focused thought directed at a spiritual or philosophical subject, especially as a form of Buddhist or religious practice.
The transfer of heat, electricity, or other forms of energy through a material, or the transfer of a stimulus through nerves.

glosses: deep thought; careful deliberation; profound consideration
explanations: The act of thinking deeply and thoroughly about something before making a decision or forming an opinion.

glosses: chilblains; frostbite-like swelling on the hands or feet
explanations: A painful, itchy swelling on the skin caused by poor circulation in cold weather. Commonly affects fingers, toes, and ears.

glosses: breaking news; news flash; news bulletin
explanations: An urgent news report broadcast immediately when an important event occurs, interrupting regular programming or appearing as an alert.
A disposable sheet of absorbent paper used for drying hands or wiping up spills.
A soft, flavored substance that is chewed but not swallowed.
A large biting fly that feeds on the blood of mammals. Common in rural and mountainous areas of Japan during summer.

glosses: lightness; light weight; lack of heaviness
explanations: The physical quality of being light in weight, or the degree to which something is not heavy.
A quality of being easygoing, casual, or lacking seriousness. Can be positive (approachability) or negative (superficiality).
A physical document that certifies ownership of shares in a company. In modern Japan, most shares are managed electronically.
A flat piece of copper metal, used in construction, art, and crafts.
The rod or spindle that passes through the center of a wheel, allowing it to rotate. Used for vehicles, machinery, and other wheeled equipment.
The quality of being excessively reluctant to spend money or share resources. A literary and somewhat formal word with strongly negative connotations.

glosses: Buddha hall; main hall of a Zen temple
explanations: The main building in a Zen Buddhist temple complex that houses the principal Buddha image. The central hall of worship in Zen temple architecture.

glosses: wind-driven waves; wind and waves; rough seas caused by wind
explanations: Waves generated directly by the wind blowing across the surface of the sea. A term used in weather forecasts and maritime contexts.

glosses: outer fabric; shell fabric; face material
explanations: The visible outer layer of fabric in a garment or textile product, as opposed to the lining. The main fabric that forms the exterior of clothing.

glosses: lining cloth; backing fabric; lining material
explanations: Fabric used as the inner layer of a garment or textile product. Covers the inside of clothing to hide seams and provide comfort against the skin.

glosses: on the lake; over the lake
on the lake; over the lake; the lake surface
explanations: The surface of a lake or the area above it. Used to describe things happening on, over, or across a lake.

glosses: main unlucky year; principal calamity year
explanations: The central and most critical year in the yakudoshi cycle, when one is believed to be most susceptible to misfortune. The ages differ for men and women.

glosses: conferring a decoration; awarding an order
conferring a decoration; awarding an order of merit
explanations: The formal act of bestowing a government decoration or order upon a person for distinguished service or achievement.

glosses: stretching exercises; flexibility exercises; calisthenics for flexibility
explanations: Physical exercises designed to increase the body's flexibility and range of motion, typically involving bending, reaching, and holding stretched positions.
A casual, friendly farewell expression used to wrap up a conversation. A playful doubling of では (well then) that signals one is leaving or ending contact.

glosses: highest-ranking courtesan; oiran of the top rank
lead performer; master narrator or puppeteer
explanations: The most elite rank of courtesan in Edo-period pleasure quarters, distinguished by exceptional beauty, cultural refinement, and artistic accomplishments.
A title for high-ranking performers in traditional Japanese arts, especially the lead chanter in bunraku puppet theater and certain Noh performers.
The Buddha of Infinite Light and Infinite Life, the central figure of Pure Land Buddhism. Believed to welcome the faithful into the Western Paradise after death.
Short for あみだくじ, a method of random selection where participants draw from a set of vertical lines connected by random horizontal rungs.

glosses: the Taira clan; the Heishi; the Heike
explanations: One of the four great clans of ancient and medieval Japan. The Taira clan rose to political dominance in the late Heian period before being destroyed in the Genpei War.

glosses: spirit behind someone; spirit hovering behind a person
explanations: A spirit believed to be attached to or following behind a person. Can refer to a protective ancestral spirit or, in popular culture, to a ghost that haunts someone by standing behind them.
The hair that grows in the armpit area.

glosses: if anything; rather; if I had to say
explanations: Used to express a mild preference or lean toward one side when neither option is strongly favored. Softens the statement that follows, presenting it as a tentative judgment rather than a firm opinion.

A standardized application form used in Japanese job hunting. Companies require applicants to fill out an entry sheet as the first step in the hiring process, typically including self-introduction, motivation, and strengths.
A list of items to be verified, confirmed, or completed. Used in workplaces, travel preparation, daily tasks, and quality control to ensure nothing is missed.
A substance formed when two or more chemical elements are bonded together in a fixed ratio. Distinguished from mixtures, where components are not chemically bonded.
A cup with graduated markings used to measure ingredients by volume, especially in cooking and baking.
An organized group that travels to unfamiliar or remote areas for the purpose of exploration, research, or discovery.

glosses: to be influenced; to be affected
explanations: To receive or be subject to an influence, effect, or impact from something or someone. The influence can be positive, negative, or neutral.
A hair care product applied after shampooing to soften, detangle, and add moisture to the hair. Coats the surface of the hair to improve texture and manageability.
A baseball player who plays a defensive position in the infield — first base, second base, shortstop, or third base.
An arranged serving of various types of sliced raw fish presented together on a plate or platter, typically ordered at restaurants or prepared for special occasions.
Indicates that something happens many times or with notable frequency. Slightly literary or formal in tone compared to everyday alternatives.
A pre-moistened disposable cloth used for cleaning hands, surfaces, or skin. Extremely common in Japanese daily life — found in restaurants, convenience stores, and carried in bags.

glosses: one after another; popping up repeatedly
explanations: Mimics the sound or appearance of bubbles rising, liquid boiling gently, or hollow tapping sounds.
Describes things appearing, emerging, or happening in quick succession, like bubbles surfacing.
The act of officially changing the name of an organization, product, place, or system. Implies a formal, deliberate decision rather than a casual nickname change.
The designated time frame during which applications, entries, or submissions are accepted. Used for jobs, contests, enrollment, and various programs.
An advance commitment to buy a product before it is released or becomes available. Common for books, games, electronics, and limited-edition items.
The process or location where reservations and bookings are received and handled. Can refer to both the physical desk or counter and the abstract act of accepting reservations.
The systematic examination and interpretation of data to extract meaningful patterns, draw conclusions, or support decision-making.

glosses: change of course; career path change
career path change; change of future plans
explanations: Changing the physical direction of travel, such as when driving, sailing, or flying.
Changing one's planned course in life, education, or career — such as switching from a university track to vocational school, or changing intended fields of study.
The temporary closure or restriction of one or more traffic lanes, typically due to road construction, accidents, or events. A common cause of traffic congestion in Japan.

glosses: others; the rest; miscellaneous; et cetera
completion; finish; result (of work or a game)
stepping up into a house; entryway; green tea (at a sushi restaurant)
facilitator; moderator; master of ceremonies; emcee
all beasts; all animals; every kind of beast
kitchen paper towel; paper towel (for cooking)
to feel a pang in one's heart; to have one's heart flutter; to feel a tug at one's heartstrings
one sun (approx. 3.03 cm); a tiny amount; a very short distance
means of support; connection; link; something to rely on; memento; keepsake; reminder (of a person or time)
means of support; connection; link; something to rely on
memento; keepsake; reminder (of a person or time)
peak season; busy period; period of flourishing business
essential item; must-have item; indispensable thing to carry
picture card; face card (in playing cards: jack, queen, king)
illustrated card; picture tag (in traditional Japanese card games)
facial beauty; beautiful face; facial care; facial treatment
public bus; shared bus; fixed-route bus
crop rotation; rotating crops on the same field across seasons
pleasure quarter; red-light district (historical); enclosure; compound; bailey (of a castle)
working without pay; unpaid attendance at work; coming to work on a day off without compensation
powder room; women's restroom; vanity area
explanations: a restroom or vanity area, typically in department stores, hotels, or commercial facilities, designed for women to freshen up
the worst possible result on a fortune slip drawn at a shrine or temple
a room designated for private consultations, counseling, or advisory services
the foreign country or region one is traveling to or has traveled to

glosses: broad daylight; middle of the day
explanations: in the middle of the day when it is fully light out, often emphasizing that something happened openly or brazenly
a quality of warmth or friendliness in one's manner; almost always used in the negative form 素っ気ない to mean cold, curt, or unfriendly
a smaller rest facility along Japanese expressways, providing basic amenities like parking, restrooms, and vending machines
the kidney-shaped edible nut of the tropical cashew tree

glosses: female proprietor; hostess; lady of the house
explanations: a woman who owns or runs an establishment such as a shop, inn, or restaurant, or the female head of a household
a device that disperses liquid as a fine mist or spray
the competitive sport of racing sailboats, especially as an Olympic event
a motorboat or large sailboat equipped with a cabin, used for leisure cruising
a stiff bracelet that slips over the hand, without a clasp or opening
a medium-sized towel, typically about 34×80 cm, used for drying the face and hands
the first child born in a family, regardless of sex
the act of shaving one's head, especially as part of entering the Buddhist priesthood or as a sign of repentance
a spring-blooming wildflower native to Japan with distinctive purple-pink drooping petals
a fine starch used as a thickening agent in cooking, originally made from the katakuri plant but now typically made from potatoes
a general term for tiny flying insects such as gnats, midges, or small flies
a private room available for short-term rental, used for meetings, parties, study sessions, or other purposes
a scholar who studies and practices Confucian philosophy, especially in the context of pre-modern East Asian intellectual history
chewing gum specifically designed for blowing bubbles, softer and more elastic than regular gum

glosses: secret photography; candid shot; taking photos without permission
explanations: the act of photographing or filming someone without their knowledge or consent
any dishonest, illegal, or unethical action, especially in professional, academic, or institutional settings
the obligation or accountability imposed by law, including both civil and criminal responsibility

glosses: irregular working hours; non-standard work schedule
explanations: a work schedule that deviates from the standard daytime hours, including shift work, rotating schedules, and split shifts

glosses: covered in sand; sandy all over
explanations: the state of being thoroughly coated or smeared with sand
the capital city of France, a major cultural, economic, and political center of Europe
a person from France or of French nationality
a vehicle or wheeled device used to move goods, materials, or equipment from one place to another
a pen or marker that uses water-soluble ink, as opposed to oil-based or permanent markers
fish kept for decorative or hobby purposes rather than for food, including tropical fish, goldfish, and koi
small pieces of paper with a re-adherable adhesive strip on the back, used for marking pages, leaving messages, or organizing information
the dried seed of the common bean plant, used in various dishes including soups, stews, and sweets
the immature pod of the same plant, eaten as a green vegetable, also called さやいんげん

glosses: toddler food; food for young children
explanations: meals and food products designed for children roughly ages 1 to 5, transitioning from baby food to regular adult meals

glosses: favoritism toward one's own; partiality to one's own side
favoritism toward one's own; partiality to one's own side; self-serving bias
explanations: the tendency to unfairly favor people on one's own side, such as family members, colleagues, or one's own group

glosses: natural face; bare face without makeup
explanations: one's face without any makeup, cosmetic enhancements, or filters applied
a celestial buddha in Mahayana Buddhism, central to Pure Land Buddhism, who vows to save all beings who call upon his name

glosses: illegally parking and abandoning a vehicle; abandoned parking
explanations: a vehicle left parked in a prohibited area with the driver absent, a traffic violation in Japan
a shop or business that acts as an intermediary between a manufacturer or service provider and the end customer
a plant grown primarily for its beauty rather than for food, timber, or other practical uses
feelings that steadily grow stronger over time, often used for love, longing, frustration, or grief
a person who writes computer code, especially one who focuses on implementation rather than design or architecture

glosses: drunk driving; driving under the influence
explanations: the act of operating a vehicle while impaired by alcohol, a serious criminal offense in Japan
the quality, texture, weight, and characteristics of paper

glosses: mischievous boy; little rascal; naughty kid
explanations: an energetic and mischievous young boy, used affectionately to describe boisterous or naughty children

glosses: mischievous child; little imp; prankster kid
explanations: a child who is playfully naughty or fond of playing tricks, used affectionately regardless of gender
a component kept in reserve to replace a broken or worn-out part in a machine, vehicle, or device

glosses: on impulse; on a whim; in a moment of weakness
explanations: acting on a sudden urge without premeditation, often used to explain or excuse bad behavior such as petty theft or cheating

glosses: to disturb public morals; to corrupt discipline
to disturb public morals; to corrupt discipline; to undermine standards of conduct
explanations: to behave in a way that violates or undermines the accepted moral standards, rules, or decorum of a group, institution, or society
the physical act of catching one's foot on something and losing balance
a figurative obstacle or mistake that disrupts progress in a plan, career, or relationship

glosses: front side; outer surface; right side (of fabric)
explanations: the side of an object meant to face outward or be seen, as opposed to the back or hidden side

glosses: guide; escort; person who shows the way
explanations: a person who leads or accompanies others to show them around a place, explain sights, or direct them to their destination
any beverage sold in a metal can, including soft drinks, coffee, tea, beer, and juice
the first year of something such as an era, a policy, a system, or a person's time in a position

glosses: station passed without stopping; non-stop station
explanations: a train station that a particular service (typically express or limited express) passes through without making a stop

glosses: hitting against a wall; solo practice
hitting against a wall; wall practice
talking to oneself; brainstorming alone; bouncing ideas off a wall
explanations: practicing a ball sport by hitting or throwing a ball against a wall, typically done alone as training
figuratively, the act of working through ideas or problems without a real conversation partner, as if hitting a ball against a wall
the amount or proportion of oil or fat contained in food, skin, hair, or other substances

glosses: person concerned; eligible person; applicable person
explanations: a person who meets certain conditions, criteria, or qualifications and is therefore subject to a rule, benefit, or requirement
a person who actively supports, defends, or champions a cause, idea, person, or right
a collective term for animals that live in water, including fish, shellfish, marine mammals, and other aquatic creatures
a line running from top to bottom, used in drawing, design, writing, charts, and everyday descriptions
an administrative unit within a Japanese university's graduate school, roughly equivalent to a graduate department or faculty in Western universities
a person whose income falls below a certain threshold, often used in policy discussions about welfare, taxation, and social support

glosses: mitigation measure; easing measure; relief measure
explanations: a policy, action, or plan designed to reduce the severity of a problem, ease restrictions, or relieve pressure on a situation
a government formed by two or more political parties working together, typically when no single party has enough seats to govern alone

glosses: influential person; local boss; prominent figure
explanations: a person who holds power or influence in a community, organization, or industry, often through personal connections rather than official position

glosses: dosage; dose; amount to be taken
explanations: the specified amount of medicine to be taken at one time or over a period, as directed by a doctor or indicated on medication packaging
woven fabric made from cotton fibers, used for clothing, towels, and various household textiles

glosses: weaver woman; woman who weaves cloth
explanations: a figure from the Tanabata legend who represents the star Vega, separated from her lover Hikoboshi (Altair) by the Milky Way and allowed to meet him only once a year on the seventh of July
a woman whose occupation is weaving fabric on a loom

glosses: win by ippon; decisive victory (in martial arts)
explanations: a victory achieved by scoring a full point (ippon) in martial arts such as judo or kendo, awarded for a clean, decisive technique
a systematic set of rules or conventions for assigning names, used in science, computing, business, and other fields that require consistent naming

glosses: dejectedly; droopingly; in a wilted manner
explanations: describes the manner of someone or something looking wilted, dejected, or dispirited, like a plant that has lost its freshness or a person who has lost their energy

glosses: crossing a major milestone; reaching a round number
explanations: surpassing a significant round-number threshold, typically used for stock prices, sales figures, ages, or other numerical milestones
a stick or rod used by a wizard, witch, or fairy to cast spells, common in fairy tales, fantasy stories, and figurative expressions
The period of mourning observed after a death, during which one refrains from celebrations and social activities.
The total count of votes cast in an election, poll, or vote.

glosses: horse riding; mounting a horse; being mounted
explanations: The act of riding on horseback, or the state of being mounted on a horse.
Damage caused to oneself or one's own property, without involvement of another party. Most commonly used in traffic and insurance contexts.
The quality of being patient and able to endure hardship, discomfort, or difficulty without giving up.
The quality of being based on personal feelings, opinions, or interpretations rather than on objective facts.

glosses: date a ban is lifted; opening day
date a ban is lifted; opening day; release date
explanations: The designated date on which a prohibition or restriction is officially removed, allowing a previously restricted activity to begin.
The act or posture of raising oneself up on the tips of the toes, either to reach something high or to walk quietly.

glosses: thing of the past; forgotten record

explanations: To take in a substance, energy, or impact, as a physical or chemical process.

glosses: banquet hall; party venue; function room
explanations: A room or hall specifically designed or designated for hosting banquets, parties, and other gatherings.
A person who appears regularly on television, often across variety shows, talk shows, and commercials, without necessarily being an actor, singer, or comedian by profession.

glosses: upstream; upper reaches of a river
upstream (in a supply chain or process)
explanations: The part of a river closer to its source, or the direction from which the water flows.
The earlier stages of a production or supply chain, closer to raw materials or initial creation.

glosses: to devote oneself to; to concentrate on; to dedicate oneself to
explanations: To focus all of one's effort and attention on a single task, activity, or goal, setting aside other concerns.

glosses: to cooperate; to collaborate; to work together
explanations: To join efforts with others to accomplish a shared goal or to assist someone in their endeavor.

glosses: to trust; to believe in; to have confidence in
explanations: To place trust in someone's character, reliability, or truthfulness based on past experience or reputation.

glosses: to reduce; to alleviate; to lighten
explanations: To make a burden, pain, tax, or negative condition less severe or heavy.

glosses: to apply; to put to practical use; to adapt
explanations: To take knowledge, theory, or techniques and use them in a new, practical context.

glosses: to protect; to preserve; to shelter
to protect; to preserve; to safeguard
to take into custody; to shelter; to give refuge
explanations: To keep something or someone safe from harm, danger, or deterioration through active measures.
To take a person or animal into protective care, especially by authorities.

glosses: to be on guard; to be vigilant; to watch out for
explanations: To remain cautious and alert against potential danger, threats, or problems.

glosses: to circulate; to cycle; to go around
explanations: To move in a continuous loop or circuit, or to pass through a recurring sequence and return to the starting point.

glosses: to emit; to discharge; to expel
explanations: To release or push out substances such as gases, waste, or pollutants from a system, body, or process.

glosses: to create; to draw up; to prepare (a document)
to create; to draw up; to prepare (a document, plan, or data)
explanations: To produce a document, plan, report, or other structured work product, typically in a professional or official context.

glosses: to debate; to discuss; to argue
to debate; to discuss formally; to argue a point
explanations: To engage in a structured exchange of differing opinions on a topic, typically with the aim of reaching a conclusion or persuading others.

glosses: to claim; to assert; to insist
to claim; to assert; to insist; to argue
explanations: To state one's opinion, position, or rights firmly and clearly, often in the face of opposition or doubt.

glosses: to reconstruct; to revive; to restore
explanations: To rebuild or revitalize something that has been damaged, destroyed, or diminished, especially in the context of disaster recovery, economic revitalization, or cultural revival.

glosses: to leave as is; to neglect; to leave unattended
explanations: To leave something or someone alone without taking action, often implying negligence or deliberate inaction. Can refer to physical objects left unattended or problems left unaddressed.

glosses: to transform; to change form; to disguise oneself
explanations: To undergo a dramatic change in appearance, form, or character. Often used for supernatural or fictional transformations, as well as striking real-life makeovers.

glosses: to dress up in costume; to masquerade
explanations: To wear a costume or disguise, especially for fun, festivals, or events. Commonly associated with Halloween, costume parties, and parade floats.

glosses: to rebel; to resist; to defy
explanations: To actively oppose or resist authority, rules, or someone in a position of power. Often describes adolescent rebelliousness or resistance to oppressive systems.

glosses: to sit in seiza; to sit formally on one's knees
explanations: To sit in the traditional Japanese kneeling position with legs folded underneath, back straight, and hands resting on the thighs. The formal sitting posture used in tea ceremony, martial arts, and formal occasions.

glosses: to be crowded; to be congested
explanations: To be packed with people or traffic, making movement difficult. Describes the state of a place, road, or transit system being uncomfortably full.

glosses: to record (audio); to make a recording
explanations: To capture sound onto a medium for later playback. Applies to recording music, voice, conversations, or any audio.

glosses: to be careless; to let one's guard down; to be off guard
to be careless; to let one's guard down
explanations: To become inattentive or complacent, lowering one's vigilance and leaving oneself vulnerable to mistakes or danger.

glosses: to look squarely at; to face directly; to confront
to look directly at; to stare straight at
to face squarely; to confront (a reality or problem)
explanations: To look at something or someone directly without averting one's eyes.
To honestly acknowledge and face an uncomfortable truth, problem, or situation without avoidance.

glosses: to undergo training; to practice asceticism; to train (in a discipline)
to undergo training; to practice asceticism
explanations: To engage in rigorous, disciplined training, originally in a religious or spiritual context (Buddhist or Shinto practice), now also used broadly for mastering a craft, martial art, or profession through dedicated practice.

glosses: to banish; to exile; to expel
explanations: To force someone to leave a place, group, or country, typically as a punishment or for political reasons. Also used for eliminating undesirable things from society.

glosses: to demote; to downgrade; to relegate
explanations: To lower someone or something in rank, status, or grade. Used in workplace hierarchies, sports leagues, and classification systems.

glosses: to sleep soundly; to sleep deeply
explanations: To fall into a deep, uninterrupted, restful sleep. Implies high quality of sleep with no disturbances.

glosses: to return; to come back; to be reinstated
explanations: To return to a previous position, role, or state after a period of absence. Commonly used for returning to work after leave, an athlete coming back from injury, or territory being returned to a nation.

glosses: to exterminate; to slay; to get rid of
explanations: To defeat and eliminate monsters, pests, villains, or other undesirable things. Used both in folklore and legends (slaying demons) and in everyday life (getting rid of pests).

glosses: to write; to author; to pen
explanations: To write literary works, articles, or other texts as an author. Implies serious, professional, or scholarly writing rather than casual everyday writing.

glosses: to intervene; to step in; to meddle
explanations: To become involved in a situation, dispute, or process, especially one that does not directly concern oneself. Often used in political, military, or economic contexts, but also in personal relationships.

glosses: to cut; to reduce; to curtail
explanations: To reduce the amount, scale, or extent of something, especially budgets, costs, personnel, or emissions. A formal word commonly used in business, government, and policy contexts.

glosses: to transfer schools; to change schools
explanations: To leave one school and enroll at another, typically due to the family moving to a new area.

glosses: to leave school; to go home from school
explanations: To leave the school grounds to go home at the end of the school day or during an early dismissal. Used specifically for students departing school.

glosses: to stare at; to gaze intently at; to fix one's eyes on
explanations: To look at something or someone with sustained, focused attention, often with concentration, suspicion, or intensity.
Indicates that something is acceptable or poses no obstacle. A polite and formal way of expressing permission or that something will not cause difficulty.
A secondary earthquake tremor that follows the main quake, swinging the ground back.
A return swing or counter-reaction following a major change or trend. Used figuratively for social, political, or economic reversals.

glosses: to be hostile toward; to oppose; to antagonize
explanations: To regard or treat someone as an enemy and act in opposition to them. Describes a relationship of mutual hostility or active opposition between parties.

glosses: to make light of; to belittle; to underestimate
explanations: To treat something as unimportant or less significant than it actually is. To give inadequate attention or respect to something that deserves more.

glosses: to implore; to entreat; to plead earnestly
explanations: To earnestly and desperately beg someone for something, often with deep emotion or humility. A stronger and more desperate form of asking than ordinary requests.

glosses: to participate; to take part in
to participate; to take part in; to join
explanations: To become involved in an activity, event, or group by actively taking part.

glosses: to join a company; to enter a firm
explanations: To begin employment at a company, typically as a full-time hire.

glosses: to be indebted to; to be taken care of by
to be indebted to; to receive someone's help or care
to be in someone's care; to be looked after
explanations: A polite expression acknowledging that one has received help, guidance, or support from someone. Used widely in business and social contexts.
Used when one is being cared for or supervised, such as by a doctor, teacher, or host.
A room or facility equipped for conducting scientific experiments and research.

glosses: judgment criteria; standard of judgment; basis for deciding
explanations: The standards or criteria used to make a decision or form a judgment about something.
The state of not having enough experience, especially for a task or role.

glosses: place of lodging; accommodation; where one is staying
explanations: The location where someone stays overnight, such as a hotel, inn, or friend's house.
A physically large ocean or sea wave.
A powerful force or trend that sweeps through, used metaphorically for social, economic, or emotional upheaval.
An organized group that meets regularly to study or research a particular subject.
A meeting or conference held for the purpose of academic or professional study and discussion.

glosses: broad outline; general framework; rough sketch
explanations: The overall structure or main points of a plan, idea, or agreement, without detailed specifics.

glosses: to accept a loss silently; to give up without protest
to accept a loss silently; to give up without protest; to swallow one's grievance
explanations: To resign oneself to an unfair situation without taking action or complaining, usually because one feels powerless to change it.
The language spoken in South Korea. This is the standard term used in Japan when referring to the Korean language in the context of South Korea.
A sitting position with legs crossed in front of the body, typically on the floor. This is a casual sitting posture in Japanese culture.
Behavior that causes worry, shame, or grief to one's parents; being a bad son or daughter.
A person who causes their parents distress or fails to show proper respect and care.
A formal gathering where participants discuss or debate a topic, often with structured rules or an audience.
The act or manner of outwardly expressing one's feelings, whether through words, facial expressions, gestures, or artistic means.
A self-propelled vehicle that provides the motive power for pulling or pushing a train along railway tracks.
The physical sensation or quality of being cold to the touch.
An unfriendly, distant, or emotionally cold attitude or manner.
A person who performs music, especially someone who plays a musical instrument.
The difference between two values, versions, or states. Commonly used in technical, mathematical, and computing contexts.

glosses: to devote oneself; to dedicate oneself
to devote oneself; to dedicate oneself (to a cause or pursuit)
to sacrifice oneself; to give one's life
explanations: To commit one's entire being to a purpose, cause, or activity, often at the expense of personal comfort or desires.
To give up one's life or safety for a cause, person, or ideal.

glosses: within range; within scope; within limits
explanations: Inside the boundaries or limits of a specified area, quantity, or set of conditions.

glosses: unchanged; as always; as before; without change
explanations: Remaining the same as before; continuing in the same state without alteration. Often used to express that something persists over time.

glosses: any more (than this); any further; beyond this
any more (than this); any further; beyond this point
explanations: Refers to exceeding the current state or level. Most commonly used in negative sentences to mean 'not any more than this' or with ない to express that something cannot continue further.
With little effort or trouble. Often used in negative sentences to imply that something is not as easy as it might seem.

glosses: family love; love for one's family
family love; love for one's family; familial love
explanations: The affection and bond shared among family members.

glosses: on'yomi and kun'yomi; Chinese and Japanese readings
on'yomi and kun'yomi; Chinese and Japanese kanji readings
explanations: The two types of readings for kanji characters: the on'yomi (Sino-Japanese reading derived from Chinese pronunciation) and the kun'yomi (native Japanese reading).

glosses: social participation; participation in society; social engagement
explanations: The act of actively engaging in society through work, volunteering, community activities, or other forms of public involvement.

glosses: rhythmical; rhythmic; having a regular beat
explanations: Having a pleasing, regular pattern of movement or sound; characterized by rhythm.

glosses: not a big deal; nothing special; not serious
not a big deal; nothing special; nothing significant
explanations: Used to downplay the importance, severity, or impressiveness of something.

glosses: another person's hands; someone else's possession
explanations: The number of workers or amount of labor available for a task or organization.
Hands belonging to someone else, or the state of something passing into another person's possession.

glosses: way of working; work style; how one works
explanations: The manner, style, or approach a person or organization takes toward work.
A period of leave from work granted to employees for the purpose of raising a child, legally guaranteed in Japan.
A type of recurring headache characterized by intense, throbbing pain, usually on one side of the head.
A person who purchases something, especially in a commercial or formal context.
A person or entity that produces goods, especially agricultural products or manufactured items.

glosses: additional cost; extra charge; supplementary expense
explanations: A cost that is added on top of the base price or original budget.

glosses: prevention method; preventive measure; way to prevent
explanations: A method or approach for preventing disease, accidents, problems, or other undesirable outcomes.

glosses: late-night bus; overnight bus; night bus
explanations: A bus that operates during late-night hours, including long-distance overnight buses that travel between cities while passengers sleep.

glosses: to complain; to grumble; to gripe
explanations: To express dissatisfaction or complaints, especially about things one cannot change, often to someone who will listen sympathetically.
The alarm clock feature that temporarily silences the alarm and rings again after a few minutes, or the act of using this feature.
The dominant or most influential group within a political party, organization, academic field, or movement.
The branch of physics that deals with the motion of objects and the forces acting on them.
Used figuratively to describe the interplay of forces or power relationships in social, political, or organizational contexts.

glosses: pen name; pseudonym; nom de plume
explanations: A fictitious name used by a writer instead of their real name.
A fictitious name adopted by a writer, borrowed from the English term 'pen name.'
Actions taken in response to hostile or harmful actions by another party, especially between nations or organizations.
The unauthorized use of copyrighted material in a way that violates the rights of the copyright holder.
A restaurant that serves traditional Japanese cuisine.

glosses: monetary gift envelope; gift envelope for money
explanations: A decorative envelope used to present monetary gifts on ceremonial occasions such as weddings, funerals, and celebrations.
Having a vision-correcting prescription, used to describe glasses or lenses that correct eyesight rather than being plain or decorative.

glosses: to complain; to express dissatisfaction; to grumble
explanations: To voice one's displeasure or discontent about a situation, treatment, or condition.
The branch of science concerned with the structure of the bodies of humans, animals, and other organisms.
The scientific study of crime, its causes, consequences, and prevention.
The quality of being sticky or adhering to surfaces, or the tendency to cling.
A group of people organized and sent to explore, research, or accomplish a specific mission in a distant or challenging location.
A military force dispatched to fight in a foreign territory.
Material used for constructing or covering floors, such as wood, tile, vinyl, or carpet.
An individual board or plank used to construct a wooden floor.
The branch of physics dealing with the relationship between electricity and magnetism, or the phenomena themselves.
The place where one was born or grew up; one's home region, carrying strong emotional and nostalgic connotations.
A place that feels like home or is the origin of something, used figuratively.

glosses: in the blink of an eye; in no time; before you know it
explanations: Describes something happening so quickly that it feels almost instantaneous. Expresses surprise at how fast time passed or how quickly an event occurred.

glosses: complexion; facial color; expression; look on one's face
expression; look on one's face; someone's mood or attitude
explanations: The color or condition of someone's face, typically used to assess health or physical state.
The look on someone's face that reveals their feelings, mood, or approval. Often used in the phrase {顔色|かおいろ}をうかがう (to read someone's expression / to try to gauge someone's mood).
A nap taken during the day, typically in the afternoon. The お prefix adds politeness or softness, and the word is especially associated with children's naptime.

glosses: photogenic quality; looking good (especially on social media); visual appeal
photogenic quality; visual appeal; looking good on social media
explanations: The quality of looking attractive or eye-catching, especially in photos posted to social media. Derived from the verb {映|は}える (to look attractive). Became widespread as a buzzword associated with Instagram culture.
A baby or young pig. Used both in farming contexts and in stories, fairy tales, and as a term of endearment.
The taste of salt, or a seasoning style based primarily on salt rather than soy sauce, miso, or other flavorings.

glosses: sky blue; azure; light blue like the sky
explanations: A light, clear blue color resembling the sky on a sunny day. One of the traditional Japanese color names.
Causing no harm, injury, or damage. Used for substances, animals, actions, or people that pose no danger.

glosses: to tempt; to seduce; to lure
to tempt; to lure; to entice
explanations: To attract or entice someone toward something, often something they should resist. The temptation may involve food, money, pleasure, or other desires.
To attract someone romantically or sexually, often with the implication of leading them away from proper behavior.
To marry again after a previous marriage has ended through divorce or the death of a spouse.
A large balloon that rises into the air by being filled with hot air or a lighter-than-air gas. Used for recreational flights, observation, and scientific research.

glosses: dwelling; abode; home; place where one lives
explanations: A place where a person lives. Often carries a literary or slightly humble nuance compared to more neutral words like {家|いえ}.
The natural living place of an animal or creature.
Physical attractiveness, especially of the face. Traditionally used more often for women's looks.
The ability or capacity to handle important tasks or leadership. Refers to someone's overall competence and character.

glosses: secret plan; secret strategy; trump card
secret plan; secret strategy; hidden trump card
explanations: A plan or strategy kept hidden until the right moment. Implies a clever or decisive measure that others do not expect.
A formal term for physical objects or merchandise. Used in administrative, legal, and business contexts.
The beating of the heart, or the rate at which the heart beats. Used in medical, fitness, and everyday contexts.
The act of calculating or determining a value, amount, or rate, typically in formal, administrative, or financial contexts.

glosses: main part; main story; this volume
main part; main story; main feature
explanations: The primary or main portion of a work, as opposed to supplementary material such as spin-offs, sequels, bonus content, or behind-the-scenes footage.
A reference to the current book, document, or work being discussed.
A meeting held in secret, often implying a romantic affair or a covert political/business meeting that the parties want to keep hidden.
Grass grown or gathered for feeding livestock such as cattle, horses, and sheep. Includes both fresh pasture grass and dried hay.

glosses: leaving one's seat; being away from one's desk
leaving one's seat; being away from one's desk; stepping away
explanations: The act of temporarily leaving one's seat or desk, especially in a workplace, meeting, or formal setting.
The geological process of land rising or being pushed upward, or the resulting elevated landform.
A raised area on a surface, including on the body. Used in medical and general descriptive contexts.
The attitude or philosophy of prioritizing one's own interests and benefit above those of others. Used both as a philosophical term and in everyday criticism of selfish behavior.

glosses: parent bird; adult bird; old hen (in cooking)
explanations: A bird that has offspring, or an adult bird as opposed to a chick. Used when discussing bird behavior, especially nesting and feeding.
In cooking, a fully grown, older chicken as opposed to a young one ({若鶏|わかどり}). The meat is tougher but more flavorful.

glosses: gastritis; inflammation of the stomach lining
explanations: A medical condition in which the lining of the stomach becomes inflamed, causing symptoms such as stomach pain, nausea, and discomfort.

glosses: secretion; the process of secreting substances from cells or glands
explanations: The biological process by which cells or glands produce and release substances such as hormones, enzymes, sweat, or saliva.
A long-handled cup or spoon used for scooping and pouring water or other liquids. Found at Shinto shrines and Buddhist temples for ritual hand-washing, and used in traditional Japanese settings.
A white powder obtained by heating limestone, used in construction, agriculture, and industry. Also refers to lime-based substances in general.

glosses: instant; moment; blink of an eye
explanations: The act of briefly closing and opening the eyes.
The flickering or sparkling of stars, lights, or other luminous objects.
A very brief period of time, used figuratively to describe how quickly something happened.

glosses: to win a championship; to take first place
explanations: To achieve victory in a competition, tournament, or contest, placing first overall.

glosses: to be established; to come into existence; to be concluded
to be established; to come into existence
to be concluded; to be finalized
explanations: For a system, organization, law, or concept to be formally created or put into effect.
For a deal, contract, agreement, or transaction to be successfully completed.

glosses: to execute; to carry out; to enforce
to enforce; to execute (a legal judgment)
explanations: To implement or put into effect a plan, decision, duty, or order.
To carry out a court ruling, sentence, or legal order, including capital punishment.

glosses: to dismiss; to remove from office
to dismiss; to remove from office; to relieve of duties
explanations: To officially remove someone from a position of responsibility, typically a managerial, executive, or public role.

glosses: to prophesy; to predict; to foretell
explanations: To declare that something will happen in the future, whether based on supernatural insight, intuition, or conviction.

glosses: to jot down; to take notes; to make a memo
